papers.title: Evaluating VLMs for Autonomous Agent-Driven Geometry Clipping Detection in Video Game QA
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we study the use of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for anomaly detection in an agent-driven game Quality Assurance (QA) pipeline focusing on geometry clipping. In this evaluation, a custom exploration agent navigates a game level to collect visual observations, while the automatic annotation pipeline provides frame-level clipping labels. This setup allows us to evaluate recent VLMs on a controlled anomaly detection task without manual annotation. We benchmark six recent VLMs (Gemini, GPT, Qwen, Gemma, Llama, and Ministral) under a zero-shot prompting setting and analyse their sensitivity to four prompt variants. Our results show that while the VLMs can capture visual cues associated with geometry clipping, they all produce substantial false positives on visually ambiguous frames such as near-contact geometry and partial occlusions. Gemini-3.1-Flash achieves the best overall accuracy and is the most robust to prompt variation, while open-source models exhibit large precision--recall swings depending on the prompt design. These findings suggest that current VLMs are best suited as high-recall candidate filters within multi-stage QA pipelines rather than as standalone bug detectors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文评估了六种视觉语言模型（VLM）在游戏质量保证（QA）中检测几何裁剪（geometry clipping）异常的能力，使用自主探索agent收集数据并在零样本提示下测试。结果表明，最佳模型Gemini-3.1-Flash在准确性和对提示变化的鲁棒性上表现最好，但所有模型在模糊帧上产生大量假阳性，因此VLM更适合作为高召回候选过滤器而非独立检测器。
Motivation: 游戏QA中的几何裁剪检测通常依赖手动标注，需要自动化方法提高效率。论文研究了VLM在该任务中的可行性和局限性。
Method: 使用定制探索agent在游戏关卡中导航收集视觉观测，自动标注管线提供帧级裁剪标签。在零样本提示下测试了六个VLM（Gemini、GPT、Qwen、Gemma、Llama、Ministral），并分析四种提示变体的敏感性。
Result: VLM能捕捉几何裁剪的视觉线索，但在近接触几何和部分遮挡等模糊帧上产生大量假阳性。Gemini-3.1-Flash在准确性和对提示变化的鲁棒性上最佳，但开源模型（如LLaMA）的精度和召回随提示设计大幅波动。
Conclusion: 当前VLM更适合作为多阶段QA管线中的高召回候选过滤器，而非独立bug检测器。

papers.title: Penelope: Localized Latent Recurrence for Efficient Structured Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Complex structured reasoning tasks often require additional computation, yet current language models obtain it mainly by increasing parameter scale or by serializing intermediate steps as chain-of-thought (CoT) tokens. The former raises training and deployment costs, while the latter ties reasoning computation to autoregressive output length. We introduce Penelope, an efficient latent-reasoning framework for pretrained decoder-only Transformers that localizes recurrent computation to a selected decoder interval. The lower decoder prefix is evaluated once to construct a problem-conditioned boundary memory, which is then iteratively refined through time-modulated GRU dynamics and recurrent readout states before answer generation. A progressive CoT-to-latent curriculum transfers visible reasoning into this internal recurrent path, allowing additional computation to be allocated in latent space without repeatedly executing the complete decoder or generating a long intermediate trace. Experiments on open-source structured-reasoning benchmarks show that, at validation-selected latent budgets, Penelope attains competitive accuracy relative to established latent-reasoning models while reducing measured inference latency. These results show that latent refinement can be localized to a narrow decoder interval, reducing repeated full-decoder execution without generating a long visible reasoning trace and providing a practical accuracy-efficiency tradeoff for decoder-only Transformer models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Penelope 是一个针对预训练 decoder-only Transformer 的高效潜在推理框架，将循环计算局部化到选定的 decoder 区间。它通过一次性计算下层 decoder 前缀构建问题条件边界记忆，然后使用时变 GRU 动态和循环读出状态进行迭代细化，再生成答案。采用渐进式 CoT-to-latent 课程将可见推理转移到内部循环路径。实验表明，在结构化推理基准上，Penelope 在验证选择的潜在预算下达到与已有潜在推理模型相当的准确率，同时降低推理延迟，实现了准确率与效率的实用权衡。
Motivation: 当前语言模型主要通过增大参数规模或使用链式思维 (CoT) 增加推理计算，前者提高训练和部署成本，后者将推理计算与自回归输出长度绑定。本文旨在实现高效的潜在推理，避免重复执行完整 decoder 或生成长中间推理迹。
Method: Penelope 将循环计算局部化到 decoder 的一个选定区间。下层 decoder 前缀只计算一次，构造问题条件边界记忆；随后通过时间调制的 GRU 动态和循环读出状态对该记忆进行迭代细化，最后生成答案。采用渐进式课程学习将可见推理转移到该内部循环路径。
Result: 在开源结构化推理基准上，在验证集选择的潜在计算预算下，Penelope 达到了与已有潜在推理模型（如 CoT 或 latent reasoning 基线）相当的准确率，同时显著降低了测量推理延迟。
Conclusion: 潜在细化可以局部化到窄 decoder 区间，无需重复执行完整 decoder 或生成长可见推理迹，从而为 decoder-only Transformer 提供了一种实用的准确率-效率权衡方案。

papers.title: Toward Standardized Cross-Vendor Agent Tool Trust Management in Autonomous Networks
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous Network Levels 4-5 require AI agents to invoke tools across vendor boundaries without human oversight, yet existing management standards lack a standardized mechanism for cross-vendor trust visibility. When a tool from Vendor B is compromised, agents from Vendor A continue invoking it -- unaware of the trust degradation -- causing cascading service impact. We present AgentToolMO, a proposed 3GPP NRM information model for agent tool trust management. The model comprises: a formally defined trust state machine with provable graduated enforcement, damped cascade propagation with bounded convergence, cross-vendor trust notifications via existing Management Services (MnS) interfaces, and retroactive impact assessment through NRM dependency graph traversal. Simulation-based evaluation across multi-vendor topologies shows that standardized cross-vendor notifications reduce blast radius from hours-scale undetected propagation to near-real-time containment bounded by MnS notification delivery, with cascade convergence guaranteed in bounded iterations and sub-linear notification scaling across vendor domains. The framework operates within existing 3GPP management infrastructure, leverages existing protocols, and provides a standardization pathway for trustworthy multi-vendor autonomous network management.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AgentToolMO，一种基于3GPP NRM的信息模型，用于自主网络中跨供应商代理工具信任管理。模型包含形式化的信任状态机、阻尼级联传播、跨供应商通知及追溯影响评估。仿真显示标准化通知能将影响半径从小时级缩小到近实时，且级联收敛有界。
Motivation: 现有管理标准缺乏跨供应商信任可视性，当某供应商工具被攻破时，其他供应商的代理仍会继续调用，导致级联服务影响。
Method: 提出AgentToolMO模型，包括形式化定义的信任状态机（带可证明的逐步强制执行）、阻尼级联传播（有界收敛）、通过现有管理服务（MnS）接口的跨供应商信任通知，以及基于NRM依赖图遍历的追溯影响评估。
Result: 跨多供应商拓扑的仿真评估表明，标准化跨供应商通知将爆炸半径从小时级未检测传播缩小到近实时控制（受限于MnS通知传递），级联收敛在有限迭代内保证，通知缩放为次线性。
Conclusion: 框架在现有3GPP管理基础设施内运行，利用现有协议，为可信多供应商自主网络管理提供标准化路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SAM3D-Guided Object-Centric Representation Alignment for Vision-Language-Action Models
authors: Jiayu Chen (1 and 5) ((1) University of Hong Kong
(3) Huazhong University of Science and Technology
(4) Beijing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong potential for general robot manipulation, but most existing models rely on 2D visual-language backbones and lack fine-grained 3D understanding of target objects, especially under occlusion, pose variation, scale changes, and precise spatial interaction. We propose an object-centric 3D representation alignment framework built upon $π_0$, using SAM3D as a frozen 3D teacher to provide target-object 3D priors during training. Specifically, we localize task-relevant objects with object recognition models, generate corresponding object masks, and use SAM3D to extract dense object-level 3D representations, which are aligned with intermediate visual features of $π_0$. This enables the policy to internalize target-object 3D information while preserving the original RGB-language-to-action inference pipeline without requiring depth, point clouds, masks, SAM3D, or additional 3D modules at test time. Simulation experiments show consistent improvements, achieving 99.1\% on LIBERO and an average length of 4.11 on CALVIN. Real-world experiments further demonstrate that our method is particularly effective in long-horizon manipulation scenarios where the robot must focus on different target objects across multiple subtasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于SAM3D的物体中心3D表示对齐框架，用于增强视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的3D物体理解能力。该方法在训练时利用冻结的SAM3D提取目标物体的3D先验，并与π0的中间视觉特征对齐，测试时无需深度图、点云或额外3D模块。模拟实验在LIBERO上达到99.1%成功率，在CALVIN上任务平均长度为4.11，真实实验在长时程操作中表现出色。
Motivation: 现有VLA模型大多基于2D视觉-语言骨干，缺乏细粒度3D物体理解，尤其难以处理遮挡、姿态变化、尺度变化和精确空间交互。
Method: 基于π0，使用物体识别模型定位任务相关物体并生成掩码，再用冻结的SAM3D提取密集物体级3D表示，与π0的中间视觉特征进行对齐，使策略内化目标物体的3D信息，同时保持原始RGB-语言到动作的推理流程。
Result: 模拟实验在LIBERO上成功率为99.1%，在CALVIN上任务平均长度为4.11；真实实验证明该方法在需要跨多个子任务关注不同目标物体的长时程操作场景中尤其有效。
Conclusion: 该方法通过训练时对齐3D教师表示，使VLA模型获得3D感知能力，且测试时不引入额外输入或模块，提升了操作鲁棒性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AnnoBench: A Benchmark for Visualization Annotation Generation
papers.abstract_en: Annotation is among the most demanding visualization tasks to automate, as it simultaneously requires correctly navigating visual, semantic, and stylistic constraints. Failure to meet any of these conditions severely undermines the utility of an annotation, rendering it challenging to read, inaccurate, or visually discordant. Despite a growing body of annotation tools and automations, no existing benchmark or evaluation framework tests whether these conditions are met because of their scope and annotation not being the focus of their studies. We introduce AnnoBench, a benchmark for visualization annotation that materializes the inherent challenges of this domain in a structured and testable manner. AnnoBench pairs visualizations from professional data journalism and visualization galleries with annotation tasks, spanning four representation formats, five chart description conditions, and two prompt specification levels. The benchmark is executed via VLM-as-a-judge, using models aligned with manual human assessment. We evaluate the benchmark via four one-factor-at-a-time experiments, exploring the effects of input representation, semantic context, and prompt specificity, and model selection on annotation quality. This work provides a foundation for advancing annotation automation, tooling, and visualization-generation pipelines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AnnoBench是一个用于可视化注释生成的基准测试，包含来自专业数据新闻和可视化画廊的可视化与注释任务，涵盖四种表示格式、五种图表描述条件和两种提示规格级别，采用VLM-as-a-judge进行评估。通过四个单因素实验探讨输入表示、语义上下文、提示特异性和模型选择对注释质量的影响。
Motivation: 现有注释工具和自动化缺乏结构化基准来评估注释是否满足视觉、语义和风格约束，导致注释难以阅读、不准确或视觉不协调。
Method: 构建AnnoBench基准，配对可视化与注释任务，使用VLM-as-a-judge进行评估，并通过四个单因素实验分析不同因素对注释质量的影响。
Result: 实验评估了输入表示、语义上下文、提示特异性和模型选择对注释质量的影响，但未报告具体数值结果。
Conclusion: 该工作为推进注释自动化、工具和可视化生成管道提供了基础，但尚未涉及与天气预测相关的应用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Minimizing Targeted Activations: Input-Only Suppression of Evaluation-Awareness Latents in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Activation steering controls model behavior by editing internal activations at inference time. We study its input-side dual: optimizing a fluent prompt so that a chosen internal latent is driven toward zero, with no inference-time model access. Our target is an "evaluation-awareness" latent-linearly readable and steerable in recent work-whose control would threaten the validity of safety evaluations if models behave differently when they detect being tested. Adapting Fluent Dreaming / EPO with a negated feature term (GCG-style token optimization plus a self-cross-entropy fluency regularizer, swept over a fluency weight), we suppress the latent under five target constructions-a CAA direction, a subspace norm, an SAE feature, a single MLP neuron, and a behavioral logit-on Llama-3.2-3B and Llama-3.1-8B. The latent is robustly suppressible ($z\approx-7$), and a causally-validated Llama Scope SAE feature can be fully and selectively turned off. But our controls tell a cautionary story about the CAA direction: a placebo random direction is suppressed just as hard and shifts behavior just as far, and when we hold a real eval passage in context and optimize only a prefix, suppressing the eval-direction fails to reduce-and slightly increases-the model's behavioral eval judgment. Activation-readability, in short, is not behavioral controllability. We further find that a single MLP neuron is eval-correlated but not causal at both scales, and that scanning the real Pile yields a natural-text baseline competitive with the optimizer for the internal direction. A positive control validates our erasure detector, bounding an erasure-vs-rotation question earlier left open.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究通过优化输入提示（input-only）来抑制大型语言模型内部“评估意识”（evaluation-awareness）潜变量的方法。采用Fluent Dreaming/EPO框架结合GCG风格的token优化和自交叉熵流畅度正则化，将目标潜变量驱动到零。实验在Llama-3.2-3B和Llama-3.1-8B上进行，覆盖CAA方向、子空间范数、SAE特征、单个MLP神经元和行为logit五种目标。结果表明潜变量可稳健抑制（z≈-7），但CAA方向存在安慰剂效应：随机方向同样被抑制并改变行为，且在真实评估上下文下抑制该方向无法减少行为评估判断。激活可读性（activation-readability）不等于行为可控性（behavioral controllability）。
Motivation: 评估意识潜变量会使模型在检测到被测试时行为改变，威胁安全评估的有效性。现有激活操控方法需要推理时模型访问，本文寻求纯输入侧的抑制方法，以保障评估的可靠性。
Method: 提出输入侧抑制方法：将目标潜变量最小化作为优化目标，结合GCG-style token优化和自交叉熵流畅度正则化，通过扫描流畅度权重平衡抑制效果与语言自然度。目标构造包括CAA方向、子空间范数、SAE特征、单个MLP神经元和行为logit。
Result: 在Llama-3.2-3B和Llama-3.1-8B上，潜变量可稳健抑制（z≈-7），SAE特征可完全选择性关闭。但CAA方向存在安慰剂效应：随机方向同样被抑制并改变行为；在真实评估上下文下，抑制评估方向未能降低反而略微增加模型的行为评估判断。单个MLP神经元有相关性但非因果。自然文本基线（Pile）与优化器效果相当。
Conclusion: 激活可读性不等于行为可控性，CAA方向容易受虚假关联影响，不能可靠控制行为。未来需谨慎使用基于线性探针的操控方法。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: The Barron-Lipschitz Energy Gap and Depth Separation Phenomena in Scientific Machine Learning
papers.abstract_en: We illustrate in several examples that even neural networks of infinite width (specifically, Barron functions) may encounter substantial obstacles when used as a model class for problems in the calculus of variations. An instance of practical relevance concerns the bending, stretching and folding of a thin elastic shell with anchored or clamped boundary conditions where elastic energy could be reduced by folding along a circular line, but the neural networks can only describe straight folds along entire lines. Conversely, we show that there is no gap between the energy that Barron functions and Lipschitz functions can achieve for a large class of integral first-order functionals.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过多个例子展示了即使在无限宽度（Barron函数）情况下，神经网络作为变分问题模型类时也可能遇到显著障碍。例如，在弹性薄壳的弯曲、拉伸和折叠问题中，神经网络只能描述直线折痕，而无法描述圆形折痕。另一方面，论文证明对于一大类一阶积分泛函，Barron函数和Lipschitz函数所能达到的能量之间不存在间隙。
Motivation: 理解无限宽神经网络（Barron函数）在科学机器学习中的变分问题中可能存在的局限性，尤其是能量间隙现象。
Method: 通过具体例子（如弹性薄壳的边界条件）展示Barron函数的局限性，并理论证明对于一类积分泛函，Barron函数与Lipschitz函数之间没有能量间隙。
Result: 发现Barron函数在描述某些几何形状（如圆形折痕）时存在根本性限制，但在一大类变分问题中与Lipschitz函数能量等价。
Conclusion: Barron函数在科学机器学习中既存在能量间隙（如弹性壳问题），也有无间隙情形，提示研究者需谨慎选择模型类。

papers.title: Interactive Reward Agent: GUI Task Evaluation via Environment-State Verification
papers.abstract_en: Graphical user interface task evaluation aims to determine whether a GUI agent has successfully completed a user instruction. Automated GUI task evaluation has received increasing attention because the evaluation results can serve as reward signals for both test-time scaling and post-training. However, reliable GUI task evaluation remains challenging because the judgments often require access to environment states, such as system configurations, file data, and application settings, beyond the screenshots of execution trajectories. In this paper, we propose an interactive reward agent (IRA) based on a propose-then-verify framework to acquire and verify evidence from the post-execution environment. Given a task instruction and a GUI environment after the GUI agent execution, IRA first proposes the task completion conditions and then verifies them by invoking system tools, application tools, and GUI tools. This design combines evidence from both visible interfaces and the environment state in an interactive process. We further introduce GUI-RewardBench, a benchmark of 321 GUI task trajectories spanning 10 Ubuntu desktop application categories. Experiments show that IRA achieves 86.9% accuracy on GUI-RewardBench, outperforming existing evaluator baselines. We further apply IRA to reinforcement learning of GUI agents, achieving a 34.0% OSWorld success rate, which demonstrates that IRA can provide effective reward signals for training GUI agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种交互式奖励代理（IRA），基于“提出-验证”框架，通过调用系统工具、应用工具和GUI工具，从执行后的环境中获取并验证证据，以判断GUI代理是否成功完成任务。作者还构建了GUI-RewardBench基准（包含321个GUI任务轨迹），实验显示IRA准确率达86.9%，并用于强化学习训练GUI代理，在OSWorld上取得34.0%的成功率。
Motivation: 现有的GUI任务评估方法通常仅依赖执行轨迹的截图，难以获取系统配置、文件数据等环境状态，导致评估不可靠。
Method: 提出IRA，首先根据任务指令和GUI环境提出任务完成条件，然后交互式地调用系统工具、应用工具和GUI工具进行验证。
Result: 在GUI-RewardBench上达到86.9%准确率，优于现有评估基线；用于强化学习训练GUI代理时，OSWorld成功率达34.0%。
Conclusion: IRA能够提供有效的奖励信号用于训练GUI代理，但评估依赖环境状态的可观测性，可能存在局限性。

papers.title: HiFi-UMI: Learning Deployable Manipulation Policies from High-Fidelity UMI Data Alone
papers.abstract_en: Learning deployable manipulation policies is bottlenecked by the scarcity of data that is both high-fidelity and scalable. Real-robot teleoperation is accurate but costly to scale; robot-free UMI capture scales readily, and current practice uses the resulting data mainly for pre-training, adding a small real-robot "anchor" at post-training. We ask whether raising the fidelity of robot-free UMI data, rather than shrinking the real-robot fraction, can remove that anchor. We present HiFi-UMI, a portable UMI data-production system co-designed for trajectory accuracy, inter-gripper relative pose, synchronization, and field of view: head-mounted offline stereo-inertial SLAM, native rather than reconstructed relative pose, a shared microsecond GPIO trigger, and two wide-angle cameras per hand covering ~200 degrees. It reaches 3 mm workspace-local end-effector accuracy without external tracking infrastructure. Using this corpus, we demonstrate zero-robot post-training: a policy post-trained solely on HiFi-UMI demonstrations deploys directly on a real robot and matches in-domain teleoperation across three backbones spanning the vision-language-action and world-action-model families, with success-rate differences of -2.5, +3.1, and -0.6 percentage points on StarVLA-QwenPI, OpenPI-pi_0.5, and LingBot-VA; the strongest policy reaches 85% on a precision insertion task, even though the teleoperation baseline is collected in the evaluation scene and no HiFi-UMI trajectory is. Pre-training on 4,000 hours from the same corpus lowers action error on ten unseen tasks by 41% and, on StarVLA-QwenPI, raises real-robot success by a further 18.1 percentage points. We open-source HiFi-UMI-2K, 2,000 hours of microsecond-synchronized, ultra-wide-FoV demonstrations, each automatically reconstructed and validated through simulation replay, as a large-scale, high-fidelity resource for the robot-learning community.
papers.comment: 33 pages, 15 figures, 4 tables. Project page: https://cloud.simpleai.tech/simple-world-lab/hifi-umi/ Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/simple-world-lab/HiFi-UMI-2K
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HiFi-UMI，一种高保真度的无机器人 UMI 数据采集系统，通过头戴式离线立体惯性 SLAM、原生相对位姿、微秒级 GPIO 同步和每只手两个宽角度相机（覆盖约 200 度）达到 3 毫米末端执行器精度。基于该数据训练的机器人操作策略无需真实机器人微调即可直接部署，在三个骨干模型上成功率与遥操作基线相差仅 -2.5、+3.1 和 -0.6 个百分点，并在精密插入任务上达到 85% 成功率。开源 2000 小时微秒同步超宽视野演示数据集 HiFi-UMI-2K。
Motivation: 操作策略的部署受限于数据既高保真又可扩展：真实遥操作精准但成本高，无机器人 UMI 数据易扩展但通常仅用于预训练，需要少量真实数据微调。本文探究是否可通过提升 UMI 数据保真度来消除对真实机器人数据的依赖。
Method: 设计 HiFi-UMI 数据采集系统：头戴式离线立体惯性 SLAM 实现轨迹精度；使用原生相对位姿而非重建；微秒级 GPIO 触发同步；每只手两个宽角度相机提供约 200 度视场。该系统无需外部跟踪基础设施即可达到 3 mm 末端执行器精度。
Result: 基于 HiFi-UMI 数据训练的模型无需任何真机后训练即可直接部署，在 StarVLA-QwenPI、OpenPI-pi_0.5 和 LingBot-VA 上成功率与同场景遥操作基线相差 -2.5、+3.1、-0.6 个百分点；最强策略在精密插入任务上达 85%。预训练 4000 小时 HiFi-UMI 数据使十个未见任务的动作误差降低 41%，并进一步提升真机成功率 18.1 个百分点。
Conclusion: 高保真度 UMI 数据可完全替代真实机器人数据用于策略后训练，且大规模预训练能显著提升泛化性能。开源 2000 小时数据集 HiFi-UMI-2K 为机器人学习社区提供高保真资源。

papers.title: TIGA: Trajectory-Injected Generative Attack against Black-box AIGC Detectors
papers.abstract_en: Recent diffusion models have achieved remarkable realism in facial image synthesis, posing growing challenges to artificial intelligence-generated content (AIGC) forensic detectors.Existing evasion methods typically perturb pre-generated images or require detector-aware training, which may introduce visible or statistical artifacts and limit applicability when the diffusion model must remain frozen and the target detector is accessible only through black-box queries. We propose Trajectory-Injected Generative Attack (TIGA), a source-image-free and training free framework that generates detector-evasive images within a single diffusion sampling trajectory. TIGA steers the latent Denoising Diffusion Implicit Model (DDIM) trajectory so that adversarial properties emerge during generation rather than being added afterward. TIGA first aggregates gradients from multiple white-box surrogate detectors to form a transferable, sign-aware prior, and then performs anisotropic directional search with symmetric finite-difference queries to estimate the black-box target response. The estimated directions are stabilized by decayed momentum and injected according to the DDIM noise schedule, with frequency-domain reshaping to suppress high frequency artifacts. Experiments on surrogate and unseen specialized forensic detectors show that TIGA achieves strong blackbox attack performance, transferability, and high robustness under common post-processing operations without source images or diffusion-model retraining, while preserving high perceptual quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TIGA（轨迹注入生成攻击），一种无需源图像、无需训练的黑盒AIGC检测器对抗攻击框架。通过在单次扩散采样轨迹中注入对抗性方向，使得生成的图像天然具有欺骗性，避免了后处理添加伪影。实验表明TIGA在多个检测器上具有强攻击性能、可迁移性和鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有对抗攻击方法要么扰动预生成图像引入可见伪影，要么需要训练检测器，限制了在扩散模型固定且目标检测器仅黑盒可访问场景下的应用。
Method: TIGA利用多白盒代理检测器聚合梯度形成可迁移先验，然后通过各向异性方向搜索结合对称有限差分黑盒查询估计目标响应，并采用衰减动量稳定方向，按照DDIM噪声调度注入，同时使用频域重塑抑制高频伪影。
Result: 在代理和未见过的专用取证检测器上，TIGA实现了强黑盒攻击性能、高可迁移性和鲁棒性，无需源图像或扩散模型重训练，同时保持高感知质量。
Conclusion: TIGA是一种无需源图像、无需训练的生成式对抗攻击框架，通过轨迹注入实现黑盒AIGC检测器欺骗。

papers.title: Messier: A High-Resolution Corpus for Cross-Benchmark Agent Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating AI agents in interactive environments is hindered by fragmented tasks, scaffolds, verifiers, and scoring rules. Existing efforts focus on narrow settings, remain limited in scale, or require costly reruns, leaving much of the empirical record incomparable. We introduce Messier, a unified corpus of 957,253 records that span 30 benchmarks, 714 agents, 11,891 tasks, and 74,205 verifiers. Messier consolidates public benchmark scores and supplements them with five-agent runs across six underrepresented professional and scientific domains, including a recent legal benchmark. Each record is standardized by model, scaffold, environment, task, verifier, and aggregation rule, with SOC/NAICS classifications for occupational and industry analysis. Using this corpus, we show frontier progress is uneven across benchmark types, with "function calling" saturated, "programming" improving the fastest, and "enterprise workflows" remaining the most challenging. Furthermore, counterfactual rescoring shows that strict all-pass aggregation in multi-verifier tasks can obscure progress and artificially alter agent rankings. From these standardized records, we derive capability scales that align with Epoch's Evaluation Capability Index rankings at Spearman \r{ho} = 0.81 and can be specialized by domain, occupation, action space, or verifier type. Messier provides a foundational, reusable infrastructure for agent capability scaling, benchmark auditing, and fine-grained analysis of evaluation failures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Messier是一个统一的高分辨率语料库，包含957,253条记录，覆盖30个基准、714个agent、11,891个任务和74,205个验证器，用于跨基准的AI agent评估。通过标准化分数和反事实重新评分，揭示了前沿进展在不同基准类型间的不均衡性，并推导出与Epoch评估能力指数排名高度相关的能力量表。
Motivation: 现有AI agent评估任务分散、scaffold和验证器不统一，导致实证结果难以比较，缺乏大规模标准化基础设施。
Method: 构建Messier语料库，整合公开基准分数并补充六个代表性不足的专业和科学领域的五-agent运行结果，每个记录按模型、scaffold、环境、任务、验证器和聚合规则标准化，并附加SOC/NAICS分类用于职业和行业分析。
Result: 发现前沿进展不均衡：函数调用类基准饱和，编程类改进最快，企业工作流最具挑战性；反事实重新评分表明严格的全通过聚合可能掩盖进展并改变排名；能力量表与Epoch评估能力指数排名的Spearman相关系数为0.81。
Conclusion: Messier为agent能力评估、基准审计和评估失败细粒度分析提供了可复用基础设施，支持按领域、职业、动作空间或验证器类型进行专业化分析。

papers.title: Distributing Security Controls Through Harness Engineering
papers.abstract_en: AI coding agents are being adopted at historic speed, yet security and risk concerns remain the primary barrier to scaling agentic AI across organizations. Existing security controls for coding agents are not systematically distributed to engineering teams, and vendor-native solutions introduce ecosystem dependencies that may not suit every deployment context. This paper investigates whether off-the-shelf security controls can be implemented on commercial AI coding agents and scaled to a distributed user base via a custom agent harness. A phased testing methodology was applied across four agent configurations --- two commercial agents with and without controls, a baseline harness, and a security-hardened harness --- using a 23-test suite derived from the OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications. SHarD (Secure Harness Distribution), a distributable harness built on the Pi agent harness, demonstrated that three categories of security controls --- OS sandboxing, skill scanning, and tool restriction --- can be embedded and distributed via a single install command while retaining equivalent efficacy to direct installation on commercial agents. SHarD achieved an adjusted score of 100\%, matching the best securely configured commercial agent, with no regression across any test category. Notable observations include evidence that model non-determinism produces inconsistent security outcomes and that autonomous agent behavior can cross system boundaries in ways that OS sandboxing directly mitigates. Initial characteristics toward a control harness fitness framework are proposed, and a third research question is identified for future investigation.

Conclusion: 提出控制框架适应性框架的初步特征，并识别出第三个研究问题供未来探索。

papers.title: Depression Markers in Speech: An Approach based on Tract Variables Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: This study identifies new depression biomarkers based on the dynamical properties of tract variables, which represent geometric features describing the configuration of the speech articulators. A key advantage of this approach lies in its ability to quantify aspects of the articulatory process that have not been previously explored in the context of depression, namely predictability, complexity, and randomness. These properties are respectively characterised using the Largest Lyapunov Exponent, the Correlation Dimension, and the Sample Entropy. Thorough experiments were conducted on the Androids Corpus, a publicly available dataset comprising 64 speakers diagnosed with depression by clinicians and 54 control speakers with no reported history of mental health conditions. The results indicate that the proposed biomarkers effectively discriminate between the depressed and control speakers, as evidenced by the high Cliffs delta values across both read and spontaneous speech.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in the Journal of the Acoustical Society of America (JASA)
papers.journal_ref: Journal of the Acoustical Society of America (JASA), July 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文基于声道变量（tract variables）的动力学特性识别抑郁的生物标志物，使用最大Lyapunov指数、关联维数和样本熵分别量化可预测性、复杂性和随机性。在Androids语料库（64名抑郁患者和54名对照）上，实验表明这些标志物能有效区分抑郁和对照说话者，Cliff's delta值较高。
Motivation: 现有抑郁语音研究缺乏对发音过程中动力学特性（可预测性、复杂性、随机性）的探索，本文旨在填补这一空白。
Method: 提取声道变量的动力学特征（最大Lyapunov指数、关联维数、样本熵），在公共数据集Androids Corpus上进行分类实验。
Result: 摘要报告所提出的生物标志物在区分抑郁与对照说话者方面表现良好，Cliff's delta值较高，且涵盖阅读和自发言语两种模式。
Conclusion: 声道变量的动力学特性可作为抑郁的有效语音标志，为临床诊断提供新工具。

papers.title: Device Invariance using Domain Adaptation on Acoustic Scene Classification
papers.abstract_en: This paper explores the effectiveness of domain adaptation techniques when using convolutional neural network (CNN)-based and transformer-based feature representations for acoustic scene classification. Two well-known domain adaptation techniques, namely domain adversarial neural network (also called DANN) and conditional domain adversarial network (also called CDAN) are evaluated under various domain shifts. Our study indicates that DANN provides effective domain adaptation fairly consistently for both feature extractors. On the other hand, CDAN provides effective domain adaptation only for CNN-based feature extractors. The study gives insights into how domain adaptation methods may need to be tailored to the underlying feature representation. Experimental evaluation with multiple devices on the DCASE 2020 dataset supports the observations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究域适应（domain adaptation）技术在声学场景分类（acoustic scene classification）中用于实现设备不变性（device invariance）。实验比较了域对抗神经网络（DANN）和条件域对抗网络（CDAN）分别在CNN和Transformer特征提取器上的效果，发现在DCASE 2020数据集上，DANN对两种特征提取器均表现一致，而CDAN仅对CNN特征提取器有效。
Motivation: 声学场景分类模型在不同设备上性能下降，需要设备不变性方法。现有域适应技术针对不同特征提取器的适用性缺乏系统比较。
Method: 使用CNN和Transformer作为特征提取器，分别结合DANN和CDAN两种域适应方法，在多重设备偏移下进行实验评估。
Result: DANN在CNN和Transformer上都提供有效的域适应；CDAN仅在CNN上有效，在Transformer上效果不佳。
Conclusion: 域适应方法需要根据底层特征表示进行定制，DANN是更通用的选择。

papers.title: A Machine-Learning-Based Gas Lift Optimization Workflow for Unconventional Fields
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we present an automated data-driven workflow using Machine Learning (ML) for gas lift optimization in unconventional fields. This workflow integrates a ML model that accurately forecasts the Gas Lift Performance Curve, and a Bayesian Optimization Framework to solve for the optimal gas injection rates under the constraints of facility capacity. The ML model leverages the historical production time series data without requiring downhole gauges or multi-rate well tests. We piloted this workflow on 30 wells across 5 well pads in Bakken and obtained >5% production uplift on average. With the success of the pilot, we have now fully-deployed this workflow in Bakken across 200+ gas lift and plunger-assisted gas lift (PAGL) wells. Moreover, the ML-based gas lift optimization workflow presented in this paper is an effective and economic solution for other assets where downhole data or multi-rate testing are not available/feasible due to cost or facility constraints.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the Unconventional Resources Technology Conference (URTeC), Houston, TX, USA, June 17-19, 2024, pp. 1600-1610
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于机器学习的气举优化工作流程，用于非常规油田。该工作流程集成ML模型预测气举性能曲线，并结合贝叶斯优化框架在设施容量约束下求解最优注气速率。在Bakken油田30口井试点获得平均>5%产量提升，现已全面部署至200多口井。该方法无需井下仪表或多速率测试，适用于数据有限的资产。
Motivation: 非常规油田中气举优化常因缺乏井下数据或多速率测试而受限，需要一种经济有效的数据驱动方法。
Method: 提出自动化数据驱动工作流程，包含ML模型（利用历史生产时间序列预测气举性能曲线）和贝叶斯优化框架（在设施容量约束下求解最优注气速率）。
Result: 在Bakken油田30口井试点获得平均>5%产量提升，并已全面部署至200多口气举和柱塞辅助气举井。
Conclusion: 该方法是一种有效且经济的解决方案，适用于因成本或设施限制无法获取井下数据或多速率测试的其他资产。

papers.title: Stemma: Induced Decision Regions Reveal LLM Provenance
papers.abstract_en: LLM provenance testing asks whether a suspect LLM belongs to the same lineage as a source. Existing black-box methods largely infer this relationship from response-level characteristics, but these characteristics may shift under adaptation or deployment even when the underlying meaning remains unchanged, weakening the reliability of provenance evidence. To address this limitation, we introduce induced decision regions by mapping open-ended outputs into a finite decision space, thereby abstracting away surface-form variation and reframing provenance testing as measuring the inheritance of decision regions. Empirical analysis shows that the source's induced regions are preserved more strongly in related models than in unrelated models. Building on this signal, we propose Stemma, a practical black-box LLM fingerprinting method that operationalises stability, robustness, and specificity as complementary probe-selection principles for reliably estimating induced decision region inheritance. Across 770 source-suspect pairs drawn from 56 public checkpoints and spanning diverse model-weight transformations, Stemma achieves 0.967 AUC and 87.8% TPR at 1% FPR, substantially outperforming four representative baselines. It further achieves 0.995 AUC and 93.5% TPR at 1% FPR on 1,260 pairs covering 91 deployment instances, demonstrating robustness to diverse inference-time deployment settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大型语言模型（LLM）来源测试问题，提出一种基于诱导决策区域（induced decision regions）的黑盒指纹识别方法Stemma。该方法将开放输出映射到有限决策空间，通过测量决策区域的继承性来判断模型间是否同源。在涵盖56个公开检查点、770对源-嫌疑模型以及91个部署实例的实验评估中，Stemma达到0.967 AUC和87.8% TPR@1%FPR，显著优于现有基线方法。
Motivation: 现有LLM来源测试方法依赖响应级特征，这些特征在模型适应或部署时可能发生变化，导致可靠性下降。需要一种不依赖表面形式、更鲁棒的来源推断方法。
Method: 提出诱导决策区域的概念，将开放式输出映射到有限决策空间，从而抽象掉表面形式变化。基于此，设计Stemma方法，利用稳定性、鲁棒性和特异性作为互补的探测选择原则，估计决策区域继承性。
Result: 在770对源-嫌疑模型上，Stemma达到0.967 AUC和87.8% TPR@1%FPR；在1260对涵盖91个部署实例的测试中，达到0.995 AUC和93.5% TPR@1%FPR，明显优于四种基线方法。
Conclusion: Stemma是一种有效的黑盒LLM指纹识别方法，其基于诱导决策区域的特征能可靠地区分同源与非同源模型，并具有较强的部署鲁棒性。

papers.title: Runtime Uncertainty Monitoring for LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems Using Bayesian Networks
papers.abstract_en: This paper investigates how multi-agent systems (MAS)-based on large language models (LLMs) can support actuarial risk modelling, with a particular focus on uncertainty quantification. Actuarial workflows represent a high-stakes decision-support setting where unreliable outputs may lead to incorrect risk assessment, unfair pricing, and regulatory non-compliance. To address uncertainty introduced by the probabilistic nature of LLMs and dependencies between agents, a multi-agent framework is proposed in which specialised agents perform data preparation, modelling, review, and explanation tasks under a central hub. The main contribution is a novel approach to uncertainty propagation using token-level log-probabilities and a Bayesian Network. Importantly, log probabilities are not treated as direct probabilities of correctness or task success. Instead, length-normalised log-probability summaries are transformed into calibrated task-level confidence estimates before incorporation into the Bayesian Network. Results show that the framework reproduces baseline actuarial performance while providing additional insight into workflow stability and runtime uncertainty propagation.
papers.comment: This paper got accepted for Ninth International Workshop on Artificial Intelligence Safety Engineering (WAISE 2026): https://www.waise.org/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究基于大语言模型的多智能体系统在精算风险建模中的不确定性量化问题。提出一个中心枢纽协调下的多智能体框架，包含数据准备、建模、审查和解释等专业智能体。主要贡献是利用token级对数概率和贝叶斯网络进行不确定性传播，将对数概率转化为校准的任务级置信度估计。实验表明该框架在保持基线精算性能的同时，提供了工作流稳定性和运行时不确定性传播的额外洞察。
Motivation: 精算工作流是高风险决策支持场景，不可靠输出可能导致错误风险评估、不公平定价和监管不合规。现有LLM多智能体系统的不确定性量化不足，尤其是智能体间依赖关系引入的不确定性。
Method: 提出一个多智能体框架，专门智能体执行数据准备、建模、审查和解释任务，由中心枢纽协调。不确定性传播方法：使用长度归一化的对数概率摘要，将其转换为校准的任务级置信度估计，再融入贝叶斯网络。
Result: 摘要显示该框架重现了基线精算性能，同时额外提供了工作流稳定性和运行时不确定性传播的洞察。
Conclusion: 该框架可用于高风险的决策支持场景，提高对LLM多智能体系统输出的可靠性监控，但具体性能提升未量化，且仅在精算领域验证。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: A2TTA: Anchored-and-Agile Test-Time Adaptation for Evolving Traffic Sensor Networks
papers.abstract_en: Traffic forecasting is important for efficient traffic management and route planning in smart cities. Existing traffic forecasting studies typically assume fixed sensor graphs, overlooking the continuous evolution of real-world traffic networks, e.g., ongoing road network construction and evolving human mobility patterns. These dynamic changes can substantially degrade conventional forecasting models, motivating test-time adaptation (TTA) to efficiently adapt pretrained models during deployment. However, applying TTA to evolving traffic sensor networks remains challenging in two aspects. First, topology expansion introduces new sensors and connections, continuously reshaping the sensor graph. Second, tem- poral shifts vary in time scale and stability, requiring differentiated adaptation to long-term and short-term shifts. In this study, we address these challenges by proposing A2TTA, an Anchored-and-Agile Test-Time Adaptation framework for evolving traffic sensor networks, which transforms topology-induced forecasting errors into an expandable output calibration problem and separates tem- poral adaptation into persistent global correction and agile context-specific specialization. By jointly addressing topology evolution and multi-scale temporal shifts, A2TTA enables efficient and robust adaptation to continuously evolving traffic environments. Extensive experiments on ten real-world traffic networks demonstrate that A2TTA consistently improves forecasting performance across different backbones, datasets, and prediction horizons. Our code is available in https://github.com/lixus7/A2TTA.

papers.title: How Do LLMs Read Bug Reports? An Empirical Study of Attention in LLMs for Automated Program Repair
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM)-based Automated Program Repair systems are advancing rapidly, yet their performance remains inconsistent. Even when provided with the same contextual information, an LLM may generate a correct patch for one bug but fail on another closely related bug. Why this happens remains poorly understood, and it is unclear how LLMs prioritize the diverse information in bug reports and whether model attention affects repair success. In this paper, we present the first empirical study of attention patterns in LLM-based program repair, providing interpretable insights into how models process bug reports and where their attention is concentrated during repair. We analyze 319 real-world Python and Java bugs from SWE-bench Verified and Multi-SWE-bench to study (RQ1) how model attention is distributed across bug report sections, (RQ2) how attention patterns within each section differ between successful and unsuccessful repairs, and (RQ3) how these patterns compare to information developers consider important for bug fixing. We find that successful repairs are characterized by diffused attention across multiple diagnostic components such as bug descriptions, stacktraces, and test cases, while failures often exhibit over-localized attention toward metadata such as version information. We further observe that stronger alignment between model attention and developer-identified key sections and phrases is associated with higher repair success. Our results provide the first empirical evidence that attention misallocation is a key factor in LLM-based APR failures, and offer actionable insights for designing more interpretable and reliable future APR systems.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 41st IEEE/ACM International Conference on Automated Software Engineering (ASE) 2026 Conference
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次实证研究基于LLM的程序修复中的注意力模式，分析319个真实Python和Java错误。发现成功修复时注意力分散于错误描述、堆栈跟踪和测试用例等多个诊断组件，失败时则过度集中于版本信息等元数据。模型注意力与开发者认定的关键部分对齐程度越高，修复成功率也越高。
Motivation: LLM程序修复性能不一致，但原因不明。本文旨在理解LLM如何优先处理错误报告中的信息以及注意力是否影响修复成功。
Method: 对SWE-bench Verified和Multi-SWE-bench中的319个真实错误进行注意力模式分析，比较成功与失败修复的注意力分布，并与开发者认为重要的信息对齐。
Result: 成功修复表现为注意力分散于多个诊断组件；失败修复注意力过度集中于元数据。注意力与开发者关键信息的对齐度与修复成功率正相关。
Conclusion: 注意力错配是LLM程序修复失败的关键因素，为设计更可解释和可靠的APR系统提供了可操作的见解。

papers.title: VAD to the Bone: Ultra-Tiny Speech Activity Detection for Edge Deployment
papers.abstract_en: Voice activity detection (VAD) triggers downstream speech processing in always-on systems under strict memory, latency, and compute constraints. Recent compact models report strong accuracy but rely on components that are not widely supported: learnable filterbanks, recurrent layers, or non-causal post-processing. We propose kiloVAD, designed for embedded inference using standard Mel features, CNN-only layers, and tunable context/spectral parameters. We introduce per-layer structured pruning with self-distillation and angle-based quantization-aware training (QAT) that outperforms standard QAT by 1-4%. Evaluated per-frame under causal conditions, kiloVAD achieves 0.850 AUC on AVA-Speech with 2.1 k parameters and 200 ms context, establishing a new state of the art for causal, deployment-ready VAD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 kiloVAD，一种超轻量级语音活动检测（VAD）模型，专为边缘部署设计。模型使用标准 Mel 特征、仅 CNN 层和可调上下文/频谱参数，引入逐层结构化剪枝、自蒸馏和基于角度的量化感知训练（QAT），在 AVA-Speech 上以 2.1k 参数和 200ms 上下文达到 0.850 AUC，树立了因果、可部署 VAD 的新标杆。
Motivation: 始终在线的语音系统需要 VAD 在严格的内存、延迟和计算约束下触发下游处理，但现有紧凑模型依赖学习滤波器组、循环层或非因果后处理等不广泛支持的组件，难以在边缘部署。
Method: 提出 kiloVAD，采用标准 Mel 特征、仅 CNN 层、可调上下文/频谱参数，并引入逐层结构化剪枝结合自蒸馏，以及基于角度的量化感知训练（Angle-based QAT），在标准 QAT 基础上提升 1-4%。
Result: 在因果逐帧评估下，kiloVAD 以 2.1k 参数和 200ms 上下文在 AVA-Speech 上达到 0.850 AUC，建立了可部署因果 VAD 的新最优水平。
Conclusion: 该工作表明，通过精心设计的轻量架构和剪枝量化策略，可以实现在边缘设备上高效运行的 VAD 模型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Bias-corrected Cox regression with AI-extracted covariates via calibration summary statistics
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale observational studies increasingly rely on AI pipelines to extract structured variables from unstructured clinical records. A common workflow separates the data vendor, who validates extraction accuracy with a gold-standard sample, from the downstream researcher, who receives only the extracted dataset and summary accuracy statistics. We develop a bias-correction framework for the Cox proportional hazards model when covariates are subject to AI extraction error. Within a unified multivariate calibration framework, we show that the naive Cox estimator's bias decomposes into a leading-order calibration term and a second-order residual that vanishes as extraction accuracy improves. The leading-order term yields a corrected estimator that operates as a post-hoc matrix multiplication on the output of any standard Cox software. We further derive bias-adjusted confidence intervals that incorporate calibration uncertainty and a sensitivity diagnostic for assessing whether the neglected residual could materially affect inference. Synthetic data experiments with cross-dependent extraction errors and controlled nonlinear calibration violations confirm that the correction substantially reduces bias and achieves near-nominal coverage even under mild violations of the linear calibration assumption. The framework yields a concrete reporting specification: a short list of summary statistics that data vendors should provide alongside any AI-extracted covariate dataset used in survival analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大规模观察性研究中，AI从非结构化临床记录中提取协变量时产生的测量误差，提出了Cox比例风险模型的偏差校正框架。该框架利用校准汇总统计量，通过后验矩阵乘法校正Cox估计，并推导了偏差调整的置信区间和敏感性诊断。合成数据实验表明，校正能大幅减少偏差，即使在线性校准假设轻微违反时也能达到近似名义覆盖。
Motivation: 大型观察性研究常依赖AI流程从非结构化记录中提取结构化变量，但提取误差会导致Cox回归估计有偏。现有方法需数据供应商提供详细验证数据，而实际中下游研究者仅获得提取数据集和汇总精度统计量，因此需要一种仅利用汇总统计量的偏差校正方法。
Method: 提出统一的多变量校准框架，将Naive Cox估计的偏差分解为首项校准项和二阶残差项。基于首项导出校正估计器，该估计器可通过在标准Cox软件输出上左乘一个矩阵来实现后验校正。同时推导了考虑校准不确定性的偏差调整置信区间，以及用于评估忽略残差是否影响推断的敏感性诊断。
Result: 在合成数据实验中，考虑了交叉依赖的提取误差和非线性校准违规，验证了校正显著减少偏差，且在轻微违反线性校准假设时仍能达到接近标称的覆盖概率。
Conclusion: 该框架给出了具体的报告规范：数据供应商应提供一系列汇总统计量，以便下游使用AI提取协变量的生存分析能进行偏差校正。

papers.title: OmniQEC: discovering practical quantum error-correcting codes by an AI scientist
papers.abstract_en: Quantum error correction (QEC) is indispensable for scalable fault-tolerant quantum computing. However, discovering QEC codes that remain effective is challenging, as logical performance depends on the interplay between code structure, hardware, syndrome extraction, and decoding, which often impose competing requirements. Here we introduce OmniQEC, an efficient AI scientist for discovering QEC codes suited to deployment on modern quantum processors. OmniQEC formulates QEC design as an iterative discovery process in which an orchestrator, implemented by advanced large language models (LLMs), coordinates code generation, code-level screening, syndrome-extraction synthesis, and decoder-based circuit evaluation. At its core, OmniQEC combines a self-evolving reasoning mechanism with a slow--fast synergistic workflow: a fast loop explores candidates using inexpensive code-level proxies, whereas a slow loop performs physically grounded circuit-level evaluation and feeds the resulting evidence back into the search. We evaluate OmniQEC across four qLDPC construction families, three LLM backends, and $14$ total-physical-qubit budgets per backend. The discovered codes show steadily improving logical-error suppression with increasing physical-qubit budgets and outperform the BB codes with $[\![72,12,6]\!]$ and $[\![144,12,12]\!]$ under complete-implementation budgets of 98 and 240 physical qubits, respectively. The discovered codes are hardware-friendly and may be of independent interest for practical QEC implementation. These findings pave the way towards LLM-assisted QEC discovery grounded in physically informed code--circuit--decoder co-design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出OmniQEC，一种由大型语言模型（LLM）驱动的AI科学家，用于自动发现适合现代量子处理器的量子纠错码。OmniQEC将纠错码设计建模为迭代发现过程，结合自演化推理机制和快慢协同工作流：快速循环使用低成本码级代理筛选候选，慢速循环执行物理基电路级评估并反馈结果。在四个qLDPC码族、三个LLM后端和每个后端14个总物理量子比特预算下评估，发现的码在逻辑错误抑制上持续改善，并在98和240物理量子比特的完整实现预算下分别优于[72,12,6]和[144,12,12]的BB码。
Motivation: 量子纠错码的发现因码结构、硬件、症候提取和解码之间的复杂相互作用而极具挑战，现有方法难以高效找到适用于现代量子处理器的实用码。
Method: OmniQEC以LLM作为编排器，协调码生成、码级筛选、症候提取综合和基于译码器的电路评估。其核心是自演化推理机制与快慢协同工作流：快速循环利用低成本码级代理（如码距估计）探索大量候选，慢速循环执行基于物理电路的全面评估并将证据反馈至搜索过程。
Result: 在14个总物理量子比特预算下，OmniQEC发现的码随着物理量子比特预算增加持续改善逻辑错误抑制，并在98和240物理量子比特的完整实现预算下分别优于[72,12,6]和[144,12,12]的BB码。
Conclusion: 表明通过LLM辅助的码-电路-译码器协同设计，能够实现物理信息驱动的实用量子纠错码发现，为实际QEC实现提供新途径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DRIFT: Direct-Recursive Intervention-Conditioned Forecasting of ICU Physiological Trajectories
papers.abstract_en: Many time-series forecasts depend not only on prior observations but also on actions specified during the forecast period. In intensive care units (ICUs), future vital signs and laboratory values are influenced by treatments such as vasopressors. However, models that predict the full future sequence all at once make little use of these treatments, whereas autoregressive models can accumulate errors. We introduce DRIFT, a hybrid framework in which a direct model produces the primary forecast and a recursive, action-conditioned model contributes constrained corrections. We evaluate DRIFT on 6,046 admissions from MIMIC-IV and 8,345 admissions from eICU-CRD. Averaged across the 8-, 24-, and 48-hour forecast endpoints, DRIFT reduces mean absolute error for mean arterial pressure (MAP) by 0.673% relative to an action-conditioned Temporal Fusion Transformer (TFT-action) on MIMIC-IV and achieves the lowest corresponding error among the compared models on eICU-CRD. Although the overall accuracy improvement is modest, a MIMIC-IV audit restricted to windows in which the supplied treatment sequence was altered showed that DRIFT achieved lower observed-target MAP error than TFT-action at 8 and 24 hours. Treatment-sequence alteration increased DRIFT's MAP error by 0.21-0.26 mmHg more than it increased TFT-action's error, with prediction changes occurring primarily after the supplied paths diverged. In a separate robustness experiment, the MAP advantage persisted under three shared checkpoint-selection rules emphasizing overall endpoint error, MAP error, or both equally.

papers.title: A Two-Regime Statistical Framework for Wind-Power Distributions: From Wind-Speed Fluctuations to Turbine Control
papers.abstract_en: Wind-power variability is a major challenge for the reliable integration of utility-scale wind energy into modern power systems. Although wind-speed statistics are often described by simple parametric distributions, translating these statistics into turbine-level power fluctuations is nontrivial because the relationship between wind speed and power is highly nonlinear and changes across different turbine operating regimes. Here, we develop a two-regime statistical framework for wind-power distributions. In the aerodynamic operating regime, between the cut-in and rated speeds, the turbine power follows an approximate cubic dependence on wind speed. Starting from a physically motivated Rician model for the wind-speed magnitude, we derive an analytical expression for the corresponding wind-power distribution using a nonlinear change of variables. In the control-dominated near-rated regime, where active blade-pitch and generator control regulate the turbine output, the aerodynamic transformation is no longer applicable. Instead, we characterize the power deficit relative to the rated power and show empirically that its continuous tail is well described by a bounded stretched-exponential distribution for both individual turbines and wind-farm ensembles. These results provide a physically interpretable statistical description of wind-power fluctuations across the full operational range of utility-scale wind turbines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对风电功率波动统计建模问题，提出一个两区域统计框架。在空气动力学区域（切入风速至额定风速），基于Rician风速模型推导了风速-功率立方关系的解析功率分布；在近额定控制区域，使用有界拉伸指数分布描述功率缺口的连续尾部。该框架为单个涡轮机和风电场集合提供了物理可解释的统计描述。
Motivation: 风力发电的可变性是电网集成的主要挑战，而风速-功率关系高度非线性且随涡轮机运行区域变化，现有简单参数化统计难以准确描述。
Method: 两区域统计框架：空气动力学区域采用Rician风速模型和变量变换导出功率分布解析式；近额定控制区域用有界拉伸指数分布拟合功率缺口。
Result: 摘要报告有界拉伸指数分布在单个涡轮机和风电场集合上能良好拟合功率缺口的连续尾部。
Conclusion: 该框架提供了跨涡轮机完整运行范围的物理可解释的风电功率波动统计描述。

papers.title: Open-Ended CT Volume Segmentation with Weak Supervision from Language
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a method for training a text-conditioned segmentation model for CT scans, which combines voxel-level supervision with coarse but scalable slice-level supervision from reports. We extract, from a large database of scan-report pairs, descriptions of findings with indices of slices where those findings occur. We then finetune a general-purpose 2D image segmentation model, SAM3, with standard segmentation losses from strongly labeled data and with a slice-level classification loss from the extracted weak supervision. Our results on the ReXGroundingCT dataset illustrate that this strategy improves the segmentation dice score: from an 8% relative gain when there are 1000 fully labeled volumes to 22% when there are 250 fully labeled volumes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种文本条件CT扫描分割模型的训练方法，结合体素级标注和从影像报告中提取的粗粒度切片级弱监督。实验表明，在ReXGroundingCT数据集上，该方法在仅有250个全标注体积时相对提升22%的Dice分数。
Motivation: CT扫描分割需要大量体素级标注，成本高昂；而报告中的切片级标注更容易获取，但监督信号较弱。如何利用弱监督提升分割性能是核心问题。
Method: 从大规模扫描-报告对中提取发现描述及其发生切片索引；微调通用2D图像分割模型SAM3，联合使用强标注数据的标准分割损失和弱监督的切片级分类损失。
Result: 在ReXGroundingCT数据集上，该方法在1000个全标注体积时Dice分数相对提升8%，在250个全标注体积时提升22%。
Conclusion: 结合粗粒度切片级弱监督可以有效减少对密集体素标注的依赖，尤其适用于标注数据稀缺的场景。

papers.title: Shieldstral
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Shieldstral, a 3B-parameter policy-adaptive multimodal safety classifier that matches or outperforms models nearly 7$\times$ its size on text safety benchmarks and sets a new state of the art on multimodal safety classification. Shieldstral formulates content moderation as a binary question-answering task. This simple formulation unifies diverse moderation tasks into a single yes/no problem, enabling heterogeneous safety datasets with divergent taxonomies to be consolidated under one training framework. We present the data construction recipe, covering curation and generation of approximately 54.1M samples and a fine-grained evaluation set to evaluate policy adaptability. Together, these enable a small adaptive model to match or outperform much larger models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Shieldstral 是一个 3B 参数的多模态安全分类器，通过将内容审核建模为二元问答任务，统一了不同安全数据集，在文本安全基准上匹配或超越近 7 倍大小的模型，并在多模态安全分类上达到新最优。论文描述了约 5410 万样本的数据构建流程和细粒度评估集。
Motivation: 现有安全分类器在多模态和策略适应方面存在局限，需要统一异构安全数据集并提升效率。
Method: 将内容审核视为二元问答任务，统一不同审核任务为单一 yes/no 问题；构建 5410 万样本数据集和细粒度评估集以训练策略自适应模型。
Result: 在文本安全基准上匹配或超越近 7 倍大小的模型，在多模态安全分类上达到新最优。
Conclusion: 通过简单的问题回答公式和小型模型即可实现高效的多模态安全分类，展示了数据质量和策略适应性的重要性。

papers.title: HiSkill: Empowering LLM Agents with Hierarchical Skill Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Skills have become an important abstraction for enabling large language model (LLM) agents to reuse past experience in long-horizon interactive tasks. However, existing trajectory-to-skill methods often produce flat collections of high-level textual skills that are stored and retrieved independently, leaving skill relations underutilized and maintaining a gap between high-level skills and executable actions. In this paper, we propose HiSkill, a hierarchical skill graph framework that organizes interaction trajectories into a directed graph with skill nodes, AtomicOp nodes, and typed edges. Specifically, the graph connects reusable high-level skills with executable action templates, while also capturing decomposition, temporal transition, compatibility, support, and recovery relations among them. At inference time, HiSkill retrieves a compact task-relevant subgraph and performs subgraph-guided task execution, where a symbolic task state, an active skill, and the retrieved subgraph guide the LLM agent to switch skills, select AtomicOps, and ground executable actions iteratively. Experiments on three interactive environments show that HiSkill outperforms state-of-the-art baselines while reducing inference token consumption, demonstrating the effectiveness of bridging high-level skills and executable action grounding through a hierarchical skill graph. Our data and code is available at https://github.com/BUPT-GAMMA/HiSkill.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HiSkill，一种层次化技能图框架，将交互轨迹组织为包含技能节点、AtomicOp节点和有向边的图结构，连接高层技能与可执行动作模板，并捕获分解、时间转移、兼容性、支撑和恢复关系。推理时检索任务相关子图指导LLM智能体迭代执行。实验表明HiSkill在三个交互环境中优于基线并减少推理令牌消耗。
Motivation: 现有轨迹到技能方法往往产生扁平的高层技能集合，技能关系未被充分利用，高层技能与可执行动作之间存在鸿沟。
Method: 构建有向技能图，包含技能节点和AtomicOp节点，边类型包括分解、时间转移、兼容性、支撑和恢复。推理时检索任务相关子图，利用符号任务状态、当前技能和子图指导技能切换、AtomicOp选择和动作接地。
Result: 在三个交互环境上，HiSkill优于最先进基线，同时减少推理令牌消耗。
Conclusion: 通过层次化技能图桥接高层技能和可执行动作接地是有效的。

papers.title: From Heat Stress to Perception: Interpretable Data-Driven Models of Human Thermal Sensation
papers.abstract_en: Heat stress indices are designed to quantify physiological thermal stress, but their relevance for inferring the thermal perception of individuals remains unclear. In this study, we show that thermal stress and thermal sensation often diverge, as evidenced by distinct global sensitivity patterns with respect to environmental drivers. Using thermal sensation vote survey data, we demonstrate that the dominant sensitivities of stress-based metrics do not align with those governing reported human thermal sensation. Given the multitude of globally-applicable thermal stress indices and the lack of comparable general thermal sensation metrics, we develop two complementary data-driven modeling frameworks for thermal sensation. First, we construct polynomial chaos expansion (PCE) surrogates to represent thermal sensation as a function of meteorological variables, enabling efficient variance-based sensitivity analysis and explicit identification of influential inputs and interactions. Second, we develop multilayer perceptron (MLP) classifiers that capture the nonlinear and subjective nature of thermal perception, while achieving high predictive accuracy. The PCE models provide physically interpretable sensitivities that can explain the drivers of thermal sensation, while the MLPs offer flexible predictive capability suited to complex environments. We apply both modeling approaches at city- and continent-scales, revealing systematic differences in sensitivity structure and performance across climates. In particular, we find that the sensitivity of TSV-based models to the variability of meteorological conditions across geoclimatic zone encodes distinct dependencies on temperature, radiation, humidity, and wind that vary geographically, and are generally different from those of heat stress indices.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究热应激指数与人体热感知之间的差异，利用多项式混沌展开（PCE）和多层感知器（MLP）建立数据驱动的热感知模型，发现热应激主导敏感性与热感知投票的敏感性不一致，且在不同气候区呈现系统性差异。
Motivation: 热应激指数旨在量化生理热应激，但其与个体热感知的相关性尚不明确，且缺乏全球通用的热感知指标。
Method: 基于热感知投票调查数据，构建两种互补数据驱动模型：PCE代理模型用于方差敏感性分析和显式识别影响输入及交互作用；MLP分类器捕捉热感知的非线性和主观性，实现高精度预测。
Result: PCE模型提供了物理可解释的敏感性，MLP实现了灵活预测；在城市和大陆尺度上揭示了不同气候区热感知敏感性结构的系统性差异，且热感知模型敏感性与热应激指数敏感性通常不同。
Conclusion: 热感知与热应激指数存在根本性差异，所提出的数据驱动框架可用于解释和预测热感知，且敏感性随地理气候区变化。

papers.title: Adversarial Deepfake Generation and an Investigation of Purification-Based Adversarial Detection
papers.abstract_en: This paper describes the participation of team "Go To Germany" in the ImageCLEF 2026 Deepfake Detection and Generation Task. For the image generation task, we employ FLUX.1-dev with PuLID for identity-preserving face synthesis, combined with a multi-model PGD adversarial attack targeting 12 detectors simultaneously (DiffJPEG-in-loop, MI/DI/EoT, adaptive weighting, two-stage warm-start). Our approach achieved 90% evasion against organizer detectors and 57.6% against participant detectors, with a final generation score of 0.4170. For the image detection task, we combine two complementary detectors - SigLIP+DINOv2 for AI-generated images and GenD-DINOv3 for face manipulations - in a max-probability ensemble, achieving 99.4% accuracy on baseline deepfakes but suffering from high false-positive rates on real images, resulting in a final detection score of 0.6986. Beyond the official submission, we conducted a self-initiated investigation of purification-based adversarial detection, comparing three families of detection signals across six detectors that share a CLIP ViT-L/14 backbone. We find that raw $|Δ\text{logit}|$ under median-3 purification, applied through the EFFORT detector, separates adversarial inputs from clean inputs with AUROC 0.81-0.98 across four adversarial source types - a finding that refutes the simple backbone-preservation hypothesis and exposes a sharp JPEG-quality cliff at Q70 where the signal collapses.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文描述了团队在ImageCLEF 2026深度伪造检测与生成任务中的参与情况。生成任务采用FLUX.1-dev与PuLID进行身份保持的人脸合成，并组合多模型PGD对抗攻击同时绕过12个检测器，达到90%的逃避率。检测任务使用SigLIP+DINOv2和GenD-DINOv3的集成，在基线深度伪造上准确率99.4%，但真实图像误报率高。此外，作者还自主研究了基于净化的对抗检测，发现中值3净化下的原始|Δlogit|信号在EFFORT检测器上能以AUROC 0.81-0.98区分对抗和干净输入。
Motivation: 深度伪造的生成与检测是重要课题，但现有方法在对抗攻击下的鲁棒性和检测器的泛化性仍有不足，尤其是净化策略对检测信号的影响尚不明确。
Method: 生成任务：FLUX.1-dev + PuLID进行人脸生成，多模型PGD攻击（含DiffJPEG、MI/DI/EoT、自适应权重、两阶段热启动）同时攻击12个检测器。检测任务：集成SigLIP+DINOv2（检测AI生成图像）和GenD-DINOv3（检测人脸篡改），取最大概率。净化检测研究：在CLIP ViT-L/14骨干的六个检测器上比较三类检测信号，使用中值3净化下的原始|Δlogit|。
Result: 生成任务获得0.4170的最终分数，逃避率90%（组织者检测器）和57.6%（参与者检测器）。检测任务在基线深度伪造上准确率99.4%，但最终分数0.6986因真实图像误报。净化检测发现EFFORT检测器在4种对抗源上AUROC 0.81-0.98，存在JPEG质量阈值Q70处信号崩溃。
Conclusion: 摘要指出结果反驳了简单的骨干保留假设，并揭示了JPEG质量对净化检测信号的关键影响（Q70处信号崩溃）。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Rician Distribution as a Physically Interpretable Model for Wind-Speed Statistics
papers.abstract_en: The statistics of atmospheric wind variations are commonly modeled using Gaussian or Weibull forms, which often trade physical interpretability against statistical accuracy, especially in the distribution tails. Here we derive a Rician distribution for wind speed from a simple physical model based on two orthogonal Gaussian velocity components with a non-zero mean in the preferred direction. Using wind-speed records from four geographically distinct wind farms, we show that the Rician model consistently outperforms the Gaussian model and remains competitive with the Weibull model. The same behavior persists when the data are partitioned into monthly windows, where the Rician parameters also provide a transparent description of seasonal and geographic variability, compared to Weibull parameters. In addition, the model naturally connects Gaussian-like and Weibull-like regimes through the Rician parameter ratio $μ/σ$, making the Rician distribution a compact and physically interpretable two-parameter model for wind-speed statistics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从物理模型出发，将风速视为两个正交高斯速度分量的合成（其中一个方向非零均值），推导出风速服从 Rician 分布。基于四个不同地理区域的风电场实测数据，该分布在统计拟合上一致优于高斯分布，与 Weibull 分布性能相当；在月度窗口中，Rician 参数能更清晰地描述季节和地理变化，且通过参数比 μ/σ 自然衔接高斯型与 Weibull 型行为，成为一种物理可解释的两参数风速统计模型。
Motivation: 常用高斯或 Weibull 模型在拟合风速分布时往往在物理可解释性与统计精度（尤其是尾部）之间权衡，缺乏一个既简洁又具有清晰物理背景的模型。
Method: 基于正交高斯速度分量（一个方向有非零均值）的物理图像，推导出风速幅值服从 Rician 分布；利用四个风电场的长期风速记录进行月度与整体拟合，并与高斯、Weibull 模型比较。
Result: Rician 模型在所有数据集上均优于高斯模型，与 Weibull 模型统计性能相近；参数 μ/σ 能区分不同季节和地域，且自然覆盖从近高斯到近 Weibull 的分布形状。
Conclusion: Rician 分布是一个紧凑、物理可解释的两参数风速统计模型，既保持统计竞争力，又提供清晰的季节与地理变化描述。

papers.title: Distributed Constraint Optimization via Online Learning and Iterative Pricing with Application to Large-Scale Satellite Scheduling
papers.abstract_en: Distributed constraint optimization problems (DCOPs) provide a popular framework for distributed decision making under limited communication, but many real-world instances are too large to solve monolithically. We address this challenge from two complementary directions. We revisit the connection between DCOPs and potential games, and adapt modern online learning algorithms for equilibrium finding to DCOPs. We show that these algorithms are competitive with representative incomplete DCOP algorithms. We then turn to decomposition frameworks for large-scale DCOPs, motivated by large-scale decentralized satellite scheduling. We propose a new framework that separates a DCOP into two interacting subproblems: a high-level meta-DCOP for task allocation, and independent local optimization problems for scheduling. To couple the two levels, we develop a novel iterative pricing method that updates the meta-level utilities using feedback from the local optimizers. Combining our online learning methods with our iterative pricing framework, we obtain near-optimal performance on real-world decentralized satellite scheduling problem instances, fulfilling over 99% of observation requests compared with 87% for state-of-the-art baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从两个互补方向解决大规模分布式约束优化问题：一是重新审视了DCOP与势博弈的联系，并采用现代在线学习算法寻找均衡，证明它们与代表性不完整DCOP算法竞争力相当；二是针对大规模星群调度提出一种新框架，将DCOP分解为高层元DCOP（任务分配）和独立局部调度优化，并通过迭代定价方法耦合两层。结合在线学习与迭代定价，在真实星群调度实例上实现了99%以上的观测请求满足率，优于基线方法的87%。
Motivation: 现有DCOP方法在处理大规模实际问题时，因通信限制和计算复杂性难以整体求解，亟需可扩展的分解与学习机制。
Method: 提出两层次框架：高层元DCOP负责任务分配，低层独立局部优化负责调度；通过迭代定价方法，利用局部优化反馈更新高层效用，并采用在线学习算法进行全局均衡求解。
Result: 在真实大规模分散卫星调度问题中，方法满足超过99%的观测请求，而最先进基线仅为87%，实现了近最优性能。
Conclusion: 本文展示了将在线学习与分解定价相结合有效处理大规模DCOP的潜力，为复杂分布式决策提供了新途径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Lowering the implementation barrier of neutral-atom quantum computing with agentic workflows
papers.abstract_en: Quantum computers are moving from research laboratories to industrial machines accessible via the cloud and integrated into high-performance computing facilities. However, translating theoretical quantum protocols into hardware experiments remains a major bottleneck, requiring expertise across protocol design, compilation, simulation, and cloud execution. Here, we introduce an agentic workflow that automates this pipeline on neutral-atom quantum processors (here two Pasqal QPUs available on the cloud) while keeping the researcher in the loop for critical validation. In three case studies from many-body physics and optimization, the agent went from published paper or patent to a QPU campaign run overnight. In particular, human intervention was crucial to ensure scientific validity: the agent selected an inadequate observable in one experiment and constructed a plausible but incorrect hardware diagnosis in another, with both failures detected only through domain-expert review. Finally, we use a second agent to classify a corpus of 633 Rydberg-array arXiv papers and show that nearly half are implementable on present-day QPUs while identifying specific hardware upgrades needed for the rest. Together, these results demonstrate that agentic workflows provide a practical bridge between theoretical ideas and physical hardware, opening quantum experimentation to a much broader scientific community.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对中性原子量子处理器（如Pasqal QPU）提出一种代理工作流（agentic workflow），自动化从理论方案设计到硬件实验的完整管线，同时保留研究人员进行关键验证。在三个多体物理和优化案例中，代理从已发表论文或专利出发，过夜即完成QPU运行。但在一个实验中，代理选择了不恰当的可观测量；在另一个实验中，它构造了看似合理但错误的硬件诊断，两次错误均仅通过领域专家审查被发现。此外，使用第二个代理对633篇Rydberg阵列arXiv论文进行分类，显示近半数可在当前QPU上实现，并识别出剩余实验所需的特定硬件升级。
Motivation: 将理论量子协议转化为硬件实验仍是主要瓶颈，需要协议设计、编译、模拟和云执行等多领域专业知识，该工作旨在降低实施门槛。
Method: 引入一种代理工作流，自动化从理论到中性原子量子处理器实验的完整流程，同时保留人类专家进行关键验证；并利用第二个代理对arXiv论文进行可实施性分类。
Result: 在三个案例中，代理从论文/专利到QPU运行过夜完成，但出现两次错误（不当可观测量、错误硬件诊断），仅由专家审查发现。分类结果显示近半数Rydberg论文可在当前QPU实现。
Conclusion: 代理工作流为理论想法与物理硬件之间提供了实用桥梁，有望让更广泛的科学社区参与量子实验。

papers.title: Beyond Static Costs: Learning-Dynamics Aware Loss Functions for Long-Tailed Classification
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning models in computer vision face significant challenges when trained on long-tailed datasets, where a few majority classes dominate while many minority classes are severely underrepresented. Such imbalances frequently arise in real-world scenarios such as rare species recognition, manufacturing fault detection, and medical image understanding, leading to biased models that underperform on tail classes. Existing reweighting methods typically rely on static class frequencies to penalize the model, ignoring the dynamic nature of how effectively a network actually learns a class over time. We address this by introducing a novel Learning-Dynamics Aware Loss (LDAL) function that shifts the focus from static sample counts to dynamic learning progress. LDAL framework adjusts class weights continuously by leveraging: (i) the strength of learned feature representations (semantic scale), (ii) the intrinsic learning difficulty of each class, measured via the Shannon entropy of its predictions, and (iii) an inter-epoch regularizer term that tracks prediction shifts between consecutive epochs to stabilize training and avoid local minima. LDAL is purely a objective function which incurs negligible computational overhead while adapting to the feature learning of the model. Experimental results on multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate that our approach significantly surpasses state-of-the-art reweighting loss functions, providing an optimal trade-off between accuracy and generalizability. The source code is available at https://github.com/sdm2026/ldal
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种学习动态感知损失函数（LDAL），用于长尾分类问题，通过动态调整类权重来替代静态重加权方法。该方法利用特征表示的语义尺度、预测熵作为学习难度、以及 epoch 间正则化项来稳定训练。实验表明在多个基准数据集上超越现有重加权损失函数。
Motivation: 现有重加权方法基于静态类频率，忽略了网络在实际学习过程中对各类别的动态学习效果，导致尾部类性能不佳。
Method: 提出 Learning-Dynamics Aware Loss (LDAL) 函数，动态调整类权重，结合三个因素：学习到的特征表示强度（语义尺度）、每个类别的内在学习难度（通过预测的香农熵衡量）、以及 epoch 间正则化项（跟踪预测变化以稳定训练）。
Result: 在多个基准数据集上超越现有最先进的重加权损失函数，实现了准确率和泛化能力的最佳权衡，且计算开销可忽略。
Conclusion: LDAL 是一种纯目标函数，无需修改模型结构，适用于长尾视觉分类任务。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Prototype Adaptation for Zero-Shot sEMG Movement Classification
papers.abstract_en: Surface electromyography (sEMG) enables the control of prostheses, allowing upper-limb amputees to re-gain some hand function. Most current research focuses on recognizing basic movements for prosthesis control. However, in most daily activities, such as opening a door, combined movements are essential. However, collecting training data for all possible combined movements is time-consuming and requires re-training of the model for any new combination. We propose two novel recognition approaches, Compositional Prototype Interpolation (CPI) and Synthetic Adaptation for Prototypes (SAP), that enable zero-shot learning of combined, novel and unseen movements in Prototype Networks after training only with basic movements. Our methods rest on a linear interpolation assumption in the embedding space, which we study by inspecting the geometry of combined motions in signal and embedding space. In experiments on the NearLab and NinaPro DB3 data sets as well as our newly recorded BasCom dataset, our proposed SAP outperforms prior zero-shot learning methods with accuracy improvements on combined movements of more than 20%. This advantage is maintained in online inference experiments in a user study.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对表面肌电信号（sEMG）假肢控制中的组合运动零样本分类问题，提出两种方法：组合原型插值（CPI）和合成原型适应（SAP）。基于嵌入空间中线性插值的假设，SAP在NearLab、NinaPro DB3和新收集的BasCom数据集上，对组合运动的分类准确率相比现有零样本方法提升超过20%，并在在线用户研究中保持优势。
Motivation: 目前sEMG研究主要识别基本运动，但日常活动需要组合运动；收集所有组合运动数据耗时且需重新训练模型，限制了假肢的实用性。
Method: 提出两种基于原型网络的零样本方法：CPI和SAP。核心假设是嵌入空间中组合运动的原型可由基本运动原型线性插值得到，并通过分析信号和嵌入空间的几何验证该假设。
Result: 在NearLab、NinaPro DB3和BasCom数据集上，SAP方法对组合运动的分类准确率相比先前零样本方法提升超过20%，在在线推理实验中同样保持优势。
Conclusion: 摘要强调SAP在零样本组合运动分类上显著优于现有方法，适用于假肢控制的实用场景。

papers.title: Food Image Segmentation with LLM-Derived Ingredient Labels and Multimodal Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Food image segmentation plays a vital role in health-related applications such as nutrition tracking and personalized health monitoring. However, existing models often underperform on visually similar ingredients and rare food categories. To address this issue, we propose two plug-and-play multimodal modules that enhance the segmentation performance by leveraging ingredient labels inferred from food images using large language models (LLMs). The first module, called LIM-F (Language Injection Module for Features), is designed to pair with any image encoder that produces multi-layer outputs (e.g., Swin Transformer), while the second module, LIM-Q (Language Injection Module for Queries), targets Mask2Former-style Transformer-based decoders. Both modules enable training without the need for pre-aligning images with text by directly injecting semantic ingredient information into the visual analysis pipeline. On the FoodSeg103 benchmark, the proposed method achieves state-of-the-art performance. Specifically, integrating LIM-Q into the Mask2Former decoder with a Swin-L image encoder yields a mean Intersection over Union (mIoU) of 55.0. LIM-F also demonstrates strong generalization and competitive performance, reaching an mIoU of 54.4 under the same model (Swin-L+Mask2Former). Furthermore, its applicability extends beyond Transformer-based decoders, as evidenced by an improvement from 47.7 to 49.8 mIoU when integrated into a CNN-based architecture. Notably, the improved segmentation accuracy is achieved with only a moderate (at most 3.8 GB) increase in the GPU memory consumption during training. Thus, the proposed approach offers a practical and scalable solution for fine-grained food understanding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对食品图像分割中视觉相似成分和稀有类别分割性能不佳的问题，提出两个即插即用的多模态模块（LIM-F和LIM-Q），利用大语言模型从食品图像推断出的成分标签，注入语义信息以增强分割效果。在FoodSeg103基准上，结合Swin-L图像编码器和Mask2Former解码器，LIM-Q达到55.0 mIoU，LIM-F达到54.4 mIoU，且仅适度增加训练显存消耗。
Motivation: 现有食品图像分割模型在处理视觉相似的食材和罕见食品类别时往往表现不佳，限制了营养追踪等健康应用的精度。
Method: 提出两个即插即用的模块：LIM-F通过注入大语言模型推断的成分标签增强图像编码器的多层特征；LIM-Q通过类似方式增强Mask2Former风格的Transformer解码器的查询向量，无需预对齐图像和文本。
Result: 在FoodSeg103上，LIM-Q（Swin-L+Mask2Former）达到55.0 mIoU；LIM-F达到54.4 mIoU；将LIM-F集成到CNN架构中将mIoU从47.7提升至49.8。训练显存增加最多仅3.8 GB。
Conclusion: 该方法提供了一种实用且可扩展的细粒度食品理解方案，通过LLM衍生标签的多模态融合有效提升了分割性能。

papers.title: SepPrune:A Separator-based Pruning Framework for Efficient Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs), such as Qwen2.5-VL and InternVL3, generate large numbers of vision tokens for high-resolution inputs, leading to substantial computational cost. Existing vision token pruning methods either depend on cross-modal attention and cannot prune before the prefill stage, or rely on diversity estimation with high computational overhead. We observe that attention scores from both vision and text tokens peak at modality separator tokens, suggesting that these separators bridge the two modalities. Based on this observation, we propose SepPrune, an efficient, training-free, plug-and-play pruning method that uses the separator token as a unified query to rank and select informative vision tokens. SepPrune reuses the LLM's built-in projection parameters and requires no architectural changes. Experiments on Qwen2.5-VL-7B show that SepPrune achieves state-of-the-art performance, retaining 96.3% of the original accuracy while removing 80.2% of vision tokens.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出SepPrune，一种基于模态分隔符（separator token）的视觉token剪枝方法，用于多模态大语言模型。该方法无需训练，即插即用，利用LLM内置投影参数，在Qwen2.5-VL-7B上剪枝80.2%视觉token，保留96.3%原始精度。
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型处理高分辨率输入时生成大量视觉token，计算成本高。现有剪枝方法或依赖跨模态注意力（无法在预填充前剪枝），或依赖高开销的多样性估计，效率不足。
Method: 观察到视觉和文本token的注意力分数在模态分隔符处达到峰值，提出用分隔符token作为统一查询来排序和选择信息性视觉token；复用LLM内置投影参数，无需架构修改。
Result: 在Qwen2.5-VL-7B上，SepPrune达到最新最优性能，移除80.2%视觉token的同时保留96.3%的原始准确率。
Conclusion: SepPrune是一种高效、无需训练、即插即用的视觉token剪枝方案，能够显著降低计算成本而不显著损失性能。

papers.title: Speculate While You Reason: Teaching Agents to Predict Their Next Tool Call via Joint Agent-Speculator RL
papers.abstract_en: Large language model agents often spend substantial wall-clock time waiting for tool call results. Tool-call speculation can hide this latency by predicting and pre-executing an agent's next tool call if the prediction matches the agent's eventual tool call, but existing speculators are typically separate draft models or cached traces that are poorly aligned with the deployed agent's own behavior. We identify this speculator-agent gap and show that the target agent itself is a strong next-call speculator. This points to a simpler design: unifying the agent and speculator within the same model. In this paper, we introduce the self-speculating agent, a single model that both solves tasks in agent mode and predicts its next tool call from partial trajectories in speculator mode, fully reusing prefix KV cache. To enable this dual-mode agent without degrading performance, we propose a joint agent-speculator reinforcement learning method, which derives speculation targets from the agent's own rollouts and alternates agent and speculator updates. Across agentic search QA and conversational tool-use agentic tasks, our method improves average next tool-call Hit@1 from 44.1 to 61.2 for Qwen3-4B and from 48.9 to 66.3 for Qwen3.5-4B, while preserving agent task success.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出自推测代理（self-speculating agent），将代理与推测器统一在同一模型中，通过联合代理-推测器强化学习（joint agent-speculator RL）来预测下一个工具调用，从而减少等待工具结果的延迟。实验表明，该方法在问答和对话式工具使用任务上显著提高了下一个工具调用的准确率（Hit@1），同时保持了代理任务成功率。
Motivation: 大语言模型代理在等待工具调用结果时存在较长延迟，现有工具调用推测方法通常使用单独的草案模型或缓存，与部署代理的行为不对齐。作者指出目标代理本身就是一个强大的下一个调用预测器，因此可以简化设计。
Method: 提出自推测代理（self-speculating agent），一个模型同时支持代理模式（解决任务）和推测模式（从部分轨迹预测下一个工具调用），完全复用前缀KV缓存。采用联合代理-推测器强化学习方法，从代理自身的轨迹中导出推测目标，并交替更新代理和推测器。
Result: 在搜索问答和对话式工具使用任务中，该方法将Qwen3-4B的下一个工具调用Hit@1从44.1提升到61.2，Qwen3.5-4B从48.9提升到66.3，同时保持代理任务成功率。
Conclusion: 论文表明，将代理和推测器统一在同一模型中，并采用联合强化学习训练，可以有效提高工具调用预测的准确性，减少代理延迟。

papers.title: Freq-RemoteVAR: Next-Frequency Autoregressive Modeling for Remote Sensing Change Detection
papers.abstract_en: Remote sensing change detection aims to identify land-cover changes from bi-temporal images. Most existing methods follow a one-shot dense prediction paradigm, directly regressing a change mask from fused features. However, such approaches overlook the intrinsic frequency characteristics of change patterns. We propose Freq-RemoteVAR, a frequency autoregressive framework that reformulates change detection as a structured generation problem in the frequency domain. Instead of predicting the change mask in a single step, we introduce a next-frequency prediction paradigm, where change information is progressively generated from coarse to fine. We design a frequency-aware mask tokenization strategy that decomposes change supervision into multi-frequency token targets via Fourier transformation and quantization. We develop a Frequency VAR Transformer, which performs causal autoregressive modeling over frequency tokens. The model starts from learned mask queries and progressively predicts frequency-level tokens conditioned on previously generated tokens and bi-temporal image features, effectively capturing long-range dependencies across frequency scales. We introduce Scale-Aligned RoPE Cross Attention (SRCA) module, which aligns frequency-domain mask queries with spatial-domain bi-temporal features under a unified coordinate system, enhancing spatial-frequency consistency during generation. We propose a Change-quality Control module that adaptively modulates the generation process through dynamic normalization, attention biasing, and spatial offset adjustment, thereby suppressing pseudo-change responses and improving robustness. Extensive experiments on CDD, GZ-CD, and LEVIR-CD demonstrate that Freq-RemoteVAR consistently outperforms existing methods, particularly in challenging scenarios with complex appearance variations and noisy disturbances.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Freq-RemoteVAR，将遥感变化检测重构为频域中的结构化生成问题，引入下一频率预测范式。方法包括频率感知掩码分词、频率VAR Transformer、尺度对齐RoPE交叉注意力（SRCA）和变化质量控制模块。在CDD、GZ-CD和LEVIR-CD数据集上，该方法一致优于现有方法，尤其在复杂外观变化和噪声干扰场景下。
Motivation: 现有变化检测方法采用单步密集预测范式，忽视变化模式的内在频率特性，难以捕捉多尺度变化信息。
Method: 提出频率自回归框架：首先通过傅里叶变换和量化将变化监督分解为多频率token目标；然后使用频率VAR Transformer对频率token进行因果自回归建模，从学习到的mask query开始逐步预测；引入SRCA模块对齐频域mask query与空域双时相特征；并设计变化质量控制模块通过动态归一化、注意力偏置和空间偏移调整来抑制伪变化。
Result: 在CDD、GZ-CD和LEVIR-CD数据集上，Freq-RemoteVAR一致优于现有方法，尤其在复杂外观变化和噪声干扰场景中表现更优。
Conclusion: 频率自回归建模可有效捕捉频率尺度上的长程依赖，提升变化检测的鲁棒性和准确性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Explicit Layer Modeling for Video Object Insertion and Layer Decomposition
papers.abstract_en: Most video editing systems still lack explicit layered video representations, limiting their ability to perform realistic compositing, object reuse, and consistent manipulation. This limitation is especially pronounced in video object insertion and video layer decomposition, where existing methods rely on implicit inference or per-scene optimization due to the absence of explicit foreground-layer supervision. We introduce TriLayer, a large-scale triplet video dataset containing aligned composite, background, and foreground videos, where the foreground layers include both object appearance and associated visual effects. This explicit supervision enables models to learn layered video representations directly rather than inferring them implicitly. Building on this dataset, we propose DBL-Diffusion, a dual-branch diffusion framework that jointly models RGB composites and RGBA foreground layers through shared denoising and cross-branch interaction. We instantiate the framework in two tasks: DBL-Insert for layered object insertion, which generates explicit RGBA layers for realistic compositing and flexible post-editing, and DBL-Decompose for video layer decomposition, which recovers foreground and background layers using triplet supervision. Experiments demonstrate that explicit layer modeling substantially improves both insertion fidelity and decomposition quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视频编辑缺乏显式分层表示的问题，提出TriLayer数据集和DBL-Diffusion框架。TriLayer包含对齐的合成、背景和前景视频，显式提供前景层监督；DBL-Diffusion是双分支扩散模型，联合建模RGB合成和RGBA前景层，通过共享去噪和跨分支交互实现分层对象插入（DBL-Insert）和视频层分解（DBL-Decompose）。实验表明显式层建模显著提升插入保真度和分解质量。
Motivation: 现有视频编辑系统缺乏显式分层视频表示，导致合成、对象复用和一致编辑能力受限，尤其在视频对象插入和层分解任务中，方法依赖隐式推理或每场景优化。
Method: 提出TriLayer大规模三元组视频数据集（合成、背景、前景视频），提供显式前景层监督。基于此提出DBL-Diffusion双分支扩散框架，包含DBL-Insert（分层对象插入）和DBL-Decompose（视频层分解），通过共享去噪和跨分支交互联合建模RGB合成和RGBA前景层。
Result: 实验证明显式层建模显著提高插入保真度和分解质量，具体数值未在摘要中给出。
Conclusion: 显式层建模和对应数据集能够有效提升视频编辑任务性能，为后续分层视频表示学习提供新方向。
