papers.title: OmniPhys: Knowledge-Graph-Driven Benchmarking and Collective Optimization for Physical Commonsense in Text-to-Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: While text-to-image models exhibit remarkable visual fidelity, they frequently violate fundamental physical commonsense. Existing benchmarks often rely on coarse-grained descriptions, failing to diagnose the mastery of specific physical principles. Moreover, the high stochasticity of generative processes causes current prompt optimization methods to suffer from gradient hallucinations, where optimizers are misled by transient visual artifacts rather than systemic flaws. To address these challenges, we introduce OmniPhys, a rigorous benchmark of 1,551 samples grounded in a Physical Knowledge Graph. By aligning PhET simulations with standard curricula, OmniPhys operationalizes a knowledge-to-scenario pipeline that performs diagnostic stress tests via a dual-path verification protocol. We further propose OmniPrompt, an iterative framework that treats physical alignment as a discrete optimization problem. For each query, OmniPrompt aggregates K stochastic images into a per-query feedback buffer. Across training, it further merges feedback from batches of B queries before each meta-policy update, filtering seed and query-local noise. Evaluations across 12 representative text-to-image models reveal universal physical bottlenecks. Results demonstrate that OmniPrompt significantly enhances physical consistency across diverse backbones, proving the transferability and efficacy of our evolved meta-policies. The code and data are available at https://github.com/zjukg/OmniPhys
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出OmniPhys，一个基于物理知识图谱的文本到图像生成物理常识基准，包含1551个样本，并设计了OmniPrompt迭代优化框架，通过聚合随机图像反馈来改进物理一致性。在12个模型上评估，OmniPrompt显著提升了物理一致性。
Motivation: 现有文本到图像模型经常违反基本物理常识，而现有基准缺乏对具体物理原理的诊断能力，且提示优化方法易受梯度幻觉影响。
Method: 构建物理知识图谱，结合PhET模拟和标准课程，通过知识到场景管道生成样本，并使用双路径验证协议进行诊断测试。提出OmniPrompt，将物理对齐视为离散优化问题，通过每查询反馈缓冲区和批量合并过滤噪声。
Result: 在12个代表性文本到图像模型上评估，OmniPrompt显著提升了物理一致性，证明了元策略的可迁移性和有效性。
Conclusion: OmniPhys基准和OmniPrompt优化方法有效诊断和改进了文本到图像生成中的物理常识，代码和数据已公开。

papers.title: F(AI)2R: Who Did What, and Who Checked? Verifiable AI Provenance as an Executable Skill
papers.abstract_en: F(AI)2R is FAIR research with AI in the loop, twice: an AI-assisted authoring pass and a machine-readable audit pass over every artefact. AI systems now draft, refactor, and verify research artefacts, yet their contributions are rarely recorded in a form a later human or machine can audit. Building on the original F(AI)2R experiment, we generalize its provenance model beyond scholarly writing into aiprov, a PROV-O extension covering any AI-in-the-loop artefact, and we package the method as an executable skill that an AI agent operates itself: setup asks the human operator for their ORCID ID, resolves their identity from the public registry, and scaffolds continuous integration that gates every push on graph conformance and publishes the current build of this very paper. The paper is its own case study. Every activity, claim, and source in its production is recorded in the repository's provenance graph under two invariants: no parentless claim, and verification rungs that only humans may grant.

papers.title: Using Data-Derived Priors to Guide CNN Architecture Design for NIR Chemometrics
papers.abstract_en: Convolutional neural networks (CNN) for near-infrared (NIR) chemometrics are often designed using generic architectural rules, although spectral datasets differ in sampling, smoothness, redundancy, and sample size. We tested whether these properties can provide empirical priors for CNN design. Across 25 NIR regression tasks, we computed descriptors of dataset size, spectral length and spacing, entropy, intrinsic rank, autocorrelation, and wavelet-scale structure. Two interpretable 1D-CNN scaffolds (a minimal single-convolution model and an extended shallow model with optional branching, dilation, etc) were optimized using five-fold cross-validated Bayesian hyperparameter optimization (HPO). Relationships extracted from near-optimal trials were converted into warm-start heuristics and evaluated directly and through leave-one-dataset-out (LODO) validation. The clearest relationships involved convolutional receptive fields. In the minimal CNN, the preferred kernel fraction decreased with spectral entropy and intrinsic rank, increased with the wavelet energy-support fraction, and the learning rate tended to decrease with training-set size. Direct and LODO heuristics were competitive with HPO, with median test-RMSE ratios of 0.953 and 1.017, respectively. The extended CNN showed similar but less transferable structure across branch usage, dilation, dropout, filter counts, and receptive-field choices. Ten stochastic refits showed seed sensitivity comparable to that of HPO-selected configurations. In a separate experiment, joint preprocessing and CNN HPO outperformed standardized-spectra HPO in 19 of 25 tasks, although gains were dataset-dependent. These results show that spectral descriptors can provide practical CNN design priors, guiding shallow NIR models toward plausible hyperparameter regions before target-specific tuning

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对近红外（NIR）光谱化学计量学中的卷积神经网络（CNN）设计问题，提出利用光谱数据集的内在属性（如熵、内在秩、自相关等）作为经验先验来指导CNN超参数选择。在25个NIR回归任务上，通过贝叶斯超参数优化发现卷积感受野与光谱描述符之间存在清晰关系，并基于此生成热启动启发式规则。实验表明，直接和留一数据集验证的启发式规则与完整超参数优化性能相近（中位测试RMSE比值分别为0.953和1.017），而联合预处理与CNN超参数优化在大部分任务上优于单独优化。
Motivation: 当前NIR化学计量学中的CNN设计通常依赖通用架构规则，忽视了不同光谱数据集在采样、平滑度、冗余度和样本量上的差异，导致超参数选择效率低且性能不稳定。
Method: 计算25个NIR回归任务的数据集大小、光谱长度与间距、熵、内在秩、自相关和小波尺度结构等描述符；设计两种可解释的1D-CNN骨架（最小单卷积模型和扩展浅层模型），通过五折交叉验证贝叶斯超参数优化获取近最优配置；将优化结果中的关系转化为热启动启发式规则，并采用直接验证和留一数据集验证评估其效果。
Result: 在最小CNN中，偏好卷积核比例随光谱熵和内在秩增加而减小，随小波能量支撑比例增加而增大，学习率随训练集大小增大而减小；直接和留一数据集启发式规则的中位测试RMSE比值分别为0.953和1.017，与完整超参数优化竞争力相当；联合预处理与CNN超参数优化在25个任务中的19个上优于单独优化，但增益依赖于数据集。
Conclusion: 光谱描述符可为NIR浅层CNN提供实用的设计先验，将超参数搜索引导至合理区域后再进行任务特定微调，从而降低优化成本并提升性能。

papers.title: AIriskEval-edu Demo: Auditing of Pedagogical Risks in Educational Explanations
papers.abstract_en: We present AIriskEval-edu Demo, a platform that audits the pedagogical quality of instructional explanations and provides explainable audit results. The platform evaluates an explanation against a rubric covering five dimensions of pedagogical risk: factual accuracy, depth and completeness, focus and relevance, student-level appropriateness, and ideological bias. For each dimension, it returns a binary decision and a confidence score. Detected risks also include a natural-language rationale and, except for Depth and Completeness, a localized evidence span. The platform integrates GPT-5.5 through an external API and a self-hosted Llama 3.1 8B evaluator that runs on consumer-grade GPUs. The local evaluator is fine-tuned on AIriskEval-edu, a dataset of K-12 instructional explanations with risk and explainability annotations. The platform operates in two modes: in AI mode, both evaluators assess stored explanations generated under six simulated teacher profiles, each representing a distinct pedagogical behavior and potential risk; in human mode, the local evaluator audits user-written explanations in real time. The local evaluator outperforms GPT-5.5 on most reported metrics, offering educational institutions a practical way to keep audited content within their own infrastructure.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at the 17th IAPR International Workshop on Document Analysis Systems (DAS 2026), ICDAR 2026, September 3, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍AIriskEval-edu Demo平台，用于审计教育解释的教学质量，从五个维度评估教学风险：事实准确性、深度和完整性、重点和相关性、学生适宜性、意识形态偏见。平台集成了GPT-5.5和基于Llama 3.1 8B的本地评估器，在K-12教育解释数据集上微调，支持AI模式和人工模式。本地评估器在多数指标上优于GPT-5.5。
Motivation: 教育解释中存在多种教学风险（如事实错误、意识形态偏见等），需要自动化审计工具来保障教学质量，同时满足教育机构对数据隐私和基础设施控制的需求。
Method: 构建了一个包含五个维度教学风险的评估框架，开发了基于Llama 3.1 8B的本地评估器，在AIriskEval-edu数据集上微调，并集成GPT-5.5作为对比。平台提供两种模式：AI模式评估六个模拟教师画像生成的解释；人工模式实时审计用户编写的解释。
Result: 本地评估器在大多数评估指标上优于GPT-5.5，且能在消费级GPU上运行，为教育机构提供了保留审计内容在自有基础设施内的实用方案。
Conclusion: 该平台展示了通过微调开源模型实现高质量、可解释的教学风险审计的可行性，且能保护数据隐私。

papers.title: Construction-Driven Injection: Linguistically-Grounded Edit-Based Code-Mixing Fingerprints for Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are costly intellectual assets that remain exposed to unauthorized redistribution and commercial misuse. Injected fingerprints, i.e., trigger--target pairs embedded in model behavior, offer a practical, black-box-verifiable ownership signal, but existing methods decouple the two stages of the fingerprint life cycle: how a fingerprint is constructed and how it is injected. Existing fingerprinting frameworks suffer from two limitations. Natural-language fingerprints are prone to accidental activation, and garbled fingerprints are easily filtered by perplexity-based detection. Furthermore, decoupling construction from injection leaves the latter unaware of the trigger's linguistic structure, missing the opportunity for targeted optimization. We argue that fingerprint construction should drive injection, and present a unified fingerprinting framework that jointly optimizes both stages. First, LCF constructs code-mixing fingerprints by combining low-resource languages under a semantic-density substitution rule and grammar-biased mixing, yielding triggers whose perplexity sits far below garbled baselines while avoiding the accidental-activation failures of natural-language triggers. Second, LCFEdit injects each fingerprint with a null-space projection derived from high-resource multilingual representations that preserves knowledge, augmented by a cross-lingual alignment step that steers the weight update toward the fingerprint language's representation subspace. This construction-aware injection ensures that the update is linguistically informed and therefore more stable. Extensive evaluations on imperceptibility, detectability, and harmlessness demonstrate persistent ownership verification with negligible impact on utility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种统一的大语言模型指纹注入框架，将指纹构建与注入两个阶段联合优化。构建阶段通过低资源语言的语义密度替换和语法偏置混合生成代码混合指纹，使其困惑度远低于乱码基线且避免自然语言指纹的意外激活；注入阶段利用高资源多语言表示的空空间投影和跨语言对齐更新模型权重，实现更稳定的所有权验证。实验表明该方法在不可感知性、可检测性和无害性上表现良好。
Motivation: 现有指纹注入方法将构建与注入解耦，导致自然语言指纹易意外激活，乱码指纹易被困惑度检测过滤，且注入阶段无法利用触发词的 linguistic 结构进行针对性优化。
Method: 提出 LCF 构建代码混合指纹（语义密度替换与语法偏置混合），以及 LCFEdit 注入方法（基于高资源多语言表示的空空间投影与跨语言对齐）。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在不可感知性、可检测性和无害性上的全面评估，验证了持续的所有权认证且对模型效用影响可忽略。
Conclusion: 作者认为指纹构建应驱动注入，联合优化两阶段可得到更稳定、隐蔽的指纹。

papers.title: A Human-in-the-Loop Corpus for LLM-Based Simplification of Scientific Summaries
papers.abstract_en: Interdisciplinary research is accelerating, yet scientific papers remain difficult to understand outside their home fields. We study large language model (LLM)-based simplification of scientific texts and present a human-in-the-loop workflow that transforms expert summaries into more accessible versions for non-specialists. Using SciSummNet as the source corpus, we first generate baseline simplifications with GPT-4o-mini. In Phase 1, readers from STEM fields outside computer science identify difficult sentences and phrases and compare the original and GPT-simplified summaries in terms of comprehensibility, naturalness, and simplicity. In Phase 2, computer science experts use this feedback to create expert-edited reference simplifications. We release the resulting corpus together with human judgments and automatic evaluation results. The Phase 1 judgments show a clear preference for the GPT-generated summaries in terms of comprehensibility and simplicity, while qualitative analysis of the Phase 2 edits highlights the importance of preserving domain-specific terminology and the strength of scientific claims. The resulting resource supports the training and benchmarking of simplification systems for cross-disciplinary scientific communication.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种人机协作的工作流，利用大语言模型（LLM）和专家反馈来简化科学摘要，使其对非专业读者更易理解。研究基于SciSummNet数据集，先由GPT-4o-mini生成简化版本，再由跨领域读者和计算机科学专家进行两阶段反馈与编辑。最终发布包含人工判断和自动评估结果的语料库，以支持跨学科科学交流中的简化系统训练和基准测试。
Motivation: 跨学科研究日益重要，但科学论文对非本领域读者难以理解，现有简化方法缺乏针对专家摘要的标注资源和迭代优化流程。
Method: 人类在环工作流：先使用GPT-4o-mini生成基线简化摘要；Phase 1中，非计算机科学STEM读者识别难句并比较原始与简化版本的易理解性、自然性和简洁性；Phase 2中，计算机科学专家根据反馈创建专家编辑的参考简化版本。最终发布包含人工判断和自动评估的语料库。
Result: Phase 1的人工判断显示，GPT生成的摘要更易理解和简洁；Phase 2的定性分析表明，保留领域特定术语和科学主张的强度至关重要。
Conclusion: 该语料库可支持训练和评测跨学科科学交流的简化系统，强调术语保留与科学准确性之间的平衡。

summary_sections.motivation: 跨学科研究日益重要，但科学论文对非本领域读者难以理解，现有简化方法缺乏针对专家摘要的标注资源和迭代优化流程。

papers.title: Joint Text-Audio Alignment for EEG-to-Text Decoding in Chinese Speech Production and Perception
papers.abstract_en: Decoding speech information directly from scalp electroencephalography (EEG) into text provides a potential non-invasive neural communication pathway for individuals with severe speech and motor impairments. Compared with invasive approaches such as electrocorticography, EEG is safer and more widely deployable, yet substantially more challenging to decode.This challenge is exacerbated for Chinese sentence decoding, which must handle a high-dimensional output space with thousands of characters, severe inter-subject variability, and low signal-to-noise ratios for text alignment.Existing methods commit to a single supervisory axis---either text semantics or audio acoustic features---yet neither can simultaneously satisfy the demands of sentence-level discriminability and fine-grained temporal resolution required for large-vocabulary Chinese decoding. We introduce EEGAlign, a novel parameter-efficient framework that jointly aligns EEG with two axes---text alignment with BGE-M3 text embeddings and audio alignment with wav2vec~2.0 speech features via contrastive learning followed by CTC character-sequence decoding. On ChineseEEG-2 data, EEGAlign yields state-of-the-art closed-set sentence classification performance, reaching up to 82.37% Top-1 accuracy on Reading Aloud EEG and 41.43% on Passive Listening EEG out of 101 candidates. Ablation studies show that the two alignment axes are highly complementary: combining them yields consistently better performance than either alone. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study on decoding large-vocabulary Chinese sentences from non-invasive EEG during overt speech production, and achieving strong classification performance with relatively large closed-set candidate-sentence setting.

TL;DR: 本文提出 EEGAlign 框架，通过联合文本对齐（BGE-M3 文本嵌入）和音频对齐（wav2vec 2.0 语音特征）的对比学习及 CTC 字符解码，从头皮脑电（EEG）解码中文句子。在 ChineseEEG-2 数据上，朗读和被动听力任务的 Top-1 准确率分别达到 82.37% 和 41.43%（101 候选），两个对齐轴互补，性能超过单一轴。这是首次从非侵入式 EEG 解码大词表中文句子。
Motivation: 现有方法仅依赖文本语义或音频声学特征单一监督轴，无法同时满足句子级判别性和细粒度时间分辨率需求，导致大词表中文 EEG 解码困难。
Method: 提出参数高效的 EEGAlign 框架，联合两个对齐轴：文本对齐使用 BGE-M3 嵌入，音频对齐使用 wav2vec 2.0 特征，通过对比学习训练，再以 CTC 进行字符序列解码。
Result: 在 ChineseEEG-2 数据上，朗读 EEG 达到 82.37% Top-1 准确率，被动听力 EEG 达到 41.43% Top-1 准确率（101 候选）。消融实验显示两个对齐轴互补，联合优于单独使用。
Conclusion: 这是首次从非侵入式 EEG 解码大词表中文句子，在封闭集候选句子设置下取得强分类性能。

papers.title: Quotient Dynamics, Effective Curvature, and Implicit Bias in Positive Quadratic Networks
papers.abstract_en: Positive quadratic networks admit the low-rank representation f_U(x)=x^top UU^top x, where Uinmathbb{R}^{dtimes r} is identifiable only up to right orthogonal multiplication, representing a rank-r PSD matrix Q=UU^top. We study how this quotient structure governs training dynamics, curvature, recovery, and interpolation bias. On the full-column-rank stratum, we identify mathbb{R}^{dtimes r}_*/O(r) with the rank-r PSD manifold. For smooth objectives L(U)=ell(UU^top), the Euclidean factor gradient is horizontal. Thus, factor gradient flow projects exactly to quotient Riemannian gradient flow, while finite-step gradient descent induces an exact congruence recursion for the predictor. For quadratic regression, we derive the effective Hessian at interpolators as the empirical measurement Gram form restricted to the tangent space relative to the quotient metric. Under Gaussian rank-one measurements, we compute population curvature, prove uniform deviation bounds for the empirical normal operator, construct a spectral initializer, and establish local exponential convergence for gradient flow and linear convergence for small-step descent. Recovery guarantees are explicit but conservative due to reliance on full-space second-moment control. In underdetermined commuting regimes, factor gradient flow becomes an exact entropy mirror flow in joint spectral coordinates. Strictly positive initializations converge to Bregman projections onto the interpolation set. With isotropic initialization q(0)=varepsilon^2mathbf{1}, predictors approach the minimum-trace solution set as varepsilondownarrow0, resolving nonuniqueness via weighted entropy within the invariant joint spectral algebra. Finite-step descent selects interpolants differing from continuous-time Bregman projections by O(eta). Numerical experiments verify these quotient identities, curvature predictions, recovery behaviors, and selection laws.

papers.title: Beyond Facial Consistency: Personalized Person Image Generation with Holistic Identity Preservation
papers.abstract_en: Personalized person image generation requires preserving subject identity across both local facial details and broader appearance cues. Existing methods typically emphasize only one level of identity information, leading to an inherent trade-off between facial fidelity and overall appearance consistency. To address this, we first propose a simple dual-branch baseline that unifies global appearance control and local facial control within a shared generation framework. This simple combination of different branches yields promising results, but suffers from instability in practice due to uncoordinated branch contributions. To this end, we propose Dynamic Balancing Scaling (DBS), a fine-tuning strategy for improving face and appearance identity coordination. DBS consists of two components: adaptive temporal gating, which dynamically modulates branch contributions along the denoising trajectory, and region-aware optimization, which improves the coordination of facial, appearance, and global supervision. Together, these designs alleviate persistent face-branch over-dominance and encourage more effective appearance-aware guidance. We also introduce Pexels-100, a benchmark for evaluating holistic identity consistency in personalized person generation. Experiments show that DBS achieves a better trade-off between facial fidelity and appearance consistency than existing open-source baselines, while providing a controllable basic framework for holistic identity modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对个性化人物图像生成中面部细节与整体外观一致性之间的权衡问题，提出动态平衡缩放（DBS）微调策略。DBS包含自适应时间门控和区域感知优化，用于协调双分支（全局外观控制与局部面部控制）的贡献。作者同时引入Pexels-100基准评估整体身份一致性。实验表明DBS在面部保真度和外观一致性之间取得更好平衡。
Motivation: 现有方法通常只强调局部面部细节或整体外观单一层面的身份信息，导致面部保真度与外观一致性之间的内在权衡，缺乏统一的框架。
Method: 提出一个简单的双分支基线统一全局外观控制与局部面部控制，并进一步提出动态平衡缩放（DBS）微调策略，包含自适应时间门控（动态调制去噪轨迹中分支贡献）和区域感知优化（改进面部、外观和全局监督的协调）。
Result: 摘要报告DBS在面部保真度和外观一致性之间取得比现有开源基线更好的权衡，并提供了一个可控的基础框架。
Conclusion: DBS通过缓解面部分支过度主导并鼓励更有效的外观感知指导，提升了整体身份建模的协调性。

papers.title: Beyond Epistemia: Epistemic Schizologia and Large Language Models as Techno-Semiotic Machines
papers.abstract_en: Quattrociocchi and colleagues warn that the fluent outputs of large language models may allow linguistic plausibility to substitute for epistemic evaluation, producing the condition they call *Epistemia*: the experience of possessing knowledge without undertaking the practices through which judgment would ordinarily be warranted. This article accepts that diagnosis but challenges its explanatory framework, which compares an embodied, socially situated human knower with an isolated generative model thereby locating epistemic legitimacy in capacities internal to autonomous agents. Drawing on Carlo Sini's philosophy of practices, writing, signs, and technics, we propose instead to understand a large language model (LLM) as a *techno-semiotic machine* that automates a phase of written semiosis by producing plausible linguistic configurations from the sedimented archive of human writing. From this perspective, *Epistemia* is one consequence of a broader phenomenon that we call *epistemic schizologia*: the socio-technical cleavage between signs as linguistically accomplished expressions and signs as moments within socially embedded circuits of interpretation, evidence, criticism, verification, and responsibility. This cleavage is reinforced by *eikotic closure*, through which a plausible continuation is presented with the finality of an epistemic result, and by algorithmic authority and epistemic self-misrecognition. The relevant unit is therefore not the model alone but the complete practice in which generated inscriptions are prompted, interpreted, verified, contested, used, and made consequential. This reframing preserves the distinction between linguistic production and responsible understanding while grounding a design programme centred on inspectable genealogy, contestability, distributed responsibility, epistemic agency, and the evaluation of hybrid human--AIpractices.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文基于Carlo Sini的实践、书写、符号和技术哲学，将大型语言模型理解为一种技术符号机器，它通过从人类书写的沉积档案中产生合理的语言配置来自动化书面符号过程的一个阶段。作者提出“认知分裂症”概念，描述社会技术中符号作为语言表达与符号作为社会嵌入的解释、证据、批评、验证和责任循环之间的分裂，并认为“认识论”是这种分裂的一种表现。文章倡导以可检查谱系、可争议性、分布式责任、认知代理和混合人机实践评估为重点的设计方案。
Motivation: 现有对LLM认知风险的诊断（如Epistemia）将认知合法性归于自主代理的内在能力，忽视了实践和社会嵌入性。本文旨在提供更全面的解释框架。
Method: 运用Carlo Sini的哲学思想，将LLM重新概念化为技术符号机器，并引入“认知分裂症”和“eikotic封闭”等概念，分析人机交互中的符号学机制。
Result: 论证了Epistemia是更广泛现象“认知分裂症”的一个后果，该现象由eikotic封闭、算法权威和认知自我误认强化。
Conclusion: 主张分析单元不应是模型本身，而是包含生成文本的提示、解释、验证、质疑、使用和赋予后果的完整实践，并据此提出设计原则。

papers.title: MemSFT: Mitigating Alignment Tax with an External Parametric Memory
papers.abstract_en: Adapting Large Language Models (LLMs) to specialized domains often incurs an alignment tax, as fine-tuning on domain-specific tasks can cause catastrophic forgetting and substantially degrade performance on general tasks. We propose MemSFT, which mitigates the alignment tax by decoupling domain specialization from backbone parameter updates through a plug-and-play parametric memory. The memory is trained to imitate the behavior of a non-parametric retriever operating over domain data, thereby memorizing knowledge and patterns that would otherwise be accessed through retrieval. Once trained on a specific domain, the memory can be reused across LLMs of different sizes. During generation, a learned router dynamically fuses the output distributions of the memory and backbone at each decoding step, allowing domain expertise to be invoked selectively. Across biology, geoscience, and law, evaluations with models ranging from Qwen3-8B to Qwen3-235B-A22B show that MemSFT consistently improves domain performance with negligible degradation in general performance, whereas full SFT suffers severe forgetting on general tasks. Overall, our results demonstrate a practical path to decoupling general model capabilities from domain-specific knowledge at the parameter level, thereby equipping LLMs with new specialized capabilities without compromising their general capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出 MemSFT，一种通过外部参数记忆（parametric memory）来缓解大语言模型（LLM）领域适配时对齐税的方法。该记忆模仿非参数检索器在领域数据上的行为，通过可学习路由器在每个解码步骤动态融合记忆和主干网络的输出分布。在生物、地学、法律三个领域，使用 Qwen3-8B 到 Qwen3-235B-A22B 模型进行实验，显示 MemSFT 能提升领域性能而通用性能几乎无损，而全参数微调则遭受严重遗忘。
Motivation: 大语言模型在专用领域微调时会产生对齐税（alignment tax），即领域适配导致对通用任务的灾难性遗忘，通用性能大幅下降。论文旨在通过参数级解耦来减轻这一问题。
Method: MemSFT 引入一个即插即用的参数记忆模块，该模块通过训练来模仿非参数检索器在领域数据上的行为，从而“记住”领域知识和模式。训练后，该记忆可跨不同大小的 LLM 复用。在生成时，一个可学习的路由器动态地融合记忆和主干网络在每个解码步骤的输出分布，实现选择性调用领域知识。
Result: 在生物、地学、法律三个领域，使用 Qwen3-8B 到 Qwen3-235B-A22B 模型，MemSFT 持续提升领域性能，且通用性能几乎无下降；相比之下，全参数 SFT 在通用任务上遭受严重遗忘。
Conclusion: 结果表明，在参数级别将通用模型能力与领域特定知识解耦是可行的，从而在不牺牲通用能力的情况下赋予 LLM 新的专业能力。

summary_sections.result: 在生物、地学、法律三个领域，使用 Qwen3-8B 到 Qwen3-235B-A22B 模型，MemSFT 持续提升领域性能，且通用性能几乎无下降；相比之下，全参数 SFT 在通用任务上遭受严重遗忘。
summary_sections.conclusion: 结果表明，在参数级别将通用模型能力与领域特定知识解耦是可行的，从而在不牺牲通用能力的情况下赋予 LLM 新的专业能力。

papers.title: Multi-Sensor Alignment for Weather Simulations
papers.abstract_en: Perception tasks for autonomous vehicles need to work satisfactorily in adverse weather conditions. Due to lack of real-world weather datasets, weather simulations are a promising alternative. To ensure simulations closely mirror real-world weather data, it's crucial that they represent the same weather characteristics, including severity and particle positioning, across different sensors. To achieve this, we propose the Reference Dataset Alignment Method (ReDAM) for weather intensity alignment in fog and Unified-weather-edit (inspired by Weather-edit[1]) for particle positioning alignment in rain and snow. We validate both alignment methods using statistical and geometrical tests, respectively. We find that 3D detection models for non-aligned versions tend to be overly optimistic as compared to aligned versions. We also show the aligned-multi-sensor simulation's effectiveness for achieving robustness for 3D object detection task by finetuning existing sensor fusion models on it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对自动驾驶在恶劣天气下的感知任务，提出多传感器天气模拟对齐方法。ReDAM用于雾的强度对齐，Unified-weather-edit用于雨雪的粒子位置对齐，并通过统计和几何测试验证。实验表明对齐版本能避免非对齐版本对3D检测的过度乐观估计，微调传感器融合模型可提升鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有天气模拟缺乏多传感器一致性，导致自动驾驶感知模型在恶劣天气下的评估不准确，且真实天气数据集稀缺。
Method: 提出两种对齐方法：ReDAM（参考数据集对齐方法）用于雾的强度对齐，Unified-weather-edit（受Weather-edit启发）用于雨雪的粒子位置对齐。
Result: 对齐后的多传感器模拟在3D目标检测任务上，通过微调现有融合模型提升了鲁棒性；非对齐版本会导致检测模型性能被高估。
Conclusion: 多传感器对齐的天气模拟能更真实地反映天气影响，有助于自动驾驶感知模型的鲁棒性评估与训练。

papers.title: Contrastive Representation Learning of Longitudinal Disease Trajectories on Temporal Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Understanding disease trajectories from longitudinal clinical data remains challenging due to complex temporal dynamics and heterogeneous patient cohorts. Here, we present a contrastive representation learning framework that models multivariate disease trajectories as temporal graphs and learns representations using contrastive graph neural networks. Nodes represent patient observations over time, while edges capture temporal continuity and structural similarity between trajectories. Structure-aware random walks guide contrastive learning to generate embeddings that preserve temporal context and trajectory topology. The resulting representations enable robust clustering of patients with similar disease progression patterns and reveal latent structure in longitudinal data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种对比表示学习框架，将纵向疾病轨迹建模为时间图，利用对比图神经网络学习患者表示。节点代表随时间变化的患者观测，边捕捉时间连续性和轨迹间的结构相似性；结构感知随机游走指导对比学习，生成保留时间上下文和轨迹拓扑的嵌入。该方法能够对具有相似疾病进展模式的患者进行稳健聚类，并揭示纵向数据中的潜在结构。
Motivation: 理解纵向临床数据中的疾病轨迹面临复杂的时间动态和患者异质性挑战，现有方法难以有效捕捉时序关系和患者间的相似模式。
Method: 将多变量疾病轨迹建模为时间图，节点为患者观测，边表示时间连续性和轨迹结构相似性；采用结构感知随机游走生成对比样本，通过对比图神经网络学习嵌入以保留时间上下文和拓扑信息。
Result: 摘要报告该方法能够实现对具有相似疾病进展模式的患者进行稳健聚类，并揭示纵向数据中的潜在结构，但未提供具体量化指标。
Conclusion: 该对比学习框架为纵向疾病轨迹的表示学习提供了一种有效方法，突出了时间图结构和对比学习在临床数据建模中的潜力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Physics-Informed Broad Learning System: An Efficient Backpropagation-Free Framework for Solving Partial Differential Equations
papers.abstract_en: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) have emerged as a powerful paradigm for solving partial differential equations (PDEs) by embedding governing physical laws into deep neural networks. However, their reliance on computationally expensive gradient-based optimization and deep architectures often results in slow training, high computational cost, and limited scalability. In this work, we propose a novel physics-informed broad learning system (PI-BLS), the first physics-informed learning framework based on broad RdNNs. The proposed formulation embeds the governing differential operator and the associated initial and boundary constraints directly into a linear output-layer optimization problem, thereby replacing nonlinear gradient-based training with a deterministic least-squares solution obtained via the pseudoinverse. Consequently, the entire learning process is reduced to a single linear optimization stage while preserving the underlying physical constraints. As a result, PI-BLS offers an efficient learning paradigm for a physics-informed learning framework for solving PDEs that eliminates iterative backpropagation while preserving the underlying physical constraints. Experimental results on representative forward PDE benchmarks demonstrate that PI-BLS achieves competitive and often superior performance with reduced training time and model parameters compared with conventional PINNs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于广义学习系统（Broad Learning System）的物理信息框架PI-BLS，用于求解偏微分方程（PDE）。它通过将微分算子及初边值条件嵌入线性输出层优化问题，用伪逆直接求解最小二乘问题，从而避免反向传播迭代。在正向PDE基准上，PI-BLS在训练时间和参数数量方面优于传统PINNs，同时保持竞争性精度。
Motivation: 传统PINNs依赖昂贵的梯度优化和深层网络，训练慢、计算成本高且可扩展性有限。本文旨在消除迭代反向传播，同时保持物理约束。
Method: 提出基于广义学习系统（Broad RdNNs）的物理信息框架，将PDE的微分算子和初始/边界条件转化为线性输出层的优化问题，通过伪逆得到确定性最小二乘解。
Result: 实验表明，在代表性正向PDE基准上，PI-BLS在减少训练时间和模型参数的条件下，达到了与传统PINNs相当或更优的性能。
Conclusion: PI-BLS提供了一个高效的无反向传播物理信息学习框架，可替代传统PINNs用于求解PDE。

papers.title: Computational Extraction of Legal Causes via al-Sabr wa al-Taqsim: A Set-Theoretic Formalization for Closed Fiqh Chapters
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a set-theoretic formalization of the classical usuli method of al-Sabr wa al-Taqsim (Examination and Division) for extracting legal causes ('ilal) within closed chapters of jurisprudence. A computational algorithm is introduced that extracts minimal operational rules from a truth table of juristic verdicts. The principal result is that, given a complete truth table for a closed chapter, the algorithm computes the minimal structural generators of the ruling and eliminates all logically redundant attributes. The resulting structures constitute admissible candidate causes for subsequent juristic evaluation. The framework is conditional upon the availability of a finite school-relative concept vocabulary and a complete ruling table for the chapter under investigation.
papers.comment: 16 pages. Published in Journal Academica, Vol. 15, No. 1, 2026, pp. 3-18. Includes an Arabic-language computational analysis of Tayammum in the Shafi'i school
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对伊斯兰法理学（fiqh）封闭章节中的法律原因提取问题，提出基于集合论的形式化方法。利用真值表表示法理判决，通过算法计算最小结构生成器并消除冗余属性，从而得到 admissible candidate causes。该方法借鉴了古典 usuli 方法 al-Sabr wa al-Taqsim（检查与划分）。
Motivation: 在封闭的法理学章节中，传统法律原因提取依赖学者专家，缺乏计算化、形式化的严谨方法。论文试图通过集合论和算法自动提取最小法律原因，提高透明性和可复现性。
Method: 提出一个集合论形式化框架，将法理判决表视为真值表，设计算法计算所有最小交织项的集合（最小结构生成器），并去除冗余属性。该算法基于 al-Sabr wa al-Taqsim 的古典方法，但用现代逻辑和集合论重新表达。
Result: 论文证明，如果给定封闭章节的完整真值表和学校相关的概念词汇表，算法能计算判决的最小结构生成器，并消除所有逻辑冗余属性，输出 admissible candidate causes。
Conclusion: 框架依赖于两个前提条件：有限的学校相关概念词汇表和完整的法理判决表。因此其适用范围限于封闭章节；对于开放或有争议的章节，方法需要进一步扩展。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Self-Knowledge: Propagating Uncertainty Across Reasoning and Retrieval in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation improves knowledge-intensive question answering, but indiscriminate retrieval can introduce irrelevant evidence and unnecessary computation. We investigate whether verbalized confidence from black-box language models can serve as an actionable signal for retrieval routing. Our method, BeyondUncertainty, first elicits a structured provisional answer and confidence estimate, then applies a model-specific threshold selected on held-out validation data and frozen before test evaluation. Low-confidence questions receive top-$5$ TF--IDF retrieval followed by a second answer call, whereas high-confidence questions return the provisional answer directly. We evaluate 27,000 policy instances across six QA benchmarks, three model families, and three retrieval policies. BeyondUncertainty achieves $0.483$ mean token-level F1, compared with $0.467$ for always retrieval and $0.401$ for no retrieval, while reducing retrieved passages by $20.4\%$ relative to always retrieval. When matched on the number of questions routed to retrieval within each dataset--model cell, it outperforms a post-hoc random allocation in 17 of 18 settings, with an average gain of 0.024 F1. Although poorly calibrated as an absolute probability, probe uncertainty modestly predicts question-level retrieval benefit (AUROC $=0.628$). However, the additional probe increases total token usage by $28.2\%$, revealing a trade-off between more selective evidence acquisition and end-to-end token efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出BeyondUncertainty方法，利用黑盒语言模型的可信度估计作为检索路由信号，在知识密集型问答中权衡检索与直接回答。在六个QA基准上，该方法在减少20.4%检索段落的同时，平均token级F1达到0.483，优于始终检索（0.467）和不检索（0.401）。但额外置信度探针增加了28.2%的总token消耗，揭示了选择性证据获取与端到端效率之间的权衡。
Motivation: 检索增强生成中盲目检索会引入无关证据和不必要计算，需要一种基于黑盒模型自身置信度的路由信号来动态决定是否需要外部检索。
Method: BeyondUncertainty先让LLM生成结构化临时答案和置信度估计，然后在验证集上选定模型特定阈值冻结；低置信度问题触发Top-5 TF-IDF检索并二次回答，高置信度问题直接返回临时答案。
Result: 在27,000个策略实例上，BeyondUncertainty平均token级F1为0.483，优于始终检索（0.467）和不检索（0.401），同时减少20.4%检索段落；在控制检索问题数量时，17/18设置下优于随机分配，平均F1提升0.024；探针不确定性对问题级检索收益的预测AUROC为0.628。
Conclusion: 摘要强调基于置信度的路由策略能有效减少检索开销并提升性能，但额外探针带来了token消耗增加，存在效率权衡；模型置信度作为绝对概率校准不佳，但作为相对信号仍有价值。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: A Density-Matrix Framework for Electronic-Structure Analysis of Functional-Group and Salt Effects in Lithium-Metal Electrolytes
papers.abstract_en: The reactivity of lithium-metal electrolytes arises from the interplay of molecular functional groups, Li$^+$ solvation, and salt-anion participation. This interplay operates through the redistribution of electron density across donor, anion, and cation centers, which is most directly read out from the electronic structure resolved in space. Quantum-chemical calculations deliver such readouts faithfully, yet become computationally demanding across this multidimensional design space, and machine-learning electronic-structure models seldom cover chemically diverse solvation shells or electrolyte-relevant readouts. Here, we present a density-matrix-centered AI platform (EMolStudio) for electronic-structure prediction and analysis. Its workflow integrates molecular functionalization, explicit Li$^+$ first-shell assembly, density-matrix prediction with idempotency projection, and readouts of frontier orbitals, electrostatic potential, Li$^+$-donor bond order, and electron localization. We apply EMolStudio to 163,655 functionalized molecules and 22,500 explicit Li$^+$ first-shell clusters across four lithium salts. We find that 1) at the molecular scale, functionalization distinguishes CO$_2$Me, CN, F/CF$_3$, and sulfonyl groups by chemically distinct changes in frontier levels, electrostatic potential, and Li$^+$-donor contact, consistent with $π^*$-acceptor, inductive, and polarization contributions, with sublinear accumulation at higher degrees of functionalization; 2) in explicit solvation shells, anion identity reshapes frontier-orbital localization: LiTDI anchors the HOMO on the anion across the entire library, whereas LiDFOB pairs an anion-hosted HOMO with strongly functional-group-dependent LUMO hosting. EMolStudio thereby translates functional-group and salt choices into electronic-structure hypotheses relevant to lithium-bond formation, desolvation, and interphase reactions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于密度矩阵的AI平台EMolStudio，用于预测和分析锂金属电解质的电子结构。该平台整合了分子功能化、Li+第一溶剂壳层组装、密度矩阵预测（含幂等投影）以及前沿轨道、静电势、Li+-供体键序和电子局域化等读出功能。作者将平台应用于163,655个功能化分子和22,500个跨四种锂盐的显式Li+第一溶剂壳层簇，发现功能化基团（如CO2Me、CN、F/CF3、磺酰基）通过前沿能级、静电势和Li+-供体接触产生化学上不同的变化，且阴离子身份重塑了前沿轨道局域化（如LiTDI中HOMO始终位于阴离子上，LiDFOB中HOMO位于阴离子而LUMO高度依赖功能化基团）。EMolStudio将功能基团和盐的选择转化为与锂键形成、脱溶剂和界面反应相关的电子结构假设。
Motivation: 锂金属电解质的反应性源于分子功能基团、Li+溶剂化和盐-阴离子参与的相互作用，这种相互作用通过供体、阴离子和阳离子中心之间的电子密度重分布体现。量子化学计算虽然准确但计算成本高，而机器学习电子结构模型很少涵盖化学多样性的溶剂壳层或电解质相关的读出。因此需要一种高效且能覆盖化学空间的电子结构预测与分析框架。
Method: 提出密度矩阵中心的AI平台EMolStudio，工作流程包括：分子功能化、显式Li+第一溶剂壳层组装、密度矩阵预测（带幂等投影）、以及前沿轨道、静电势、Li+-供体键序和电子局域化等读出。
Result: 应用于163,655个功能化分子和22,500个显式Li+第一溶剂壳层簇，发现功能化基团（CO2Me、CN、F/CF3、磺酰基）通过π*受体、诱导和极化效应在分子尺度上引起前沿能级、静电势和Li+-供体接触的化学特异变化，且在高功能化程度下呈次线性累积。在显式溶剂壳层中，阴离子身份决定前沿轨道局域化：LiTDI中HOMO始终位于阴离子，LiDFOB中HOMO位于阴离子而LUMO高度依赖功能化基团。
Conclusion: EMolStudio将功能基团和盐的选择转化为与锂键形成、脱溶剂和界面反应相关的电子结构假设，为电解质设计提供了理论工具。

papers.title: Forensic Reproducibility Audit of a Radiology Vision-Language Model Benchmark: From Intended Protocol to Released Artifact
papers.abstract_en: Medical-imaging AI benchmarks combine datasets, DICOM rendering, prompts, provider APIs, automated labels, statistical code, manuscripts, and repository releases. Agreement across these artifacts is usually assumed rather than tested. We performed a retrospective forensic reproducibility audit of a preserved chest-radiograph vision-language model (VLM) pilot; no model was called again and no image or report was newly annotated. We traced prompt bindings, DICOM metadata, output completeness, label extraction, matched analyses, and release propagation. Of 300 planned model-prompt calls, 297 yielded nonempty reports. Sixty Claude calls labeled A/B were executed with the same C prompt. The 30 studies represented 28 patients. Four MONOCHROME1 images were rendered without required polarity inversion, dataset split membership was not retained, and the unvalidated extractor truncated five reports to 4000 characters. Reconstructing one common cohort of 369 complete case-finding blocks changed Cochran's Q from 154.73 to 182.29. Of 45 McNemar comparisons, 27 had unadjusted p < 0.05 and 20 remained below 0.05 after Holm adjustment. These values describe only the archived automated-label matrix; they do not recover the intended prompt comparison or establish clinical performance. We withdraw the original performance, ranking, prompt-effect, and clinical claims and specify machine-verifiable controls for cohort, DICOM rendering, prompt and model identity, call status, annotation provenance, keyed analysis, and derived artifacts.
papers.comment: 25 pages, 5 figures, 7 tables. Retrospective artifact audit; no new model calls or annotations. Corrective audit and archival reconstruction: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21629849
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文对一项已发表的胸部X光视觉语言模型（VLM）基准进行了回顾性法庭式再现性审计，未重新调用模型或标注。作者追踪了从提示绑定到发布物的完整流程，发现多项严重不一致：包括提示错误（60次Claude调用使用了错误提示）、图像渲染问题（4幅MONOCHROME1图像极性反转未按要求翻转）、数据集分割信息丢失、标签提取器截断报告（5份截断至4000字符），以及分析结果差异（重建完整队列后Cochran's Q从154.73变为182.29）。因此，作者撤回原始的性能、排名、提示效应和临床声称，并提出了可机器验证的控制规范。
Motivation: 医学影像AI基准通常依赖多个工件（数据集、渲染、提示、API、标签、代码等）的一致性，但这种一致性往往被假设而非测试。该论文旨在通过系统的审计揭示这种假设的风险。
Method: 对已发表的胸部X光VLM基准进行法庭式追溯审计，不重新运行模型或重新标注，而是检查提示绑定、DICOM元数据、调用状态、标签提取、分析代码和发布物之间的一致性。
Result: 发现了多项问题：60个Claude调用使用了错误的提示；4个MONOCHROME1图像渲染极性反转；数据集分割信息未保留；标签提取器将5个报告截断为4000字符；重建完整案例队列后Cochran's Q从154.73变为182.29；27/45个McNemar比较未调整p<0.05，20个经Holm调整后仍<0.05。作者据此撤回原始声称。
Conclusion: 作者撤回原始的性能、排名、提示效应和临床声称，并指定了可机器验证的控制措施，包括队列、DICOM渲染、提示和模型身份、调用状态、注释来源、关键分析以及派生工件，以确保未来基准的可重复性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: How Small Can You Go? A Controlled Study of LoRA Rank, Target Modules, and Quantization Trade-offs for Text-to-SQL on a 60M-Parameter Model
papers.abstract_en: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) and low-bit quantization are now standard tools for adapting language models under tight compute budgets, yet their interaction is most often studied on billion-parameter models where the design space is expensive to explore. We ask a complementary question: on a specific, fully reproducible 60M-parameter encoder-decoder model (T5-small) and a single-table text-to-SQL benchmark (WikiSQL), how much task accuracy does each efficiency knob actually cost? We run a controlled, single-variable study over (i) LoRA rank r in {2, 4, 8, 16, 32}, (ii) the set of adapted modules, and (iii) numerical precision. We report task accuracy alongside system-level metrics including trainable parameters, peak training memory, inference latency, and throughput, and frame adaptation as a constrained trade-off rather than an accuracy-only objective. Our results show that LoRA with r=16 recovers within 11.6 percentage points of full fine-tuning accuracy (59.6% vs. 71.2% exact-match) while training fewer than 1% of parameters and consuming 31% less peak GPU memory. Within this setting, rank beyond r=16 yields no measurable accuracy gain. QLoRA with INT8 and NF4 quantization achieves comparable accuracy (52.8% and 53.2%) at dramatically lower memory cost (0.60 GB each), demonstrating a compelling trade-off for memory-constrained deployments. All code, configurations, and logs are released for full reproducibility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在60M参数的T5-small模型和WikiSQL基准上，系统研究了LoRA秩、目标模块和量化精度对文本到SQL任务精度的影响。结果表明，LoRA r=16可恢复全微调精度的11.6个百分点内（59.6% vs 71.2%），仅训练不到1%的参数并节省31%峰值显存；INT8和NF4量化在极低内存消耗下达到可比精度。
Motivation: 现有研究多在十亿参数模型上探索PEFT与量化的交互，成本高昂，缺乏对小型模型在特定任务上的可控研究。
Method: 采用单变量控制实验，在T5-small和WikiSQL上依次变化LoRA秩（2,4,8,16,32）、适配模块集合和数值精度（全精度、INT8、NF4），并记录精度与系统指标。
Result: LoRA r=16达到59.6%精确匹配准确率（全微调71.2%），训练参数少于1%，峰值显存降低31%；INT8和NF4量化分别达到52.8%和53.2%准确率，仅需0.60 GB显存。
Conclusion: 在小型模型上，LoRA和量化可有效逼近全微调性能，但存在精度与资源消耗的权衡，秩超过16无额外收益。

papers.title: IRIS: Reusable Identity Representations from Frozen LLMs for Entity Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Entity alignment (EA) identifies entities across knowledge graphs (KGs) that refer to the same real-world object. Conventional EA methods mainly exploit explicit graph structures and textual fields, which often provide insufficient semantic understanding to recognize the same entity under heterogeneous descriptions and distinguish it from semantically similar entities. Although large language models (LLMs) offer deeper entity understanding, existing LLM-based EA methods largely use this capability for auxiliary generation or candidate-conditioned decisions. Consequently, such understanding is not distilled into a stable and directly comparable identity space, leaving alignment tied to specific KG pairs or candidate sets and requiring repeated processing as the matching context changes. To address these limitations, we propose IRIS (Identity Representations from Internal States), a training-free framework that constructs for each entity an iris-like signature encoding its distinctive and stable identity characteristics. IRIS derives these signatures by eliciting identity-oriented contextual representations from a frozen LLM, thereby forming a shared space in which each entity is encoded once and can be aligned across different KGs through direct similarity comparison, without pair-dependent representation construction or candidate-wise LLM inference. Across four established EA benchmarks and two frozen LLM backbones, the best IRIS variants achieve Hits@1 scores of 100.00, 99.38, 98.31, and 97.99 on D-Y-15K V2, DBP-WIKI, ICEWS-WIKI, and ICEWS-YAGO, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 IRIS 框架，利用冻结的大型语言模型（LLM）为每个实体生成类似虹膜的身份签名，实现跨知识图谱的实体对齐。该方法无需训练，通过直接相似度比较进行对齐，在四个基准数据集上取得了高 Hits@1 分数。
Motivation: 现有实体对齐方法多依赖显式图结构和文本字段，语义理解不足，难以区分异构描述下的同一实体。基于 LLM 的方法虽理解更深，但未将理解蒸馏为可直接比较的稳定身份空间，导致对齐依赖于特定 KG 对或候选集。
Method: 提出 IRIS 框架，从冻结的 LLM 中提取面向身份的上下文表示，为每个实体构建独特的身份签名，构建共享表示空间，使得每个实体只需编码一次，即可通过直接相似度比较实现跨 KG 对齐，无需重复的候选推理。
Result: 在 D-Y-15K V2、DBP-WIKI、ICEWS-WIKI 和 ICEWS-YAGO 上，最佳 IRIS 变体分别取得 100.00、99.38、98.31 和 97.99 的 Hits@1 分数。
Conclusion: IRIS 展示了从冻结 LLM 中提取可重用身份表示用于实体对齐的有效性，且无需训练或候选特定的 LLM 推理。

papers.title: Matrix-Free Photoacoustic Image Reconstruction via Sensor-Token Self-Attention
papers.abstract_en: Photoacoustic tomography (PAT) combines the optical absorption contrast of biological tissue with the spatial resolution of ultrasound, yet recovering the initial pressure distribution from sparse-view sensor measurements remains an ill-posed inverse problem. Iterative compressive-sensing solvers and unrolled deep networks both retain a dependence on the system matrix at inference, which leaves real-time clinical reconstruction computationally expensive. This paper proposes the Sensor Attention Network (SAN), a Transformer-based architecture that treats the full time series of each sensor as a token and maps raw measurements directly to the reconstructed image without invoking the system matrix at inference. For training and benchmarking, an analytical k-space H-matrix is constructed and validated against the k-Wave pseudo-spectral solver under matched geometry, achieving a mean per-sensor Pearson correlation of 0.919 +/- 0.049, with k-space apodization and Gaussian temporal damping acting synergistically to reduce the energy-normalized mismatch by 49%. Trained with a vessel-weighted loss on 488 augmented samples and evaluated on 46 held-out samples against ISTA, split-Bregman total variation (SBTV), and learned ISTA (LISTA), SAN attains the highest mean SSIM (0.522) and PSNR (22.09 dB) and the lowest NMSE (0.233). Paired t-tests and Wilcoxon signed-rank tests confirm the superiority of SAN over LISTA on PSNR, NMSE, and Pearson correlation at p < 1e-8, and over ISTA and SBTV on all fidelity metrics. By bypassing the H-matrix at inference, SAN reduces reconstruction time by at least an order of magnitude, supporting real-time PAT reconstruction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出传感器注意力网络（SAN），一种基于Transformer的架构，无需系统矩阵即可从原始传感器测量值直接重建光声图像。通过构建解析k-space H矩阵并与k-Wave伪谱求解器对比验证，SAN在稀疏视图传感器测量中实现了高保真重建。实验表明，SAN在SSIM、PSNR和NMSE指标上优于ISTA、SBTV和LISTA，且推理时间减少至少一个数量级。
Motivation: 光声层析成像（PAT）中，从稀疏视图传感器测量恢复初始压力分布是一个病态逆问题。现有迭代压缩感知求解器和展开网络均依赖系统矩阵，导致实时临床重建计算成本高。
Method: 提出传感器注意力网络（SAN），将每个传感器的完整时间序列视为一个token，通过自注意力机制直接从原始测量映射到重建图像，推理时无需系统矩阵。训练时构建了解析k-space H矩阵，并采用血管加权损失。
Result: 在488个增强样本上训练，46个样本上测试，SAN取得最高平均SSIM（0.522）和PSNR（22.09 dB），最低NMSE（0.233）。配对t检验和Wilcoxon符号秩检验表明SAN在PSNR、NMSE和Pearson相关性上显著优于LISTA（p<1e-8），并全面超越ISTA和SBTV。推理时间减少至少一个数量级。

papers.title: The LAIA Dataset: Labelled Attention for Intelligent Automobiles
papers.abstract_en: The development of autonomous vehicles (AVs) usually relies heavily on data-driven artificial intelligence (AI) models that require large volumes of sensor data with ground-truth annotations. While modular architectures are widely used, end-to-end driving paradigms offer a promising alternative by directly mapping sensor inputs to control actions. However, their adoption is limited by challenges in interpretability and explainability. To address this, we present LAIA (Labelled Attention for Intelligent Automobiles), a novel synthetic dataset designed to enrich end-to-end driving research with human attention data. Collected using the CARLA simulator in closed-loop environments, LAIA comprises over 15 hours of driving from 44 participants across carefully crafted scenarios designed to evoke natural responses. Each sequence includes RGB images under six weather conditions, semantic and instance segmentation, depth, optical flow, CAN bus signals, and synchronized eye-tracking data. LAIA enables applications including training attention-aware end-to-end AI drivers, predicting driver behavior, developing methods to detect anomalous driver-attention patterns, and improving model explainability. In this work, we use LAIA to compare human attention with the perceptual attention emerging in our end-to-end driving models, thereby providing insight into their behavior.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 12 figures, 3 tables. Dataset and supplementary information available from the project website
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了一个名为LAIA的合成数据集，旨在为端到端自动驾驶研究提供人类注意力数据。数据集使用CARLA模拟器收集，包含44名参与者在多种天气条件下的15小时驾驶记录，并提供RGB图像、语义分割、深度、光流、CAN总线信号及眼动追踪数据。作者利用该数据集比较了人类注意力与端到端驾驶模型中的感知注意力，以提升模型可解释性。
Motivation: 端到端自动驾驶模型虽然直接从传感器映射到控制动作，但缺乏可解释性，限制了其应用。现有数据集缺乏人类注意力标注，难以研究模型注意力行为。
Method: 通过CARLA模拟器在闭环环境中收集44名参与者的驾驶数据，包含6种天气条件、多模态传感器（RGB、语义分割、深度、光流、CAN总线）和同步眼动追踪，构建了超15小时的注意力标注数据集。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，但指出数据集可用于训练注意力感知的端到端AI驾驶员、预测驾驶行为、检测异常注意力模式，并改善模型可解释性。作者通过比较人类注意力与模型注意力获得了行为洞察。
Conclusion: LAIA数据集为端到端驾驶研究提供了独特的注意力标注资源，有望推动模型可解释性和安全性研究。

papers.title: CORF-GS: Real-Time Wireless Radiance Field Reconstruction via Coupled Optical-RF Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS)-based wireless radiance field (WRF) reconstruction provide an efficient solution for wireless channel modeling. However, existing WRF reconstruction methods rely on pre-collected observations and offline optimization, and thus struggle to provide real-time channel knowledge. To bridge this gap, we propose CORF-GS, a real-time WRF reconstruction framework that processes sequential optical and radio frequency (RF) keyframes. Specifically, CORF-GS constructs a unified Gaussian representation for optical and RF with shared geometry and modality-specific appearance, allowing high-resolution optical images to provide structural priors for WRF reconstruction. When a new keyframe arrives, CORF-GS first employs optical-guided Gaussian sampling to densify the WRF in under-represented regions. Since light and radio waves may respond differently to the same object surfaces due to wavelength mismatch, relying solely on optical guidance may neglect RF-informative areas. Therefore, CORF-GS performs coupled optical-RF optimization to jointly refine the shared Gaussians. Compared with the existing two-stage training pipelines, this prevents WRF from passively adapting to a frozen optical geometry and encourages the shared Gaussians to adapt to both optical structures and RF power distributions. Simulations show that CORF-GS achieves state-of-the-art RF spectrum synthesis quality and reduces the reconstruction time by $6.4\times$ compared with existing WRF methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CORF-GS框架，利用光学和射频关键帧实时重建无线辐射场。通过共享几何但分离模态外观的统一高斯表示，CORF-GS在新型关键帧到达时先进行光学引导的高斯采样，再执行耦合光学-RF优化联合调整共享高斯。仿真表明该方法在RF频谱合成质量上达到最先进，重建时间比现有方法减少6.4倍。
Motivation: 现有基于3DGS的无线辐射场重建方法依赖预采集数据和离线优化，无法提供实时信道知识，限制了动态环境的应用。
Method: 构建统一高斯表示，共享几何但分离光学和射频外观；新关键帧到达时，先通过光学引导高斯采样在欠表示区域稠密化，再进行耦合光学-RF优化联合精调共享高斯。
Result: 仿真显示CORF-GS在RF频谱合成质量上达到最先进性能，重建时间比现有方法降低6.4倍。
Conclusion: 耦合光学-RF优化避免了无线辐射场被动适应冻结的光学几何，使共享高斯同时适应光学结构和射频功率分布，从而实现实时高质量重建。

papers.title: ReDesign: Recovering Editable Design Structures from Images via Agentic Decomposition
papers.abstract_en: Recovering an editable design file from a raster image is a common and costly bottleneck in modern design workflows, yet remains challenging since editability depends on recovering multi-modal attributes, such as typography, vector geometry, colors, grouping, and layer ordering. We present ReDesign, an agentic framework that grows an editable layer hierarchy by selecting and composing specialized tools across modalities. To keep this long decision process reliable despite imperfect tool outputs, we introduce graceful verification at each expansion, which provides local accept, prune, or retry feedback that prevents error accumulation and avoids large scale reruns. To evaluate editability at scale, we introduce the Figma Edit Replay Benchmark, consisting of 909 raw Figma files and 14,796 controlled edit instructions that replay edits on reconstructed outputs. Across this benchmark and standard reconstruction metrics, ReDesign achieves strong visual fidelity while delivering the highest editability across layout, color, and text edits, outperforming layered decomposition baselines and serial tool use pipelines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ReDesign，一个基于代理的框架，通过选择并组合跨模态专业工具，从光栅图像中恢复可编辑的设计文件层结构。引入优雅验证（graceful verification）机制在每一步扩展中提供接受、剪枝或重试反馈，防止错误累积。同时提出Figma Edit Replay Benchmark用于评估可编辑性。在基准上，ReDesign实现了高视觉保真度和最高的可编辑性。
Motivation: 从光栅图像恢复可编辑设计文件是设计工作流中常见且昂贵的瓶颈，因为可编辑性依赖于恢复多模态属性（如排版、矢量几何、颜色、分组和图层顺序）。
Method: 提出ReDesign代理框架，通过选择并组合跨模态专业工具逐步构建可编辑图层层次。引入优雅验证，在每一步扩展中提供局部接受、剪枝或重试反馈，防止错误累积。
Result: 在Figma Edit Replay Benchmark（909个原始Figma文件和14,796个受控编辑指令）上，ReDesign实现了高视觉保真度，并在布局、颜色和文本编辑方面取得了最高的可编辑性，优于分层分解基线和串行工具使用流水线。
Conclusion: ReDesign展示了通过代理分解和优雅验证从图像恢复可编辑设计结构的有效性，并提供了新的基准。

papers.title: Few-Shot Open-Vocabulary Remote Sensing Segmentation via Textual Inversion
papers.abstract_en: Open-vocabulary segmentation labels arbitrary categories from a text query without per-class training, yet on remote sensing imagery it underperforms on categories it handles reliably elsewhere. We find that much of this gap traces to the text query rather than to the segmentation model. Because these models are not specialized for overhead imagery, the class name that serves as the query is often a weak address into the vision-language embedding space. We show that a better name repairs part of the gap, while the remaining failures call for an address that the tested natural-language rephrasings do not provide. We recover that address from a few examples through textual inversion on a frozen model, keeping inference text only. On a representative benchmark this raises the mean intersection over union on the affected categories from 3.9 to 39.4, and across eight remote sensing datasets it improves over few-shot methods that instead inject visual prompts at inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对遥感图像开集分割中，文本查询类别名称在视觉-语言嵌入空间中表现不佳的问题，提出通过文本反演（textual inversion）从少量样本中恢复更好的类别嵌入，仅需文本推理。在代表性基准上，受影响类别的平均交并比从3.9提升至39.4，并在八个遥感数据集上优于其他小样本方法。
Motivation: 开集分割模型在遥感图像上对某些类别性能差，主要原因不是分割模型本身，而是文本查询（类别名称）不能有效映射到嵌入空间，而自然语言改写不能完全解决。
Method: 在冻结的视觉-语言模型上，通过文本反演从少量样本中学习更合适的类别嵌入，推理时仅使用文本输入，无需视觉提示。
Result: 在受影响类别上mIoU从3.9提升至39.4；在八个遥感数据集上优于注入视觉提示的小样本方法。
Conclusion: 文本反演能有效修复遥感开集分割中因查询不佳导致的性能差距，且保持纯文本推理的简洁性。

papers.title: Agent Skills Matter: Inferring Proprietary Skills from Execution Trajectories
papers.abstract_en: Agent skills package reusable procedures that improve downstream performance. Their lightweight, portable form enables marketplace monetization and private deployment behind cloud-hosted agent interfaces, giving providers incentives to keep high-value skills proprietary. Yet hiding the artifacts does not conceal their behavioral effects, which remain observable in execution trajectories and form a behavioral side channel. We define this exposure as Skill Leakage: reconstructing proprietary skills from trajectories elicited by benign queries, without reference answers or success labels. We introduce SigLeak, a black-box framework that exploits recurring skill signatures in agent behavior. It constructs diverse, decision-rich diagnostic tasks, contrasts matched skill-enabled and skill-disabled trajectories, and iteratively refines a reconstructed skill from the isolated patterns. Across five scenarios, three model families, and three agent frameworks, SigLeak outperforms or matches three baselines in nearly every setting. It raises the success rate by 6.88 percentage points over the skill-disabled reference on average and achieves the highest overall SkillSim, our metric for coarse- and fine-grained semantic similarity. These results show that benign execution trajectories can expose proprietary procedural knowledge. The code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SigLeak-D1DB.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出技能泄露（Skill Leakage）问题，即从Agent执行轨迹中重建私有技能。作者提出黑盒框架SigLeak，通过构造诊断任务、对比技能启用/禁用轨迹，迭代优化重建的技能。在多个场景和框架下，SigLeak显著提升成功率，表明良性执行轨迹可暴露专有过程知识。
Motivation: Agent技能作为轻量可重用程序具有商业价值，但隐藏其制品无法掩盖行为效果，攻击者可通过轨迹行为侧信道泄露技能。
Method: SigLeak黑盒框架，构建多样化决策丰富的诊断任务，对比匹配的技能启用和技能禁用轨迹，从分离的模式中迭代精炼重建的技能。
Result: 在五个场景、三个模型系列、三个Agent框架下，SigLeak几乎在每种设置中优于或匹配三种基线。平均提升6.88个百分点，并达到最高SkillSim（粗粒度和细粒度语义相似性指标）。
Conclusion: 良性执行轨迹可以暴露专有过程知识，存在安全隐患。

papers.title: Distilling Temporal Search and Reasoning: Evolving LLMs for Future Prediction via Harness-Assisted Efficient Data Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Future event prediction carries broad social impact yet remains challenging. SOTA approaches augment LLMs with external agent frameworks whose predictive capability vanishes once the harness is removed. While recent Tool-Integrated Reasoning (TIR) internalizes deep search for multi-hop retrieval of facts, forecasting further demands temporal search and reasoning over historical trends and dynamic shifts. The key obstacle is data: historical queries induce temporal leakage that degrades forecasting into retrieval. Prior works either freeze information gathering with static observations, or rely on rejection sampling or unresolved fresh queries that discard vast amounts of data, degrading synthesis efficiency. We propose a time-truncation harness that enforces a temporal cut-off at every turn, enabling TIR-style sampling from historical events, reducing temporal leakage and reliance of rejection sampling or unsolved queries, increasing the sampling efficiency. We further build a large-scale corpus and a process-based metric and show that our harness naturally induces a broader temporal breadth of search and raises the proportion of high-quality data, further increasing the efficiency and reducing the reliance on complex rubrics. Distillation experiments show that students trained on harness-intervened data achieve the best performance, demonstrating harness-assisted model evolving that turns higher quality temporal search and reasoning data into a parametric advancement of the students.

papers.title: From Training to Deployment: Post-Hoc Causal Feature Identification via Sensitivity Ratios
papers.abstract_en: Given a model that is already trained, which features does it rely on causally versus spuriously? Existing methods require access to the training procedure and cannot answer this post-hoc. We introduce the \textbf{Normalised Sensitivity Ratio~(NSR)}, a post-hoc, model-agnostic diagnostic for this question under a structured-shift regime: environments differ primarily in the mean of spurious features while the causal mechanism and causal marginals remain stable, as in multi-site clinical data or multi-batch genomics. Within this regime, causal features induce constant model sensitivity across environments while spurious features track shift. NSR formalises this as the squared coefficient of variation of per-environment sensitivity. Under a linear structural causal model (SCM) with $K\ge3$ non-degenerate environments, NSR achieves exact identification (Theorem~1). We fully characterise failure: weak shifts ($O(\varepsilon^4)$ collapse), degenerate geometry, and proxy attenuation ($O((1-α)^4)$), giving practitioners quantitative criteria for assessing whether the regime holds. Finite-sample rates are $O_p(n^{-1})$ under the null and $O_p(n^{-1/2})$ under the alternative. Experiments confirm all theoretical predictions on synthetic data (area under the ROC curve [AUROC] $= 1.000$ under conditions satisfying the regime), show consistent rankings across five model families (Kendall $τ\ge0.529$), and recover six of eight causal features on bike-sharing data (Precision@7 $= 0.75$) without modifying any trained model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出归一化灵敏度比（Normalised Sensitivity Ratio, NSR），一种后验、模型无关的诊断方法，用于区分模型依赖的特征是因果性的还是虚假性的。在结构化偏移（structured-shift）假设下（不同环境中虚假特征均值变化，因果机制和边缘稳定），NSR通过跨环境灵敏度的变异系数平方来识别因果特征。理论证明在线性结构因果模型（SCM）且K≥3个非退化环境中可达精确识别，并刻画了失效条件。实验合成数据AUROC=1.000，五个模型家族Kendall τ≥0.529，自行车共享数据中恢复六个因果特征（Precision@7=0.75）。
Motivation: 现有方法需要访问训练过程，无法对已训练模型进行后验因果特征识别。本文旨在解决这一问题。
Method: 定义归一化灵敏度比（NSR）为跨环境灵敏度的变异系数平方。在结构化偏移假设下，因果特征灵敏度恒定，虚假特征灵敏度随环境变化。通过NSR值的大小区分因果与虚假特征。
Result: 理论证明线性SCM下精确识别，实验合成数据AUROC=1.000，五个模型家族一致排序（Kendall τ≥0.529），自行车共享数据恢复6/8因果特征（Precision@7=0.75）。
Conclusion: NSR是一种有效的后验因果特征识别工具，适用于结构化偏移场景，但需要满足较强假设（如线性SCM、K≥3个环境等），实践中需检验假设是否成立。

papers.title: OrthKD: Extracting Generalized Clinical Knowledge from Heterogeneous Teachers for Lightweight Deployment
papers.abstract_en: Deploying diabetic retinopathy (DR) screening models in primary care requires edge-efficient systems that remain accurate, safe, and reliable under domain shift. Multi-teacher knowledge distillation (KD) is a natural compression strategy, but existing approaches largely assume that all teachers provide equally trustworthy supervision. In our setting, this assumption fails: a strong CNN teacher (EfficientNet-B3, 0.876 QWK) and a weaker Transformer teacher (Swin-Base, 0.830 QWK) are complementary, yet the Transformer's logits can still mislead the student. We therefore propose OrthKD, a selective-trust distillation framework that transfers full supervision from the strong CNN, uses feature-only distillation from the weak ViT, and enforces orthogonality between teacher-specific student projections to encourage complementary rather than redundant evidence. This design preserves local lesion precision, injects global structural context, and improves robustness to distribution shift. On 132,049 retinal images, a 5.4M-parameter MobileNetV3 student reaches 0.885 QWK on EyePACS and improves zero-shot Messidor-2 performance from 0.507 to 0.728 QWK, while also achieving strong referral AUC and calibration. These results show that selectively distilling heterogeneous teachers can enable practical DR screening on resource-constrained devices.
papers.comment: Accepted to the IJCAI-ECAI 2026 Special Track on AI and Health. 8 pages, 3 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OrthKD，一种选择性信任知识蒸馏框架，用于将异构教师网络（强 CNN 和弱 ViT）的知识迁移至轻量级学生模型，以在资源受限设备上实现糖尿病视网膜病变筛查。在 132,049 张视网膜图像上，5.4M 参数的 MobileNetV3 学生模型在 EyePACS 上达到 0.885 QWK，并将零样本 Messidor-2 性能从 0.507 提升至 0.728 QWK。
Motivation: 现有多教师知识蒸馏方法假设所有教师提供同样可信的监督，但在糖尿病视网膜病变筛查中，强 CNN 教师（EfficientNet-B3, 0.876 QWK）和弱 Transformer 教师（Swin-Base, 0.830 QWK）互补，但弱教师的 logits 可能误导学生。
Method: OrthKD 从强 CNN 教师迁移完整监督，从弱 ViT 教师仅进行特征蒸馏，并通过强制教师特定学生投影正交化来鼓励互补而非冗余的证据。
Result: 在 132,049 张视网膜图像上，5.4M 参数的 MobileNetV3 学生模型达到 0.885 QWK（EyePACS），零样本 Messidor-2 性能从 0.507 提升至 0.728 QWK，同时实现强转诊 AUC 和校准。
Conclusion: 选择性蒸馏异构教师可使资源受限设备上的糖尿病视网膜病变筛查变得实用，增强对分布偏移的鲁棒性。

papers.title: Less is More: Modality-Decoupling for General AIGC Audio-Video Detection
papers.abstract_en: Generative AI has rapidly expanded audio-visual forgery beyond human-centric deepfakes into general scenes. Existing AIGC detection methods assume audio-visual content correspondence, identifying forgeries by spotting cross-modal inconsistencies. However, we empirically find that this assumption does not consistently hold in general scenarios. We argue that, for general audio-visual AIGC detection, decision-level fusion is a more robust alternative to feature-level fusion. Therefore, we propose DAV-Det, a decoupled audio-visual AIGC detection system that independently models forensic evidence from each modality. The visual detector leverages multi-granularity representations at global, patch, and segment levels to capture spatial forgery cues, while the audio detector exploits both temporal and spectral irregularities via a gated temporal-spectral dual-branch architecture to model acoustic artifacts. Our method ranks 1st in the General AIGC Audio-Video Detection Challenge of the IJCAI-ECAI 2026 DDL 2.0 Workshop, with a final score of 0.8460. Code is available at https://github.com/tuffy-studio/DAV-Det.
papers.comment: First place in the General AIGC Audio-Video Detection Challenge at the IJCAI-ECAI 2026 DDL 2.0 Workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对通用AIGC音频-视频检测任务，指出现有方法依赖跨模态一致性假设在通用场景中不成立，提出解耦的DAV-Det系统。该系统采用决策级融合，视觉检测器利用全局、局部和片段级多粒度表示捕捉空间伪造痕迹，音频检测器通过门控时频双分支架构建模时间与频谱异常。在IJCAI-ECAI 2026 DDL 2.0 Workshop的通用AIGC音视频检测挑战赛中取得第一名，最终得分0.8460。
Motivation: 现有AIGC检测方法假设音视频内容存在对应关系，通过检测跨模态不一致性来识别伪造，但该假设在通用场景中并不总是成立，需要更鲁棒的检测范式。
Method: 提出DAV-Det，一种解耦的音视频AIGC检测系统。视觉检测器采用多粒度表示（全局、补丁、片段）捕获空间伪造线索；音频检测器通过门控时频双分支架构利用时间和频谱不规则性建模音频伪影。整个系统采用决策级融合而非特征级融合。
Result: 在IJCAI-ECAI 2026 DDL 2.0 Workshop的通用AIGC音视频检测挑战赛中取得第一名，最终得分0.8460。
Conclusion: 论文强调在通用音视频AIGC检测中，决策级融合相比特征级融合更为鲁棒，解耦各模态的取证证据能更有效地应对通用场景下的伪造检测。

papers.title: Mind the Missing Split: Resolving Feature Heterogeneity in Swarm Learning with Random Forests
papers.abstract_en: Swarm Learning is a decentralized collaborative learning mechanism that allows multiple organizations to train a shared model without central coordination or direct data sharing. In typical horizontal Swarm Learning, datasets across sites are usually assumed to share the same feature set. However, in real-world applications, sites often have partially overlapping features because measurements, protocols, and available covariates differ across sites. This feature heterogeneity creates a practical issue for machine learning algorithms such as Random Forests. Specifically, when decision trees are pooled into a global Random Forest, inference at a given site can become ill-defined if a traversal encounters a split on a feature that is not available locally, often forcing organizations to discard site-specific variables upfront. In this paper, we address feature heterogeneity in Swarm Learning with Random Forests under partially overlapping feature spaces. We propose several deterministic and probabilistic inference-time strategies that resolve such missing splits without restricting training to the intersection of features. We evaluate the methods on nine datasets and demonstrate that they outperform both the intersection baseline and locally trained models across a broad range of scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对Swarm Learning中随机森林在部分重叠特征空间下的特征异质性（feature heterogeneity）问题，即不同站点的特征集不同导致决策树推理时遇到缺失特征而无法进行。作者提出多种确定性和概率性的推理时策略来应对缺失分裂（missing splits），无需限制训练到特征交集。在9个数据集上的实验表明，这些方法优于基线（特征交集模型）和本地独立训练的模型。
Motivation: 现有Swarm Learning通常假设各站点特征集相同，但实际中特征部分重叠，导致随机森林聚合后推理时遇到缺失特征而失效，迫使组织丢弃特有特征。
Method: 提出多种推理时策略，包括确定性和概率性方法，用于处理决策树中遇到缺失特征分裂的情况，使得全局随机森林可以在部分重叠特征空间中使用所有特征训练。
Result: 在9个数据集上评估，所提策略在多种场景下优于特征交集基线以及局部独立训练的模型。
Conclusion: 论文展示了在Swarm Learning中处理特征异质性的有效推理时方法，允许各站点保留特有特征，提升模型性能。
Relevance: 20

papers.title: Visual prompt engineering for video models
papers.abstract_en: In the age of foundation models, a model is only as good as its prompt. For this reason, prompt engineering has become an essential technique for improving language model performance. Since video models are currently becoming foundation models for visual tasks (e.g., visual reasoning), we here ask whether they similarly benefit from visual prompt engineering: automatically modifying the task image to improve model performance. For example, for a visual physics reasoning task ("Where does the ball land, after passing a set of obstacles?"), an abstract sketch-like scene can be turned into a photorealistic version with a simple call to an image editing model. We find that visual prompt engineering, or VIPE for short, improves video reasoning performance across tasks. In fact, for video models, visual prompt engineering can be even more effective than classic text-based prompt engineering or test-time scaling. Ultimately, just as text-based prompt engineering systematically improves language model performance, visual prompt engineering can serve as a simple, compute-efficient approach to elicit better visual reasoning performance from video models. Example videos on our project page at https://visual-prompt-engineering.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨视频模型的视觉提示工程（VIPE），即自动修改任务图像以提升模型性能。研究发现 VIPE 可改善视频推理性能，甚至比文本提示工程或测试时缩放更有效。
Motivation: 基础模型时代，提示工程对语言模型至关重要；视频模型正在成为视觉任务的基础模型，但缺乏类似视觉提示工程的研究。
Method: 提出视觉提示工程（VIPE），通过调用图像编辑模型自动将任务图像转换为更有利于模型推理的版本（例如将抽象草图转为逼真图像）。
Result: 摘要表明 VIPE 在多项视频推理任务上提升了性能，且比文本提示工程或测试时缩放更有效。
Conclusion: 视觉提示工程是一种简单、计算高效的提升视频模型视觉推理性能的方法，类似于文本提示工程对语言模型的系统性提升。

summary_sections.result: 摘要表明 VIPE 在多项视频推理任务上提升了性能，且比文本提示工程或测试时缩放更有效。
summary_sections.conclusion: 视觉提示工程是一种简单、计算高效的提升视频模型视觉推理性能的方法，类似于文本提示工程对语言模型的系统性提升。

papers.title: Entangled by Design: Spurious Intra-Variable Signal Routing in Tabular In-Context Learners
papers.abstract_en: Consider a model trained at a single hospital to predict patient recovery, where the measured feature $X$ bundles the patient's true health signal ($C$) with a systematic artefact from that hospital's equipment ($S$). Within that hospital, the artefact correlates with outcomes through unmeasured confounders such as patient demographics; an in-context learner rationally routes predictions through $S$, not $C$, and fails silently when deployed at a new hospital with different equipment. We formalise this as \emph{spurious routing in composite representations}: when a feature $X = [C;\,αS;\,η]$ encodes a causal signal $C$ and a spurious signal $S$ in distinct subspaces, the ICL cannot determine which drives predictions. We prove that under ridge ICL, a linear in-context learner, this routing is unavoidable regardless of context size; TabPFN, a state-of-the-art pretrained tabular ICL model, shows qualitatively consistent behaviour empirically. We derive a closed-form characterisation, $\mathrm{CSR} \propto ρ_S/ρ_C$, confirmed at $r = 0.997$ for linear ICL and $r = 0.979$ for TabPFN. Contrary to intuition, larger context sharpens commitment to the dominant in-context signal, amplifying spurious routing by up to $1.74\times$; in the high-spurious corner, more expressive models show greater vulnerability empirically ($+2.22$ CSR gap at high entanglement). We introduce two lightweight mitigations: environment-stratified context construction and S-swap augmentation, that require only weak environment labels and no knowledge of the causal partition. S-swap reduces spurious routing by $74\%$ for linear ICL and $98.8\%$ for TabPFN, with TabPFN's causal sensitivity increasing $8.4\times$ simultaneously: the model does not become agnostic, it reroutes through the causal signal.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究表格上下文学习模型（如TabPFN）在跨域部署时因虚假信号导致预测失败的问题。作者形式化了复合表示中的虚假路由，证明了在岭ICL下不可避免，并在TabPFN中验证了定性一致行为。提出了环境分层上下文构建和S-swap增强两种轻量级缓解方法，其中S-swap使线性ICL虚假路由减少74%，TabPFN虚假路由减少98.8%，同时因果敏感性提升8.4倍。
Motivation: 单一医院训练的模型因特征X中混合真实信号C与设备伪影S，ICL会通过S而非C进行预测，导致在新医院部署时失败。
Method: 形式化定义虚假路由，推导CSR度量与ρ_S/ρ_C比例关系，并引入环境分层上下文构建和S-swap增强两种仅需弱环境标签的缓解方法。
Result: 线性ICL中CSR与ρ_S/ρ_C相关系数r=0.997，TabPFN中r=0.979；更大上下文可放大虚假路由至1.74倍；S-swap使线性ICL虚假路由减少74%，TabPFN减少98.8%，因果敏感性提升8.4倍。
Conclusion: 表格ICL中虚假路由不可避免，但通过弱环境标签的缓解方法可有效重定向至因果信号，且更大上下文会加剧而非削弱该问题。

papers.title: Multi-Scale Structural Features for Continual, Comprehensible Visual Recognition in a Developmental Learning Framework
papers.abstract_en: Contemporary machine learning struggles to learn continually, reuse prior knowledge, and expose a comprehensible internal structure. A recently proposed developmental, gradient-free learning framework addresses these limitations by learning a discrete, topological model of its inputs through local variation and selection, yielding an inherent continual-learning guarantee: new observations refine existing structure without overwriting past knowledge, and without replay buffers or predefined task boundaries. Its extension to visual inputs demonstrated this principle on shape recognition, but relied on a feature representation of limited expressivity that capped recognition accuracy. We introduce a new visual feature representation that encodes shape structure across multiple scales, capturing edge and contour features together with their spatial relations, and integrate it with the network-refinement learning process; we further improve the learning dynamics and the read-out used to predict from the learned model. The study targets two-dimensional shape, with class-incremental MNIST as a controlled, interpretable benchmark in which continual-learning behavior can be measured directly. Our approach substantially increases accuracy over the prior representation, matching or exceeding replay- and regularisation-based baselines at comparable storage while storing no past data, and preserves the framework's defining behavior: earlier-learned classes are retained as new ones are introduced, with no destructive adaptation, and the learned representations remain human-interpretable. What separates the methods is retention: the baselines surrender most of a just-trained class within its own cycle and relearn it afterwards, which ours does not. TL;DR: 本文在一种持续学习框架中引入多尺度结构特征表示，用于二维形状识别。该框架基于局部变异与选择的离散拓扑模型，无需梯度、回放缓冲区或预定义任务边界。在类增量MNIST基准上，新表示提高了识别精度，匹配或超越基于回放和正则化的基线，同时保持对人类可解释的内部结构和持续学习特性。
Motivation: 现有机器学习模型难以实现持续学习、重用先验知识并保持内部结构可解释。此前该框架扩展到视觉输入时，特征表示表达能力有限，限制了识别精度。
Method: 提出一种多尺度结构特征表示，融合边缘和轮廓特征及其空间关系，并与基于局部变异和选择的网络细化学习过程整合，同时改进了学习动力学和用于预测的读出机制。
Result: 在类增量MNIST基准上，该方法相比先前表示显著提高了精度，在相近存储条件下匹配或超越基于回放和正则化的基线，且无需存储历史数据。基线方法在单个周期内会遗忘刚学过的类别并重新学习，而本方法不会。
Conclusion: 该方法在持续学习场景下保留了先前学习类别，学习表示对人类可解释，其意义在于逐样本整合信息的同时保证对先前经验的响应不变。

papers.title: Are the High-weight Neurons the Important Ones in Image Classification Neural Networks?
papers.abstract_en: As neural network models for image classification advance, neurons play critical roles in pruning, backdoor defense, and interpretability. Yet existing work lacks clarity on the weight-importance relationship. We address this with a neuron importance assessment method using three experiments: quantifying overlap between high-weight and accuracy-impacting neurons, analyzing high-weight neuron perturbation effects, and testing post-retraining accuracy after high-weight neuron ablation. Experiments on CIFAR-10 and Mini-ImageNet reveal key patterns. Overlap analysis shows top 10\% high-weight neurons overlap with important ones by only about 25\% at maximum, dropping further in subsequent intervals. Perturbation tests find top 10\% high-weight neurons cause 45-80\% accuracy degradation under certain operations compared to 3-7\% for random perturbations, but a third of them show minimal impact. Ablation-retraining results show removing top 10\% high-weight neurons leaves accuracy 10-20\% below baseline with no recovery, while ablating top 0.1\% allows near-full recovery. Notably, some low-weight intervals show 10-17\% degradation when perturbed, comparable to mid-range high-weight neurons. These results confirm not all high-weight neurons are important: their importance is nonlinear. Low-weight neurons also contribute significantly. This challenges weight-importance equivalence, offering refined neuron role insights. It supports applications like encryption prioritizing critical high-weight neurons and pruning removing non-critical ones, advancing neural network analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过三项实验（高权重与重要性神经元重叠分析、扰动测试、消融后重训练）系统研究了图像分类神经网络中高权重神经元是否真正重要。在CIFAR-10和Mini-ImageNet上的实验表明，高权重神经元与重要性神经元的重叠率最高仅约25%，且部分高权重神经元扰动后影响极小，而低权重神经元在某些情况下也会造成显著性能下降，挑战了权重-重要性等价假设。
Motivation: 现有研究缺乏对神经元权重与重要性之间关系的清晰理解，阻碍了剪枝、后门防御和可解释性等应用的发展。
Method: 提出了神经元重要性评估方法，包括三个实验：量化高权重神经元与影响准确率的神经元之间的重叠程度；分析高权重神经元扰动的影响；测试消融高权重神经元后重训练的准确率恢复情况。
Result: 重叠分析显示，前10%高权重神经元与重要性神经元的最大重叠率仅约25%，且后续区间进一步下降；扰动测试中，前10%高权重神经元在某些操作下导致45-80%准确率下降，但其中三分之一影响极小；消融-重训练结果显示，移除前10%高权重神经元导致准确率低于基线10-20%且无法恢复，而移除前0.1%可近乎完全恢复；此外，某些低权重区间扰动导致10-17%下降，与中高权重神经元相当。
Conclusion: 并非所有高权重神经元都重要，其重要性是非线性的，低权重神经元也有显著贡献，这挑战了权重-重要性等价观点，并为优先保护关键神经元或剪除非关键神经元等应用提供了新见解。

papers.title: Argus-Unified: Towards A Compact and Economical Unified Model for Image Understanding and Generation
papers.abstract_en: Unifying visual understanding and generation in one model holds immense promise, but remains challenging and expensive due to heavy compute and data demands and conflicts between the visual features needed for these two capabilities. To address these challenges, we present Argus-Unified, a compact, effective and unified multimodal model built with low demand on computation and data. Instead of aligning modalities from scratch, Argus-Unified effectively leverages pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) that provide strong multimodal priors. Specifically, we introduce hybrid visual tokens that preserve continuous tokens for understanding while learning discrete tokens for generation from a frozen unified vision encoder. Our training pipeline includes two stages: the first stage learns a quantizer and image decoder on top of the frozen vision encoder, the second stage trains the LLM initialized from a pretrained VLM for the unified multimodal modeling. Using by far the least amount of data (15.6M) and the lowest cost (~$2,000), we demonstrate that unified multimodal models can be trained economically while achieving strong performance in both understanding and generation. Notably, our model attains state-of-the-art multimodal understanding on GQA, POPE, and VQAv2, and competitive generation quality compared to models with dedicated vision encoders (e.g., Janus, Janus-Pro), all at ~10x lower cost and with ~5x less data. We envision Argus-Unified as a useful baseline that lowers the development barrier for unified models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Argus-Unified，一个紧凑、高效且经济统一的视觉理解与生成模型，利用预训练视觉-语言模型（VLM）和多模态先验。通过引入混合视觉token（连续/离散）和两阶段训练（量化器+解码器，LLM统一训练），仅用1560万数据和约2000美元成本，即在GQA、POPE、VQAv2等理解基准上达到SOTA，生成质量接近专用视觉编码器模型（如Janus、Janus-Pro），但成本降低约10倍、数据减少约5倍。
Motivation: 现有统一视觉理解与生成模型存在计算和数据需求高、视觉特征冲突的问题，导致训练昂贵且困难。
Method: 利用冻结的预训练统一视觉编码器提取视觉特征，设计混合视觉token：连续token用于理解，离散token（通过量化器学习）用于生成。训练分两阶段：第一阶段学习量化器和图像解码器，第二阶段用预训练VLM初始化LLM进行联合建模。
Result: 在GQA、POPE、VQAv2上达到多模态理解SOTA；生成质量与Janus、Janus-Pro等模型竞争力相当，但训练成本约降低10倍、数据量约减少5倍。
Conclusion: Argus-Unified作为统一视觉理解和生成的经济基线，有望降低该领域的发展门槛。

papers.title: ReLATE: Reliability-Guided Evidence Fusion for Robust UAV--Satellite cross-view Geo-Localization
papers.abstract_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV)-satellite cross-view geo-localization matches UAV images against satellite imagery and has achieved impressive accuracy on clean (non-degraded) image benchmarks. In real-world flights, however, UAV observations are frequently affected by adverse weather, illumination changes, platform motion, sensor noise, and compression, while the robustness of existing methods under such degradations remains largely unexamined. In this paper, we present UAVSat-Deg, a large-scale robustness benchmark for degraded UAV-satellite geo-localization, comprising University-1652-Deg and SUES-200-Deg. UAVSat-Deg covers 27 corruption types, including 19 core and 8 compound corruptions, at three severity levels, supports bidirectional drone-to-satellite and satellite-to-drone retrieval as well as multi-height UAV acquisition, and contains more than 11.7 million pre-generated corrupted test images. Benchmarking representative methods under this protocol reveals substantial robustness gaps, particularly under severe and compound corruptions. To address this problem, we propose ReLATE, a Reliable Evidence Learning framework with Adaptive Token Evidence Regulation, which realizes reliability-adaptive feature fusion during descriptor construction. ReLATE estimates a structure-smoothed reliability field over visual tokens, aggregates trustworthy local evidence, and adaptively integrates it into query-derived representations; the regulated query representations are then combined with the CLS-token and GeM-pooled branches to form the final cross-view descriptor. Across both test sets and retrieval directions, ReLATE achieves the best average corrupted-test performance among the compared methods while maintaining competitive accuracy on clean images. The code and dataset will be available at https://github.com/JHC626/ReLATE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ReLATE，一种可靠性引导的证据融合框架，用于提升无人机-卫星交叉视角地理定位在真实退化环境下的鲁棒性。作者构建了一个大规模鲁棒性基准 UAVSat-Deg，涵盖 27 种退化类型和三个严重级别，包含超过 1170 万张退化测试图像。实验表明现有方法在严重和复合退化下性能大幅下降，而 ReLATE 通过自适应令牌证据调节实现可靠性自适应的特征融合，在退化测试上取得最佳平均性能，同时保持干净图像上的竞争精度。
Motivation: 现有无人机-卫星地理定位方法在干净图像上表现优异，但真实飞行中常遇恶劣天气、光照变化、运动模糊、传感器噪声和压缩等退化，而现有方法在这些退化下的鲁棒性未被充分研究。
Method: 提出 ReLATE 框架，包含结构平滑的可靠性场估计、可信局部证据聚合，以及自适应证据调节的查询表示融合；最终描述符由调节后的查询表示与 CLS 令牌和 GeM 池化分支联合构成。
Result: 在所有测试集和检索方向上，ReLATE 在退化测试上取得最佳平均性能，同时保持干净图像上的竞争精度。
Conclusion: ReLATE 通过可靠性引导的特征融合有效提升了跨视角地理定位在多种退化下的鲁棒性，代码和数据集将公开。
