summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 ReLATE，一种可靠性引导的证据融合框架，用于提升无人机-卫星交叉视角地理定位在真实退化环境下的鲁棒性。作者构建了一个大规模鲁棒性基准 UAVSat-Deg，涵盖 27 种退化类型和三个严重级别，包含超过 1170 万张退化测试图像。实验表明现有方法在严重和复合退化下性能大幅下降，而 ReLATE 通过自适应令牌证据调节实现可靠性自适应的特征融合，在退化测试上取得最佳平均性能，同时保持干净图像上的竞争精度。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有无人机-卫星地理定位方法在干净图像上表现优异，但真实飞行中常遇恶劣天气、光照变化、运动模糊、传感器噪声和压缩等退化，而现有方法在这些退化下的鲁棒性未被充分研究。
summary_sections.method: 提出 ReLATE 框架，包含结构平滑的可靠性场估计、可信局部证据聚合，以及自适应证据调节的查询表示融合；最终描述符由调节后的查询表示与 CLS 令牌和 GeM 池化分支联合构成。
summary_sections.result: 在所有测试集和检索方向上，ReLATE 在退化测试上取得最佳平均性能，同时保持干净图像上的竞争精度。
summary_sections.conclusion: ReLATE 通过可靠性引导的特征融合有效提升了跨视角地理定位在多种退化下的鲁棒性，代码和数据集将公开。

papers.title: I2VShield: An Efficient Proactive Defense Framework against DiT-based Image-to-Video Models
papers.abstract_en: The rapid advancement of video generation models has led to the increasing misuse of image-to-video (I2V) models. Although substantial progress has been made in detecting AI-generated videos, proactive defenses against I2V models remain underexplored. In particular, current proactive defenses against I2V models predominantly rely on gradient-based adversarial attacks, which require defenders to possess GPUs with substantial memory resources (VRAM) to generate adversarial examples. To address this issue, we propose I2VShield, a privacy protection method based on generative adversarial attacks tailored to Diffusion Transformer (DiT)-based I2V models. The proposed method primarily consists of two components: (1) a text-adaptive perturbation generation framework integrating adversarial learning to mitigate computational overhead while maintaining visual imperceptibility; and (2) an untargeted Multimodal Attention Disruption (MAD) attack that exploits the inherent vulnerabilities of DiT-based I2V models, maximizing the deviation of the internal attention features from their clean states. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves highly competitive protection performance across various datasets and mainstream DiT-based I2V models, particularly in disrupting spatiotemporal coherence, while substantially reducing computational costs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出I2VShield，一种针对基于DiT（Diffusion Transformer）的图像到视频（I2V）模型的主动防御框架，通过生成对抗攻击来保护隐私。方法包括文本自适应扰动生成和多模态注意力破坏攻击，能够在降低计算成本的同时有效破坏生成的视频质量。
Motivation: 当前针对I2V模型的主动防御主要依赖梯度攻击，需要大量GPU显存，本文旨在提出一种更高效的防御方法。
Method: 由两部分组成：1) 文本自适应扰动生成框架，结合对抗学习以降低计算开销并保持视觉不可察觉性；2) 无目标多模态注意力破坏（MAD）攻击，利用DiT模型的固有漏洞，最大化内部注意力特征与干净状态的偏差。
Result: 实验表明，该方法在各种数据集和主流DiT-based I2V模型上实现了高度竞争的保护性能，尤其在破坏时空连贯性方面，同时显著降低计算成本。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法能有效防御DiT-based I2V模型，且计算效率高。

papers.title: AMPBench-MT: A Homology-Controlled Benchmark for Antimicrobial Peptide Potency, Spectrum, and Safety Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Computational AMP discovery is often evaluated through AMP/non-AMP recognition, yet follow-up decisions depend on assay-derived evidence such as target-species potency, hemolysis, toxicity, and selectivity. Existing AMP and peptide benchmarks cover binary recognition, multilabel annotation, assay regression, or broader peptide-model comparison, but they do not jointly place AMP recognition, species-conditioned potency, spectrum, safety-facing proxy endpoints, and cross-endpoint behavior within one sequence-homology-controlled protocol. To address this problem, we introduce AMPBench-MT, a provenance-preserving benchmark that standardizes canonical peptide records and organizes them into binary recognition, species-conditioned pMIC regression, and endpoint-specific potency and safety-facing readouts. Across 161 endpoint-specific model evaluations, high binary performance does not reliably indicate assay-endpoint behavior. Frozen protein-language-model embeddings form the leading pMIC error cluster, while graph and classical regressors remain close. Spectrum labels further reveal that PR-oriented metrics can be misleading under scarce observed negatives, whereas low-toxicity, HC50 hemolysis, and selectivity expose smaller but more assay-facing signals. AMPBench-MT shows that AMP evaluation should move beyond recognition leaderboards toward endpoint-aware evidence auditing. Our proposed benchmark is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/ZihengZhou06/AMPBench-MT.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AMPBench-MT，一个同源性控制的抗菌肽（AMP）基准，涵盖二元识别、物种依赖性效力、谱系及安全性预测。通过161个端点评测，发现高二元识别性能不完全预示化验端点表现，图谱和经典回归优于冷冻蛋白质语言模型嵌入。基准强调AMP评估应转向端点感知的证据审计。
Motivation: 现有AMP基准多集中于二元识别，缺乏同时考虑物种依赖性效力、溶血性、毒性和选择性等化验端点及其跨端点行为的同源性控制协议。
Method: 构建同源性控制的基准，标准化肽记录并组织为二元识别、物种依赖性pMIC回归及端点特异性效力和安全性读数，采用序列同源性控制协议。
Result: 高二元识别性能不能可靠指示化验端点行为；冷冻蛋白质语言模型嵌入形成主要pMIC误差簇，而图和经典回归器表现更优；谱标签显示高假阳性率下PR指标可能误导，低毒性、HC50和选择性暴露较小但更面向化验的信号。
Conclusion: AMP评估应超越识别排行榜，转向端点感知的证据审计。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: At-the-Roofline Sparse Tensor Contractions on Vector Processors for Transformer Inference
papers.abstract_en: Fine-grained weight pruning and activation sparsification have emerged as effective approaches for reducing the compute and memory cost of inference for Transformer models. In the moderate-sparsity regime, Gustavson's dataflow provides a natural execution model for exploiting both activation and weight sparsity on vector processors through metadata-driven indexed accumulation. However, existing RVV architectures lack native support for this pattern, forcing kernels to rely on software index decoding and L1-backed indexed memory operations that keep sparse tensor contractions far below their roofline performance bound. We present Ventaglio, a runtime-configurable sparse execution unit coupled with RVV ISA extensions that drives sparse tensor contractions toward their roofline through indexed gather-accumulate-scatter support. Integrated into an open-source vector processing cluster and implemented in 12nm FinFET, Ventaglio accelerates sparse tensor contraction kernels by $6.9\text{--}7.4\times$ over optimized RVV baselines, with only $3.1\%$ area overhead for a cluster of tightly-L1 coupled vector processing elements. We build a performance-accurate instruction-level model of the Ventaglio extension, calibrate it against RTL implementation, and leverage it for scale-out performance analysis on a large $4\times4$ multi-cluster system. Using a DuoGPT-pruned LLaMA-3-8B model with practical $40\text{--}60\%$ dual sparsity, Ventaglio achieves $2.40\text{--}5.25\times$ and $2.06\text{--}3.16\times$ speedup over dense baselines during prefill and autoregressive decoding, respectively.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 4 figures, 34th IFIP/IEEE International Conference on Very Large Scale Integration SoC (VLSI-SoC 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Ventaglio，一种针对向量处理器的运行时配置稀疏执行单元及RVV ISA扩展，通过索引聚集-累积-分散操作将稀疏张量收缩推向roofline。在12nm FinFET实现中，稀疏张量收缩核加速6.9-7.4倍于优化RVV基线，面积开销仅3.1%。在LLaMA-3-8B剪枝模型上，Ventaglio在prefill和解码阶段分别实现2.40-5.25倍和2.06-3.16倍加速。
Motivation: 现有RVV架构缺乏对Gustavson数据流的原生支持，导致稀疏张量收缩因软件索引解码和L1支持索引内存操作而远低于roofline性能上限。
Method: 通过Ventaglio硬件单元扩展RVV ISA，提供索引聚集-累积-分散操作；集成到开源向量处理集群并实现于12nm FinFET工艺。
Result: 稀疏张量收缩核加速6.9-7.4倍于优化RVV基线，面积开销3.1%；在DuoGPT剪枝LLaMA-3-8B模型上，prefill与自回归解码分别加速2.40-5.25倍和2.06-3.16倍于密集基线。
Conclusion: Ventaglio通过硬件支持索引数据流有效桥接了稀疏张量收缩与roofline之间的差距，在较低面积开销下取得显著加速。

papers.title: Group Equivariant Diffusion for Anomaly Detection in Computational Cytology
papers.abstract_en: Computational cytology on whole-slide images is challenging because malignant cells are rare, heterogeneous, and annotated slides are scarce. Anomaly detection frameworks can be trained on normal slide-negative patches and then applied at test time to flag abnormal patches in held-out slides. Most unsupervised anomaly detection approaches including generative ones (GAN-based and diffusion-based), are tuned to organ-level imaging and require large curated datasets. In cytology the signal is cell-centric: rotating or flipping a single-cell patch does not change its diagnostic class, yet standard diffusion models treat transformed views as distinct inputs, leading to transformation-dependent reconstructions and unstable anomaly scores. We propose a D4-equivariant diffusion framework that enforces rotation and reflection symmetry both architecturally, via a D4-equivariant U-Net, and at inference, via equivariant noise coupling and (optionally) frame averaging. This alignment with biological invariance yields transformation-consistent pseudo-healthy reconstructions and more stable anomaly ranking under symmetry. On two publicly available cytology datasets of bone marrow and peripheral blood smears, our D4-equivariant diffusion models achieve higher AUC and retrieve more abnormal cells in the top K predictions than non-equivariant generative baselines, a deep one-class, and a multiple instance learning based method, while substantially reducing score variance across rotations and flips. Code is available at https://swchmida.github.io/D4diffCyto/.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 2 figures, 1 table, 1 algorithm. Accepted for publication in MICCAI 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对计算细胞学全切片图像中恶性细胞稀少、异质且标注稀缺的问题，提出一种D4等变扩散模型（D4-equivariant diffusion）。通过D4等变U-Net架构、等变噪声耦合和可选帧平均，强制模型对旋转和反射变换保持不变性，从而得到变换一致的伪健康重建和更稳定的异常评分。在骨髓和外周血涂片两个公开数据集上，该方法相比非等变生成基线、深度单类方法及多实例学习方法取得更高AUC，并在top K预测中检索到更多异常细胞，同时显著降低旋转/翻转下的分数方差。
Motivation: 现有无监督异常检测方法（包括生成式方法）在细胞学中面临挑战：标准扩散模型将旋转/翻转后的单细胞斑块视为不同输入，导致变换依赖的重建和异常分数不稳定，而细胞诊断本身对旋转反射不变，因此需要对齐生物对称性的生成模型。
Method: 提出D4等变扩散框架，包括D4等变U-Net结构、等变噪声耦合（equivariant noise coupling）以及可选的帧平均（frame averaging），使扩散过程在架构和推理阶段都遵守旋转与反射对称性。
Result: 在两个公开细胞学数据集（骨髓和外周血涂片）上，所提D4等变扩散模型比非等变生成基线、深度单类方法及多实例学习方法获得更高AUC，在top K预测中检索到更多异常细胞，且异常分数在旋转/翻转下的方差显著降低。
Conclusion: 本文证明将旋转反射等变性纳入扩散模型可提升细胞学异常检测的稳定性和性能，代码已公开，为计算病理学中的生成式异常检测提供了对称性对齐的新范式。

papers.title: Anti-Backdoor Coreset Selection via Cumulative Entropy
papers.abstract_en: Recent training-time defenses against neural backdoors isolate a benign subset from poisoned training data, to learn a backdoor-free model from it. In this paper, we formulate this defense strategy as a coreset selection problem, giving rise to so-called "Anti-Backdoor Coreset Selection." Since poisonous samples have (a) lower prediction uncertainty and are (b) less frequent than benign samples, coreset selection naturally focuses more on samples associated with benign functionality than the backdoor functionality. We use the Cumulative Entropy as selection criterion to further facilitate this effect. The metric tracks the learning dynamics of training samples and allowing us to select benign samples with high informativeness for the coreset. Additionally, we unlearn the chosen samples in each epoch to facilitate the separability between benign and poisonous samples. Together, this yields an exceptionally effective training-time defense that constructs a benign coreset to train a backdoor-free model. Unlike prior defenses that compromise natural accuracy and fail against certain attacks, our method mitigates backdooring attacks consistently with a negligible impact on natural performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文将训练时后门防御问题形式化为核心集选择问题，称为“抗后门核心集选择”。利用有毒样本预测不确定性低且频率低的特点，使用累积熵作为选择标准来追踪样本学习动态，并每轮遗忘已选样本以增强良性与有毒样本的可分离性，从而构建良性核心集训练无后门模型。
Motivation: 现有训练时后门防御方法需要从被污染的训练数据中隔离出良性子集，但缺乏系统化的核心集选择方法，且易牺牲自然准确率或无法抵抗某些攻击。
Method: 提出抗后门核心集选择框架，使用累积熵作为选择标准追踪样本学习动态，并每轮遗忘已选样本以增强良性与有毒样本的可分离性。
Result: 摘要称该方法能持续缓解后门攻击，且对自然性能影响可忽略，优于先前防御方法。
Conclusion: 该方法为训练时后门防御提供了一种有效的核心集选择范式，但摘要未明确讨论局限性或范围。

summary_sections.result: 摘要称该方法能持续缓解后门攻击，且对自然性能影响可忽略，优于先前防御方法。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该方法为训练时后门防御提供了一种有效的核心集选择范式，但摘要未明确讨论局限性或范围。

papers.title: Beyond Counts: A Distributional Robustness Margin For Pathology Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Pathology foundation models are approaching clinical deployment, yet remain vulnerable to systematic non-biological variation across centres. Differences in tissue preparation, staining and scanning are strongly encoded in their representations, enabling shortcut learning and weakening generalisation across cohorts and institutions. The Robustness Index (RI) quantifies whether local representation geometry is dominated by biology or by non-biological variation, but its count-based formulation discards distance information. We show that adding distance weights changes little because the deeper limitation lies in RI's pooled, fixed-neighbourhood design, which obscures sample-level heterogeneity and effectively evaluates only a model-dependent subset of samples. We introduce the Cross-confounder Robustness Margin (CRoMa), a sample-resolved measure that directly compares distances to cross-confounder biological matches and same-confounder biological distractors. CRoMa recasts robustness as a cohort-wide margin distribution rather than a single pooled score. We evaluated frozen representations from 20 tile-level encoders across three benchmarks and 4 slide-level encoders on a fourth. Rankings by median CRoMa were broadly consistent across datasets, while the underlying distributions revealed substantial within-model heterogeneity. Every tile encoder retained a confounder-dominated lower tail, whose prevalence and severity varied markedly across models. These distinct robustness profiles frame model selection as a Pareto trade-off between typical and lower-tail robustness. Higher CRoMa was also associated with smaller shortcut-induced performance drops after supervised adaptation. By turning representation geometry into a distributional robustness readout that anticipates downstream shortcut susceptibility, CRoMa provides a principled basis for robustness assessment and model selection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对病理基础模型在跨中心非生物变异下的鲁棒性评估，指出现有Robustness Index（RI）基于计数的固定邻域设计丢失距离信息且掩盖样本异质性，提出Cross-confounder Robustness Margin（CRoMa）作为样本分辨的分布鲁棒性度量。在多个基准上评估了20个切片级编码器和4个全切片级编码器，发现模型内异质性和低尾分布。
Motivation: 病理基础模型在临床部署前易受非生物变异影响，现有鲁棒性度量RI存在局限性。
Method: 提出CRoMa，直接比较到跨混淆因子生物学匹配和同混淆因子生物学干扰物的距离，将鲁棒性视为整个队列的边际分布而非单一得分。
Result: 在三个基准上评估20个切片级编码器和第四个基准上4个全切片级编码器，中位数CRoMa排名一致，但分布显示模型内显著异质性，每个切片编码器保留混淆因子主导的低尾。
Conclusion: CRoMa将表示几何转化为分布鲁棒性读数，可预测下游捷径易感性，为鲁棒性评估和模型选择提供基础。

papers.title: Automated Numerical Stability Analysis of Deep Learning Operators
papers.abstract_en: Finite-precision arithmetic unavoidably introduces numerical approximation errors. Numerical computations may use insufficient precision or an improper formulation, which leads to numerical instability. In this paper, we introduce the first unified software tool that integrates CESTAC for detecting the numerical stability of deep learning operators. Our developed software not only enables numerical validation with a single computation pass but also detects the sources of numerical instability and provides numerical stability monitoring during deep learning training and inference. We verified its effectiveness on the detection of polluted operators with injected numerical instabilities across various tasks. We believe that our developed method and tool provide valuable insights into developing numerically stable computing kernels, which are particularly critical for numerically stable and efficient deep learning training and inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出首个统一软件工具，基于CESTAC方法检测深度学习算子的数值稳定性，支持单次计算验证、识别不稳定源并监控训练与推理过程。在注入数值不稳定的算子上的实验验证了有效性。
Motivation: 有限精度算术不可避免引入数值近似误差，不适当的精度或公式会导致数值不稳定，但缺乏统一工具检测深度学习算子的稳定性。
Method: 集成CESTAC方法，实现单次计算通路的数值验证，自动检测数值不稳定源，并在深度学习训练和推理中提供稳定性监控。
Result: 在多种任务中成功检测出注入数值不稳定的算子，验证了方法的有效性。
Conclusion: 本工具和方法为开发数值稳定的计算内核提供了见解，对稳定高效的深度学习训练和推理至关重要。

papers.title: Quantum Speedups for Stochastic Optimization with Heavy-Tailed Noise
papers.abstract_en: We study stochastic optimization with heavy-tailed gradient noise. We first propose a novel quantum mean estimator for multivariate heavy-tailed random variables that achieves lower query complexity than optimal classical estimators in the low-dimensional regime. We further develop an unbiased quantum mean estimator by applying a generalized multi-level Monte Carlo technique. We prove quantum lower bounds showing that, when the dimension $d$ of the random vector is small and can be viewed as a constant, our quantum estimators are optimal up to logarithmic factors. We further derive stronger dimension-dependent lower bounds for tail index $p>4/3$, showing that a nontrivial dependence on the dimension is unavoidable in the low-dimensional regime. Based on these estimators, we propose a quantum normalized stochastic gradient descent method ($\texttt{QNSGD}$), which finds an $ε$-stationary point using $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}\big(\sqrt d\,ε^{-\frac{5p-4}{2p-2}}\big)$ queries to the quantum stochastic gradient oracle. For a convex objective function, we propose a quantum projected stochastic gradient descent method ($\texttt{QPSGD}$), which computes a solution with $ε$-optimal solution using $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}\big(\sqrt d\,ε^{-\frac{3p-2}{2p-2}}+ε^{-2}\big)$ queries in expectation. These sharper bounds improve upon the classical lower bounds $Ω\big(ε^{-\frac{3p-2}{p-1}}\big)$ for nonconvex problems and $Ω\big(ε^{-\frac{p}{p-1}}\big)$ for convex problems in the low-dimensional regimes $d\lesssimε^{-\frac{p}{p-1}}$ and $d\lesssimε^{-\frac{2-p}{p-1}}$, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究重尾噪声下的随机优化问题，提出一种新的多元重尾随机变量的量子均值估计器，在低维情形下查询复杂度低于最优经典估计器。通过广义多级蒙特卡罗技术得到无偏量子均值估计器，并证明其最优性（对数因子内）。基于这些估计器，提出量子归一化随机梯度下降方法（QNSGD）和量子投影随机梯度下降方法（QPSGD），在低维区域取得比经典下界更优的查询复杂度。
Motivation: 经典随机优化在重尾噪声下存在下界瓶颈，量子计算可能带来加速。现有量子方法缺乏针对重尾噪声的高效均值估计器，且低维情形下的量子优势尚待探索。
Method: 提出量子均值估计器，结合多级蒙特卡罗技术实现无偏估计；基于此设计QNSGD（非凸问题）和QPSGD（凸问题），并给出理论查询复杂度。
Result: QNSGD 找到 ε-稳定点的查询复杂度为 Õ(√d ε^{-(5p-4)/(2p-2)})，QPSGD 的期望查询复杂度为 Õ(√d ε^{-(3p-2)/(2p-2)} + ε^{-2})，在低维区域 d ≲ ε^{-p/(p-1)}（非凸）和 d ≲ ε^{-(2-p)/(p-1)}（凸）下改进经典下界。
Conclusion: 量子方法在低维重尾随机优化中可实现理论加速，且最优性可达对数因子。维数依赖性在尾指数 p>4/3 时不可避免。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Agentic AI in medicine: architectures, applications, evaluation, and challenges for clinical translation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models and multimodal foundation models are enabling medical artificial intelligence (AI) systems to move beyond isolated prediction and undertake multistep clinical tasks that require planning, tool use, memory, iterative correction, and coordination among specialized agents. However, the scope of agentic AI in medicine remains unsettled, and current evaluation practices are not yet aligned with the requirements of clinical use. We conducted a scoping review with systematic evidence mapping across five electronic sources, screened 1,649 exportable records, and provisionally included 557 unique studies that met predefined criteria for goal-directed task execution, tool use, interaction with external resources, feedback-based refinement, or multi-agent collaboration. The included studies describe single agents that use external tools, workflows supported by retrieval and external knowledge, multimodal agents, and multi-agent systems applied to medical question answering, image interpretation, electronic health record analysis, drug safety, and clinical trial prediction. The evidence base remains dominated by public benchmarks, simulated settings, retrospective datasets, and small-scale expert evaluation. Process reliability, evidence traceability, uncertainty, safety, workflow impact, and external validity are evaluated less consistently. Clinical translation will depend on clearer definitions, reproducible evaluation, auditable oversight, interoperable system design, and prospective validation in real-world clinical workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对医学中的代理人工智能（agentic AI）进行了范围综述，系统梳理了单智能体工具使用、多模态智能体、多智能体协作等架构在医学问答、图像解读、电子病历分析等任务中的应用，并通过557项纳入研究总结出当前评估以公共基准和模拟为主、过程可靠性和外部效度评估不足的现状。
Motivation: 医学AI正从孤立预测转向多步临床任务，但代理AI在医学中的范围尚不清晰，现行评估实践未与临床需求对齐，亟需系统性综述来界定领域、总结证据并指出转化障碍。
Method: 采用范围综述（scoping review）结合系统性证据映射方法，检索五个电子数据库，筛选1649条记录后纳入557项符合预设标准的研究，对单智能体、多模态、多智能体系统及其应用与评估进行归类分析。
Result: 纳入研究涵盖单智能体工具使用、检索增强工作流、多模态智能体及多智能体系统，应用于医学问答、图像解读、电子病历分析、药物安全等；但证据基础以公共基准、模拟、回顾性数据和小规模专家评估为主，过程可靠性、证据可追溯性、不确定性、安全性、工作流影响及外部效度评估不足。
Conclusion: 临床转化需要更清晰的定义、可重复的评估、可审计的监督、可互操作的系统设计以及真实临床工作流中的前瞻性验证。

papers.title: CoTinyVLA: Chain-of-Thought Distillation for a Sub-Billion-Parameter Vision-Language-Action Model
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models translate natural-language commands into robot action sequences, but leading systems on the LIBERO-Plus robustness benchmark use three- to seven-billion-parameter backbones whose memory demands can exceed embedded robotic budgets. We present CoTinyVLA, a 0.9B-parameter action model on a Qwen3.5-0.8B backbone that obtains that robustness by structuring supervision instead of enlarging the model. Three components target different axes of the problem: dual-view temporal input of 16 history frames per step with textual camera and time markers; hierarchical chain-of-thought (CoT) distillation from a 35B teacher into an episode-level Plan and a chunk-level Think span over task phase, gripper state and next subaction; and paraphrase augmentation expanding 40 base commands into 800 variants. On LIBERO-Plus, spanning 10,030 perturbed tasks across seven perturbation dimensions, CoTinyVLA reaches 90.8% on Spatial, 87.3% on Object, 86.6% on Goal and 80.7% on Long, leading the strongest 7B baseline on all four suites by 4.7, 2.8, 15.9 and 3.0 points, with every margin interval excluding zero. The gains concentrate on the hardest axes of the benchmark: across the eleven published baselines none exceeds 53.2% on Robot Initial States in any suite, whereas CoTinyVLA reaches 73.6% on Goal against 39.9% for the strongest baseline. Ablations show the three components to be separable by perturbation axis, and at a matched image budget how frames are divided between the two cameras and across time accounts for 8.6 points on its own. Closed-loop inference peaks at 2.25 GiB of allocated GPU memory, and paired interventions show the episode Plan to be load-bearing: replacing it with an empty or contradictory span costs 40 to 45 points of success. Structured supervision thus lets a 0.9B backbone exceed all of them. Code: https://github.com/BrainJellyPie/CoTinyVLA
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CoTinyVLA 是一个 0.9B 参数的视觉-语言-动作模型，基于 Qwen3.5-0.8B 骨干，通过层次化链式思维蒸馏（从 35B 教师模型提取 episode 级 Plan 和 chunk 级 Think）、双视图时间输入（16 历史帧）和释义增强（40 命令扩展至 800 变体），在 LIBERO-Plus 鲁棒性基准的 Spatial、Object、Goal、Long 四个套件上分别达到 90.8%、87.3%、86.6%、80.7%，领先最强 7B 基线 4.7、2.8、15.9、3.0 点。推理峰值 GPU 内存仅 2.25 GiB。
Motivation: 现有 VLA 模型（3B–7B 参数）内存需求超出嵌入式机器人预算；本文探索通过结构化监督而非扩大模型规模来获得鲁棒性。
Method: 三个组成部分：① 双视图时间输入，每步 16 历史帧并附加文本相机和时间标记；② 层次化链式思维蒸馏，从 35B 教师模型蒸馏出 episode 级 Plan（任务阶段、夹爪状态）和 chunk 级 Think（下一子动作）；③ 释义增强，40 个基础命令扩展为 800 个变体。
Result: 在 LIBERO-Plus 的七个扰动维度中，CoTinyVLA 在 Spatial、Object、Goal、Long 上领先所有 11 个已发布基线，尤其是 Goal 套件中的 Robot Initial States 轴达到 73.6%（最强基线仅 39.9%）。消融表明三个组件可分离，且帧分配方式贡献 8.6 个点。推理峰值 GPU 内存 2.25 GiB。
Conclusion: 结构化监督使 0.9B 骨干模型在所有扰动维度上超越 7B 基线；episode 级 Plan 是承载成功的关键，替换为空或矛盾内容会导致 40–45 个点的成功率下降。

summary_sections.conclusion: 结构化监督使 0.9B 骨干模型在所有扰动维度上超越 7B 基线；episode 级 Plan 是承载成功的关键，替换为空或矛盾内容会导致 40–45 个点的成功率下降。

papers.title: PatientAgentBench: A Benchmark Framework for Evaluating Patient-Facing Health AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: Health AI is evolving from answering questions to agentic systems that converse with patients, reason about health records, and act on their behalf. Primary care guards against diagnostic errors and unsafe care; agents assisting in this domain warrant evaluation against the same risks. Current benchmarks focus on medical knowledge, assessed through isolated question-answering or clinician-facing tasks. PatientAgentBench benchmarks patient-facing agentic healthcare; it evaluates a foundation model, wrapped in an agent with a sandbox of healthcare tools, conversing with a simulated patient. Each conversation is scored by an LLM-as-a-Jury across six dimensions via over a hundred conversation-agnostic, clinician-grounded criteria. To validate alignment, licensed clinicians annotated shared conversations, yielding 79-93% adjacent agreement between jury and expert raters, on par with or exceeding clinician inter-rater agreement. We benchmarked 10 models across four families on the same 1,200 scenarios and found clinical gaps. Triage quality is the most discriminating dimension: pass rates rise from 32% for the weakest models to 88% for the strongest, with agents often acting on administrative requests without clinical screening. Clinical safety and workflow accuracy follow the same pattern: the weakest models fail often, fabricating unexecuted actions, while frontier models fail on only 1-3% of cases, from unverified tool outputs and omitted crisis resources in an emergency. More capable models narrow these gaps but do not close them; the strongest scores only 4.25 of 5 overall. These failures surface only in sustained, tool-using conversations against realistic patient records, confirming that static benchmarks are insufficient as healthcare agentic systems gain autonomy. We release the framework as a reproducible, clinician-validated evaluation standard to help the field close this gap.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PatientAgentBench，一个用于评估面向患者的健康AI智能体的基准框架。该框架将基础模型封装为智能体，配备医疗工具沙盒，与模拟患者进行对话，并由LLM作为陪审团根据临床专家定义的六维度标准评分。作者在10个模型、1200个场景上进行了基准测试，发现分诊质量是最具区分度的维度，最强模型通过率88%而最弱模型仅32%，同时最强模型总体得分仅4.25/5，表明静态基准不足。
Motivation: 现有健康AI基准主要评估医学知识或面向临床医生的任务，缺乏对面向患者的智能体系统的评估，而此类系统在初级保健中可能产生诊断错误或不安全行为。
Method: 构建一个包含医疗工具沙盒的智能体，与模拟患者进行多轮对话，并由LLM作为陪审团基于超过100个临床专家制定的标准，在六个维度上对每次对话评分。
Result: 在10个模型上的评估显示，分诊质量通过率从32%（最弱模型）到88%（最强模型），最强模型总体得分4.25/5；最弱模型频繁编造未执行的动作，而最前沿模型在1-3%的案例中因未验证工具输出和遗漏紧急资源而失败。
Conclusion: 只有在持续使用工具的对话中才能暴露这些失败，证实静态基准对于日益自主的健康AI智能体是不充分的；作者发布该框架作为可重复的、经临床验证的评估标准。

papers.title: Finding Optimal Cost-Bounded Plan Reductions: Refined Model
papers.abstract_en: In some real applications a plan may later become unfeasible due to newly imposed budget constraints, yet, at the same time, using only the original actions of the plan and their order is mandatory. In this paper, we study the problem of extracting, from a precomputed plan, a valid subplan that maximizes utility while respecting a cost bound. Each goal is given a utility value and the plan is reduced by removing actions that support low-utility goals, while preserving both executability and the original action order. We show the decision variant is NP-complete and propose two exact methods to solve it: one via oversubscription planning (OSP) and another via Integer Linear Programming (ILP). This paper extends our previous work published at ICAPS 2026 (Del Toro, Fuentetaja, and García-Olaya 2026b). While the core framework remains as introduced there, we further introduce a refined ILP formulation that significantly decreases the model size and improves computational efficiency.
papers.comment: Extended version of a paper accepted at ICAPS 2026 (doi: 10.1609/icaps.v36i1.42849). Includes a new model and expanded experimental results
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究从预先计算的计划中提取一个有效子计划的问题，要求在满足成本约束的同时最大化效用。每个目标赋予一个效用值，通过删除支持低效用目标的动作来缩减计划，同时保持可执行性和原始动作顺序。作者证明了决策变体是NP完全的，并提出了两种精确求解方法：基于超额订阅规划（OSP）和整数线性规划（ILP）。该文是ICAPS 2026论文的扩展版本，提出了改进的ILP公式，显著减小模型规模并提高计算效率。
Motivation: 实际应用中，计划可能因新的预算约束而变得不可行，但必须使用原始动作及其顺序。需要从预计算计划中提取一个满足成本约束且效用最大的有效子计划。
Method: 将问题形式化为决策变体并证明NP完全性；提出两种精确求解方法：基于超额订阅规划（OSP）和整数线性规划（ILP），并引入改进的ILP公式以减小模型规模和提升计算效率。
Result: 摘要未提供具体数值结果，仅声称改进的ILP公式显著减小模型大小并提高计算效率。
Conclusion: 本文扩展了之前的工作，提出了一个更高效的ILP模型来解决成本约束下的计划缩减问题。

papers.title: Data-Dependent Regret and Polyak Corrections for Constrained Online Convex Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Constrained online convex optimization requires minimizing regret against adversarial convex costs while satisfying a convex constraint at every round, as needed in safety-critical applications. A computationally efficient method combines online gradient descent with a Polyak feasibility step, using one constraint evaluation and one subgradient per round. Although this method achieves O(sqrt(T)) regret with per-round feasibility, we derive a tighter, data-dependent analysis by retaining two quantities omitted by the standard worst-case argument. First, we replace the gradient envelope G_f^2 T with the observed accumulation G_T = sum_t ||grad f_t(x_t)||^2. Second, we identify a nonnegative Polyak correction P_T that measures the cumulative squared displacement caused by feasibility projections and enters the regret bound with a negative sign. The resulting improvement, Delta_T = (eta/2)(G_f^2 T - G_T) + P_T/(2 eta), is always nonnegative. We further propose AdaOGD-PFS, an adaptive-step-size method that achieves O(sqrt(G_T)) regret while preserving per-round feasibility. Experiments on ball- and halfspace-constrained problems improve the regret bound by 38 to 43 percent, with both data-dependent gradients and Polyak corrections contributing substantially.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对约束在线凸优化问题，重新分析了结合在线梯度下降与Polyak可行性步骤的方法，提出了数据依赖的遗憾界，并引入非负的Polyak修正项。进一步设计了自适应步长方法AdaOGD-PFS，在球和半空间约束实验中遗憾界改进38-43%。
Motivation: 现有约束在线凸优化方法的标准遗憾分析忽略了两项量：梯度范数平方的累积和以及Polyak投影导致的位移累积，导致界不够紧，无法反映实际数据特性。
Method: 保留标准分析中省略的梯度累积G_T和Polyak修正P_T，推导出更紧的数据依赖遗憾界；并基于此提出自适应步长方法AdaOGD-PFS，实现O(sqrt(G_T))遗憾。
Result: 在球和半空间约束问题上，遗憾界改进38-43%，且数据依赖梯度和Polyak修正均有显著贡献。
Conclusion: 数据依赖分析和Polyak修正能有效收紧约束在线凸优化的遗憾界，自适应方法在保持每轮可行性的同时提升性能。

papers.title: Architectural Backdoors in Vision-Language Model Supply Chains via Representation Steering
papers.abstract_en: Vision--Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly deployed through a model supply chain in which pretrained checkpoints, architecture definitions, text encoders, and exported computation graphs are distributed by third parties and reused across downstream services. This reuse model creates a security-critical trust boundary: VLM deployments inherit not only learned parameters but also executable behavior encoded in shared model artifacts. In this paper, we show that a malicious provider can exploit this trust boundary by embedding architectural backdoors into VLM supply chains through representation steering. Our attack introduces dormant steering logic into the model architecture through a trigger-gated additive modification of an intermediate representation, without poisoning training data, controlling downstream fine-tuning, or modifying prompts at deployment time. When the trigger is absent, the modification reduces to zero and the model follows its normal computation, preserving clean utility. When the trigger is present, a steering direction shifts the internal representation toward an attacker-defined objective. We evaluate the attack across multiple VLM families and downstream tasks, including visual question answering, text-to-image generation, retrieval, and semantic response biasing. The results show that the proposed architectural steering backdoor compromises integrity, safety enforcement, and ranking fairness while preserving normal behavior on clean inputs. We further show that shared VLM artifacts can carry dormant steering logic against downstream services, and we propose an auditing defense that inspects the executable logic distributed with model artifacts rather than only their learned weights.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示视觉语言模型供应链中的安全隐患：恶意提供商可通过表示引导（representation steering）在模型架构中嵌入架构后门（architectural backdoor），无需污染训练数据或控制微调，仅在触发条件满足时改变模型行为。攻击在多种VLM系列和下游任务上有效，并能保持干净输入下的正常功能。文章还提出了一种审计防御方法。
Motivation: 视觉语言模型通过第三方分发的预训练检查点、架构定义等供应链组件重用，导致安全信任边界漏洞；攻击者可能嵌入后门但现有方法主要关注权重污染或数据投毒，本文指出仅通过架构定义即可实现后门。
Method: 提出基于表示引导的架构后门攻击：在模型架构中插入触发器门控的中间表示加法性修改（trigger-gated additive modification），触发器不存在时修改为零，存在时沿特定方向偏移内部表示。该攻击不修改训练数据或下游微调，也不修改部署时的提示。
Result: 在多个VLM家族和下游任务（视觉问答、文本到图像生成、检索、语义响应偏向）上评估，表明该架构引导后门会破坏完整性、安全执行和排名公平性，同时保持干净输入正常行为。
Conclusion: 共享的VLM构件可以携带针对下游服务的休眠引导逻辑；提出一种审计防御，检查随模型构件分发的可执行逻辑而不仅仅是学习权重。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Balancing multiscale similarity and cartographic constraints: A similarity-driven optimization framework for line generalization
papers.abstract_en: Cartographic generalization is essential for generating multiscale map representations by balancing information preservation and cartographic readability. However, automated generalization remains challenging because existing approaches often treat spatial similarity evaluation, cartographic constraints, and parameter optimization as separate processes, limiting adaptive and interpretable control across scales. This study formulates cartographic generalization as a constrained multiscale similarity optimization problem and proposes a similarity-driven framework for adaptive generalization control. The framework integrates multiscale spatial similarity as an optimization objective to quantify representation consistency between original and generalized data, while incorporating cartographic constraints to regulate readability, smoothness, and geometric validity. A unified objective function is optimized to automatically identify scale-dependent parameter configurations for different generalization algorithms. Experiments using multiple line simplification algorithms, target scales, and similarity measures, including geometric, structural, and learning-based metrics, demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves an effective balance between similarity preservation and cartographic abstraction. The results further show that combining similarity optimization with cartographic constraints provides more consistent and interpretable parameter control than relying on similarity evaluation alone. This study provides a unified optimization perspective that connects similarity assessment, constraint modeling, and algorithm control, contributing to adaptive and automated cartographic generalization.
papers.comment: Submitted to Cartography and Geographic Information Science
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文将制图综合形式化为一个有约束的多尺度相似性优化问题，提出一个相似性驱动的自适应综合控制框架。该框架将多尺度空间相似性作为优化目标，并结合制图约束来调节可读性、平滑性和几何有效性，通过优化统一目标函数自动确定不同尺度下的参数配置。实验使用多种线简化算法、目标尺度和相似性度量，表明该框架在保持相似性和制图抽象之间取得了有效平衡，且结合相似性优化与制图约束比单独使用相似性评估能提供更一致和可解释的参数控制。
Motivation: 现有制图综合方法通常将空间相似性评估、制图约束和参数优化作为分离过程处理，限制了跨尺度的自适应和可解释控制。
Method: 提出一个相似性驱动的优化框架，将多尺度空间相似性作为优化目标，并集成制图约束（可读性、平滑性、几何有效性）到统一的目标函数中，通过优化自动识别不同尺度的参数配置。
Result: 实验采用多种线简化算法、目标尺度和相似性度量（包括几何、结构和学习型度量），表明该框架能有效平衡相似性保持与制图抽象，且结合相似性优化与制图约束比单独使用相似性评估提供更一致和可解释的参数控制。
Conclusion: 本研究提供了一个统一的优化视角，连接了相似性评估、约束建模和算法控制，有助于实现自适应和自动化的制图综合。

summary_sections.result: 实验采用多种线简化算法、目标尺度和相似性度量（包括几何、结构和学习型度量），表明该框架能有效平衡相似性保持与制图抽象，且结合相似性优化与制图约束比单独使用相似性评估提供更一致和可解释的参数控制。
summary_sections.conclusion: 本研究提供了一个统一的优化视角，连接了相似性评估、约束建模和算法控制，有助于实现自适应和自动化的制图综合。

papers.title: TRWH: A Text-Driven Random Walk Heterogeneous GNN for Semantic-Aware Sparse Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) and Large Language Models (LLMs) have each advanced recommendation systems by modeling structural and semantic signals, respectively. However, integrating their complementary strengths remains challenging, particularly in sparse settings where maintaining semantic precision is critical. We propose TRWH (Text-driven Random Walk Heterogeneous Graph Neural Network), a novel framework that fuses LLM-generated textual profiles with heterogeneous graph structures through strategic random walk augmentation. TRWH consists of three core components: (1) Embedding Creation, which produces user and item representations using both Word2Vec and LLM-based profiling; (2) a Heterogeneous Graph Neural Network (HeteroGNN) that propagates information across multi-relational edges; and (3) Random Walk-based Path Construction, which enriches sparse graphs with second-order user-user and item-item links. Experiments on the Amazon-2023 Fashion (2M users, 825K items) and Beauty (631K users, 112K items) datasets demonstrate that TRWH achieves substantial performance gains over state-of-the-art methods, including 80.0% RMSE and 52.6% MAE reductions on Fashion, and 25.7% and 10.8% improvements on Beauty. Notably, while random walks improve performance with traditional embeddings, they can dilute the nuanced representations learned by LLMs, underscoring the importance of adaptive integration strategies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TRWH，一种结合大语言模型文本描述和异构图神经网络的稀疏推荐框架。通过随机游走增强图结构，在 Amazon-2023 Fashion 和 Beauty 数据集上显著降低了 RMSE 和 MAE。
Motivation: 现有推荐系统难以有效融合图神经网络的图结构信号和大语言模型的语义信号，尤其在数据稀疏场景下保持语义精度面临挑战。
Method: 提出 TRWH 框架，包含三个组件：(1) 使用 Word2Vec 和 LLM 生成用户和物品嵌入；(2) 异构图神经网络 (HeteroGNN) 跨多关系边传播信息；(3) 基于随机游走的路径构建，为稀疏图增加二阶用户-用户和物品-物品链接。
Result: 在 Amazon-2023 Fashion 数据集上，RMSE 降低 80.0%，MAE 降低 52.6%；在 Beauty 数据集上，RMSE 和 MAE 分别提升 25.7% 和 10.8%。
Conclusion: 随机游走能提升传统嵌入性能，但可能稀释 LLM 学习的细粒度表示，需要自适应集成策略。

papers.title: Safety-Aware Cascaded Inference for Crop Damage Assessment with Controlled Error Trade-offs
papers.abstract_en: In picture-based agricultural insurance for smallholder farmers, missed damage detections carry substantially higher cost than false alarms: a farmer who sustained real losses receives no payout, while unnecessary expert review is operationally costly but reversible. Standard multi-class classifiers optimize global accuracy but provide no mechanism to operationalize or control this asymmetric cost structure at inference time. We propose CascadeCropNet, a two-stage cascade architecture calibrated to satisfy a target recall constraint (Rec-Damaged >= 0.95) through threshold selection. A lightweight Sentinel model performs binary health triage; samples exceeding a calibrated damage probability threshold tau are escalated to a specialist Expert model for fine-grained diagnosis. This design provides explicit, deployment-time control over the safety-efficiency trade-off without retraining. Evaluated on the Eyes on the Ground dataset (23,804 images from Kenyan smallholder maize farms), the cascade achieves Rec-Damaged = 0.974 at tau = 0.5, reducing missed damage cases by up to 54% relative to a flat baseline. Under evaluation alignment, the representational gap reduces to +0.008 F1-macro, confirming the contribution is architectural rather than representational. Under input degradation, the system prioritizes escalation over confident misclassification, reflecting error containment through architectural isolation rather than intrinsic model robustness. These results demonstrate that cascade architectures can operationalize safety-oriented decision constraints through calibrated routing in settings where reliability matters more than aggregate accuracy. These properties depend on threshold calibration and deployment conditions and do not constitute guarantees under arbitrary distribution shift.

TL;DR: 本文提出CascadeCropNet，一种两阶段级联架构，用于基于图像的农业保险中的作物损害评估。设计轻量级Sentinel模型进行健康分类，超过阈值的样本由Expert模型精细诊断。在肯尼亚小农玉米田数据集上，召回率达0.974，误检减少54%。
Motivation: 标准多分类器优化全局精度，无法在推理时控制漏检与虚警的不对称成本。农业保险中漏检损失远高于虚警，需要可操作的召回率约束。
Method: 两阶段级联：第一阶段用轻量级Sentinel模型进行二分类健康评估，样本的损害概率超过校准阈值τ时，升级到第二阶段Expert模型进行细粒度诊断。阈值τ可调，无需重训练即可控制安全-效率权衡。
Result: 在Eyes on the Ground数据集（23,804张图像）上，当τ=0.5时，召回率达0.974，漏检比基准减少54%。评估对齐下F1-macro相差仅+0.008，表明贡献来自架构而非表征。输入降质时，系统倾向于升级而非错误分类。
Conclusion: 级联架构可通过校准路由实现安全导向的决策约束，在可靠性比总体精度更重要的场景中有效。但依赖阈值校准和部署条件，在任意分布偏移下不保证性能。

papers.title: Seen, Said, or Forgotten? A Causal Audit of Visual KV Memory Across Dialog Turns
papers.abstract_en: Stateful multimodal assistants encode an image once but may answer questions about it many turns later. Attention-guided visual-KV eviction assumes that evidence irrelevant now will remain dispensable, although future questions are unknown. We ask when a visual fact is actually safe to forget and introduce the Causal Visual Memory Audit (CVMA), a paired single-prefill framework that tests what later answers lose when a visual region, the whole image, or prior assistant text becomes unavailable. On VisDial and ConvBench, current attention can rank future-useful regions worse than random even though a diagnostic marginal-utility control shows substantial selection headroom. Aggregate scores hide this failure when later turns do not need vision; controlled and stock-generated histories reveal a second escape route, in which assistant-text KV replaces image KV for facts already stated but not reliably for unstated facts. In the tested stacks, safe forgetting is supported by low future visual dependence or fact-specific verbalization---not by low current attention.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出因果视觉记忆审计（CVMA）框架，用于评估多模态助手在对话中遗忘视觉信息的安全性。在VisDial和ConvBench上的实验表明，当前注意力无法可靠预测未来有用的视觉区域，聚合分数掩盖了失败情况。安全遗忘依赖于低未来视觉依赖或事实特异性言语化，而非低当前注意力。
Motivation: 现有注意力引导的视觉KV逐出方法假设当前无关的证据未来也可丢弃，但未来问题未知，因此需要检验何时可以安全遗忘视觉事实。
Method: 引入CVMA，一种配对单预填充框架，通过模拟视觉区域、整张图像或前序助手文本不可用的情况，测试后续答案的损失情况。
Result: 在VisDial和ConvBench上，当前注意力对未来有用区域的排序比随机更差，尽管诊断性边际效用控制显示存在大量选择空间。聚合分数隐藏了失败，受控和生成的历史揭示了助手文本KV可替代已陈述事实的图像KV，但对未陈述事实不可靠。
Conclusion: 在测试的堆栈中，安全遗忘由低未来视觉依赖或事实特异性言语化支持，而非低当前注意力。

papers.title: DensFiLM: Density-Conditioned Video Saliency for Crowd Scenes
papers.abstract_en: Video saliency models typically apply a single fixation strategy across crowd scenes, despite systematic changes in attention with crowd density. Sparse scenes encourage tracking individuals, whereas dense scenes shift attention toward collective motion and scene-level landmarks. We introduce DensFiLM, a density-conditioned video saliency model that inserts a lightweight Feature-wise Linear Modulation layer at the bottleneck of a Video Swin Transformer. A learned density embedding produces channel-wise scale and shift parameters, allowing the decoder to reconstruct saliency from features selected for each density regime. The module adds only ~100K parameters and can use either CrowdFix density labels or the model's own density prediction. On CrowdFix, DensFiLM achieves mean NSS 1.434 and CC 0.517 over four seeds, improving over ACLNet by 14.7% and 14.9%, respectively, while predicted-density conditioning matches oracle-label performance. Ablations show that explicit RAFT optical flow and larger temporal and social-force extensions provide no further improvement in this setting. In a centre-prior-subtraction diagnostic, density conditioning yields an NSS gain of 0.462 over the unconditioned backbone, compared with 0.124 under standard evaluation. These results show that lightweight bottleneck conditioning provides a more effective inductive bias than increasing model capacity for crowd-video saliency. Our code is available at https://github.com/aniskhan25/crowdfix-saliency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DensFiLM，一种密度条件化的视频显著性模型，通过在 Video Swin Transformer 的瓶颈处插入轻量级特征线性调制 (Feature-wise Linear Modulation) 层，利用密度嵌入生成通道级的尺度和平移参数，以自适应不同人群密度下的注意力策略。在 CrowdFix 数据集上，平均 NSS 达 1.434，CC 达 0.517，较 ACLNet 分别提升 14.7% 和 14.9%，且预测密度条件化性能与真实标签相当。
Motivation: 现有视频显著性模型对人群场景采用单一注视策略，忽略了注意力随密度变化的系统性差异：稀疏场景倾向于追踪个体，密集场景则转向集体运动和环境地标。
Method: 在 Video Swin Transformer 的瓶颈处插入特征线性调制 (Feature-wise Linear Modulation) 层，通过学习密度嵌入产生通道级别的缩放 (scale) 和平移 (shift) 参数，使解码器能根据不同密度区域的特征重建显著性图。模块仅增加约 100K 参数，可使用 CrowdFix 密度标签或模型自身密度预测。
Result: 在 CrowdFix 上，DensFiLM 在四个随机种子上平均 NSS 为 1.434，CC 为 0.517，比 ACLNet 分别提高 14.7% 和 14.9%；使用预测密度条件化时性能与真实标签持平。消融实验显示，显式 RAFT 光流、更大时间窗口和社会力扩展均未带来额外提升。在中心先验减法诊断中，密度条件化带来 NSS 增益 0.462，远高于标准评估下的 0.124。
Conclusion: 轻量级瓶颈条件化比增加模型容量为人群视频显著性提供了更有效的归纳偏置。

papers.title: Emergent Latent-State Computation under Stochastic Volatility
papers.abstract_en: Mechanistic interpretability has largely focused on language models and deterministic toy tasks. Much less is known about how sequence models internally represent latent stochastic dynamics under noisy, partially observed observations. We study this question in a controlled multivariate stochastic volatility setting, where models observe only returns while the ground-truth latent volatility state is known to the researcher. This setting provides a useful benchmark for mechanistic interpretability under partial observability: the latent state is hidden from the model but directly available for evaluation. Across architectures, losses, and output heads, we find evidence for a two-stage computation. Hidden representations encode substantial information about the next latent volatility state, and the output head maps this representation to squared return forecasts. Furthermore, in Transformers, latent-state decodability emerges at identifiable architectural stages whose location depends on the volatility period. In long-cycle regimes, this computation simplifies into an explicit latent-state filter consisting of a learned linear projection followed by $\ell^2$ normalization. Output-head replacement further shows that part of the degradation under noisy MSE training arises from readout misalignment rather than representation failure. These results suggest that stochastic volatility models provide a useful benchmark for mechanistic interpretability under noisy latent dynamics and partial observability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究序列模型在部分可观察的随机波动率环境下如何内部表示潜在随机动态。通过控制多变量随机波动率设置，发现两阶段计算：隐藏表示编码关于下一个潜在波动率状态的信息，输出头将其映射到平方收益预测。在Transformer中，潜在状态解码出现在可识别的架构阶段，长周期下计算简化为显式潜在状态滤波器。结果表明随机波动率模型为噪声潜在动态和部分可观察性下的机制可解释性提供了有用基准。
Motivation: 现有机制可解释性主要关注语言模型和确定性玩具任务，对序列模型如何在噪声、部分可观察观测下内部表示潜在随机动态知之甚少。
Method: 在控制的多变量随机波动率设置中，模型仅观察收益而真实潜在波动率状态已知。通过跨架构、损失和输出头的分析，研究隐藏表示和输出头映射。
Result: 隐藏表示编码关于下一个潜在波动率状态的大量信息，输出头将其映射到平方收益预测。Transformer中潜在状态解码出现在可识别的架构阶段，长周期下计算简化为显式潜在状态滤波器。输出头替换显示噪声MSE训练下的部分退化源于读出器未对齐而非表示失败。
Conclusion: 随机波动率模型为噪声潜在动态和部分可观察性下的机制可解释性提供了有用基准。

summary_sections.conclusion: 随机波动率模型为噪声潜在动态和部分可观察性下的机制可解释性提供了有用基准。

papers.title: Reading Legends on Ancient Coins: An Object Detection Approach for Character Recognition on a Novel Roman Republican Dataset
papers.abstract_en: When it comes to the proper classification of ancient coins with respect to their time and issuer, the textual inscriptions on these coins, also known as legends, are of paramount importance. These legends consist of alphabets or characters still used in English. This paper addresses image based character recognition on ancient Roman Republican coins via a deep learning based object detection strategy. However, legends on these coins pose high variation due to non-uniform placement, primitive inscription techniques, and wear and tear. Additional challenges include inconsistent imaging conditions such as illumination, orientation, and scale. To accommodate these, we gathered a novel large-scale dataset of 5,654 Roman Republican coin images, manually annotated with 21 character labels, totaling 38,808 annotations. For recognition, we use You Only Look Once (YOLO) variants: YOLOv3, v4, v5, v7, and v8. YOLOv7-Large achieves the best mAP50 of 90.4%, followed by YOLOv7-Extended and YOLOv7-xl with 90.2% and 90.1%, respectively.

papers.title: Bits and Memories: Measuring Verbatim Extraction Across LLM Quantization
papers.abstract_en: Language models are almost always quantized before they are deployed, and a growing line of work asks whether quantization also lowers their privacy risk. That work measures privacy almost entirely with membership inference. We think this is the wrong thing to measure for the risk that most people actually worry about, namely a model reproducing its training data word for word, and we measure that directly. Using the Pythia models and the public set of sequences each of them is known to have memorized, we track verbatim extraction across five precision levels, from full precision down to four bits, and across three model sizes, while measuring general capability (perplexity) at every point. We find two things. Quantization is a selective forgetter: verbatim memorization falls off faster than capability at every precision and every model size we tried, and this holds under two unrelated quantization algorithms and two evaluation corpora. But the selectivity is not enough to make quantization a privacy defense, which cuts against the optimistic reading of earlier membership-inference results. At the largest model we study, four-bit quantization still reproduces most of the memorized sequences while giving up only a few percent of capability, and the fraction of memorized data that survives quantization grows with model size. We conclude that compression should not be treated as a way to remove memorized training data, and that extraction, not membership inference, is the number practitioners should be watching. All code, sampled evaluation data, and per-configuration results are released.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 3 figures. Code: https://github.com/AkshaySasi/bits-and-memories. Data and results: https://huggingface.co/datasets/AkshaySasi/bits-and-memories
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型量化对隐私风险的影响，直接测量模型逐字提取训练数据的能力，而非常用的成员推断攻击。使用Pythia模型和已知记忆序列，在五种精度（全精度到4比特）下测试逐字提取率和困惑度。发现量化选择性遗忘记忆数据（记忆下降快于能力下降），但不足以作为隐私防御：最大模型在4比特下仍能复现大部分记忆序列。
Motivation: 现有研究多用量化后的成员推断攻击衡量隐私风险，但成员推断不是公众实际担心的风险；真正风险是模型逐字复述训练数据。本文直接测量逐字提取，以评估量化对隐私的实际影响。
Method: 使用Pythia模型及已知记忆序列集，在五种精度（全精度到4比特）下，采用两种不相干的量化算法和两个评估语料库，测量逐字提取率和困惑度，并比较不同模型规模。
Result: 量化选择性遗忘记忆数据：在所有精度和模型规模下，逐字记忆下降速度快于能力（困惑度）下降。但最大模型在4比特量化下仍能复现大部分记忆序列，且记忆存活比例随模型规模增大而增大。
Conclusion: 压缩不能作为移除训练数据记忆的手段；应监测逐字提取率而非成员推断，以评估隐私风险。

papers.title: Toward an Organizational Science of Multi-Agent LLM Systems: Decoupling Who, How, and Which Algorithm
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent frameworks built on large language models (LLMs) routinely entangle three logically distinct concerns: who is on the team (organization), how members align (coordination), and which algorithm fuses their work (collaboration protocol). IMACS (Intelligent Multi-Agent Collaboration System) separates the three into orthogonal, independently swappable layers. Classic organizational theory (Belbin roles, Mintzberg coordination, RACI accountability) becomes executable, validated configuration, and the framework places six published collaboration algorithms behind a common interface while exposing roles, coordination, and accountability as independently configurable factors. We use this separation to conduct controlled comparisons in which organizational assignments vary while the collaboration protocol is held fixed. It also turns protocol choice into a variable that can be learned: Adaptive Org Routing, a contextual-bandit meta-protocol, selects a protocol per task under an explicit quality-cost tradeoff, outperforms every fixed protocol in a controlled study, and trains online on real benchmark and LLM-judge rewards. The ablations expose a mechanism. Accountability placement changes outcomes exactly when the protocol routes the deliverable through the accountable agent, and the winning placement flips across model families, so organizational design cannot be hard-coded; it must be revalidated, or learned, for each model binding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出IMACS（智能多智能体协作系统），将基于大语言模型的多智能体框架解耦为三个独立可互换的层次：组织（谁在团队中）、协调（成员如何对齐）、协作协议（算法如何融合工作）。通过这种分离，可以独立配置角色、协调机制和问责制，并引入自适应组织路由（Adaptive Org Routing）作为元协议，在质量与成本之间权衡，选择每个任务的最优协作协议。实验表明，问责制的放置效果因模型家族而异，因此组织设计必须针对每个模型重新验证或学习。
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的多智能体框架通常将组织、协调和协作协议纠缠在一起，导致设计难以比较和优化，缺乏可重用性和可解释性。
Method: 提出IMACS，将多智能体系统正交化为组织层、协调层和协作协议层；将经典组织理论（Belbin角色、Mintzberg协调、RACI问责制）作为可执行配置；并设计Adaptive Org Routing作为上下文赌博机元协议，用于动态选择协作协议。
Result: 控制实验表明，问责制放置在不同模型家族上效果不同，某些协议通过问责代理路由时的表现更优；Adaptive Org Routing在质量-成本权衡下优于所有固定协议，并能在线学习。
Conclusion: 多智能体LLM系统的组织设计不能硬编码，必须针对每个底层模型重新验证或自适应学习。

papers.title: PIcsC: Partitioning-Induced Covariate Shift Correction
papers.abstract_en: Covariate shift across training-data partitions biases model selection and parameter estimation in cross-validation, lifelong learning, and federated learning. We propose \textit{Partition-Induced Covariate-shift Correction} (\texttt{PIcsC}), a Fisher information-based regularization framework that mitigates distribution mismatch between data partitions and a reference distribution. \texttt{PIcsC} approximates partition divergence using the Fisher Information Matrix (FIM) and incorporates the resulting statistic as a regularizer during optimization. The same formulation applies to both centrally partitioned datasets (batches or cross-validation folds) and inherently distributed data (federated clients or decentralized nodes), requiring only partition-local gradient statistics rather than raw data. We further introduce a conditional adaptation mechanism that combines FIM shift with KL divergence to detect significant distribution shifts and activates regularization only when necessary. Experiments on more than 40 datasets demonstrate consistent improvements under both natural and synthetic covariate shift. On fragmented batch and fold settings, \texttt{PIcsC} reduces fragmentation-induced performance degradation by more than 20\% and 25\%, respectively. On seven federated learning benchmarks, it consistently outperforms FedAvg, FedProx, and SCAFFOLD by 3 -5 percentage points without requiring client-specific personalization. These results demonstrate that Fisher information provides an effective and unified mechanism for mitigating partition-induced covariate shift across both centralized and distributed learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PIcsC，一个基于 Fisher 信息矩阵 (FIM) 的正则化框架，用于缓解训练数据分区（如交叉验证折叠、联邦学习客户端）间的协变量偏移。该方法通过 FIM 近似分区与参考分布之间的差异，并将其作为正则项纳入优化，仅需分区局部梯度统计而非原始数据。实验在 40 多个数据集上验证，在碎片化批次和折叠设置中性能退化分别降低 20% 和 25%，在 7 个联邦学习基准上比 FedAvg、FedProx、SCAFFOLD 提升 3-5 个百分点。
Motivation: 在交叉验证、终身学习、联邦学习中，训练数据分区间的协变量偏移会导致模型选择偏误和参数估计偏差，现有方法缺乏统一且通用的矫正机制。
Method: 提出 PIcsC，使用 Fisher 信息矩阵近似分区与参考分布间的散度，并作为正则项加入优化目标；同时引入条件自适应机制，结合 FIM 偏移与 KL 散度检测显著分布偏移，仅在必要时激活正则化。
Result: 在超过 40 个数据集上的实验表明，PIcsC 在自然和合成协变量偏移下均持续改进；在碎片化批次和折叠设置中性能退化分别降低 20% 和 25%；在 7 个联邦学习基准上比 FedAvg、FedProx、SCAFFOLD 提升 3-5 个百分点，无需客户端个性化。
Conclusion: Fisher 信息提供了一种有效且统一的机制，用于缓解集中式和分布式学习中的分区诱导协变量偏移。

papers.title: Robust Unsupervised Network Intrusion Detection via Federated Learning with Selective Aggregation under Anomalous Sample Contamination
papers.abstract_en: Network intrusion detection systems (NIDS) have become essential for Internet of Things (IoT) environments, as malware targeting IoT devices continues to evolve in sophistication. Unsupervised learning approaches offer a promising direction by removing the dependency on labeled datasets. However, the common assumption that training data are entirely clean is often violated in practice, particularly when data samples are collected directly from deployed network devices, where anomalies are likely to be present in the training datasets. Such contamination degrades detection performance and highlights the need for robust unsupervised NIDS methods capable of operating effectively under contaminated unlabeled training data. To address this issue, we propose a robust training methodology for anomaly detection (AD) that remains effective even in the presence of unlabeled anomalies. Our method consists of two primary components. First, we exploit a known limitation of federated learning (FL), namely its tendency to underrepresent minority data. By leveraging this characteristic, we attenuate the influence of anomalous data originating from a small number of compromised clients. Second, we introduce a selective aggregation mechanism during model aggregation, which quantifies the "distance" between local client models and a global reference. Specifically, we employ the Expectation-Maximization (EM) algorithm to detect and exclude client groups whose model updates significantly diverge from the majority. This selective aggregation ensures that anomalous updates do not compromise the global model. Experiments conducted on multiple NIDS datasets demonstrate that our method outperforms existing approaches in environments contaminated with anomalous data. Furthermore, the proposed method maintains its detection performance even as the proportion of anomalies increases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种鲁棒的无监督网络入侵检测方法，通过联邦学习选择性聚合机制应对训练数据中的异常样本污染。方法利用联邦学习对少数数据的欠表示特性，并引入基于EM算法的选择性聚合，排除偏离多数客户端的模型更新。在多个NIDS数据集上，该方法在污染环境下优于现有方法，且检测性能随异常比例增加仍保持稳定。
Motivation: 实际网络环境中无标签训练数据常包含异常样本，污染会降低无监督入侵检测性能，现有方法缺乏对此的鲁棒性。
Method: 基于联邦学习框架，利用其倾向于忽视少数数据的特点减弱异常数据影响；在模型聚合时采用EM算法量化客户端模型与全局参考的距离，排除异常客户端更新。
Result: 在多个NIDS数据集上，该方法在异常污染环境下检测性能优于现有方法，且随异常比例增加性能保持稳定。
Conclusion: 所提方法通过联邦学习的欠表示和选择性聚合，有效提升了无监督入侵检测在污染数据下的鲁棒性，且无需标注数据。

papers.title: Bi-Level Collaborative Learning for Few-Shot Scribble-Supervised Medical Image Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Scribble annotations offer an efficient alternative to costly pixel-wise labeling for medical image segmentation, yet in real clinical scenarios, scribble-annotated samples are often still limited, imposing the dual challenges of sparse supervision and annotated sample scarcity. These compounded constraints severely deprive models of the structural evidence needed for complete region recovery and precise boundary delineation. To break this bottleneck, we propose a bi-level collaborative learning framework for few-shot scribble-supervised medical image segmentation. Specifically, an upper-level learnable superpixel model is introduced to provide region-structural priors for lower-level segmentation, while superpixel-based region-wise pseudo-label propagation and a spatial-prior-guided filtering strategy are performed to generate reliable dense pseudo-labels for segmentation learning. Meanwhile, the anatomical semantics learned by the lower-level segmentation model under the guidance of the current superpixels are fed back to the upper level, further driving it to learn region-structural representations better aligned with the segmentation task. Through bidirectional interaction and collaborative learning between the upper and lower levels, the proposed framework significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art scribble-supervised methods on the ACDC and Prostate datasets under the few-shot scribble-supervised setting.

papers.title: The Disruptive Impact of Large Language Models on Capture the Flag Competitions and the Path Toward Fair Play
papers.abstract_en: Capture the Flag (CTF) competitions are among cybersecurity's most effective training grounds, developing practical skill across cryptography, web exploitation, and binary exploitation. Large language models (LLMs) can now solve a growing share of challenges with minimal human input, raising urgent questions about fairness, the validity of rankings, and whether participation still delivers the learning that justifies the effort. This paper reports a mixed-methods study of LLM impact on modern CTFs, combining a synthesis of published benchmarks, including a recent government evaluation, case studies of live competition across three challenge categories, structured observation of the public channels where the community debates AI use, and semi-structured interviews with experienced players and organisers. We map the current human-machine capability boundary by category, showing that easy and intermediate challenges in cryptography, web, and binary exploitation are now reliably automated while narrower sub-categories continue to resist. We find that community disagreement about whether AI should be permitted is downstream of an undeclared prior question: what a competition is for. Against this backdrop we contribute a four-component safeguard framework, combining tiered competition divisions, LLM-resistant challenge design, telemetry used investigatively, and a draft community code of conduct, together with a decision tool that ties the combination of safeguards to a competition's declared purpose. The argument reaches beyond CTFs to any setting in cybersecurity where a demonstrated result is taken as evidence of an underlying ability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过混合方法研究大语言模型（LLM）对夺旗赛（CTF）的影响，发现LLM已能可靠自动化易和中级挑战（密码学、Web、二进制利用），但狭窄子类别仍难以自动化。社区对AI使用的争议源于对竞赛目的的根本分歧。作者提出四组件保障框架（分级竞赛、抗LLM挑战设计、遥测调查、社区行为准则）及决策工具，将保障措施与竞赛目标关联，并指出该问题可推广至网络安全中任何将结果作为能力证据的场景。
Motivation: LLM能解决越来越多的CTF挑战，引发公平性、排名有效性和学习价值的问题，亟待理解其影响并制定应对策略。
Method: 结合已发表基准综合、三类挑战的现场竞赛案例研究、社区公开渠道结构化观察，以及对经验丰富的玩家和组织者的半结构化访谈。
Result: 易和中级密码学、Web和二进制利用挑战现已可靠自动化，但窄子类别仍抵抗自动化；社区对AI是否应被允许存在分歧，且分歧源于对竞赛目的未明言的预设。
Conclusion: 提出四组件保障框架（分级竞赛、抗LLM挑战设计、遥测调查、社区行为准则）及决策工具，将保障措施与竞赛目的绑定，并指出该问题超越CTF，关乎网络安全中任何以结果推断能力的场景。

papers.title: From Dyad to Triad: Eliciting XAI Requirements in Stroke Rehabilitation
papers.abstract_en: Eliciting explainable AI (XAI) requirements from stroke survivors presents a methodological challenge with direct implications for the design of trustworthy brain-computer interfaces for rehabilitation. How can patients and caregivers articulate preferences about algorithmic transparency when they lack conceptual frameworks for explainability, and when standard elicitation approaches are structurally inadequate for users with acquired communication disorders? We present a video-based scaffolding protocol for XAI requirements elicitation, developed and piloted in a rehabilitation context. In a formative study with three stroke survivors (two with moderate-to-severe aphasia) and three caregivers, facilitators employed four scaffolding approaches alongside the videos: 1) analogical bridging mapping AI states to familiar systems, 2) projective personas depersonalising sensitive topics, 3) binary forcing reducing cognitive load, and 4) extended response time. These approaches successfully surfaced heterogeneous, sometimes conflicting XAI needs across participants. Reflexive analysis additionally revealed three systematic facilitation biases, namely, normative bias, hypothesis confirmation bias, and presence effect, where scaffolding inadvertently shaped responses. We present these as protocol risk guidelines for practitioners. Together, the protocol and guidelines constitute a reusable methodological contribution for eliciting patient-facing XAI requirements in rehabilitation, arguing that such elicitation is a necessary prerequisite for trustworthy human-machine systems design, not an optional preliminary.
papers.comment: AI and Cognitive Computing for Trustworthy Human Machine Systems Session, IEEE International Conference on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics (IEEE SMC 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对脑卒中康复场景中难以从患者和护理人员处获取可解释AI（XAI）需求的方法学挑战，提出了一种基于视频的支架式（scaffolding）需求引出协议。在包含三名脑卒中幸存者（两名伴中重度失语症）和三名护理人员的形成性研究中，作者采用类比桥接、投射人格、强制二元选择和延长响应时间四种支架方法，成功揭示了异质的、有时相互冲突的XAI需求。反思分析还识别出规范性偏差、假设确认偏差和在场效应三种系统性引导偏差，并将其作为协议风险指南。
Motivation: 患者在缺乏可解释性概念框架且存在沟通障碍时，难以表达对算法透明度的偏好；标准的需求引出方法对获得性沟通障碍用户结构性不足。
Method: 提出视频辅助的XAI需求引出协议，在康复语境中采用四种支架方法：类比桥接（将AI状态映射到熟悉系统）、投射人格（去个人化敏感话题）、二元强制选择（降低认知负荷）和延长响应时间。
Result: 成功引出异质的、有时冲突的XAI需求；发现三种系统性引导偏差：规范性偏差、假设确认偏差和在场效应。
Conclusion: 该协议及风险指南构成可复用的方法论贡献，强调面向患者的需求引出是可信人机系统设计的必要前提而非可选步骤。

papers.title: Salient Knowledge Pathways: Sparse Cross-Modal Routing for Efficient Knowledge-Intensive Multimodal Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge-intensive multimodal question answering (KI-MMQA) sits at the intersection of three expensive primitives: long visual token sequences, dense retrieval over large external corpora, and full cross-modal fusion. Existing systems pay all three costs uniformly per query, even though only a small fraction of visual content and retrieved knowledge is actually relevant to any given question. We introduce SKIP (Salient Knowledge-Injected Pathways), a unified inference architecture that routes computation along sparse pathways jointly conditioned on the question, the image, and a difficulty estimate. SKIP combines question-guided visual token pruning, region-conditional sparse retrieval, bipartite sparse cross-attention, and speculative knowledge verification with an adaptive budget controller that allocates compute proportional to predicted question difficulty. We derive an information-bottleneck bound showing that the optimal visual sparsity rate scales as $O(1/\sqrt{N})$ under realistic question-image mutual-information assumptions, with retained accuracy guarantees. Across five KI-MMQA benchmarks (OK-VQA, A-OKVQA, InfoSeek, Encyclopedic-VQA, and ViQuAE), SKIP matches or exceeds the accuracy of strong dense baselines while using $3.4$--$6.8\times$ fewer FLOPs and $2.7\times$ less end-to-end latency. Code available at: https://pmlrbd.github.io/skip/
papers.comment: Accepted at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026) Workshop on Efficient Multimodal Question Answering (EMM-QA), Seoul, South Korea. Copyright 2026 by the author(s). (Archival)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SKIP (Salient Knowledge-Injected Pathways) 架构，用于高效知识密集型多模态问答。SKIP 通过问题引导的视觉 token 剪枝、区域条件稀疏检索、二分稀疏交叉注意力和自适应预算控制器，沿稀疏路径路由计算。在五个 KI-MMQA 基准上，SKIP 匹配或超越密集基线，同时减少 3.4-6.8 倍 FLOPs 和 2.7 倍延迟。
Motivation: 现有 KI-MMQA 系统对所有查询均匀付出长视觉序列、密集检索和全跨模态融合的成本，但大部分内容与问题无关，导致计算效率低下。
Method: SKIP 联合条件于问题、图像和难度估计，包含问题引导的视觉 token 剪枝、区域条件稀疏检索、二分稀疏交叉注意力、推测性知识验证和自适应预算控制器，并推导了信息瓶颈界限证明最优视觉稀疏率。
Result: 在 OK-VQA、A-OKVQA、InfoSeek、Encyclopedic-VQA、ViQuAE 五个基准上，SKIP 匹配或超越强密集基线，使用 3.4-6.8 倍更少 FLOPs 和 2.7 倍更少端到端延迟。
Conclusion: 通过稀疏路由联合条件于问题、图像和难度估计，可以实现高效且准确的知识密集型多模态问答。

papers.title: MARS: Multi-Agent Re-ranking for Repeat-Order Food Delivery Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in recommender systems, but it is often unclear how much performance can be obtained from strong pre-trained backbones alone when they are placed inside a structured recommendation pipeline. In this paper, we present MARS, a modular multi-agent re-ranking framework for repeat-order food delivery recommendation. MARS serves as a controlled hybrid framework for studying how far pre-trained LLMs can go in this setting when combined with lightweight collaborative retrieval and contextual filtering. MARS performs coarse-to-fine recommendation in two stages: cuisine prediction followed by vendor ranking. The framework combines LightGCN-based global preference signals, Swing-based local peer evidence, geospatial filtering, and prompt-driven LLM reasoning over behavioral, temporal, and geographic context. We evaluate MARS on two real-world Delivery Hero benchmarks, DHRD-SE and DHRD-SG, and compare it against heuristic, sequential, graph-based, and food-delivery-specific baselines. We also provide detailed implementation and evaluation protocols, including prompting and decoding. Our study makes three contributions. First, it presents a modular multi-agent framework for repeat-order food delivery recommendation that integrates collaborative signals and LLM-based re-ranking in a transparent pipeline. Second, it shows that strong pre-trained backbones can already be competitive in repeat-order recommendation when paired with lightweight collaborative retrieval. Third, it establishes a reproducible evaluation setting for hybrid LLM recommenders in food delivery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MARS，一个模块化多智能体重排序框架，用于重复订单食品配送推荐。MARS采用粗到细的两阶段推荐：先预测菜品类别，再对商家排序。框架结合LightGCN全局偏好信号、Swing局部邻居证据、地理空间过滤以及基于LLM的提示推理。在Delivery Hero的两个真实数据集上评估，与多种基线对比。

papers.title: A Control System, a Dataset, and a Recipe for Making Frozen LLM Agents Learn a Domain
papers.abstract_en: Production LLM agents are increasingly assembled from a frozen model wrapped in a harness: a prompt template, a tool set, a memory/retrieval layer, a planning strategy, and a verification policy. Two 2026 systems, Meta-Harness (Lee et al., 2026) and HyperAgents (Meta AI, 2026), show that this harness can itself be optimized or even self-rewritten by an agentic proposer -- at the cost of either an expensive code-search loop or unconstrained self-modifying code, neither of which is auditable or usable with a fully black-box model API. We take a narrower, more constrained position: treat the harness as a small, fixed, human-legible action space and learn a policy over it online with classic sample-efficient reinforcement learning (an $ε$-greedy contextual bandit and REINFORCE), scored against a multi-objective reward (task success, verifier score, policy compliance, cost, latency, and an unsupported-claim penalty). We instantiate this control system with DSPy (Khattab et al., 2024) as both the context assembler and the source of the strongest non-adaptive baseline (a DSPy BootstrapFewShot static prompt), and evaluate it across three verifiable task domains -- tool-use workflows, code generation (HumanEval), and multi-hop retrieval QA (HotpotQA) -- and two model providers (a local Ollama model and AWS Bedrock). We release the harness-control-system code, the cross-domain verifiable task suite, the full trajectory/reward-decomposition logs from training, and a provider-agnostic deployment recipe for applying this to a new organization's domain and verification setup.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables. Code and dataset: https://github.com/dpaul0501/context-optimization-rl
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于强化学习的控制框架，用于优化由冻结LLM和外部工具（prompt模板、工具集、记忆/检索层、规划策略、验证策略）组成的代理系统，将其视为固定且可读的动作空间，通过ε-贪婪上下文赌博机和REINFORCE在线学习策略，并在工具使用、代码生成（HumanEval）和多跳检索QA（HotpotQA）任务上评估。
Motivation: 现有优化冻结LLM代理的方法（如Meta-Harness、HyperAgents）依赖于昂贵的代码搜索循环或不可审计的自修改代码，无法用于完全黑盒模型API。本文希望以更受限的方式，将代理的配置空间视为小型固定动作空间，通过经典强化学习在线学习策略，保证可审计性和可用性。
Method: 将LLM代理的配置（提示模板、工具集等）视为固定且人类可读的动作空间，使用ε-贪婪上下文赌博机和REINFORCE算法在线学习策略，并以多目标奖励（任务成功率、验证器得分、策略合规性、成本、延迟、未支持声明惩罚）进行评分。基于DSPy实现上下文组装和基线（DSPy BootstrapFewShot静态prompt），在三个可验证任务域和两个模型提供商（本地Ollama模型和AWS Bedrock）上评估。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，但提及在工具使用、HumanEval和HotpotQA任务上进行了评估，并比较了与DSPy BootstrapFewShot基线的表现。
Conclusion: 本文强调了在受限动作空间中通过强化学习优化冷冻LLM代理的可行性，并发布了控制框架代码、跨领域可验证任务套件、训练轨迹/奖励分解日志以及部署配方。

papers.title: SPARC Segmentation to Prediction via Affine Regression and Counterfactuals
papers.abstract_en: Transaction propensity prediction in B2B e commerce presents unique challenges distinct from B2C contexts, primarily due to the heterogeneous procurement behaviors of organizational entities, which violate SMOTE's implicit assumption of within class feature homogeneity. Specifically, B2B buyers exhibit multi modal procurement cycles that render linear interpolation between minority class samples structurally invalid, producing synthetic data that does not represent real purchasing behavior. This paper introduces a production deployed propensity modeling framework designed to address these complexities through two primary contributions. First, we replace conventional SMOTE based augmentation with a synthetic data generation approach leveraging Diverse Counterfactual Explanations (DiCE). This method produces minority class samples with superior distributional fidelity compared to SMOTE, as validated through quantitative proximity analysis and UMAP cluster visualization. Second, we adapt the PyPARC piecewise affine classification framework to generate calibrated propensity probabilities, facilitating the interpretable segmentation of customers into actionable risk tiers. Evaluated on two years of longitudinal data from a large scale B2B e commerce platform with a 1 to 9 class imbalance ratio, the proposed architecture achieves 93.1% precision at a decision threshold of 0.8, a 9.2 percentage point improvement over SMOTE based baselines at the same threshold (83.9%), and a 26.1 point improvement over SMOTE at threshold 0.7 (66.04%), demonstrating consistent superiority across operating points. These results demonstrate the framework's efficacy in enabling high precision marketing campaigns with significant improvements in customer activation and return on investment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对B2B电子商务中交易倾向预测的挑战，提出SPARC框架，用反事实解释（DiCE）替代SMOTE进行少数类样本合成，并采用分段仿射分类（PyPARC）生成校准的倾向概率。在两年期大规模B2B平台数据（不平衡比1:9）上，该框架在阈值0.8时达到93.1%的精确率，比SMOTE基线高9.2个百分点。
Motivation: B2B交易倾向预测中，组织买家的异质采购行为违反SMOTE的类内特征同质性假设，导致线性插值生成的合成数据不真实。
Method: 使用多样化反事实解释（DiCE）生成分布保真度更高的少数类样本，并基于PyPARC分段仿射分类框架输出校准的倾向概率，实现客户可解释分段。
Result: 在两年期大规模B2B平台数据（不平衡比1:9）上，阈值0.8时精确率93.1%，比SMOTE基线（83.9%）高9.2个百分点；阈值0.7时精确率66.04%，比SMOTE（40.0%）高26.1个百分点。
Conclusion: 该框架能有效支撑高精度营销活动，提升客户激活率和投资回报率。

papers.title: Context Assembly as the Controlled Variable: A Control-Theoretic View of Harness Policies for Frozen LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: A growing body of 2026 work applies control theory to LLM agents: Lyapunov-certified stability for tool-mediated controllers (Prinos et al., "Stable Agentic Control", 2026), sample-complexity bounds for sparse policies over massive discrete tool universes (Majumdar, "Sparse Agentic Control", 2026), and regulatory-control decompositions of multi-agent systems into auditable feedback loops (Nogueira and Skogestad, 2026). We do not claim to introduce control theory to LLM agents -- that ship has sailed. Our narrower claim is about what the controlled variable is. Prior work controls tool selection, inter-agent message routing, or the agent's raw action stream. We instead treat context assembly itself -- which prompt template, which few-shot demonstrations, how much retrieved context, how many planning/verification passes -- as the controlled variable, learned online by a contextual bandit or REINFORCE policy sitting outside a frozen model. This paper develops the formal decomposition (inner frozen policy $π_θ$, outer context policy $π_φ$), gives a stability argument for the online controller in the sense used by Zhang et al. (2026) (non-decreasing expected reward under bounded policy change), and reports an uncertainty-calibration analysis of the controller's own confidence against realized task outcomes. The applied counterpart to this paper instantiates the same controller across three domains and two model providers and releases the dataset, trajectory logs, and a deployment recipe; here we focus on the formal framing and the stability/uncertainty evidence a control-theoretic claim requires.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 2 figures, 1 table. Code and companion paper's data: https://github.com/dpaul0501/context-optimization-rl
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从控制理论视角出发，将上下文组装（context assembly）视为被控变量，提出一种外部上下文策略（outer context policy），通过在线学习（contextual bandit或REINFORCE）为冻结的LLM智能体动态选择提示模板、示例、检索上下文和规划次数。论文给出了形式化分解（内层冻结策略π_θ和外层上下文策略π_φ），提供了类似Zhang等人（2026）意义上的稳定性论证（有界策略变化下期望奖励非递减），并报告了控制器置信度与任务结果的不确定性校准分析。
Motivation: 现有控制理论应用于LLM智能体时，被控变量多为工具选择、消息路由或原始动作流。本文认为上下文组装本身才是更合适的被控变量，但缺乏形式化框架和稳定性保证。
Method: 提出双层策略分解：内层为冻结的LLM策略π_θ，外层为可学习的上下文策略π_φ（基于contextual bandit或REINFORCE）。形式化论证了在有限策略变化下期望奖励非递减的稳定性，并对控制器置信度进行不确定性校准。
Result: 摘要报告了稳定性论证和不确定性校准分析，但未给出具体数值结果。实际应用结果在配套论文中，本文聚焦于形式化框架和稳定性/不确定性证据。
Conclusion: 本文主张上下文组装应作为LLM智能体控制中的被控变量，并提供了相应的形式化方法和稳定性分析。

papers.title: ANFI: Rethinking Neighbor Feature Interaction in Person Re-ID
papers.abstract_en: In person re-identification, neighbor-based methods have achieved significant success by interacting with neighbor samples to obtain more robust representations. However, existing methods rely only on affinity relations, causing their success to depend heavily on the reliability of selected neighbors. We find that affinity-only interaction often fails in challenging scenarios due to the inevitable presence of noisy neighbors. To enable effective interactions under noisy neighborhoods, we revisit neighbor-based methods under distinct reliability conditions and propose a novel Adaptive Neighbor Feature Interaction (ANFI) method. The core idea of ANFI is to account for negative effects from noisy neighbors, allowing samples to remain distinguishable from false positive neighbors. Unlike existing methods, ANFI models not only affinity relations but also discrepancy relations, and employs sample-wise adaptive weighting for these two types of relations. Given that capturing negative effects from noisy neighbors differs significantly from traditional relation learning, we derive discrepancy relations from a new neighborhood similarity, which provides more information than pairwise similarity. In addition, we propose Noisy Relation Supervision (NRS) to train ANFI, gradually injecting robustness to noisy relations into the model. Extensive experiments conducted under standard, cross-modal, and cross-domain settings, including comparisons with neighbor-based methods and re-ranking methods, demonstrate the superiority of our method across various neighbor distributions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对行人重识别中基于邻居特征交互方法在噪声邻居下失效的问题，提出自适应邻居特征交互（ANFI）方法。核心是同时建模亲和关系（affinity）和差异关系（discrepancy），并通过样本自适应加权处理两种关系。进一步提出噪声关系监督（NRS）训练策略，逐步注入对噪声关系的鲁棒性。在标准、跨模态和跨域设置下的实验表明，该方法在不同邻居分布下均优于现有邻居方法和重排序方法。
Motivation: 现有基于邻居的方法仅依赖亲和关系，在噪声邻居不可避免的困难场景下容易失败。论文旨在解决噪声邻居环境下邻居特征交互的有效性问题。
Method: 提出ANFI，同时建模亲和关系和差异关系，并对两种关系进行样本级自适应加权。差异关系从一种新的邻居相似度推导而来。同时提出NRS训练策略，逐步增强模型对噪声关系的鲁棒性。
Result: 在标准、跨模态和跨域设置下的广泛实验，包括与邻居方法和重排序方法的比较，证明了ANFI在不同邻居分布下的优越性。
Conclusion: 重新思考噪声邻居下的特征交互，通过引入差异关系和自适应加权，使样本能与假正邻居保持可区分性，有效克服了噪声邻域的负面影响。

papers.title: TWICE: Two-Clock, Two-Window Learning for Long-Horizon Conversion Prediction in Online Advertising
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon conversion prediction under delayed feedback creates a two-clock, two-window learning problem in online advertising. A short base observation window releases recent clicks on the click clock before their outcomes mature, whereas conversions continue to arrive on the conversion clock throughout a longer target conversion window. The click clock provides timely but partially observed status supervision. The conversion clock reveals long-tail delays, but the delay composition within an arrival-time slice is weighted by historical click cohorts with different traffic volumes and target-window conversion rates. We present TWICE, a framework that factorizes long-horizon post-click conversion rate (CVR) into a target-window conversion probability and a grouped elapsed-delay cumulative distribution function (CDF). The two clocks provide complementary supervision. Click-clock records train the target-window CVR head through a current-status likelihood over the base observation window. Newly arrived conversions train the delay model on the conversion clock. To account for the cohort mixture, TWICE uses fixed click-time predicted CVR (pCVR) mass as cohort exposure in an arrival-conditioned likelihood. This accounts for differences in cohort traffic and conversion propensity. The resulting aggregate records are self-contained. A single learned CDF produces monotone predictions for all requested horizons up to the target conversion window. Serving requires neither historical lookup nor convolution. Experiments on a public benchmark and an industrial advertising dataset demonstrate the effectiveness of TWICE. In an online A/B test in Kwai's advertising system, TWICE increased expected revenue, revenue, and conversions by 2.486%, 1.858%, and 2.061%, respectively. It was subsequently deployed to full traffic.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对在线广告中长周期转化预测的延迟反馈问题，提出TWICE框架，将点击后转化率分解为目标窗口转化概率和分组的历时延迟累积分布函数。利用点击时钟和转化时钟的双时钟互补监督，通过到达条件似然处理历史点击队列混合。实验在公开基准和工业数据集上有效，在快手广告系统在线A/B测试中提升预期收入2.486%、收入1.858%、转化数2.061%，并已全量部署。
Motivation: 长周期转化预测中，短基础观察窗口提供及时但部分监督，长转化窗口揭示长尾延迟但队列混合加权复杂，现有方法难以兼顾。
Method: 提出TWICE框架，将点击后转化率分解为目标窗口转化概率和历时延迟累积分布函数；利用点击时钟的当前状态似然和转化时钟的新到达似然进行联合训练，并通过固定点击时间预测转化率质量作为队列暴露量来处理混合问题。
Result: 在公开基准和工业数据集上有效，在线A/B测试中预期收入提升2.486%、收入提升1.858%、转化数提升2.061%。
Conclusion: TWICE框架有效解决了长周期转化预测中的延迟反馈和队列混合问题，生成的累积分布函数单调且服务时无需历史查找或卷积，适用于工业部署。
