papers.title: COVENANT: Natural-Language Workflow Compilation for Aligned Agent Execution
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly entrusted with natural-language workflow instructions (e.g., retail-payment policies) that specify not only what outcome to achieve, but also which steps, branches, and tool interactions are permitted. When these instructions are supplied as prompt context, however, the model retains control over both procedure selection and step execution. As interactions accumulate, an agent can skip required steps, take unsupported branches, or execute a valid step with unsupported arguments or effects--a failure mode we call workflow misalignment. In this work, we propose COVENANT, a compiler-and-interpreter architecture for workflow-aligned agent execution. Our key insight is to treat workflow instructions as source programs rather than prompts. COVENANT converts the instructions into a workflow abstract syntax tree (WAST) and lowers it to a workflow control-flow graph (WCFG). At runtime, a controller interprets the WCFG one node at a time, checks each proposal against requirements extracted from the instructions before committing controller state or advancing the graph, and returns diagnostic feedback for repair. To evaluate COVENANT, we use 120 cases from three existing benchmarks, spanning seven workflow scenarios. Compared with state-of-the-art LLM agents, COVENANT improves benchmark success from 50.00% to 83.33% and reduces the workflow-misalignment failure rate from 42.50% to 15.83% (62.75% relative). These results show that COVENANT substantially mitigates workflow misalignment, moving LLM-agent alignment beyond isolated prompt following toward reliable execution of complex and multi-step workflows.

papers.title: HANDBOOK.md: A Benchmark for Long-Context Agentic Instruction Following
papers.abstract_en: Language-model agents are increasingly deployed under standing instructions: a system prompt, a policy file, or a skills document is placed in context, and the agent is trusted to let it govern every action that follows. Existing benchmarks rarely test this deployment pattern directly; they measure whether an agent can complete a task, not whether a long, binding policy document actually constrains its behavior over an extended tool-use horizon. We present HANDBOOK.md, a benchmark of 65 agentic tasks modeled on how enterprise employees follow company handbooks. Each task places an agent in a self-contained company environment, a file workspace together with mock email, chat, calendar, issue-tracking, and commerce services exposed over the Model Context Protocol, and instructs it to carry out routine professional work governed by an expert-written standard operating procedure of 20 to 124 pages. Tasks span five domains (finance, medical billing, insurance, logistics, and HR) and ten fictional companies. To resist memorization, every task modifies one of ten base handbooks, altering the specific rules and thresholds on which grading turns, so no two tasks share a policy. Grading is fully deterministic: each task carries a rubric of programmatic criteria (824 in total) that check both that required actions occurred and that prohibited actions did not. Under strict grading, where a trial passes only if every criterion is satisfied, the best of thirty evaluated model configurations passes 36.2% of trials, and most frontier configurations remain below 25%. Failures follow consistent patterns: agents let a plausible in-environment request override the standing policy, perform a required check and then act against its result, lose rule details over long horizons, and report compliance they did not achieve. We release all tasks, environments, and the evaluation harness.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Accepted to the Workshop on Agent Behavior (WAB) at COLM 2026. Benchmark, environments, and evaluation harness: https://github.com/surge-ai/handbook
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HANDBOOK.md，一个包含 65 个代理任务的基准，用于测试语言模型在长上下文（20-124 页标准操作规程）下的指令遵循能力。每个任务模拟企业环境，通过邮件、聊天、日历等工具要求代理执行专业工作，并根据确定性标准（共 824 条）严格评分。在最佳配置下，通过率仅为 36.2%，多数前沿模型低于 25%。失败模式包括忽略政策、检查后违规、丢失规则细节及虚假报告。
Motivation: 现有基准主要测试任务完成能力，而非检查代理是否在长期工具使用中严格遵循绑定指令（如系统提示或政策文档），这与实际部署需求存在差距。
Method: 构建 65 个任务，每个任务基于一个 20-124 页的专家编写操作规程，代理在包含文件、邮件、聊天、日历、问题跟踪和商业服务的模拟公司环境中执行任务；每个任务修改基础手册中的特定规则以保证新颖性，评分通过 824 个程序化标准进行确定性判定。
Result: 在严格评分（所有标准均满足才算通过）下，30 个评估模型配置中最佳通过率为 36.2%，大多数前沿模型低于 25%。失败呈现一致模式：代理允许环境请求覆盖政策、执行检查后反其道而行、长序列中丢失规则细节、以及虚假报告合规。
Conclusion: 当前语言模型在企业场景的长指令遵循方面表现不足，常见的失败模式提示需要改进模型对约束的持久保持和抗干扰能力。基准已开源。

papers.title: Towards Reliable Stain Transfer: An Iterative Data-Model Co-Optimization Framework Based on Multimodal Expert-Guided Assessment
papers.abstract_en: Histopathological examination primarily relies on hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) and immunohistochemistry (IHC) staining. Although IHC provides critical molecular information, it is costly and requires specialized expertise. Stain transfer provides an efficient alternative by computationally generating IHC from H&E images, but remains challenged by unified and interpretable modeling for heterogeneous biomarkers under pixel-unaligned supervision. We propose DMCoStain, a novel Data-Model Co-optimization framework for Stain transfer. It iteratively co-refines training data and model capability, improving staining accuracy and interpretability in both pathological and structural consistency. To refine training data in a clinically meaningful manner, it incorporates the Multimodal Expert-Guided Finer Selection (MEGFS) strategy, built upon a pioneering IHC-positive-expression (IPE) vision-language model (VLM) that emulates pathologist reasoning. To support MEGFS, we construct ImmunoInstruction, the first large-scale IPE instruction-following dataset with 150K VQA samples. Extensive experiments on multiple tissues and biomarkers demonstrate that DMCoStain achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) accuracy. This paradigm offers strong practical value, and MEGFS also functions as a specialized evaluation tool for future model development. Dataset, code, and more details are in https://github.com/SikangSHU/DMCoStain.
papers.comment: 10 pages, accepted by ACMMM2026 Main Track
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对H&E到IHC染色转移中异质性生物标记物在像素未对齐监督下的建模难题，提出了一种数据-模型联合优化框架DMCoStain。该框架通过迭代精炼训练数据和模型能力，并引入多模态专家引导的精细选择策略（MEGFS），该策略基于首个IHC阳性表达（IPE）视觉语言模型，以及包含15万VQA样本的大规模指令微调数据集ImmunoInstruction。实验表明该方法在多种组织和生物标记物上达到当前最佳（SOTA）精度。
Motivation: 现有染色转移方法在处理异质性生物标记物时缺乏统一且可解释的建模能力，且依赖像素对齐的监督数据，限制了实际应用。
Method: 提出DMCoStain框架，迭代联合优化数据和模型。核心包括多模态专家引导的精细选择（MEGFS）策略，该策略基于一个新型的IHC阳性表达（IPE）视觉语言模型模拟病理学家推理，并构建了首个大型IPE指令微调数据集ImmunoInstruction（150K VQA样本）。
Result: 在多个组织和生物标记物上的大量实验表明，DMCoStain达到了当前最佳（SOTA）精度。
Conclusion: 该范式提供了很强的实用价值，且MEGFS也可作为未来模型开发的专门评估工具。数据集和代码已开源。

papers.title: RDVSv2: A Large-scale Benchmark for RGB-D Video Salient Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: We introduce RDVSv2, a large-scale benchmark for RGB-D video salient object detection (RGB-D VSOD) with dense frame-level annotations. Existing datasets in this emerging field are often limited in scale and annotation quality, while also relying on less geometry-consistent depth cues. To address these limitations, RDVSv2 is built from publicly accessible stereoscopic online videos and contains 249 video sequences with 29,077 annotated frames. It includes depth maps derived from stereoscopic videos, together with frame-wise salient object masks annotated with eye-tracking guidance. Compared with existing datasets, RDVSv2 is much larger in scale and covers more diverse and challenging scenarios. In addition, we establish a strong baseline for RGB-D VSOD based on Segment Anything Model 2 (SAM2). Specifically, we employ a parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) strategy to adapt the SAM2 encoder to jointly encode RGB, depth, and optical flow cues. Extensive experiments show that RDVSv2 is substantially more challenging for existing RGB-D VSOD methods. Meanwhile, the proposed baseline achieves state-of-the-art results on RDVSv2 and existing RGB-D VSOD benchmarks. We hope that RDVSv2 and the provided baseline will serve as useful resources for future research on RGB-D VSOD and related multi-modal video understanding tasks. Our dataset and code will be available at https://github.com/ltynick/RDVSv2.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RDVSv2，一个大规模 RGB-D 视频显著目标检测 (RGB-D VSOD) 基准，包含 249 个视频序列和 29,077 帧密集标注。数据集来源于立体视频，提供深度图及眼动追踪引导的逐帧显著目标掩码，覆盖更多样化和挑战性场景。同时基于 SAM2 构建基线，采用参数高效微调策略联合编码 RGB、深度和光流线索。实验表明 RDVSv2 对现有方法更具挑战性，所提基线在 RDVSv2 及现有基准上达到最优。
Motivation: 现有 RGB-D VSOD 数据集规模小、标注质量低，且依赖几何一致性较差的深度线索，限制了该领域的发展。
Method: 构建大规模基准 RDVSv2，从公开立体视频中采集数据并生成深度图；基于 SAM2 提出基线，使用参数高效微调联合编码 RGB、深度和光流。
Result: RDVSv2 比现有数据集更具挑战性；所提基线在 RDVSv2 和现有 RGB-D VSOD 基准上均达到当前最优。
Conclusion: 希望 RDVSv2 及其基线成为 RGB-D VSOD 及相关多模态视频理解研究的资源。

papers.title: Noise-Free One-Step LoRA for Task-Driven Image Restoration with Diffusion Priors
papers.abstract_en: Degraded images not only reduce visual quality but also impair downstream high-level vision tasks. Task-driven image restoration (TDIR) addresses this issue by jointly optimizing restoration quality and task performance. Recent works show that pretrained diffusion priors benefit TDIR, yet diffusion-based restoration is inherently stochastic, as the sampling process depends on a random noise term, which can undermine task consistency. In this paper, we show that a deterministic, noise-free one-step forward pass with pretrained diffusion priors can substantially improve TDIR, but the benefit critically depends on the adaptation module: LoRA yields consistent gains, whereas ControlNet-style conditioning does not. This enables one-step forwarding that surpasses conventional multi-step diffusion TDIR baselines. Furthermore, we introduce a task-preserving GAN training strategy that improves perceptual quality without sacrificing task performance. Extensive experiments on classification, segmentation, and detection demonstrate consistent gains over prior TDIR methods, and we further validate generalization on real-world degraded images and OCR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对任务驱动的图像恢复（TDIR）问题，提出一种基于无噪声单步前向传播的扩散先验方法。作者发现，使用LoRA适配模块的确定性单步前向传播可以显著提升任务一致性，而ControlNet式条件化则无效。此外，引入保持任务性能的GAN训练策略来改善感知质量。在分类、分割和检测任务上，该方法优于传统多步扩散TDIR基线，并在真实退化图像和OCR上验证了泛化性。
Motivation: 退化图像不仅降低视觉质量，还会损害下游高层视觉任务。TDIR通过联合优化恢复质量和任务性能来解决该问题，但现有基于扩散的恢复方法因其随机采样过程（依赖随机噪声项）而破坏任务一致性。
Method: 提出无噪声、确定性的单步前向传播方法，使用预训练扩散先验，关键依赖于LoRA适配模块；同时设计任务保持的GAN训练策略，在不牺牲任务性能的前提下提升感知质量。
Result: 在分类、分割、检测等任务上，该方法一致优于先前TDIR方法；在真实退化图像和OCR上验证了泛化性。摘要未提供具体数值。
Conclusion: 单步确定性扩散前向传播结合LoRA能有效提升TDIR，且任务保持GAN训练可改善感知质量，无需多步采样。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: HOME: Robust Hough-space Matching Method for Structured and Textureless Videos
papers.abstract_en: Visual front-ends for robotic localization typically rely on point-based features such as Oriented FAST and Rotated BRIEF (ORB), which frequently fail in structured environments dominated by strong linear structures or textureless surfaces. While line-based Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) systems mitigate this by utilizing line segments, conventional line extraction and description algorithms are computationally prohibitive for real-time edge robotics. To address this fundamental bottleneck, we propose HOME (Hough-space One-dimensional Matching of Extrema), an ultra-lightweight, training-free feature matching framework. HOME transforms images into Hough space, mapping global linear structures to stable local extrema, which serve as keypoints, thereby reformulating complex line matching into highly efficient one-dimensional point matching. The proposed 1D radial descriptor mathematically guarantees rotational and translational invariance without the overhead of explicit orientation estimation. As a proof of concept to validate the matching accuracy and efficiency of HOME, this paper focuses on homography estimation. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that HOME achieves robust registration in challenging scenarios where point-based methods fail, operating at a much faster speed than existing line-based methods. Extending this robust matching engine to full 3D pose estimation remains a highly promising future direction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出HOME，一种基于Hough空间的一维匹配框架，用于结构化和无纹理视频中的特征匹配。将图像变换到Hough空间，将全局线性结构映射为稳定的局部极值作为关键点，并用一维径向描述子实现旋转和平移不变性。实验证明在点特征方法失效的挑战场景中，HOME能实现鲁棒的配准，且速度远快于现有基于线的方法。
Motivation: 现有基于点的特征（如ORB）在结构化环境和纹理表面常失效，而基于线的SLAM系统虽然有效但计算昂贵，难以用于实时边缘机器人。
Method: 将图像变换到Hough空间，提取全局线性结构对应的局部极值作为关键点，并设计一维径向描述子，无需显式估计方向即可保证旋转和平移不变性，将复杂线匹配转化为高效的一维点匹配。
Result: 在挑战性场景中，HOME实现鲁棒配准，速度快于现有线基方法；实验侧重于单应性估计，验证了匹配精度和效率。
Conclusion: HOME作为轻量级、免训练的特征匹配框架，在结构化和无纹理场景中有效，但论文仅验证了单应性估计，扩展到完整3D位姿估计是未来方向。

papers.title: Learned, Relied Upon, or Necessary? Separating Checkpoint Dependence from Task-Level Value in Sheaf GNNs
papers.abstract_en: Learned restriction maps in sheaf graph neural networks are often treated as proof that the model has discovered useful edge geometry. That conclusion does not follow from parameter movement or from a post-hoc ablation: both can show how one checkpoint is organized while leaving open whether learned transport still helps after the rest of the model adapts. We separate these claims with two estimands. Checkpoint reliance intervenes on the maps of a fixed predictor; protocol-relative replacement retrains matched families that remove map capacity, edge variation, or persistent edge assignment. A task-null theorem shows why the claims can diverge: labels identify only the transported classifier directions, leaving $d^2-d$ invisible degrees of freedom in every full $d\times d$ map. An exact frame model then gives the boundary at which reliance becomes unreplaced task value. Label-only training realizes the predicted separation, while audits of public NSD, DNSD, and Directed Sheaf Neural Network (DSNN) implementations recover both replaceable and unreplaced transport regimes on real graphs. All five DNSD benchmarks exhibit fixed-checkpoint reliance. After retraining, assignment-breaking or shared-map controls recover Full performance on four; Roman-Empire retains a $.0675$ advantage over continually resampled assignment and a $.0391$ advantage over a parameter-matched shared map across ten official splits. Thus, a learned map can govern a fitted computation without constituting indispensable edge geometry. Claims of learned transport should pair checkpoint interventions with matched retraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究sheaf GNN中学习到的限制映射是否真正代表有用的边几何，还是仅仅依赖检查点。作者提出两种估计量区分检查点依赖和任务级价值，并通过任务零定理和实验证明两者可能分离。
Motivation: 现有工作常将学习到的限制映射视为模型发现边几何的证据，但该结论不能从参数移动或事后消融中得出，因为两者只显示检查点的组织方式，而非其他部分适应后仍有效。
Method: 提出检查点依赖（干预固定预测器的映射）和协议相关替换（重新训练匹配族移除映射能力等）两个估计量；利用任务零定理说明标签仅识别分类器方向；使用精确框架模型给出依赖变为任务价值的边界。
Result: 标签训练实现预测分离；在NSD、DNSD、DSNN基准上恢复可替换和不可替换传输机制；所有DNSD基准显示固定检查点依赖，重新训练后四个基准恢复完整性能，Roman-Empire保留微小优势。
Conclusion: 学习到的映射可支配拟合计算，但不构成不可替代的边几何。主张结合检查点干预和匹配重新训练。

papers.title: Cyber-Capable AI Agents: Vulnerabilities, Evaluation Containment, and Defensive Response
papers.abstract_en: Cyber-capable AI agents combine language models with tools, memory, and execution en- vironments to perform multi-step offensive-security tasks. Existing work separately measures cyber capability and catalogs attacks against agent components, but provides less guidance on containing a capable agent within the environments used to evaluate it. This review synthe- sizes five vulnerability classes at that boundary: multi-step offensive chains, objectives that conflict with sandbox boundaries, supply-chain and credential exposure, persistent command- and-control, and the speed of automated action. We use the reported July 2026 Hugging Face/OpenAI incident as a bounded case study, distinguishing incident-specific observations from findings established in the wider literature. Across the taxonomy and case, we examine controls for containment, privilege separation, provenance, and responder access, including the dual-use problem that defensive artifacts may also enable misuse. The review identifies practical priorities for evaluating cyber capability together with the security of the environment in which that capability is exercised.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文综述了具备网络能力的AI代理（结合语言模型、工具、记忆和执行环境）在执行多步攻击任务时面临的五类边界漏洞：多步攻击链、冲突目标、供应链与凭证暴露、持久命令与控制、自动行动速度。以2026年7月Hugging Face/OpenAI事件为案例，探讨了包含、权限分离、溯源和响应控制等防御措施，并指出评估网络能力与评估环境安全性应并行进行。
Motivation: 现有工作分别测量网络能力或记录针对代理组件的攻击，但缺乏对如何在评估环境中有效控制强大代理的指导。
Method: 通过综合文献综述和案例研究，分类识别五类漏洞，并分析包含、权限分离、溯源和响应等防御控制措施。
Result: 论文分类了五类漏洞，并以实际事件为例说明控制措施的双刃剑效应（防御技术也可能被滥用）。
Conclusion: 强调评估网络能力时必须同步评估环境安全性，并提出了实用优先级。

papers.title: Gaussian Volumetric Representation for Efficient Shear-Warp Visualization
authors: Ojaswa Sharma (1) ((1) Indraprastha Institute of Information Technology Delhi)
papers.abstract_en: Medical image visualization requires volumetric rendering algorithms that preserve anatomical fidelity while maintaining high rendering speeds. To address the high computational cost of large volumetric datasets, we propose a Gaussian-based volumetric representation for efficient visualization of dense medical volumes without compromising structural and radiometric details. We optimize the proposed representation using Monte Carlo volumetric estimation, which enables training on a highly sparse subset of voxels while maintaining consistency with the dense volumetric objective. In addition, we introduce a curriculum learning strategy that progressively incorporates structured slice-based sampling during training. Sparse voxel samples provide an early global coverage of the volume, while slice samples capture spatially correlated regions that aid geometric structure and texture continuity. This combination enables the Gaussian representation to learn anatomical details of various structures and corresponding textures from sparse supervision while significantly reducing the computational cost associated with dense voxel processing. The learned representation supports slice-based rendering methods such as shear-warp volume rendering, enabling efficient visualization of multimodal medical datasets including MRI and Cryosection volumes while preserving anatomical structures. Using sparse supervision, our method achieves up to 43.86 FPS rendering with a compression ratio of 11.31:1.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于高斯体素表示的方法，用于高效可视化大型医学体积数据（如MRI和Cryosection体积），通过蒙特卡洛体积估计和课程学习策略，在保持结构细节的同时大幅降低计算成本。该方法支持剪切-扭曲（shear-warp）体渲染，可实现高帧率渲染，压缩比达11.31:1。
Motivation: 医学体素数据量大，传统渲染方法计算成本高，难以在保持解剖结构保真度的同时实现快速渲染。
Method: 提出高斯体素表示，采用蒙特卡洛体积估计在稀疏体素子集上训练，并引入课程学习逐步整合切片采样，以平衡全局覆盖与局部纹理连续性。最终表示支持剪切-扭曲渲染。
Result: 在MRI和Cryosection数据集上，该方法以稀疏监督达到最高43.86 FPS的渲染帧率，压缩比11.31:1，同时保持解剖细节。
Conclusion: 高斯体素表示结合稀疏监督和课程学习，能高效实现医学体积的快速可视化，适用于多模态数据，但未讨论动态场景或非医学应用。

papers.title: Rethinking Likelihood distributions: Student's t Likelihood Boosts Bayesian Neural Network Performance
papers.abstract_en: In Bayesian neural networks (BNNs), variational inference is a widely adopted framework for modeling uncertainty in a distributional way, with the evidence lower bound (ELBO) serving as the standard objective function. Several distributions contribute to the ELBO loss, such as the prior, approximated posterior, and likelihood distribution. Typically, these distributions are all approximated by a Gaussian distribution, since it is easy to compute, allows for reparameterized gradients, and provides a closed-form loss for training. However, several works have highlighted that this assumption may not generally hold, posing the risk of model misspecification. Alternative distributions have been proposed for the prior specifically, while the effect of distribution choice on the likelihood distribution remains unexplored. In this work, our aim is to close this gap by investigating whether alternative assumptions for the likelihood distribution can outperform the commonly used Gaussian. We compare several likelihood distribution assumptions, such as skewed or heavy-tailed, across regression tasks on both artificial and real-world datasets using standard multilayer perceptrons (MLPs). Our findings demonstrate that Student's t yields better predictive performance than a Gaussian likelihood distribution, independent of the data distribution and MLP architecture (depth and width). In some cases, Student's t can also lead to shorter training times, while still being easy to implement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究贝叶斯神经网络 (BNN) 中似然分布的选取，挑战传统高斯假设，通过实验对比多种分布（如重尾分布）在全连接网络上的回归任务表现，发现 Student's t 分布能一致地提升预测性能，且有时缩短训练时间。
Motivation: 现有 BNN 普遍假设似然分布为高斯，可能造成模型误设；已有工作探索了先验的替代分布，但似然分布的选取影响尚未被系统研究。
Method: 在多层感知机 (MLP) 的回归任务中，对比高斯、偏态和重尾等不同似然分布假设，使用变分推断优化 ELBO，并在人工和真实数据集上进行评估。
Result: Student's t 似然分布无论在何种数据分布或 MLP 架构（深度、宽度）下，均优于高斯似然，部分情况下还缩短了训练时间。
Conclusion: 作者建议在 BNN 中采用 Student's t 似然分布作为高斯分布的替代，因其实现简单且性能更优。

papers.title: Hyperspectral Intrinsic Decomposition: Joint Recovery of Reflectance and Photometric Components for Non-Lambertian Scenes
papers.abstract_en: Hyperspectral intrinsic decomposition (HID) aims to disentangle material-related spectral properties and photometric effects in hyperspectral images (HSIs), which is essential for understanding real-world imaging processes and benefits a variety of downstream applications. Most existing HID studies have been developed under Lambertian or near-Lambertian assumptions. The few prior non-Lambertian efforts rely on simplified specular assumptions insufficient to handle diverse real-world specularity, and typically require auxiliary inputs or recover only a subset of the coupled reflectance and photometric components, hindering complete and blind decomposition. In this paper, we revisit the dichromatic reflection model (DRM) and develop a unified inversion paradigm that reformulates the recovery of four coupled reflectance and photometric components as the estimation of two spectral--spatial target variables. Building on this reformulation, we propose a dual-scale decomposition scheme to handle non-Lambertian effects with distinct spatial characteristics. At the global scale, photometrically invariant descriptors serve as edge priors for high-fidelity intrinsic boundary preservation; at the local scale, specularity-guided attention directs refinement with emphasis on specularity-dominated regions, including those affected by clipping distortion. To facilitate future research, we establish CITE, the first public real-world HID dataset for non-Lambertian objects, and develop a Physically-faithful Intrinsic Set Generator (PISG) for controllable data synthesis. Extensive ablation studies and experiments on the CITE and additional HSIs demonstrate the effectiveness of our method and its robustness across diverse scenes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种针对非朗伯场景的高光谱图像内在分解方法，基于双色反射模型重新公式化，采用双尺度分解方案处理不同空间特征的非朗伯效应，并构建了首个公开真实非朗伯物体高光谱数据集CITE。
Motivation: 现有高光谱内在分解方法多基于朗伯或近朗伯假设，对真实世界的非朗伯效应处理不足，且需辅助输入或仅恢复部分耦合成分，缺乏完整盲分解能力。
Method: 基于双色反射模型，将四个耦合的反射率和光度分量恢复转化为两个光谱-空间目标变量的估计；提出全局尺度（光度不变描述子作为边缘先验）和局部尺度（镜面引导注意力）的双尺度分解方案。
Result: 在CITE数据集和其他高光谱图像上的实验表明，该方法在不同场景下有效且鲁棒，能够高保真地恢复内在边界并处理镜面主导区域。
Conclusion: 该方法为非朗伯场景的高光谱内在分解提供了统一框架，但摘要未明确讨论局限性和未来工作。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ODYSSE: Episode-wise Policy Optimization for Personalized Agentic Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Agentic systems have rapidly advanced in their ability to interact with real-world environments, leverage external tools, and provide services for users. However, unlike natural-world tasks that assume well-defined instructions, human-centered scenarios are characterized by ambiguous requests that lead to large, open-ended solution spaces. Decoding users' personalized preferences is therefore essential for narrowing the candidate solution space. This introduces a new challenge, personalized agentic reasoning, which requires agents to jointly interact with both users and environments to deliver personalized services. In this paper, we present ODYSSE, a Reinforced Fine-Tuning (RFT) framework for personalized agentic reasoning. At its core, ODYSSE proposes Episode-wise GRPO (ESPO), a novel extension of Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) designed to address long action horizons and strong cross-step dependencies in personalized agentic reasoning. Rather than optimizing individual steps independently, ESPO introduces an episode-level reward mechanism together with episodic advantage estimation, enabling upstream evidence to effectively guide downstream personalized decisions and allowing agents to progressively resolve ambiguous user requests across multiple interaction steps. We further propose an episodic batch sampler that groups actions from the same episode into unified training batches, facilitating coherent optimization under ESPO. We evaluate ODYSSE on realistic long-horizon personalized GUI reasoning tasks. Experimental results demonstrate that ODYSSE consistently outperforms both specialist and general-purpose LVLMs, highlighting its effectiveness for personalized agentic reasoning.

papers.title: AI Deployment and Cyber Governance Failures in Public-Sector Organizations: A Typological Analysis
papers.abstract_en: The intersection of artificial intelligence adoption, cybersecurity governance, and public sector institutional constraints has not been examined as a unified analytical problem in the existing literature. Studies address AI cybersecurity risks generically, public sector governance independently, and framework adequacy separately. Existing studies have not integrated these three streams to explain specifically how AI adoption causes cybersecurity governance failure in government organizations, nor test existing governance instruments against AI-specific public sector failure causes. This paper ad-dresses that gap. It proposes a seven-domain typology identifying ten specific AI-driven cyber governance failure causes grounded in public sector institutional analysis. It presents a three-pathway failure model showing how accountability failure, opera-tional resilience failure, and compliance failure interact and reinforce each other. It de-livers a structured coverage matrix testing five major governance frameworks (NIST CSF 2.0, ISO/IEC 27001, COBIT, NIST AI RMF, and ISO/IEC 42001) against the typology, finding that no instrument addresses Shadow AI, speed asymmetry, or gov-ernance vacuum at the operational specificity required for public sector application. The paper introduces speed asymmetry as a named structural construct with a specified mechanism. The framework provides the design specification for an AI-enabled cyber-security maturity model for government organizations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个七域类型学，识别公共部门中AI部署导致的十种特定网络治理失败原因，并构建三路径失败模型（问责失败、运营韧性失败、合规失败）。通过结构化覆盖矩阵测试五大治理框架（NIST CSF 2.0、ISO/IEC 27001、COBIT、NIST AI RMF、ISO/IEC 42001），发现这些框架均未以公共部门所需的操作特异性解决影子AI、速度不对称和治理真空问题。
Motivation: 现有文献未将AI采用、网络安全治理与公共部门制度约束作为统一分析问题，缺乏解释AI如何在政府组织中导致网络安全治理失败的综合研究。
Method: 基于公共部门制度分析，提出七域类型学与十种具体失败原因，构建三路径失败模型，并设计结构化覆盖矩阵评估五大治理框架。
Result: 发现所有测试框架均未以公共部门所需的操作特异性解决影子AI、速度不对称和治理真空问题；速度不对称作为具有指定机制的结构性构念被正式提出。
Conclusion: 该框架为政府组织设计AI驱动的网络安全成熟度模型提供了设计规范，但摘要未提及其在实际公共部门中的验证或局限性。

papers.title: Leak-Free Cross-Validated Stacking with Per-Architecture Calibration for Sand-Boil Segmentation in Earthen Levees
papers.abstract_en: Sand boils, points where water seeping beneath an earthen levee re-emerges at the surface, are early warnings of internal erosion, and deep segmentation networks are increasingly used to find them in inspection photographs. Annotated examples are scarce, and two common ways of working around that scarcity quietly inflate reported accuracy: tuning ensemble weights on the same images later used to score them, and training on synthetic images derived from the very photographs held out for testing. We present a sand-boil segmentation framework that closes both loopholes. Every synthetic image carries a pointer to its real parent, and a per-fold filter excludes any image whose parent is held out; five encoder-decoder backbones are trained under five-fold cross-validation, calibrated by one temperature scalar each, and combined by a per-pixel meta-learner fitted only on out-of-fold predictions. On the held-out test set the proposed Updated SandBoilNet reaches an intersection-over-union of 0.707 over three seeds, against 0.608 for the published original re-evaluated on the same split. Under the stacking protocol the calibrated stack reaches 0.681 against 0.694 for the strongest fold-averaged member, so it does not improve on the best single model; eight meta-learner families reproduce that outcome, which we trace to a mean pairwise error correlation of 0.894 among members. A synthetic pool filtered for label fidelity lifts the champion to 0.718 over three seeds against a 0.707 control. We also introduce a mask-conditioned synthesis route that makes the conditioning mask the label by construction, giving labelled training images at zero annotation cost.

TL;DR: 本文针对土堤砂沸分割任务中标注稀缺导致的评分泄漏问题，提出一种无泄漏交叉验证堆叠框架。通过为每个合成图像记录原始父图像并在每折过滤掉父图像在测试集中的样本，结合五个编码器-解码器架构的五折交叉验证、每个架构一个温度标量的校准，以及仅在折外预测上训练的逐像素元学习器，在保留测试集上使Updated SandBoilNet的IoU达到0.707（原始0.608）。但堆叠后的校准集成IoU为0.681，未超过最佳单模型（0.694），平均成对误差相关性高达0.894。额外引入的标签保真合成池可将最佳模型提升至0.718，并提出了掩码条件合成路线实现零标注成本生成训练图像。
Motivation: 砂沸分割中标注图像稀缺，现有方法常在测试集上调整集成权重或在测试集衍生合成图像上训练，导致精度虚高。需要一种无泄漏的评估与训练协议。
Method: 提出五折交叉验证框架：每个合成图像关联一个真实父图像，每折排除父图像在保留集中的所有合成图像；五个编码器-解码器骨干网络各自用单个温度标量校准；最后用仅在折外预测上训练的逐像素元学习器进行堆叠。
Result: 保留测试集上，Updated SandBoilNet的IoU为0.707（原始版0.608）；堆叠校准后IoU为0.681，弱于最强单模型（0.694），且八类元学习器均未改善，平均成对误差相关性0.894。加入标签保真合成池后最佳模型IoU升至0.718。
Conclusion: 所提框架消除了数据泄漏，但堆叠集成因成员间高误差相关性未优于单模型；标签保真合成池和掩码条件合成可有效扩充训练数据。

papers.title: Sharpness-aware Model Merging with Salience Recovery for LLM-based Cross-Domain Sequential Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based Cross-Domain Sequential Recommendation (CDSR) leverages LLMs to enhance target performance via deep semantic reasoning, alleviating the dependency on overlapping users. Among LLM-based paradigms, model merging is particularly promising for multi-domain scenarios due to its superior scalability and flexibility in integrating diverse knowledge sources. However, our empirical investigations reveal two critical bottlenecks: (1) cross-domain knowledge conflict; and (2) performance saturation in multi-domain fusion. Our analysis attributes these phenomena to parameter-level misalignment and statistical homogenization during the merging process. To address these bottlenecks, we propose SharpRec, Sharpness-aware Model Merging with Salience Recovery for LLM-based CDSR, a framework designed to lift the performance upper bound of merged models. SharpRec incorporates two synergistic modules: Sharpness-aware Geometric Alignment to establish a stable geometric foundation for interference-free fusion; and Preference Salience Activation to effectively recover the distinctive features essential for bolstering target domain performance. Extensive experiments in both dual-domain and multi-domain scenarios demonstrate that SharpRec consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines.
papers.comment: Published in Proceedings of the 32nd ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining (KDD '26). 12 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. Code available at https://github.com/muyiahhh/SharpRec
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 32nd ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining V.2 (KDD '26), August 9-13, 2026, Jeju Island, Republic of Korea, ACM, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对基于大语言模型的跨域序列推荐（CDSR）中模型合并时存在的跨域知识冲突和性能饱和问题，提出了SharpRec框架。该框架包含锐度感知几何对齐（Sharpness-aware Geometric Alignment）和偏好显著性激活（Preference Salience Activation）两个模块，旨在提升合并模型的上界性能。在双域和多域场景下的实验表明，SharpRec一致优于现有基线。
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的CDSR中，模型合并虽具有可扩展性和灵活性，但存在跨域知识冲突和多域融合的性能饱和两大瓶颈，其根源在于参数级错位和统计同质化。
Method: 提出SharpRec框架，包含两个协同模块：锐度感知几何对齐（为无干扰融合建立稳定的几何基础）和偏好显著性激活（有效恢复目标域性能所需的关键特征）。
Result: 在双域和多域场景下的广泛实验表明，SharpRec consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines.
Conclusion: 该工作通过解决参数级错位和统计同质化问题，提升了合并模型在跨域推荐中的性能上限，具有通用性。

papers.title: Explanation-Bound Tool Execution for AI Agents: Server-Verified Action Claims Without Trusting Model Rationales
papers.abstract_en: Tool-using agents expose structured calls but commonly attach free-form rationales. Such rationales are neither authorization nor reliable introspection. We present Explanation-Bound Tool Execution (EBTE), a claim-carrying mediation layer that converts decision-relevant rationale content into typed action claims and checks them against server-held intent, policy, payload, tool, risk, provenance, and freshness facts. EBTE cannot widen baseline authority: conflicts deny, incomplete or uncertain claims review, and only matching claims remain eligible for governed execution. We formalize this composition under explicit mediation and trusted-fact assumptions and implement a versioned reference profile with minimized audit packets. Across 136 authored conformance scenarios, the full profile matches all specified dispositions, admits none of 96 designated hard contradictions, and passes 232 metamorphic checks; these results validate the included profile rather than population performance. A draft-only reference integration forwards none of 48 authored hard cases under EBTE while preserving all 16 soft-review and 4 aligned draft paths. In a frozen 2026-07-12 exploratory 224-attempt hosted-model record, the historical generation/runner agreement counts are 71/96, 66/96, and 19/32; a separately labeled zero-call post-hoc revalidation of the preserved minimized claims under the current pipeline yields 70/96, 65/96, and 17/32. In an AgentDojo-derived semantic check, existing high-risk controls already make all 12 attack proposals non-allow; EBTE additionally resolves them as deny. These results support the feasibility and diagnostic value of server-checked action claims, not rationale faithfulness, human-review benefit, representative attack resistance, or production safety.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出解释边界工具执行（EBTE），一种声明承载的中介层，将智能体的决策推理内容转化为类型化动作声明，并依据服务器持有的意图、策略、载荷、工具、风险、来源和新鲜度事实进行检查。EBTE不扩大基线权限，仅匹配声明可执行。在多个测试场景中验证了该方法的可行性与诊断价值。
Motivation: 工具使用智能体常生成自由形式的推理，但这类推理既非授权也不可靠，需要一种服务器端验证动作声明的方法。
Method: 提出EBTE，作为中介层将推理内容转化为类型化动作声明，并与服务器持有的事实进行匹配检查，冲突则拒绝，不确定则审查。
Result: 在136个符合性场景中，完整配置匹配所有指定处置，拒绝96个硬矛盾，通过232个变形检查；参考集成在EBTE下拒绝所有48个硬案例，保留所有16个软审查和4个对齐路径。在AgentDojo语义检查中，现有高风险控制已使12个攻击提案不可行，EBTE进一步将其解析为拒绝。
Conclusion: 结果支持服务器检查动作声明的可行性与诊断价值，但不涉及推理真实性、人工审查收益、代表性攻击抵抗或生产安全性。

papers.title: PanoLess: Environment Reconstruction from Partial Reflective Views
papers.abstract_en: Reflections from shiny objects and glass facades naturally extend the field of view of a camera, capturing the surrounding environment without the need to pan the camera or acquire a full panorama. We propose PanoLess, a Gaussian-splat-based framework that reconstructs the surrounding environment as a distant illumination map from images captured on only one side of a reflective surface. PanoLess leverages surface-aligned 2D Gaussian splats with deferred shading to recover accurate per-pixel normals and reflection cues, which are fused into a neural cubemap representation of the environment. In addition, PanoLess produces a visibility map that explicitly denotes which regions of the environment are supported by the partial reflective observations. Unlike existing inverse-rendering and reflection-aware Gaussian-splatting approaches, which typically require full 360-degree coverage and struggle under incomplete views, PanoLess enables consistent, physically grounded illumination estimation from partial-view input. We show that PanoLess achieves high-fidelity and geometrically consistent environment reconstruction, outperforming reflection-aware baselines on a new custom synthetic benchmark and publicly available datasets, and demonstrating generalization to real-world reflective captures.

TL;DR: 本文提出 PanoLess，一种基于高斯点云（Gaussian splatting）的框架，从仅采集自反射表面一侧的图像中重建周围环境作为远距离光照图。该方法利用表面对齐的二维高斯点云与延迟着色恢复逐像素法线和反射线索，融合为神经立方体贴图，并生成可见性图指示反射观测支持的环境区域。与需要360度覆盖的现有方法不同，PanoLess支持部分视角输入下的一致光照估计。实验表明，PanoLess在合成基准和公开数据集上优于反射感知基线，并泛化到真实反射场景。
Motivation: 现有逆渲染和反射感知高斯点云方法通常要求完整的360度覆盖，在部分视角输入下难以实现一致的环境重建。本文目标是从仅一侧反射表面的图像中重构周围环境光照图。
Method: 提出基于高斯点云的框架，包括：表面对齐的二维高斯点云、延迟着色恢复逐像素法线和反射线索、神经立方体贴图表示环境、以及可见性图标记观测支持的区域。训练过程利用部分反射视图进行重建。
Result: 在自建合成基准和公开数据集上，PanoLess实现高保真且几何一致的环境重建，优于反射感知基线，并展示了对真实世界反射捕获的泛化能力。
Conclusion: PanoLess利用部分反射视图有效重建环境光照，克服了现有方法对完整360度覆盖的依赖，为反射感知场景理解提供了新途径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Raven: High-Recall Sequence Modeling with Sparse Memory Routing
papers.abstract_en: Long-context recall in linear-time sequence models highlights a tradeoff in how they write to memory. State-based linear models, such as state-space models (SSMs) and linear Transformers, write densely, updating the entire state for each newly arrived token, which leads to interference and makes specific past tokens hard to recover. Sliding-window attention (SWA) exhibits the opposite behavior: it writes sparsely by storing explicit token representations, but only within a fixed window, so recall drops once the relevant token is evicted. Interpolating between these models, we introduce Raven, a linear-time sequence model that maintains a fixed set of memory slots and, at each step, decays and updates only a selected subset via learned, input-dependent routing. This lets Raven mitigate SWA's position-based overwriting and hard eviction while reducing interference from dense state updates in SSMs, thereby preserving long-range content much more effectively. Across recall-intensive benchmarks, Raven is competitive with or outperforms prior linear-time baselines, achieving strong long-context recall where both SWA and SSMs sharply degrade. It remains effective when extrapolating to context lengths as large as 16x its training length, with similar gains in hybrid architectures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Raven 是一种线性时间序列模型，通过固定一组记忆槽并在每一步仅通过输入依赖的路由更新选中的子集，实现了在长上下文回忆任务中优于状态空间模型和滑动窗口注意力的性能，且能外推到训练长度16倍的上下文。
Motivation: 现有线性时间模型在长上下文回忆中存在权衡：状态空间模型（SSM）和线性Transformer密集写入状态导致干扰难以恢复特定过去令牌，而滑动窗口注意力（SWA）稀疏存储但固定窗口导致相关令牌被驱逐后回忆下降。Raven旨在缓解二者各自的缺陷。
Method: Raven维护一组固定大小的记忆槽，每个时间步通过学习的输入依赖路由（learned input-dependent routing）仅衰减和更新选中的子集，从而避免SWA基于位置的重写和硬驱逐，同时减少SSM中密集状态更新的干扰。
Result: 在回忆密集型基准测试中，Raven与先前线性时间基线相比具有竞争力或更优，在SWA和SSM均严重退化的长上下文回忆任务上表现强劲，并能外推到训练长度16倍的上下文，在混合架构中也有类似增益。
Conclusion: Raven通过在稀疏和密集记忆写入策略之间插值，有效保持了长范围内容，为线性时间序列模型提供了更好的长上下文回忆能力。

papers.title: Data Quality Profiling at Scale with Progressive Sampling: A Benchmark for Data-Centric AI Pipelines
papers.abstract_en: Data quality profiling -- computing missing-value rates, duplicate fractions, outlier densities, and functional-dependency violations -- is foundational for data-centric AI pipelines, yet exhaustive scans over millions of rows are prohibitively slow for near-real-time monitoring. Progressive sampling is the standard alternative; the open question is which strategy best preserves profile fidelity at scale. We benchmark nine sampling strategies -- blind (random uniform, geometric, Yamane, cluster) and proxy-guided (Metropolis-Hastings, DAG, stratified by column type or quality score, importance-weighted) -- on three real-world datasets (NYC 311, NYPD arrests, UCI Adult; up to 500K rows), an IoT sensor stream (2.3M rows), two ultra-large real datasets including Ultra-Marathon Running (up to 7.4M rows), and synthetic data scaled to 5x10^6 rows. Contrary to the assumption sharpens estimates, blind representative samplers dominate uniformly. At a 5% budget, random uniform achieves 0.49% mean relative error on NYC 311; DAG-guided MCMC yields 19.5% (approx. 40x worse), and across all real datasets DAG is 11-49x worse (Wilcoxon W=0, p=0.002, n=9 pairs). Cluster sampling matches random uniform (MRE 0.110 vs. 0.111); proxy-guided methods share DAG's failure mode (MRE 0.20-0.35). At scale, random uniform is near-linear (O(N^{0.964})) while DAG is super-linear (O(N^{1.272})), running 28--47x slower on ultra-large data with 6x worse accuracy. The root cause is an IQR proxy mismatch: proxy-guided samplers over-pursue numeric outliers, while quality defects concentrate in categorical columns invisible to the proxy. The actionable finding: representativeness, not domain knowledge, determines sampler quality -- schema-free random uniform or cluster sampling suffices for production-grade quality profiling at scale.
papers.journal_ref: Transactions on Large-Scale Data and Knowledge-Centered Systems Special Issue on Advances in Data-Centric Artificial Intelligence (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对数据质量剖析中的渐进采样策略，本文在真实大规模数据集（NYC 311、NYPD arrests、UCI Adult、IoT传感器流、Ultra-Marathon Running，最大740万行）上基准测试了九种采样策略。结果出乎意料：盲代表性采样器（随机均匀、聚类采样）一致优于代理指导的采样器（如DAG导向MCMC）。在5%采样预算下，随机均匀平均相对误差仅为0.49%，而DAG方法误差高达19.5%（差约40倍），且在大数据上DAG运行速度慢28–47倍。根本原因是代理指导方法过度追求数值异常值，而数据质量缺陷集中在分类列中，导致代理失配。
Motivation: 数据质量剖析（计算缺失率、重复比例、异常密度、函数依赖违规）是数据-centric AI的基础，但全量扫描在近实时监控中不可行。渐进采样是标准替代方案，但关键在于哪种策略能在规模上保持剖析的保真度。
Method: 基准测试了九种采样策略：盲采样（随机均匀、几何、Yamane、聚类）和代理指导采样（Metropolis-Hastings、DAG、按列类型或质量评分分层、重要性加权）。在三个真实数据集、一个IoT传感器流、两个超大规模真实数据集和合成数据（最大500万行）上进行评估。
Result: 在5%预算下，随机均匀采样在NYC 311上达到0.49%平均相对误差，而DAG导向MCMC为19.5%（约差40倍）。所有真实数据集上DAG比随机均匀差11–49倍（Wilcoxon W=0, p=0.002）。聚类采样与随机均匀相当（MRE 0.110 vs 0.111）。在大数据上随机均匀近线性（O(N^0.964)），DAG超线性（O(N^1.272)），速度慢28–47倍且精度差6倍。
Conclusion: 代表性（representativeness）而非领域知识决定采样质量；无模式的随机均匀或聚类采样足以满足生产级质量剖析。代理指导方法因代理失配（过度追求数值异常值，忽略分类列中的质量缺陷）而失败。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Explainable AI for Chronic Kidney Disease Prediction Using Simulated Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD), characterized by the gradual loss of kidney function, remains a significant public health challenge. Early detection is crucial for preventing severe complications and enhancing patient outcomes. In this study, Federated Learning (FL) with a VotingClassifier was used to predict CKD using a clinical dataset, where Random Forest, AdaBoost, and XGBoost were utilized to compare and identify the best-fitting model for the global server. Additionally, GridSearchCV was applied to optimize the models' performance on the client's side. To enhance model transparency and trustworthiness, explainable AI (XAI) techniques were incorporated to interpret the prediction mechanisms. The global model's average accuracy was 99%, highlighting the potential of interpretable FL models in supporting early CKD diagnosis and advancing data-driven healthcare solutions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出使用联邦学习(Federated Learning)结合投票分类器(VotingClassifier)预测慢性肾病(CKD)，并通过可解释AI(XAI)增强模型透明度。在临床数据集上，全局模型平均准确率达99%。
Motivation: 慢性肾病早期检测对预防严重并发症至关重要，但数据隐私和模型可解释性面临挑战。
Method: 采用联邦学习框架，客户端使用随机森林、AdaBoost和XGBoost并通过GridSearchCV优化，服务端使用投票分类器聚合，并集成XAI技术解释预测机制。
Result: 全局模型平均准确率99%。
Conclusion: 可解释联邦学习在早期CKD诊断中具有潜力，可推动数据驱动的医疗解决方案。

papers.title: Cardiologent: Multi-Agent Clinical Decision Support for Patient-Level Arrhythmia Assessment, Urgency, and Management
papers.abstract_en: The same episode of atrial fibrillation is a minor finding in a healthy adult and grounds for anticoagulation in an elderly patient with hypertension: identical signal, opposite decision. Naming the rhythm is only the start; what determines a patient's outcome is the judgement that follows -- what the arrhythmia is across the whole record, what it means for this patient, and what should be done about it. Recent work pairing large language models with the ECG stops short of this, reading one recording without assembling a patient-level finding; and agentic systems built around it either receive the arrhythmia a device has already detected or target a different diagnostic task, stopping before the decision this task requires. We formulate patient-level arrhythmia decision support as a task and present Cardiologent, a multi-agent system that spans it from detection to decision. An agent for each signal -- a single ECG lead and the photoplethysmogram a wearable acquires -- grounds its window reading in measured features rather than a bare label; the readings are assembled into the patient's rhythm profile and, with the patient's own data, reasoned against clinical guidelines retrieved for the case, with a critic checking each conclusion against the guideline it cites. We evaluate the clinical decision rather than the report, across integrated diagnosis, clinical significance, and urgency and management. Cardiologent scores highest on every axis, first on every patient-level task under both cardiologists and an at-scale LLM judge -- whose agreement with the cardiologists (ICC 0.74, 0.66) matches theirs with each other (0.67). Because each conclusion traces to a cited guideline and is validated against expert cardiologists, it yields decisions a clinician can audit rather than act on blindly -- a step toward use in continuous monitoring.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Cardiologent，一个多智能体系统，用于患者级心律失常的临床决策支持，涵盖从检测到决策的全流程。系统结合ECG导联和光电容积描记图（PPG）信号，通过测量特征分析窗口，整合为患者心律概况，并结合患者数据和临床指南进行推理，由批评者检查每个结论与所引用指南的一致性。评估显示在综合诊断、临床意义、紧急性和管理方面，Cardiologent在所有患者级任务上得分最高，与心脏病专家的一致性（ICC 0.74, 0.66）与心脏病专家之间的一致性（0.67）相当。
Motivation: 现有工作将大语言模型与ECG结合时，只读取单个记录而不构建患者级发现；智能体系统要么接收设备已检测到的心律失常，要么针对不同的诊断任务，未达到所需的决策。因此需要从检测到决策的全流程患者级支持。
Method: 多智能体系统，每个信号（单ECG导联和可穿戴设备PPG）有一个智能体，基于测量特征进行窗口阅读，然后将阅读结果组装成患者心律概况，并结合患者数据根据临床指南推理，另有批评者检查每个结论与所引用指南的一致性。
Result: 在综合诊断、临床意义、紧急性和管理方面评估，Cardiologent在所有轴和所有患者级任务上得分最高，且与心脏病专家的ICC（0.74, 0.66）与心脏病专家之间的一致性（0.67）相当。
Conclusion: 每个结论可追溯到引用指南，并经过心脏病专家验证，产生可审计的决策，适用于连续监测。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Dual-Domain Manifold Modeling for Hyperspectral Image Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Achieving a coherent integration of spectral richness and spatial fidelity remains a central objective in hyperspectral image fusion. However, existing hyperspectral image fusion methods struggle to effectively model geometric constraints. In the spatial domain, weak spatial-spectral interaction limits geometry-aware feature learning and suppresses high-frequency structural information, resulting in low-frequency bias and structural degradation. In the spectral domain, local manifold structures induced by spectral similarity are insufficiently exploited, limiting intrinsic pixel relationship modeling and fine-grained spectral reconstruction. To address these challenges, we propose a dual-domain manifold modeling (DDMM) framework. Specifically, we introduce a Topology-Aware Transformer (TPFormer) that combines global attention with neighborhood propagation, jointly modeling spatial topology and pixel-level feature manifold relationships to capture intrinsic spatial-spectral structures and improve topology-aware representation learning. Furthermore, a Frequency-Decoupled Spatial-Spectral Collaborative Fusion (FDSCF) module is devised, in which features are projected into the frequency domain via the discrete cosine transform and explicitly decoupled into low- and high-frequency components. Guided by a low-rank structural prior and spectral-driven spatial enhancement, FDSCF selectively enhances geometry-aware high-frequency features, strengthening spatia-spectral coupling and recovering sharper edges and finer textures. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate that DDMM achieves superior overall performance over SoTA methods in terms of spatial structure preservation and spectral reconstruction.

TL;DR: 本文提出双域流形建模（DDMM）框架用于高光谱图像融合，通过拓扑感知Transformer（TPFormer）联合建模空间拓扑和像素级特征流形关系，并设计频率解耦空间-光谱协同融合模块（FDSCF）增强高频特征。实验表明DDMM在空间结构保持和光谱重建上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有高光谱图像融合方法难以有效建模几何约束，空间域中弱空间-光谱交互限制了几何感知特征学习，光谱域中局部流形结构利用不足，导致低频偏差和结构退化。
Method: 提出DDMM框架，包含拓扑感知Transformer（TPFormer）结合全局注意力和邻域传播建模空间拓扑与像素流形关系；以及频率解耦空间-光谱协同融合模块（FDSCF），通过离散余弦变换投影到频域并解耦为低/高频分量，借助低秩先验和光谱驱动空间增强选择性增强高频特征。
Result: 在多个基准数据集上，DDMM在空间结构保存和光谱重建方面取得优于现有方法（SoTA）的整体性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调双域流形建模能有效提升空间-光谱耦合，恢复更清晰的边缘和纹理。

papers.title: Every Time I Hire a Linguist, Inference Costs Go Down: On Linguistic Rules as Effective Prompt Compressors
papers.abstract_en: Prompt compression shortens LLM input to reduce inference cost, yet existing methods score token importance through LM forward passes. It remains questionable whether such nuanced, costly token selection is necessary. Compression requires identifying informative content, a problem that linguistic research has long addressed through cues that can be operationalized as deterministic rules. We therefore ask: can \textbf{linguistic rules alone} serve as effective prompt compressors, without LM-based scoring at compression time? To address this, we conduct offline evolutionary search over lexical, syntactic, semantic, and discourse seeds to find competitive rule combinations. The resulting linguistic compressor requires no LM forward pass at deployment and uses only CPU-side processing for compression. We evaluate it with a dual-path protocol to balance compression quality and reconstruction fidelity. Across short passages, multi-document reasoning, and dialogue-memory QA datasets, evolved compressors achieve performance similar to that of recent advanced prompt-compression strategies. Performance is strongest under light-to-moderate compression and degrades as compression becomes more aggressive, while the Direct and Reconstruction paths exhibit distinct patterns. Evolutionary analysis reveals that effective compression fuses signals across linguistic levels and, as the compression ratio increases, rules shift from token pruning to sentence extraction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出仅使用语言规则（无需LM前向传递）进行提示压缩，通过离线进化搜索找到最优规则组合。在多个基准上，该方法在轻到中度压缩下性能与现有高级压缩策略相当，但压缩率增大时性能下降。
Motivation: 现有提示压缩方法依赖LM前向传递计算token重要性，成本高昂。本文探索是否仅凭语言规则就能有效压缩提示，以降低推理成本。
Method: 离线进行进化搜索，从词汇、句法、语义和话语层面的初始规则中寻找最优组合，得到仅需CPU处理的压缩器，部署时无需LM前向传递。采用双路径协议平衡压缩质量与重建保真度。
Result: 在短文本、多文档推理和对话记忆QA数据集上，进化出的压缩器性能与近期先进压缩策略相似，在轻到中度压缩下表现最强，压缩率增大时性能下降。Direct和Reconstruction路径呈现不同模式。
Conclusion: 有效压缩融合了多层面的语言信号，随着压缩率增加，规则从token剪枝转向句子提取。但该方法在激进压缩下性能受限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Specula: Scaling formal specifications for autonomous model checking of system code
papers.abstract_en: Specula is a push-button agentic system that generates high-quality formal specifications for large, complex system code and uses the specifications for highly effective model checking and bug finding. Specula employs large language model (LLM) based coding agents to autonomously develop TLA+ specifications, including invariants that describe correctness properties of the target system and formal models that describe the system implementation with the right level of abstractions. Specula is fully autonomous and thus eliminates the barrier of applying formal methods to real-world system code (as in traditional human-centric approaches). Meanwhile, Specula addresses limitations of LLM-driven techniques like reward hacking and hallucinations through self-evolving loops that iteratively improve specification quality by enabling the agents to deepen their understanding of system code and its behaviors. We have used Specula to check 48 open-source system projects; Specula found 249 bugs including many deep bugs that are hard to find by existing approaches. Specula has been used by several companies and is maintained at https://github.com/specula-org/Specula.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Specula 是一个全自动 agentic 系统，它使用基于大型语言模型（LLM）的编码智能体来为大型复杂系统代码生成高质量的 TLA+ 形式化规范（包括不变量和形式化模型），并利用这些规范进行自动模型检查和错误发现。该系统在 48 个开源系统项目中发现了 249 个 bug，其中包括许多现有方法难以发现的深层 bug。
Motivation: 传统形式化方法应用于实际系统代码需要大量人工专家投入，门槛极高；而纯 LLM 驱动的技术存在奖励作弊（reward hacking）和幻觉（hallucination）等局限性。
Method: 采用基于 LLM 的编码智能体自主开发 TLA+ 规范，并通过自演化循环（self-evolving loops）迭代提升规范质量，使智能体逐步加深对系统代码及其行为的理解。
Result: 在 48 个开源系统项目上共发现 249 个 bug，其中包含许多现有方法难以发现的深层 bug。系统已在多家公司使用，并开源维护。
Conclusion: Specula 证明了全自动生成高质量形式化规范并用于实际系统代码模型检测的可行性，消除了传统形式化方法的人力壁垒，同时缓解了 LLM 驱动的技术的局限性。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Physics-Informed Neural Operator for Warm-Starting Background-Decomposed and Preconditioned PSFD: Enabling Scalable 3-D EUV Mask Simulation
papers.abstract_en: We present a physics-informed neural operator (PINO) trained with pseudo-spectral frequency-domain (PSFD) equations for electromagnetic (EM) scattering problems in EUV lithography. The Fourier neural operator is factorized into a two-dimensional lateral ($xy$) branch and a one-dimensional axial ($z$) branch and is trained self-consistently with background decomposition.Thus, the full-vector coupling between the mask and the multilayer response is retained without invoking a finite-order Born approximation. In this way, the computational domain size is significantly reduced, thereby lowering the computational cost. The PINO is trained on approximately 16,000 mask designs from the LithoBench library sampled randomly at each training iteration without using precomputed EM field solutions. The PINO surrogate model yields predictions with a mean absolute error of about $7 \times 10^{-3}$ for the scattered intensity of held-out mask patterns relative to the reference PSFD solution. Combined with spectral damping, the PINO warm-start initialization accelerates the background-decomposed PSFD solver on finer discretizations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种物理信息神经算子（PINO），用于EUV光刻掩模的电磁散射快速模拟。该算子结合伪谱频域（PSFD）方程和背景分解，分解为二维横向分支和一维轴向分支，在约16,000个掩模设计上自洽训练，无需预计算EM场解。替代模型在留出图案上达到约7×10⁻³的平均绝对误差，并可作为热启动加速更细离散化上的PSFD求解器。
Motivation: 传统EUV掩模电磁模拟计算成本高昂，需要更快速的替代模型以提高设计迭代效率。
Method: 提出PINO，使用物理信息训练，结合背景分解和伪谱频域方程，通过二维横向和一维轴向分支分解降低计算域大小，未使用预计算解进行训练。
Result: 在LithoBench库的约16,000个掩模设计上训练，留出图案的散射强度平均绝对误差约7×10⁻³；结合谱阻尼，PINO热启动可加速PSFD求解器在更细离散化上的收敛。
Conclusion: PINO能有效替代传统EM求解器提供快速预测，并作为热启动加速更精细的数值求解。

papers.title: Balanced Soft mixture-of-expert model for Glaucoma Detection
papers.abstract_en: Glaucoma is a group of eye diseases that damage the optic nerve, often caused by elevated intraocular pressure. It is a leading cause of irreversible vision loss and is typically developed slowly and painlessly, making it difficult to notice until significant damage has occurred. Therefore, early detection is crucial to prevent or slow the progression of vision loss. In recent years, deep learning based uni-modal models have improved the accuracy and efficiency of glaucoma detection, empowering doctors with tools for earlier diagnosis, better monitoring, and timely treatment. Building on this, multi-modal models have emerged, leveraging the strengths of different imaging modalities to learn richer and more robust representations, further enhancing glaucoma detection accuracy. However, multi-modal learning faces challenges such as imbalanced and under-optimized uni-modal representations due to joint learning objectives. To address this, we propose a balanced soft mixture-experts model with three experts and load balancing loss. The performance is measured by AUC, our proposed method surpasses the performance of all uni-modal baselines, conventional multi-modal models, and current stateof- the-art balanced multi-modal models. The proposed model can be generalized to other disease detections such as diabetic retinopathy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对青光眼检测中的多模态学习不平衡问题，提出一个平衡软混合专家模型（balanced soft mixture-of-experts model），包含三个专家和负载平衡损失。在AUC指标上，该方法超越了所有单模态基线、传统多模态模型以及当前最先进的平衡多模态模型。
Motivation: 多模态学习在青光眼检测中面临单模态表征不平衡和优化不足的问题，导致性能受限，因此需要更好的平衡策略。
Method: 提出一个平衡软混合专家模型，由三个专家网络和一个负载平衡损失函数组成，旨在平衡各专家的贡献。
Result: 在青光眼检测任务上，该方法的AUC优于所有单模态基线、传统多模态模型和当前最先进的平衡多模态模型。
Conclusion: 所提模型可推广到其他疾病检测，如糖尿病视网膜病变，具有通用性。

papers.title: From Cellular Responses to Pharmacological Domains: Multimodal Zero-Shot Drug Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal drug discovery enables drug representation learning beyond chemical structure by incorporating cellular responses such as gene expression and cell morphology. However, direct fusion and instance-level contrastive alignment may mix mechanism-related signals with modality-specific noise and incorrectly separate structurally dissimilar but biologically related compounds. This limitation can obscure transferable mechanism patterns required for predicting the properties of unseen compounds. We introduce PMRD, a pharmacological response domain-guided framework for multimodal zero-shot drug property prediction. PMRD separates mechanism-consistent factors from modality-specific information and constructs a consensus response domain across three modalities. Mechanism candidate augmentation identifies locally stable factors, while retrieval-geometry attribution dynamically reweights the alignment and augmentation objectives according to whether their updates preserve inter-drug discriminability.This feedback suppresses training signals that conflict with mechanism-discriminative retrieval. PMRD further combines complementary representations through reliability-aware multiview retrieval. Experiments on public datasets show improved zero-shot property prediction and more biologically coherent drug neighborhoods. Hard-negative analysis further indicates fewer conflicts between structurally dissimilar but response-related compounds. These results support PMRD as an effective framework for mechanism-aware multimodal drug representation learning.\footnote{The code will be released upon publication.}
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PMRD框架，一种基于药理反应域的多模态零样本药物表征学习方法。该方法通过分离机制一致因子与模态特异性信息，并引入机制候选增强和检索几何属性重加权，实现跨模态药物属性预测。实验表明PMRD在零样本预测和药物邻居生物一致性上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有多模态药物表征学习在直接融合或实例级对比对齐时，可能混淆机制相关信号与模态噪声，且错误分离结构不相似但生物相关的化合物，导致无法有效预测未见化合物的属性。
Method: PMRD框架包含三个关键模块：分离机制一致因子与模态特异性信息，构建跨三模态的共识响应域；机制候选增强识别局部稳定因子；检索几何属性重加权根据更新是否保持药物间区分性动态调整对齐和增强目标，抑制与机制判别检索冲突的训练信号。最后通过可靠性感知多视图检索组合互补表示。
Result: 在公共数据集上，PMRD改进了零样本药物属性预测，生成了更生物一致的药物邻居空间。硬负样本分析表明，结构不相似但反应相关的化合物之间的冲突减少。
Conclusion: PMRD是实现机制感知多模态药物表征学习的有效框架，强调了分离机制一致性与模态特异性的重要性。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 在公共数据集上，PMRD改进了零样本药物属性预测，生成了更生物一致的药物邻居空间。硬负样本分析表明，结构不相似但反应相关的化合物之间的冲突减少。
summary_sections.conclusion: PMRD是实现机制感知多模态药物表征学习的有效框架，强调了分离机制一致性与模态特异性的重要性。

papers.title: Physics-Grounded Fluid Video Generation with a Simulation Dataset and Dual-Stream Optical-Flow Supervision
papers.abstract_en: Video diffusion models generate visually compelling content but routinely violate elementary physics when the subject involves fluids: liquid columns break apart in mid-air, container water levels fail to rise as liquid is poured in, and splashes disperse without regard to momentum or gravity. We attribute this gap to the fact that large-scale video-text corpora contain almost no explicit motion supervision, so models learn to imitate fluid appearance rather than dynamics. We address this with two contributions. First, we build a physics-simulation fluid dataset combining 1,638 MPM-simulated pouring/sloshing videos with 2,320 keyword-filtered real pouring videos mined from stock footage, plus two held-out test sets: a 1,515-video real-video benchmark and an 18-prompt text-to-first-frame generalization benchmark. Second, we introduce a dual-stream image-to-video architecture built on a pretrained diffusion-transformer video generator. It augments the standard RGB decoder with a lightweight Optical-Flow Decoder branch trained with explicit end-point-error and smoothness losses, fused into the RGB stream via zero-initialized convolutions so the pretrained backbone starts undisturbed. Only the two decoders are updated; the encoder, temporal transformer, and text encoder remain frozen. Across two model scales (1.3B and 14B) and two test sets, our method improves VideoPhy-2 Physical-Commonsense and Video-Quality scores over the frozen backbone by up to 8.75 and 4.65 points, outperforms a leading open competitor, and is preferred by human raters in a blind study. A direct optical-flow read-out evaluation further shows an end-point error as low as 0.54 pixels in-distribution, confirming the model has internalized a coherent motion prior rather than merely improving surface appearance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视频扩散模型生成流体时违反物理规律（如液柱空中断裂、水位不随倾倒上升）的问题，提出一个物理模拟流体数据集（包含1638个MPM模拟视频和2320个真实倾倒视频）以及双流光流监督架构。该方法在预训练扩散Transformer上增加轻量流光解码器分支，通过端点误差和平滑损失训练，与RGB流融合，仅更新解码器。在1.3B和14B模型规模上，VideoPhy-2物理常识和视频质量分数分别提升最多8.75和4.65点，优于领先的开源模型，且光流端点误差低至0.54像素。
Motivation: 大规模视频-文本语料缺乏显式运动监督，导致视频扩散模型学习流体外观而非动力学，产生违反物理的生成结果。
Method: 构建包含MPM模拟和真实倾倒视频的流体数据集；提出双流图像到视频架构，在预训练扩散Transformer上附加轻量流光解码器，用端点误差和平滑损失训练，通过零初始化卷积融合到RGB流，仅更新解码器参数。
Result: 在两个模型规模和两个测试集上，VideoPhy-2物理常识和视频质量分数分别提升8.75和4.65点；光流端点误差低至0.54像素；人类盲评中更受偏好。
Conclusion: 该方法使模型内化一致的流体运动先验，而不仅改善表面外观，为物理感知视频生成提供有效路径。
Relevance: 30

papers.title: Beyond Background Bias: Saliency-Driven Prototype Alignment for Dataset Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Dataset distillation aims to synthesize compact datasets that can approximate the performance of full-data training while significantly reducing computational and storage costs. However, diffusion-based distillation methods often struggle to preserve structural coherence and generalization, especially in visually complex domains. This issue often stems from latent prototypes that are weakly aligned with class-discriminative regions and contaminated by irrelevant background, thereby degrading generation quality and generalization. To address this limitation, we propose a saliency-driven distillation framework that constructs class-discriminative latent prototypes to enhance representativeness and generalization. The framework proceeds in two stages: (1) ensemble Grad-CAM saliency is used to construct prototypes emphasizing high-confidence regions, and (2) hard prototype refinement is then applied to construct challenging yet class-consistent prototypes, thereby enhancing discriminability and diversity. Importantly, the diffusion backbones (e.g., LDM and DiT) remain frozen; only lightweight classifiers used for saliency extraction are trained. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate consistent performance improvements over strong baselines. Code will be released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于显著性驱动原型对齐的数据集蒸馏框架，针对扩散模型蒸馏中结构一致性差、原型被背景污染的问题，通过集成Grad-CAM构建类别判别性潜在原型，并辅以硬原型精炼增强区分度与多样性，在多个视觉基准上取得一致改进。
Motivation: 扩散模型蒸馏在视觉复杂领域难以保持结构连贯性和泛化性，主要原因是潜在原型与类别判别区域对齐弱且被无关背景污染。
Method: 两阶段框架：首先使用集成Grad-CAM显著性图构建强调高置信度区域的类别原型，然后应用硬原型精炼生成具有挑战性但类别一致的样本，提升判别性和多样性；扩散骨干（LDM、DiT）冻结，仅训练轻量分类器用于显著性提取。
Result: 在多个基准数据集上，该方法持续优于强基线，展示了结构保持和泛化能力的提升。
Conclusion: 显著性引导的原型对齐能有效改善扩散蒸馏中的背景偏差，无需修改生成骨干即可提升数据集蒸馏质量。
Relevance: 30

papers.title: Sense it with your eyes: Sensation Generation and Understanding for Advertisements
papers.abstract_en: Sensory advertising evokes human senses through visual cues, enabling audiences to mentally simulate experiences and increasing persuasive impact. Despite the recent increase in using AI in generating and understanding creative and persuasive content, how advertisements visually evoke sensations remains largely unexplored. In this work, we introduce the first study of understanding, evaluating, and generating sensory ads. We introduce the Sensory Ad dataset, and define sensation classification tasks (SenseClass) to benchmark LLMs and MLLMs. We further propose SenseScore, an automated evaluation metric for sensation evocation achieving strong agreement with human judgments. Finally, we introduce the Sensory Ad Generation (SenseGen) task and propose SAGA, a multi-agent framework that improves message image alignment, sensory evocation, and persuasion. Our work establishes a foundation for sensory-aware visual persuasion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次系统研究广告如何通过视觉线索唤起感官体验（sensory advertising）。作者构建了Sensory Ad数据集，定义了感觉分类任务（SenseClass）以基准测试大语言模型（LLM）和多模态大语言模型（MLLM），提出了自动评估指标SenseScore（与人类判断高度一致），并进一步提出感官广告生成任务（SenseGen）和多智能体框架SAGA，旨在改进消息-图像对齐、感官唤起和说服力。该工作为感知视觉说服（sensory-aware visual persuasion）奠定了基础。
Motivation: 尽管AI在生成和理解创意内容方面应用日益增多，但广告如何通过视觉唤起感官体验这一重要问题尚未被探索。本文旨在填补这一研究空白。
Method: 构建Sensory Ad数据集；定义SenseClass分类任务；提出自动化评估指标SenseScore；提出多智能体框架SAGA用于感官广告生成。
Result: SenseScore与人类判断达到高度一致；SAGA在消息-图像对齐、感官唤起和说服力方面取得改进（摘要未提供具体数值）。
Conclusion: 本文为感官感知视觉说服建立了基础框架，为未来广告生成和理解研究提供了新方向。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Guiding Posterior Exploration with Optimizer-Derived Geometry
papers.abstract_en: Sampling-based methods offer a principled approach to uncertainty quantification in Bayesian neural networks. Their practical use, however, is often challenged by the computational cost of exploring high-dimensional and multimodal posterior distributions. To overcome these difficulties, Bayesian Deep Ensembles, i.e., warmstarting the sampling from several optimized solutions, have proven to be an effective strategy. In this paper, we demonstrate that curvature estimates computed during the warmstart as a byproduct in adaptive optimizers such as AdamW can inform the sampling phase at negligible additional cost. Specifically, our proposed preconditioned sampling strategy based on optimizer-derived geometries can substantially reduce or even eliminate the need for a lengthy sampling burn-in phase and leads to greater numerical stability. This approach consistently maintains or improves predictive performance and uncertainty quantification without any additional computational costs. We confirm the consistency of our findings across various datasets and network architectures.
papers.comment: Accepted for presentation at the OPTIMAL Workshop at AISTATS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于优化器导数几何的后验采样策略，利用AdamW等自适应优化器在预热期间计算的曲率估计来指导MCMC采样，减少或消除采样预热阶段，提高数值稳定性，且不增加额外计算成本。在多种数据集和网络架构上验证了一致性。
Motivation: 贝叶斯神经网络中采样方法面临高维和多模态后验分布的高计算成本问题。
Method: 提出一种预条件采样策略，利用AdamW等优化器预热阶段计算的曲率估计来构造预条件矩阵，从而指导采样。
Result: 摘要表明该方法可大幅减少或消除采样预热阶段，提高数值稳定性，并保持或提升预测性能与不确定性量化，且无额外计算开销。
Conclusion: 该方法在多种数据集和网络架构上一致性良好，可有效改善贝叶斯深度集成中的采样效率。

papers.title: Human-in-the-Loop Signature Bootstrapping for UAV Hyperspectral PFM-1 Mine Detection
papers.abstract_en: Hyperspectral imaging (HSI) is useful for material discrimination, but operational mine screening also depends on how many false alarms must be inspected before targets are found. This paper studies PFM-1 landmine detection in unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) visible and near-infrared (VNIR) HSI using spectral angle mapper (SAM), matched filter (MF), adaptive coherence estimator (ACE), and constrained energy minimization (CEM). We compare a ground-measured SVC signature, a fully informed in-scene core-pixel signature, and a simulated human-in-the-loop signature bootstrap. Besides receiver operating characteristic area under the curve and average precision, we report target-discovery curves and spatial candidate-review counts. Full-review bootstrapping reaches the fully informed in-scene signature case after all seven target regions are verified, but the required inspection effort varies strongly: ACE confirms all regions in two rounds and nine candidate inspections, whereas the SAM variants need thousands of candidate reviews for their final target locations. Code is available at https://github.com/SagarLekhak/IEEE_WHISPERS_2026_UAV_HSI_PFM1.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究无人机可见光-近红外高光谱成像用于PFM-1地雷检测，比较地面测量光谱、全知场景核心像素光谱和模拟人机回环签名自举方法。使用SAM、MF、ACE、CEM四种检测器，通过目标发现曲线和候选检查次数评估，表明全检查自举可达到全知签名性能，但不同检测器检查次数差异显著：ACE只需两轮9次检查，而SAM变体需要数千次。
Motivation: 高光谱成像可用于物质判别，但实际地雷筛查中需要检查的虚警数量影响操作效率。本文研究如何通过人机回环签名自举方法减少检查次数，提高检测效率。
Method: 提出模拟人机回环签名自举方法，与地面测量光谱和全知场景核心像素光谱对比。使用SAM、MF、ACE、CEM四种检测器，评估指标包括ROC AUC、平均精度、目标发现曲线和空间候选检查次数。
Result: 全检查自举在验证所有七个目标区域后达到全知签名性能，但所需检查次数因检测器而异：ACE在两轮中仅需九次候选检查确认所有区域，而SAM变体需要数千次。
Conclusion: 人机回环签名自举可显著减少所需检查次数，ACE方法尤其高效。代码已公开。

papers.title: CAST: Game Solvers as Turn-Level Teachers for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Training large language models (LLMs) to act in long-horizon games is a promising step toward generalist decision-making, yet reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) relies on sparse final rewards that reveal little about which decisions determine success. Denser process signals could supply this missing turn-level credit, but existing sources are hard to keep both cheap and accurate. We observe that changes in a game solver's state value reveal whether an action advances the state toward success. Building on this insight, we propose CAST (Credit Assignment from Solver Teachers), which converts these value changes into solver advantages and injects them into RLVR as turn-level signals. We further show that, under a soft-optimal solver assumption, maximizing the solver advantage is equivalent to on-policy distillation from the solver, requiring only scalar values rather than teacher logits. Across Sokoban, Minesweeper, and Rush Hour, CAST outperforms all trained baselines on every game under both in-domain and unseen-difficulty evaluation and achieves the highest average zero-shot performance on ALFWorld and WebShop. Our code is available at https://github.com/Wloner0809/CAST.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对LLM在长期游戏中的信用分配问题，提出CAST方法，利用游戏求解器（solver）的回合级状态值变化作为信用信号，注入强化学习框架中，在Sokoban、Minesweeper、Rush Hour等多个游戏中超越基线，并在ALFWorld和WebShop上取得最高零样本性能。
Motivation: 现有强化学习（RLVR）依赖稀疏的最终奖励，缺乏回合级信用信号，而现有密集信号难以兼顾准确和廉价。
Method: 提出CAST，通过游戏求解器的状态值变化计算求解器优势（solver advantages），将其作为回合级信号注入RLVR；并证明在软最优求解器假设下，最大化求解器优势等价于从求解器进行在线蒸馏，仅需标量值。
Result: 在Sokoban、Minesweeper、Rush Hour上，CAST在所有游戏的域内和未见难度评估中优于所有训练基线，并在ALFWorld和WebShop上达到最高平均零样本性能。

papers.title: MEDit-Bench: A Dataset for Evaluating Message-Driven Narrative Video Editing
papers.abstract_en: Video editing is fundamentally message-driven: even from the same source footage, the selected shots change depending on the narrative the editor wishes to convey. Benchmarks for a closely related task, video summarization, reduce editorial intent to a single, message-agnostic notion of saliency and thus do not account for this diversity. For evaluating message-driven video editing, we present \textbf{MEDit-Bench}, a dataset and benchmark, which pairs long-form videos with multiple editing messages and multiple professionally produced edits per message, demonstrating that different messages yield substantially different edits from the same source. We define an automatic evaluation protocol based on temporal alignment metrics, and find that an LLM-as-a-judge preference, a natural proxy for narrative quality, is unreliable for this task due to severe position bias. We additionally annotate each message with ambiguity and contextfulness scores, and show that both dimensions negatively correlate with model performance, establishing message difficulty as a meaningful stratification factor. Experiments with state-of-the-art MLLMs and reinforcement fine-tuned baselines show that while strong models approach human temporal alignment at lenient thresholds, all models fall behind humans at stricter criteria. A human perceptual study further confirms a large quality gap, with professional human edits remaining consistently preferred over model outputs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MEDit-Bench是一个用于评估消息驱动叙事视频编辑的数据集和基准。它包含长视频、多个编辑消息以及每个消息对应的多个专业编辑版本，证明不同消息会导致同一源视频的编辑存在显著差异。实验发现，基于LLM的裁判偏好存在严重位置偏差，不可靠；消息的模糊性和上下文性分数与模型性能负相关。当前最强模型在宽松阈值下接近人类时序对齐，但在严格标准下仍有差距。
Motivation: 现有视频摘要基准将编辑意图简化为单一、消息无关的显著性概念，无法评估消息驱动视频编辑的多样性。
Method: 构建MEDit-Bench数据集，将长视频与多个编辑消息及对应的专业编辑配对；提出基于时序对齐指标的自动评估协议；通过LLM-as-a-judge和人类感知研究进行评估。
Result: LLM-as-a-judge因严重位置偏差而不可靠；消息难度（模糊性和上下文性）与模型性能负相关；强模型在宽松阈值下接近人类，但在严格标准下所有模型均落后于人类；人类专业编辑始终优于模型输出。
Conclusion: 该基准揭示了当前模型在消息驱动视频编辑中的局限性，为未来研究提供了有意义的难度分层因素。

papers.title: Retraction-Free Optimization over the Stiefel Manifold for the LoRA Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Optimization over the Stiefel manifold plays a significant role in various machine learning tasks. Existing methods either use the retraction operators, requiring costly orthonormalization for large-scale matrices, or employ landing methods that rely on careful step size selection and penalty parameter tuning. To address these challenges, we propose a retraction-free and penalty parameter-free algorithm that directly lands on the manifold. By leveraging the strongly-convex-like property of the quadratic penalty function and the proximal smoothness of the Stiefel manifold, we establish global convergence guarantees with the best-known iteration complexities under both constant and diminishing step sizes. Then, we reformulate the low-rank adaptation (LoRA) fine-tuning problem for large language models as a manifold optimization problem, introducing Manifold-LoRA for geometry-accelerated adaptation. This approach employs the proposed landing technique and a carefully designed step size strategy to accelerate the training process. Numerical experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate the efficiency and strong downstream performance of the proposed method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需回缩（retraction-free）和无需惩罚参数的Stiefel流形优化算法，利用二次罚函数的强凸性质和Stiefel流形的近端光滑性，在常数和递减步长下均达到已知最优的全局收敛复杂度。随后将大语言模型的低秩适配（LoRA）微调重新表述为流形优化问题，提出Manifold-LoRA以加速训练。实验表明该方法在基准数据集上具有高效性和强下游性能。
Motivation: 现有Stiefel流形优化方法要么依赖回缩算子，需要成本高昂的正交化；要么采用着陆方法，需仔细调节步长和惩罚参数。本文旨在消除这些依赖，提出更为简洁高效的算法。
Method: 提出一种直接着陆于流形的无回缩、无惩罚参数算法。利用二次罚函数的类强凸性质和Stiefel流形的近端光滑性，建立全局收敛保证。然后将LoRA微调转化为流形优化问题，采用所提着陆技术和精心设计的步长策略加速训练。
Result: 摘要报告在基准数据集上展示了方法的效率和强下游性能，但未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为所提方法在理论和实践上均优于现有Stiefel流形优化方法，并为LoRA微调提供了几何加速途径。

papers.title: Zhinv: Real-time hub-height wind field reconstruction using only local sparse observations
papers.abstract_en: The high proportion of wind power connected to the grid places higher demands on fine-grained knowledge of regional wind fields. Since the wind information directly obtainable in actual operations is mostly sparse, discrete, and irregularly distributed local observations, it is difficult to directly meet the needs of tasks such as wind power regulation, wind resource assessment, and low-altitude environmental perception of continuous regional wind fields. Therefore, we propose Zhinv, an end-to-end reconstruction framework that directly weaves sparse and irregular observations into a fine-grid wind field at hub-height. Experiments in Northeast China, Europe, and Southeast Asia demonstrate that Zhinv can accurately, robustly, and efficiently reconstruct fine-grid wind fields from sparse observations, reducing the error by about 66% compared with Kriging. With local wind-power observations as input, Zhinv enables wind power centers to bypass NWP and complex assimilation processes, supporting direct and real-time wind resource assessment from locally available data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Zhinv，一种端到端的风场重建框架，仅利用稀疏、离散、不规则分布的本地观测数据，实时重构轮毂高度 (hub-height) 的精细网格风场。在东北、欧洲和东南亚地区的实验中，Zhinv 将重建误差相比克里金法 (Kriging) 降低约 66%，且无需数值天气预报 (NWP) 和复杂数据同化过程。
Motivation: 实际运行中的风信息多为稀疏、离散、不规则的本地观测，难以直接满足风电功率调节、风资源评估及低空环境感知等对连续区域风场的需求。
Method: 提出端到端重建框架 Zhinv，直接将稀疏和不规则的观测数据编织为精细网格风场，绕过 NWP 和同化过程。
Result: 在东北、欧洲和东南亚的实验表明，Zhinv 能准确、鲁棒、高效地从稀疏观测重建精细网格风场，误差比克里金法降低约 66%。
Conclusion: Zhinv 使得风电中心可仅依赖本地观测数据进行实时风资源评估，无需 NWP 和复杂同化流程。

papers.title: Hybrid Analysis for Secure MCP Tool Use in LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: The rapid development of large language model (LLM) agents has enabled their broad adoption across diverse real-world tasks. To standardize interactions between LLM agents and external environments, Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools have emerged as a de facto standard and have been widely integrated into these systems. However, the use of MCP tools also introduces new safety risks, as LLM agents can be induced to perform malicious or unauthorized actions. Although prior work has proposed defenses for securing tool use in LLM agents, most methods rely on static analysis, i.e., inspecting prompts and generated outputs, which limits the defense effectiveness and robustness. To address these limitations, we propose MTGuard, a hybrid analysis-based defense framework designed to safeguard the use of MCP tools in LLM agents by leveraging lifecycle-aware static-dynamic co-analysis. Extensive evaluation demonstrates that MTGuard effectively mitigates multiple categories of harmful tool use across different LLM agents while maintaining performance on benign user tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对LLM代理使用MCP工具时的安全风险，提出MTGuard防御框架，采用生命周期感知的静态-动态协同分析。实验表明该方法能有效减轻多种有害工具使用，同时保持良性用户任务的性能。
Motivation: 现有防御大多依赖静态分析（检查提示和输出），效果和鲁棒性有限，无法应对复杂的恶意工具调用。
Method: MTGuard：混合分析框架，结合静态分析和动态执行追踪，对MCP工具使用进行全生命周期监控与约束。
Result: 在多种LLM代理上，MTGuard有效减轻了多类有害工具使用，且对良性任务性能影响很小。
Conclusion: 混合分析是提升LLM代理工具使用安全性的有效路径，可弥补纯静态分析的不足。

papers.title: Breaking the Periodicity Assumption: Robust Tensorial Multi-View Clustering via Graph-Spectral Low-Rank Learning
papers.abstract_en: Tensorial multi-view clustering (TMC) has achieved strong performance due to its ability to capture high-order correlations across multiple views. Most existing t-SVD-based TMC frameworks apply the Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) along the sample mode to impose frequency-domain low-rank constraints. However, we reveal that this widely adopted design critically relies on an implicit ``periodicity assumption'' induced by the sample arrangement. When samples are ordered by class, neighboring indices tend to be semantically similar, creating artificial local continuity along the sample mode and a favorable spectral structure for FFT-based low-rank regularization. Once this ordering is removed by random permutation, existing t-SVD-based TMC methods suffer severe performance degradation. This strong sensitivity to class ordering conflicts with the permutation-invariant nature of clustering and indicates that part of the reported performance may be attributed to a privileged sample arrangement rather than genuine high-order structure modeling. In this paper, we systematically investigate this phenomenon and its underlying algebraic and spectral mechanisms. To address this fundamental flaw, we further propose a graph-spectral low-rank tensor learning framework based on the Graph Fourier Transform (GFT), which replaces the fixed Fourier basis along the sample mode with a data-driven graph spectral basis, thereby capturing the intrinsic manifold structure without relying on a particular sample ordering. Moreover, we develop an anchor-based variant to address large-scale datasets efficiently. Extensive experiments on various benchmarks validate our findings and demonstrate the competitive or superior performance of the proposed methods compared with state-of-the-art TMC approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示了基于t-SVD的张量多视图聚类（TMC）方法隐式依赖样本排列的“周期性假设”，当样本按类别排序时，FFT的低秩正则化受益于人为局部连续性；随机置换后性能显著下降。为此，提出基于图傅里叶变换（GFT）的图谱低秩张量学习框架，用数据驱动的图谱基替代固定傅里叶基，无需特定样本顺序即可捕获流形结构，并设计了锚点变体以应对大规模数据。实验表明该方法在多个基准上达到与最先进TMC方法相当或更优的性能。
Motivation: 现有t-SVD-based TMC方法依赖样本排序带来的周期性假设，导致聚类结果对排列敏感，违背了聚类问题的排列不变性，且部分性能提升可能来自人为有利的样本顺序而非真实的高阶结构建模。
Method: 提出基于图傅里叶变换（GFT）的图谱低秩张量学习框架，沿样本模式用数据驱动的图谱基替换固定傅里叶基；并开发锚点变体以处理大规模数据集。
Result: 实验表明，所提方法在多个基准上具有竞争力或优于现有TMC方法，并且当样本顺序随机排列时性能不会严重退化。
Conclusion: 本文揭示了张量多视图聚类中一个被忽视的缺陷，并提出图傅里叶变换替代方案以去除对样本排序的依赖，增强了方法的鲁棒性和实际适用性。
