papers.title: CLBench-V: Evaluating Multimodal Context Learning from Grounding to Knowledge Acquisition
papers.abstract_en: Real-world tasks often require models to learn from task-specific context rather than relying only on pre-trained knowledge. While recent work has highlighted this capability as context learning, existing evaluations mainly focus on textual contexts. In many practical settings, however, the context to be learned from is multimodal: scientific findings are conveyed through figures and tables, financial indicators are scattered across converted reports, and spatial decisions depend on maps, scenes, or web pages. We introduce CLBench-V, a benchmark for multimodal context learning that addresses the difficulty of localizing where context use breaks down by organizing tasks around three dimensions: context grounding, new information application, and new knowledge learning. CLBench-V combines converted public benchmarks with newly constructed datasets spanning domains such as science, finance, long-document understanding, spatial reasoning, and web-based visual question answering. To reduce the cost of constructing domain-specific context-learning tasks, we further use automated construction and filtering procedures for our newly built datasets. Across 3,443 instances and six recent multimodal models, the best overall score is only 0.2847, indicating that multimodal context learning remains far from saturated. Moreover, InternVL3.5-30B-A3B performs best on context grounding and new knowledge learning, while Qwen3.5-Plus performs best on new information application. We further analyze judge reliability, context length, image count, and representative failure cases. Code is available at https://github.com/IamLihua/CLBench-V.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CLBench-V，一个评估多模态上下文学习 (multimodal context learning) 的基准，涵盖上下文定位 (context grounding)、新信息应用和新知识学习三个维度，包含科学、金融、长文档、空间推理和网页 VQA 等领域的 3443 个实例。实验评测六个近期多模态模型，最佳整体得分仅为 0.2847，表明该任务远未解决。
Motivation: 现有上下文学习评测主要聚焦文本，而实际场景中待学习的上下文往往是多模态的（如图表、地图、网页等），缺乏系统性的多模态上下文学习评估基准。
Method: CLBench-V 围绕上下文定位、新信息应用和新知识学习三个维度组织任务，整合了转换后的公开基准和新构建的数据集，并采用自动化构建和过滤流程降低成本。
Result: 在 3443 个实例上评测六个多模态模型，最佳整体得分为 0.2847；InternVL3.5-30B-A3B 在上下文定位和新知识学习上表现最佳，Qwen3.5-Plus 在新信息应用上表现最佳。
Conclusion: 多模态上下文学习当前远未饱和，仍需更多研究；该基准为诊断模型在何处失败提供了结构化视角。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Instruction-Tuned Language Models Cannot Sample from Distributions They Can Describe
papers.abstract_en: Silicon sampling uses language models as proxies for human survey respondents, treating each model call as an independent draw from the persona's response distribution. We show this draw does not exist: instruction-tuned models do not sample from distributions, they collapse to a single output. The same persona on the same question returns the same answer on more than half of items in a public-opinion benchmark. The collapse is sharp: the model's internal probabilities concentrate on a single option, and the failure is substantially amplified by instruction tuning: across three model families with materially different post-training pipelines, every instruction-tuned model fails on every task we test, while base models fail far less often. Strikingly, the same model that cannot sample from a distribution can describe it accurately in a single call. We call this gap the KNOWS/DOES split, and trace it to a degenerate sampling primitive visible in the logits and induced by alignment training. Exploiting this split, asking the model to describe the response distribution in one call more than halves the error against human survey data compared to persona aggregation. For applications that require per-persona outputs, we propose Prompt-Perturbed Argyle (PPA), which reduces the same error by 21% at no added cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现指令调优语言模型无法从分布中采样，而是坍缩为单一输出。在公共舆论基准上，同一主体回答同一问题超过半数情况返回相同答案。指令调优放大了这一失败，而基座模型失败频率低得多。模型能准确描述分布但无法从中采样，作者称之为KNOWS/DOPS分裂，并追溯至对齐训练引入的退化采样基元。利用该分裂，一次调用描述响应分布比主体聚合误差降低一半以上。对于需要逐主体输出的应用，提出Prompt-Perturbed Argyle (PPA)，以零额外成本将误差降低21%。
Motivation: 硅采样使用语言模型作为人类调查受访者的代理，但指令调优模型并不从分布中采样，这破坏了硅采样的有效性。
Method: 分析了指令调优模型输出坍缩的现象，定位到对齐训练导致的退化采样基元，并提出利用KNOWS/DOES分裂和Prompt-Perturbed Argyle (PPA)方法来改善。
Result: 指令调优模型在公共舆论基准上超过半数问题返回相同答案；一次调用描述响应分布比主体聚合误差减少一半以上；PPA方法在不增加成本的情况下将误差降低21%。
Conclusion: 指令调优模型存在KNOWS/DOES分裂，即能描述分布但无法从中采样，这对依赖模型采样的应用构成挑战，但利用该分裂可改善结果。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AMRD: Adaptive Multi-Teacher Relational Distillation for Lightweight Speech Emotion Recognition
papers.abstract_en: On-device speech emotion recognition (SER) is critical for real-time applications, yet large self-supervised models that excel at SER are too costly for edge devices. Multi-teacher knowledge distillation can compress them into a lightweight student, but two challenges remain: teacher reliability varies across batches, and logit-level distillation ignores inter-sample relational structure. We propose Adaptive Multi-teacher Relational Distillation (AMRD) to address both. A one-class SVM on each teacher's logit similarity matrix assigns per-batch weights favoring more coherent teachers. A relational distillation loss aligns teacher and student similarity matrices, capturing structure that logit matching misses. On IEMOCAP and CREMA-D datasets across four student architectures, AMRD outperforms single-teacher distillation baselines in most settings, and ablations confirm both components yield complementary gains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出自适应多教师关系蒸馏（AMRD），旨在将大型自监督语音情感识别模型压缩为轻量级学生模型。AMRD通过一类SVM基于每个教师的logit相似性矩阵分配逐批权重，并引入关系蒸馏损失对齐教师与学生的相似性矩阵，从而捕获样本间结构信息。在IEMOCAP和CREMA-D数据集上的实验表明，AMRD在多种学生架构下优于单教师蒸馏基线，消融实验验证了两个组件的互补增益。
Motivation: 大型自监督模型在边缘设备上部署成本过高，多教师知识蒸馏虽能压缩模型，但面临教师可靠性随批次变化以及逐logit蒸馏忽略样本间关系结构的挑战。
Method: 提出AMRD框架：使用一类SVM（one-class SVM）基于每个教师输出的logit相似性矩阵评估其可靠性，并为每批次分配自适应权重；同时设计关系蒸馏损失（relational distillation loss）强制学生样本间的相似性矩阵逼近教师集成矩阵，从而保留样本间结构信息。
Result: 在IEMOCAP和CREMA-D两个数据集上，使用四种不同学生架构，AMRD在大多数实验设置中优于单教师蒸馏基线。消融实验表明，自适应权重与关系蒸馏两个组件能够带来互补的性能提升。
Conclusion: AMRD通过同时解决多教师可靠性变化和结构信息缺失的问题，有效提升了轻量级语音情感识别的性能，适用于边缘设备上的实时应用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Does Deep Representation Learning Help Single-Cell Clustering? A Sensitivity-Aware Diagnostic Benchmark for Biomedical AI Pipelines
papers.abstract_en: Single-cell ribonucleic acid sequencing (scRNA-seq) is a foundational technology for precision-medicine workflows that contribute to United Nations Sustainable Development Goal 3 on Good Health and Well-being, and unsupervised clustering is the analytical step that turns raw expression matrices into interpretable cell populations. Practitioners therefore face a recurring engineering decision: is an additional deep representation stage worth its compute and tuning cost, or do classical principal component analysis (PCA) pipelines already suffice? We address this question with a diagnostic benchmark of nine clustering pipelines on ten real datasets (90-5,685 cells, 19,046-41,480 genes, 4-11 cell types), augmented by a partial scVI V2 specialized comparison on seven datasets. The protocol integrates Optuna hyperparameter search, repeated-run robustness, Friedman/Wilcoxon-Holm/TOST testing, and Sobol total-order sensitivity analysis. The contrastive autoencoder achieved the highest mean Adjusted Rand Index (0.7872), but Holm-corrected tests did not establish dominance over the strongest baselines. Per-dataset analysis reveals three reproducible regimes: probabilistic variational autoencoder (VAE) variants help on the smallest datasets, deep autoencoders win on mid-scale data with multi-batch or many-type structure, and classical PCA pipelines remain competitive when linear projection already captures the dominant variation. Sobol indices identify learning rate ($S_T=0.70$) and latent dimensionality ($S_T=0.56$) as the dominant variance contributors, indicating where limited tuning budgets should be allocated. The contribution is therefore a dataset-aware and compute-conscious decision framework for biomedical AI pipelines supporting sustainable healthcare analytics, rather than a universal superiority claim.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估了深度表示学习在单细胞RNA测序聚类中是否优于传统PCA方法。通过9种聚类流水线在10个数据集上的诊断基准测试，辅以Optuna超参数搜索和Sobol敏感性分析，发现对比自编码器平均ARI最高（0.7872），但统计检验未证明其显著优于最强基线。不同数据集存在三种可复现的适用模式：概率VAE在小数据集上占优，深度自编码器在中规模多批次/多类型数据上获胜，PCA在主导变异可线性捕捉时仍有竞争力。
Motivation: 生物医学AI流水线中，从业者面临一个常见工程决策：增加深度表示阶段是否值得额外的计算和调优成本？现有研究缺乏系统性的诊断基准来回答这一问题。
Method: 构建包含9种聚类流水线的诊断基准，在10个真实数据集（90-5,685个细胞，19,046-41,480个基因，4-11种细胞类型）上进行测试，并通过部分数据集进行scVI V2专门比较。实验流程整合了Optuna超参数搜索、多次重复稳健性、Friedman/Wilcoxon-Holm/TOST统计检验以及Sobol总阶敏感性分析。
Result: 对比自编码器取得了最高的平均调整兰德指数（0.7872），但Holm校正后的检验未确立其对最强基线的优势。Sobol指数显示学习率（ST=0.70）和潜在维度（ST=0.56）是方差的主要贡献者。
Conclusion: 本文提供了一个数据集感知和计算意识决策框架，强调没有通用的优越性，而应根据具体数据特性选择聚类流水线，以支持可持续的医疗分析。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ContractHIL-HLS: Contract-Aligned Multi-Agent Workflow with Hardware-in-the-Loop Feedback for HLS Design
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents ContractHIL-HLS, a contract-aligned multi-agent workflow for practical high-level synthesis (HLS) engineering. The workflow makes three contributions. First, it introduces a structured contract as the semantic-alignment and task-execution artifact that translates natural language requirements into explicit interfaces, constraints, validation checks, and rollback rules. Second, it incorporates hardware information into the feedback loop by feeding HLS, Vivado, PYNQ runtime, power, and failure evidence back into generation, thereby extending LLM-assisted HLS from kernel code toward system- and board-level closure. Third, it decomposes agents by semantic lowering and execution tasks rather than by conversational roles: a Contract Agent lowers natural language into the contract, an HTML Agent renders the contract as persistent structured HTML, and a Hardware-in-the-Loop Agent implements and revises the design with measured evidence. We evaluate ContractHIL-HLS in two parts. On 94 locally executable HLS-Eval tasks, the structured contract provides the largest small design gain, improving the estimated single-sample testbench pass rate from 64.0% to 70.2%; the full flow reaches 70.4% pass@1 and 76.6% pass@5. Because HLS-Eval does not exercise board-level design, we also validate ContractHIL-HLS on a board tested ML-KEM/ML-DSA post-quantum cryptography (PQC) secure-message accelerator, where the retained dual-bitstream organization reduces six-message average text runtime from 207.3 ms to 52.4 ms with positive routed WNS on both images while preserving decrypted-message verification. We open-source our work at BJUT-CS316-LAB/ContractHIL-HLS (https://github.com/BJUT-CS316-LAB/ContractHIL-HLS).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ContractHIL-HLS，一个面向高层次综合（HLS）工程、基于合约对齐的多智能体工作流。它通过结构化合约将自然语言需求转化为接口与约束，引入硬件在环反馈（HLS、Vivado、PYNQ运行时、功耗、故障证据）循环，并按照语义降级与执行任务而非对话角色分解智能体。在94个HLS-Eval任务上，结构化合约将估计的单样本测试通过率从64.0%提升至70.2%，完整流程达到70.4% pass@1和76.6% pass@5。在基于板级测试的ML-KEM/ML-DSA后量子密码安全消息加速器上，该方法将六条消息的平均文本运行时间从207.3毫秒降至52.4毫秒，且保持正布线时间余量（WNS）和解密消息验证。代码已开源。
Motivation: 现有LLM辅助HLS设计缺乏系统级和板级闭环验证，且多智能体编排常基于对话角色而非语义对齐与执行任务，导致需求-实现偏差。
Method: 提出三种智能体：Contract Agent将自然语言降级为结构化合约，HTML Agent将合约渲染为持久化HTML，Hardware-in-the-Loop Agent利用HLS、Vivado、PYNQ运行时、功耗、故障等硬件实测证据迭代实现与修订设计。合约明确接口、约束、验证检查和回滚规则。
Result: 在94个HLS-Eval任务上，结构化合约使估计单样本测试通过率从64.0%提升至70.2%；完整流程达到70.4% pass@1和76.6% pass@5。在板级后量子密码加速器上，六条消息平均文本运行时间从207.3毫秒降至52.4毫秒，正WNS和消息验证保持。
Conclusion: ContractHIL-HLS通过合约对齐和硬件在环反馈有效提升了HLS设计的正确性与效率，但在仅有HLS-Eval任务时无法体现板级设计优势，需结合具体硬件验证。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 在94个HLS-Eval任务上，结构化合约使估计单样本测试通过率从64.0%提升至70.2%；完整流程达到70.4% pass@1和76.6% pass@5。在板级后量子密码加速器上，六条消息平均文本运行时间从207.3毫秒降至52.4毫秒，正WNS和消息验证保持。
summary_sections.conclusion: ContractHIL-HLS通过合约对齐和硬件在环反馈有效提升了HLS设计的正确性与效率，但在仅有HLS-Eval任务时无法体现板级设计优势，需结合具体硬件验证。

papers.title: Normalizing Flows to Reconstruct Pseudo-PDFs
papers.abstract_en: We investigate a normalizing-flow approach for reconstructing parton distribution functions (PDFs) from synthetic matrix-element data. Our framework combines Gaussian Process priors with invertible neural networks to learn a posterior distribution over PDFs consistent with limited Ioffe-time data. We demonstrate that the architecture preserves physical constraints and extrapolation properties.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出使用归一化流（normalizing flows）从合成矩阵元数据中重建部分子分布函数（PDFs）。结合高斯过程先验与可逆神经网络，学习符合有限Ioffe时间数据的后验分布，并保留物理约束与外推能力。
Motivation: 精确重建部分子分布函数（PDFs）是理解强子结构的核心问题，但现有方法依赖于有限数据和模型假设。
Method: 将归一化流与高斯过程先验结合，利用可逆神经网络在Ioffe时间数据上学习PDFs的后验分布，并显式编码物理约束。
Result: 在合成数据上验证了架构保持物理约束和外推性质的能力。
Conclusion: 归一化流为从格点QCD数据中非参数地重建PDFs提供了有前景的方向。

papers.title: Many-body Tipping Dynamics of ChatGPT-like AIs
papers.abstract_en: Why do ChatGPT-like AIs, despite major architectural and training differences, unexpectedly tip to undesirable content (e.g. harmful, misleading, repetitive) even under deterministic greedy decoding? We show that a broad class of such tippings is caused by the many-body interactions between tokens (spins) as they cross the finite-layer system. Tipping emerges as a dynamical first passage process between competing output basins. Attention disorder controls the transport toward, away from, or along the basins' boundary. A few-basin reduction yields a closed finite-layer threshold, whose coarse-grained predictions show good agreement across ChatGPT-like families. These results suggest that a broad class of AI failures represents 'foreseeable engineering risk' rather than inherently unpredictable behavior, with important implications for legal and societal assessments of AI harm.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究ChatGPT类AI在确定性贪婪解码下意外产生不良内容（如有害、误导、重复）的机制，将其归因于token（自旋）跨越有限层系统时的多体相互作用，倾覆是竞争输出盆地之间的动力学首通过程，注意无序控制传输，粗粒化预测与多个ChatGPT-like系列一致，表明此类失败是“可预见的工程风险”而非不可预测行为。
Motivation: 解释ChatGPT类AI在架构和训练差异下为何会意外产生不良内容，即使采用确定性贪婪解码。
Method: 使用多体物理模型，将token视为自旋，分析其跨越有限层系统的相互作用，将倾覆建模为竞争输出盆地之间的动力学首通过程，引入注意无序控制传输。
Result: 粗粒化简化的封闭有限层阈值与多个ChatGPT-like系列的预测一致。
Conclusion: 此类AI失败可视为可预见的工程风险，对法律和社会评估AI伤害有重要意义。

papers.title: FunnelAL: Retrieve-then-Rank Active Learning for Single-Class Discovery
papers.abstract_en: We present FunnelAL, a retrieve-then-rank active learning system for single-class discovery, which adapts the multi-stage funnel architecture of industrial recommender systems to data annotation. Large-scale supervised learning faces two challenges: efficiently finding relevant samples in a massive corpus, and distinguishing true positives from visually confusable negatives when embeddings do not cleanly separate classes. Conventional active learning offers a principled framework for reducing annotation cost, yet it treats sample selection as a single-stage process that addresses neither challenge efficiently. FunnelAL decomposes the problem into cascaded stages. Starting from a single positive and negative example, the system iterates through: (1) embedding-based retrieval scoring that narrows the corpus to a manageable candidate set; (2) a precision-triggered ranking stage that exploits a learned ranker (RankNet) while batch precision remains high, then automatically blends in committee-based exploration (QBC) once returns diminish; and (3) feedback from the annotator's labels that refines both stages in subsequent iterations. We evaluate on three diverse image classification benchmarks. With a perfect annotator, FunnelAL attains the best final F1 on all three benchmarks, the best annotation efficiency (first in AULC), and the fewest annotation rounds. The most recent single-class discovery methods (GAL, PF-MA) at best match its final quality, and only at consistently higher labeling cost. Under annotator labeling errors at realistic rates, FunnelAL remains first or statistically tied for first while classical uncertainty-based methods degrade two to three times faster. Our work provides a concrete bridge between multi-stage recommender systems and active learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FunnelAL 是一个用于单类发现 (single-class discovery) 的检索-排序主动学习系统，将工业推荐系统的多级漏斗架构适配到数据标注中。它从单张正负样本开始，依次经过基于嵌入的检索粗筛、基于 RankNet 的精确排序和基于 QBC 的探索，利用标注反馈迭代优化。在三个图像分类基准上，FunnelAL 取得了最优的最终 F1、最佳的标注效率 (AULC) 和最少的标注轮次，并且在存在标注错误时退化速度远低于经典不确定性方法。
Motivation: 大规模监督学习面临两个挑战：在海量数据中高效发现相关样本，以及当嵌入空间无法清晰分离类别时区分真正例与视觉混淆的负例。传统主动学习将样本选择视为单阶段过程，不足以同时应对这两个挑战。
Method: 提出 FunnelAL，采用检索-排序 (retrieve-then-rank) 级联架构：首先通过嵌入检索评分将语料缩小到可管理的候选集；然后在批次精确度较高时使用 RankNet 排序，当收益递减时自动混合委员会查询 (QBC) 探索；最后利用标注者的标签反馈在后续迭代中改进两个阶段。
Result: 在三个图像分类基准上，FunnelAL 在所有基准上取得最佳最终 F1、最佳标注效率 (AULC 第一) 和最少的标注轮次。与最新单类发现方法 (GAL, PF-MA) 相比，FunnelAL 在最终质量上不劣于它们，且标注成本更低。在现实标注错误率下，FunnelAL 仍保持第一或统计上并列第一，而经典不确定性方法性能下降快 2-3 倍。
Conclusion: 该工作为多阶段推荐系统与主动学习之间建立了具体桥梁，表明漏斗式级联架构能有效提升单类发现中的标注效率和对标注噪声的鲁棒性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ScaleResfusion: Residual Rectified Flow based on Residual Vector Field
papers.abstract_en: Real-world Image Restoration (Real-IR) aims to recover high-quality (HQ) images from complex and unknown degradations. Although recent diffusion-based methods have substantially improved perceptual quality, their current designs leave two key challenges unresolved. Methods that start from Gaussian noise are slow and often less faithful to the degraded input. Residual-based methods usually train from scratch, which makes it hard to exploit modern pre-trained generative priors. In this paper, we present ScaleResfusion, a scalable diffusion framework for real-world image restoration built on pre-trained text-to-image rectified-flow models. The core of our method is Residual Rectified Flow, which introduces the residual term R into Standard Rectified Flow. Instead of starting from pure noise, it uses a residual transport path that starts from noisy low-quality (LQ) images and admits an exact acceleration point. By learning the residual vector field, Residual Rectified Flow keeps the output distribution and linear diffusion process consistent with the pre-trained rectified-flow models. This makes parameter-efficient fine-tuning possible at scale. We further introduce a knowledge-distillation pipeline to reduce sampling cost while maintaining restoration quality. Extensive experiments on multiple real-world restoration tasks show that ScaleResfusion achieves state-of-the-art performance with much higher efficiency. These results suggest a practical and scalable way to adapt large pre-trained diffusion models to real-world image restoration. Our code and models are available at https://github.com/YukinoshitaLove/ScaleResfusion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ScaleResfusion，一个基于预训练文本到图像修补流模型的可扩展真实世界图像修复框架。核心是残差修补流（Residual Rectified Flow），通过引入残差项 R，从带噪低质量图像开始学习残差向量场，保持与预训练修补流模型一致的输出分布和线性扩散过程，从而实现参数高效的微调。还引入了知识蒸馏流水线以减少采样成本。在多个真实世界修复任务上，该方法以更高效率达到最先进性能。
Motivation: 现有基于扩散的真实世界图像修复方法存在两个挑战：从高斯噪声出发的方法速度慢且对退化输入不忠实；基于残差的方法通常需要从头训练，难以利用现代预训练生成先验。
Method: 提出残差修补流（Residual Rectified Flow），在标准修补流中引入残差项 R，从带噪低质量图像出发构建残差传输路径，学习残差向量场，保持与预训练修补流模型的一致性，支持参数高效微调。进一步采用知识蒸馏流水线降低采样成本。
Result: 在多个真实世界修复任务上，ScaleResfusion 实现了最先进性能，且效率更高。
Conclusion: 该工作提供了一种实用且可扩展的方式，将大规模预训练扩散模型适配到真实世界图像修复任务中。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: HeAD-CP: Heterophily-Aware Diffused Conformal Prediction Sets for Graph Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Conformal prediction (CP) provides distribution-free uncertainty quantification, and its extension to graphs is an active research direction. Diffused Adaptive Prediction Sets (DAPS) is a widely used graph-aware diffusion baseline, propagating Adaptive Prediction Sets (APS) non-conformity scores along edges with a uniform coefficient $λ$. We identify a fundamental shortcoming of this design: the uniform low-pass diffusion presupposes graph homophily and proves detrimental on heterophilic graphs, enlarging the mean prediction-set size by up to 10.6% relative to plain APS. To mitigate this, we propose HeAD-CP, a family of node-wise diffusion variants whose coefficients are determined by a label-free local-homophily estimate derived from the GNN softmax. Three variants, namely signed-$γ$, edge-compatibility, and a DAPS-baseline-with-correction, are most effective at extreme heterophily, intermediate heterophily, and moderate-to-high homophily, respectively, and all preserve the marginal coverage guarantee. On ten benchmarks, the HeAD-CP family stays at or below plain APS on every dataset, while DAPS exceeds APS on six. The post-hoc oracle over the family improves over DAPS on 8/10 datasets at $p<0.01$ (paired Wilcoxon), with the largest gains on heterophilic graphs (10.3% on Texas); on the two homophilic datasets where DAPS still wins (CiteSeer, PubMed), it retains a marginal advantage of at most 0.002, statistically insignificant on CiteSeer ($p=0.23$). Designing a calibrated label-free selector that approaches this oracle is the main outstanding empirical question.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出现有图共形预测方法DAPS在异配图上的局限，并提出HeAD-CP系列变体来缓解该问题。实验表明HeAD-CP在异配图上显著优于DAPS，且保持边际覆盖保证。
Motivation: DAPS使用均匀低通扩散假设图是同配的，在异配图上会导致预测集增大，最高达10.6%。
Method: 提出HeAD-CP系列变体，节点扩散系数由基于GNN softmax的无标签局部同配性估计决定，包括signed-γ、edge-compatibility和修正版DAPS三种变体。
Result: 在10个基准上，HeAD-CP所有变体预测集大小均不差于plain APS，而DAPS在6个数据集上更差。后验oracle在8/10数据集上显著优于DAPS，异配图提升最大（Texas上10.3%）。
Conclusion: HeAD-CP有效改善异配图上的共形预测效率，但设计接近oracle的无标签选择器仍是主要挑战。

papers.title: Sequential Preconditioned Conjugate Gradient Method for Linear Statistical Models
papers.abstract_en: We propose a randomized iterative method for the ordinary least-squares estimation problem in large-scale linear statistical models, namely the Sequential Preconditioned Conjugate Gradient Method (SPCG). SPCG constructs a sequence of sketched least-squares subproblems with increasing sketch sizes, applies PCG as the inner solver, and warm-starts each subproblem from the previous solution. A final refinement stage is then performed on the full-scale problem. Since most iterations are carried out on smaller subproblems, the overall computational cost is significantly reduced. We establish the convergence theory, prove that SPCG attains OLS prediction accuracy, and derive per-subproblem iteration bounds and complexity estimates. Numerical experiments show that SPCG reaches the target prediction accuracy with fewer iterations and less CPU time than full-data PCG and Iterative Double Sketching (IDS).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出序贯预处理共轭梯度法（SPCG），一种用于大规模线性统计模型最小二乘估计的随机迭代方法。SPCG通过构建一系列草图规模递增的子问题，使用PCG作为内求解器并热启动，最后在全规模问题上进行精化，显著降低计算成本。理论分析证明了其收敛性和OLS预测精度，数值实验表明SPCG在迭代次数和CPU时间上优于全数据PCG和迭代双重草图法。
Motivation: 大规模线性统计模型的最小二乘估计计算成本高，现有方法如全数据PCG和迭代双重草图法效率不足，SPCG旨在通过序贯草图策略加速求解。
Method: SPCG构建一系列草图规模递增的线性最小二乘子问题，对每个子问题应用预处理共轭梯度法（PCG）作为内求解器，并从上一子问题的解热启动，最后在全规模问题上执行精化步骤。
Result: 数值实验显示SPCG达到目标预测精度所需的迭代次数和CPU时间均少于全数据PCG和迭代双重草图法（IDS）。
Conclusion: SPCG能显著降低大规模线性统计模型最小二乘估计的计算开销，并保持预测精度，适用于高维数据场景。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出序贯预处理共轭梯度法（SPCG），一种用于大规模线性统计模型最小二乘估计的随机迭代方法。SPCG通过构建一系列草图规模递增的子问题，使用PCG作为内求解器并热启动，最后在全规模问题上进行精化，显著降低计算成本。理论分析证明了其收敛性和OLS预测精度，数值实验表明SPCG在迭代次数和CPU时间上优于全数据PCG和迭代双重草图法。
summary_sections.motivation: 大规模线性统计模型的最小二乘估计计算成本高，现有方法如全数据PCG和迭代双重草图法效率不足，SPCG旨在通过序贯草图策略加速求解。
summary_sections.method: SPCG构建一系列草图规模递增的线性最小二乘子问题，对每个子问题应用预处理共轭梯度法（PCG）作为内求解器，并从上一子问题的解热启动，最后在全规模问题上执行精化步骤。

papers.title: Bridging Compute- and Data-Optimal Pretraining
papers.abstract_en: Classical compute-optimal scaling laws assume an unbounded supply of fresh pretraining data, yet pretraining is increasingly entering a regime in which compute grows faster than the availability of high-quality data. We propose Compute-Data (CD) scaling laws, a unified framework that bridges compute-optimal scaling, where data scales freely with compute, and data-optimal scaling, where the corpus is fixed while compute can grow without bound. CD scaling extends classical scaling laws by introducing a token-effectiveness function, $η$, which quantifies the value of a derived token-produced, for example, through multi-epoch repetition or paraphrasing-relative to a fresh token, ranging from a perfect substitute to having no value. We fit $η$ for two data-expansion strategies, multi-epoch repetition and paraphrasing, across model sizes from 14M to 600M parameters using the Dolma-3 corpus. We find that token effectiveness is far from constant: it depends jointly on model size, the tokens-per-parameter ratio, and the amount of derived data, and it saturates as the corpus is expanded. The functional form of $η$ implies diminishing returns when substituting compute for data as either model size or data availability increases. It also partitions training into three operational regimes---compute-bound, data-bound, and model-bound---and shows that classical compute-optimal allocation is suboptimal across most practically relevant settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出计算-数据（CD）缩放定律，统一了计算最优缩放（数据随计算自由缩放）和数据最优缩放（数据有限、计算无限增长）的框架。通过引入令牌有效性函数η，量化衍生令牌（如多轮重复或释义产生的令牌）相对于新鲜令牌的价值，并在14M到600M参数的模型上拟合η。发现η依赖于模型大小、令牌/参数比和衍生数据量，且随数据扩展饱和。该函数表明，用计算替代数据时收益递减，并将训练分为计算受限、数据受限和模型受限三个区域，指出经典计算最优分配在大多数实际场景中并非最优。
Motivation: 经典计算最优缩放定律假设无界的新鲜预训练数据，但实际中高质量数据增长慢于算力增长，需要统一计算最优和数据最优两种场景的缩放定律。
Method: 提出CD缩放定律，引入令牌有效性函数η（0到1之间），量化衍生令牌相对于新鲜令牌的价值；利用Dolma-3语料库，在14M-600M参数模型上实验两种数据扩展策略（多轮重复和释义），拟合η的依赖关系。
Result: 令牌有效性并非恒定，而是联合依赖于模型大小、令牌/参数比及衍生数据量，并随语料扩展而饱和；η的函数形式表明用计算替代数据时收益递减，并将训练划分为计算受限、数据受限和模型受限三个区域；经典计算最优分配在大多数实际场景下是次优的。
Conclusion: CD缩放定律为预训练资源分配提供了更现实的指导，表明在数据有限时不应盲目遵循计算最优缩放；未来可扩展至更多数据扩展策略和更大模型。

papers.title: Where Steering Signals Come From: Activation Source Selection in Activation Steering
papers.abstract_en: Activation steering controls language models by adding vectors or features to hidden states at inference time, but the upstream source of these steering signals is often treated as a secondary detail. We study this source choice as activation source selection: the combination of source context and activation readout policy used to collect the hidden states from which a steering signal is built. Holding the downstream intervention fixed, we show across three instruction-tuned models and four steering task families that changing only the source activations substantially changes steering success. We further find that effective steering is not explained simply by whether the desired behavior appears in the source text. Instead, strong signals come from execution-boundary states, where the model is about to produce or continue the target behavior. This pre-/post-realization distinction explains why answer-based sources sometimes work: their useful component aligns with execution-boundary directions rather than target appearance alone. Building on this view, we introduce tail subtraction, which removes shared prompt and continuation semantics from boundary states and yields cleaner, more stable steering signals. Overall, our results suggest that steering depends on representations of what the model is about to do, not merely on what has already appeared.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究激活引导（Activation Steering）中信号来源的选择问题，即“激活源选择”（activation source selection）。通过固定下游干预，仅改变源激活（源上下文和激活读出策略），在三种指令调优模型和四种引导任务上发现源激活的选择显著影响引导效果。有效引导并非简单地因为目标行为出现在源文本中，而是来自执行边界状态（execution-boundary states），即模型即将产生或继续目标行为的状态。基于此，提出“尾部减法”（tail subtraction）从边界状态中移除共享语义，获得更干净稳定的引导信号。结论：引导依赖于模型即将做什么的表征，而非已经出现的内容。
Motivation: 现有激活引导研究通常将信号来源视为次要细节，缺乏对源选择如何影响引导效果的系统理解。
Method: 通过保持下游干预不变，仅改变源激活（包括源上下文组合和激活读出策略）来评估影响。提出尾部减法，从执行边界状态中移除共享提示和延续语义，以提取更纯粹的引导信号。
Result: 发现有效引导的关键在于执行边界状态，而非目标行为在源文本中是否出现；尾部减法能提供更稳定、更干净的引导信号。
Conclusion: 激活引导依赖于模型即将产生目标行为的表征，而非已经出现的表征，强调了激活源选择的重要性。

papers.title: Structure-aware Relative Policy Optimization for Ranking
papers.abstract_en: Ranking is a fundamental component of modern information access systems. Reinforcement learning (RL) provides a flexible framework for directly optimizing coarse-grained feedback and system-level objectives defined over the complete ranking list. However, existing RL-based ranking methods typically treat each sampled permutation as an atomic output and evaluate it primarily through a scalar reward, overlooking the structural relationships among different ranking lists. Consequently, permutations with similar rewards but substantially different permutation patterns may receive comparable optimization signals, potentially leading to inaccurate credit assignment and overly aggressive policy updates. To address this limitation, we propose SRPO, a \textbf{S}tructure-aware \textbf{R}elative \textbf{P}olicy \textbf{O}ptimization framework for listwise ranking. SRPO measures the discrepancy between sampled permutations using a top-weighted Kendall-tau distance and normalizes their pairwise reward differences by the corresponding distances. It quantifies the reward improvement per unit of ranking change, thereby emphasizing efficient local refinements, particularly those involving top-ranked positions. Experimental results across two ranking scenarios demonstrate that explicitly modeling permutation-level differences improves the effectiveness and stability of listwise ranking, with particularly favorable performance in limited-feedback and complex list-level optimization settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对现有基于强化学习的排序方法忽略排列间结构关系的问题，提出结构感知的相对策略优化（SRPO）框架。SRPO使用top-weighted Kendall-tau距离衡量采样排列的差异，并通过该距离归一化奖励差异，从而强调针对顶层位置的高效局部调整。实验表明，显式建模排列级差异能提升列表排序的有效性和稳定性，尤其在有限反馈和复杂列表优化场景中表现良好。
Motivation: 现有RL排序方法将每个采样排列视为原子输出，仅用标量奖励评估，忽略了不同排列间的结构关系，导致相似奖励但不同模式的排列获得相近优化信号，造成信用分配不准确和策略更新过于激进。
Method: 提出SRPO框架，通过top-weighted Kendall-tau距离量化排列间差异，并将成对奖励差异除以该距离，得到每单位排序变化对应的奖励改善，从而引导策略倾向于更高效的局部调整，特别是顶层位置的优化。
Result: 在两种排序场景下的实验表明，显式建模排列级差异提升了列表排序的有效性和稳定性，在有限反馈和复杂列表级优化设置中尤其有优势。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过结构感知的相对策略优化可以更精确地评估排列质量，改善排序性能，但未明确讨论方法的局限性或适用范围。

papers.title: FORGE: Frame Orthogonality in Relevance Geometry for Long-Form Video Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have enabled long-form video understanding at a scale that was not previously possible. However, the density of relevant content decreases sharply as video sequence length increases, and exposing the model to more irrelevant content measurably reduces its accuracy. In this paper, we address the problem of maximizing query-relevant information in a frame subset selected at inference time, without training. FORGE (Frame Orthogonality in Relevance Geometry) is a model-agnostic method that induces a query-conditioned geometry on a pretrained multimodal embedding space, unifying relevance and diversity into a single objective. In this space, frames that cover independent query-relevant directions are far apart, and selecting the subset of maximum information captures diverse query-relevant content within the budget. Experiments on Video-MME and LongVideoBench at budgets of 16, 32, and 64 frames show that FORGE improves the unified keyframe selection score by 11.0-15.3 points over the strongest training-free baseline and up to doubles keyframe recall (0.415 vs. 0.204 at K=64 on Video-MME). The gains extend to question answering, where accuracy improves in every evaluated setting across eight open-source MLLMs spanning 4B to 32B parameters, by up to 8.7 points over uniform sampling and 5.2 points over the strongest baseline. Our findings suggest that aligning the embedding space with the query's high-dimensional structure is a promising direction for inference-time video understanding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FORGE，一种无需训练、模型无关的帧选择方法，通过在预训练的多模态嵌入空间上引入查询条件几何，将相关性和多样性统一为单一目标。在 Video-MME 和 LongVideoBench 上，16/32/64 帧预算下，FORGE 将统一关键帧选择分数提升 11.0-15.3 点，关键帧召回率翻倍，并在八种开源 MLLM（4B-32B）上提升问答准确率最高达 8.7 点。
Motivation: 长视频中相关内容的密度随序列长度增加而急剧下降，暴露模型于更多无关内容会显著降低准确率，现有方法难以在不训练的情况下最大化查询相关的帧子集信息。
Method: FORGE 在预训练的多模态嵌入空间上诱导查询条件几何，使覆盖独立查询相关方向的帧彼此远离，通过最大化子集信息量在预算内选取多样化的查询相关内容。
Result: 在 Video-MME 和 LongVideoBench 上，16/32/64 帧预算下统一关键帧选择分数提升 11.0-15.3 点；关键帧召回率在 K=64 时从 0.204 提升至 0.415；在八种开源 MLLM 上问答准确率最高提升 8.7 点（vs 均匀采样）和 5.2 点（vs 最强基线）。
Conclusion: 将嵌入空间与查询的高维结构对齐是推理时视频理解的一个有前途的方向。

papers.title: Laplace-PSN-IRT: Uncertainty Quantification for Neural Item Response Theory Models of LLM Benchmarks
papers.abstract_en: Item Response Theory (IRT) has recently been proposed as a framework for evaluating large language model (LLM) benchmarks by separating a model's latent ability from the properties of individual benchmark items. Existing neural IRT approaches, including PSN-IRT, estimate these quantities using point estimates, limiting uncertainty quantification and downstream statistical inference. We introduce Laplace-PSN-IRT, a post-hoc last-layer Laplace approximation that augments a trained PSN-IRT model with approximate Bayesian posterior inference, recovering calibrated uncertainty over model ability and item difficulty without retraining. The resulting posterior enables credible intervals, probabilistic comparisons between models, and propagation of parameter uncertainty into Fisher-information-based item selection. We show that most pairwise comparisons among 12 models on a standard LLM benchmark leaderboard are not statistically distinguishable despite differing point-estimate ranks. We further show that point-estimate Fisher information can become nearly zero for many benchmark items because it is evaluated at a single reference ability, whereas posterior-expected Fisher information remains substantially more stable across the ability range. Finally, posterior-expected Fisher information more accurately recovers full-benchmark ability rankings from small benchmark subsets in most experimental settings while matching point-estimate performance for the smallest subsets. We validate the calibration of the approximate posterior using held-out predictive coverage and find that modeling item difficulty as random while treating item discrimination as fixed produces well-calibrated uncertainty in this architecture.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Laplace-PSN-IRT，通过对已训练的PSN-IRT模型进行事后最后一层拉普拉斯近似（post-hoc last-layer Laplace approximation），实现贝叶斯近似后验推断，从而量化LLM基准评估中模型能力和题目参数的不确定性。实验表明，标准LLM排行榜上12个模型的大多数成对比较在统计上不可区分，且点估计Fisher信息对许多基准题目近乎为零，而基于后验期望的Fisher信息更稳定，并能从小基准子集中更准确地恢复完整排名。
Motivation: 现有神经IRT方法（如PSN-IRT）仅提供点估计，缺乏不确定性量化，限制了后续统计推断（如模型间可比性、题目选择）的可靠性。
Method: 在已训练的PSN-IRT模型上，对最后一层参数应用拉普拉斯近似（Laplace approximation），获得模型能力和题目难度的近似后验分布，无需重新训练模型。
Result: 12个模型在标准LLM基准上的大多数成对比较统计上不显著；点估计Fisher信息在许多题目上近乎为零，而后验期望Fisher信息更稳定；后验期望Fisher信息从小子集恢复完整排名的准确性在多数设置下优于或持平于点估计方法，且后验校准通过留出预测覆盖得到验证。
Conclusion: 该工作展示了将贝叶斯不确定性引入IRT模型的重要性，并指出点估计可能导致误导性结论，后验推断为基准评估和题目选择提供了更鲁棒的统计基础。

papers.title: The User Asks, Platforms Compete: How Agentic Recommendation Markets Take Shape
papers.abstract_en: Online recommendation has traditionally taken place after a user enters a platform, which determines the candidate pool and the ranking shown to the user. LLM-based user agents enable a different recommendation process: a user specifies a need before choosing a platform, leaving platforms to compete for the user's attention, which we refer to as an agentic recommendation market. In our controlled LLM-based experiments across three product domains, we find this new setting of recommendation creates a tension between access and attention. Compared with traditional platform-centric recommendation, user-centric recommendation greatly expands the opportunity for relevant items to enter comparison; yet broader participation does not translate directly into effective exposure. Competition directly triggers platforms' strategic play: selectively positive explanations occupy 73--78% of first-ranked positions. When the user agent relates platforms' actions to subsequent user feedback, this share falls to 36--41%, while the chance of a user purchasing the relevant item increases. A user agent is therefore more than a ranker over a larger pool of candidates: its querying, ranking, and feedback mechanism governing who can compete, how scarce attention is allocated, and how earlier outcomes shape the evaluation of platforms directly affect user utility. Designing agentic recommendation therefore requires treating access, attention, and accountability as a joint mechanism design problem.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究LLM驱动的用户智能体（agent）如何改变推荐系统的运作方式：用户先表达需求再选择平台，平台间竞争用户注意力，形成‘代理推荐市场’。实验发现，与平台为中心的传统推荐相比，用户中心推荐扩大了候选集，但平台会策略性使用选择性正面解释（占首位73-78%），而引入用户反馈机制后该比例降至36-41%，且用户购买概率提升。说明代理推荐需综合对待准入、注意力和问责的机制设计问题。
Motivation: 传统推荐以平台为中心，用户进入平台后才被推荐；LLM用户智能体使得用户可先指定需求，平台需竞争用户注意力，这一新型代理推荐市场中的访问与注意力冲突尚未被系统研究。
Method: 在三个产品领域进行受控LLM实验，比较平台中心推荐与用户中心推荐的效果，并分析平台策略性解释行为及用户反馈机制的影响。
Result: 用户中心推荐扩大了相关物品进入比较的机会，但平台策略性使用选择性正面解释占首位73-78%；引入用户反馈后该比例降至36-41%，且用户购买相关物品的概率增加。
Conclusion: 设计代理推荐需将访问、注意力和问责视为联合机制设计问题，而非简单地扩大候选池并排序。

papers.title: CADENCE: A Cardiac Atom Dictionary for Interpretable Neural Concept Extraction from ECG Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models for 12-lead electrocardiograms (ECGs) transfer well across clinical tasks, but the physiological knowledge encoded in their representations remains opaque. We present CADENCE, a framework that decomposes an ECG foundation model into a human-interpretable, queryable dictionary of physiological concepts. Using a BatchTopK sparse autoencoder, CADENCE factorizes Layer-6 embeddings from more than nine million ECG tokens into 8,192 sparse cardiac atoms. These atoms align better than individual dense embedding dimensions with clinical phenotypes and waveform morphology, recovering arrhythmias, conduction abnormalities, infarction and repolarization patterns, chamber and axis findings, and lead- and beat-phase-specific waveform primitives. At Layer 6, the best atoms achieve mean AUROCs of 0.88 for clinical phenotypes and 0.90 for morphology, versus 0.78 and 0.83 for the best dense dimensions. Sparse atom probes match or outperform dense probes for phenotype, morphology, and age prediction while attributing each prediction to a small set of interpretable atoms; phenotype AUROC improves from 0.93 to 0.95. Atom-space geometry recovers physiologically coherent relationships, and targeted atom ablation selectively changes frozen downstream outputs. An automated LLM pipeline generates and quantitatively validates atom descriptions by predicting held-out activations. On independent external ECG datasets, CADENCE recovers overlapping concepts and maintains consistent phenotype-prediction performance. CADENCE provides a scalable framework for discovering and auditing the physiological knowledge encoded by ECG foundation models.
papers.comment: 21 pages, 5 main figures, 15 appendix figures, 6 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CADENCE 是一个将 12 导联心电图 (ECG) 基础模型分解为可解释生理概念字典的框架。它使用 BatchTopK 稀疏自编码器将超过 900 万个心电图标记的 Layer-6 嵌入分解为 8,192 个稀疏心脏原子 (cardiac atoms)，这些原子在临床表型和波形形态上比密集嵌入维度对齐更好，且稀疏原子探针在多个任务上匹配或优于密集探针。
Motivation: 心电图基础模型在临床任务中表现良好，但其表示中编码的生理知识仍不透明，缺乏可解释性。
Method: 提出 CADENCE 框架，使用 BatchTopK 稀疏自编码器将 ECG 基础模型的 Layer-6 嵌入分解为 8,192 个稀疏的心脏原子，并利用自动 LLM 管道生成和验证原子描述。
Result: 最佳原子在临床表型和形态预测上平均 AUROC 分别达到 0.88 和 0.90，优于密集维度的 0.78 和 0.83；稀疏原子探针在表型预测上 AUROC 从 0.93 提升至 0.95，且原子消融实验选择性地改变冻结下游输出。
Conclusion: CADENCE 提供了一个可扩展的框架，用于发现和审计 ECG 基础模型编码的生理知识。

papers.title: Medical world models in healthcare: foundations, applications, and challenges for trustworthy clinical translation
papers.abstract_en: Medical world models offer a framework for extending medical artificial intelligence beyond static prediction by representing evolving patient states and modelling how they change over time and in response to clinical interventions. This Review defines the conceptual boundaries, technical foundations, application domains, and evidence requirements of the field through a structured narrative synthesis with reproducible evidence mapping.We screened 1,455 unique records and assembled a corpus of 98 sources, including 14 studies that met a strict empirical definition of a medical world model. The field is organised around four capabilities: patient state representation, temporal dynamics modelling, intervention-conditioned simulation, and clinician-supervised planning. Evidence spans medical imaging, longitudinal electronic health records, treatment response modelling, physiological and multimodal state modelling, ultrasound and surgical interaction, and population and health-system simulation; clinical digital twins are treated as a cross-cutting integration framework.Current studies provide early evidence of technical feasibility for trajectory forecasting and comparison of candidate interventions, but most remain retrospective, task-specific, or preclinical. The evidence base is further limited by incomplete longitudinal intervention data, inconsistent action semantics, limited causal identifiability, long-horizon error accumulation, inadequate uncertainty estimation, and limited external validation. Clinical translation will therefore depend on precise intervention representations, robust causal and mechanistic grounding, calibrated trajectory-level uncertainty, safety-constrained planning, and prospective multicentre validation against clinically meaningful endpoints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对医疗世界模型（medical world models）进行了系统综述，定义了其概念边界、技术基础、应用领域和证据要求。通过筛选1,455条记录，纳入98篇文献，其中14篇符合严格的实证定义。该领域围绕四个核心能力组织：患者状态表示、时间动态建模、干预条件模拟和临床监督规划。当前证据显示技术可行性，但多数研究为回顾性、任务特定或临床前，面临不完整数据、动作语义不一致等挑战。
Motivation: 现有医学人工智能主要局限于静态预测，无法动态反映患者状态随时间的变化及其对临床干预的响应。本文旨在明确医疗世界模型这一新兴领域的概念框架、技术基础和应用范围，为可信临床转化奠定基础。
Method: 采用结构化叙述综合与可重复证据映射方法，系统检索并筛选文献，最终从1,455篇唯一记录中纳入98篇文献，其中14篇符合严格的实证定义。
Result: 摘要指出，当前研究在轨迹预测和候选干预比较方面展示了早期技术可行性，但大多数仍为回顾性、任务特定或临床前。证据基础受限于不完整的纵向干预数据、不一致的动作语义、有限的因果可识别性、长程误差累积、不确定估计不足以及外部验证匮乏。
Conclusion: 临床转化依赖于精确的干预表示、稳健的因果与机制基础、校准的轨迹级不确定性、安全性约束规划以及前瞻性多中心验证。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Learning from the Unseen: Offline Reinforcement Learning with Hidden Actions
papers.abstract_en: Standard offline reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms typically assume that the actions in the dataset are observed without error. However, in many real-world applications, the true actions are unobserved and only noisy proxies are available, causing existing RL methods to yield biased and potentially misleading conclusions. We study off-policy evaluation in infinite-horizon discounted Markov decision processes with hidden actions. By leveraging the next-state variable as a natural proxy for the unobserved action, we establish identification of the policy value and propose an influence-function-based estimator called LURE (Learning from the Unseen: Robust Estimator). LURE is multiply robust, remaining consistent under several combinations of correctly specified nuisance components, and is asymptotically normal, enabling valid statistical inference. To our knowledge, this is the first work to address offline RL with hidden actions. We demonstrate LURE's effectiveness through simulations and a sepsis management application using the MIMIC-III database.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了离线强化学习中动作不可观测的问题，即数据集中真实动作未知，仅有带噪声的代理变量。作者利用下一状态变量作为自然代理，提出了基于影响函数的鲁棒估计器LURE，实现了策略价值的可识别性、多重鲁棒性和渐近正态性。通过模拟实验和MIMIC-III败血症管理数据验证了方法的有效性。
Motivation: 在离线强化学习中，通常假设数据集中的动作是准确观测的，但许多实际应用中真实动作不可观测，存在噪声代理，导致现有RL方法产生偏差。本文旨在解决这一未涉及的问题。
Method: 在无限折扣马尔可夫决策过程中，利用下一状态变量作为未观测动作的代理，建立策略价值的可识别性，并提出基于影响函数的估计器LURE，该估计器具有多重鲁棒性和渐近正态性。
Result: 通过模拟实验和基于MIMIC-III数据库的败血症管理应用，验证了LURE的有效性。
Conclusion: 本文是首个处理离线RL中隐藏动作的工作，所提出的LURE估计器在多种正确设定下保持一致且可进行统计推断。

papers.title: CD-RMOT-Bench: Benchmarking the Cross-Domain Referring Multi-Object Tracking
papers.abstract_en: Referring multi-object tracking (RMOT) extends tracking from category-driven perception to language-guided understanding by grounding object trajectories in natural-language expressions. Despite recent progress, existing RMOT studies are largely conducted under in-domain settings, leaving the robustness of language-conditioned tracking under inevitable visual domain shifts unexplored. In this paper, we study Cross-Domain Referring Multi-Object Tracking (CD-RMOT), a new and challenging problem that evaluates whether an RMOT model trained on a labeled source domain can reliably follow natural-language expressions in an unlabeled target domain with different visual conditions. To support systematic study, we construct CD-RMOT-Bench, a unified benchmark that combines real clear-domain referring tracking data, aligned digital-twin variants, and real adverse-domain videos. CD-RMOT-Bench enables both controlled weather/viewpoint shift analysis and realistic synthetic-real transfer evaluation under a shared RMOT protocol. Further, we provide a Query-Centric Adaptation (QCA) framework, designed to stabilize the query space that bridges visual trajectories and referring expressions. Extensive experiments reveal that domain shifts severely degrade RMOT performance, where the failure is not merely caused by object detection errors but more critically by unstable expression-conditioned temporal association and target selection. QCA establishes a strong baseline, while CD-RMOT-Bench opens a new direction for robust language-guided tracking across visual domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出跨域指代多目标跟踪（CD-RMOT）问题，构建统一基准CD-RMOT-Bench，包含真实清晰域、数字孪生变体和真实恶劣域视频，并设计查询中心自适应（QCA）框架。实验表明领域偏移严重降低性能，主要源于不稳定的表达条件时间关联和目标选择。
Motivation: 现有RMOT研究多在同域设置下进行，未考虑视觉域偏移对语言引导跟踪鲁棒性的影响，本文首次系统研究跨域RMOT。
Method: 构建CD-RMOT-Bench基准，包含真实清晰域、数字孪生变体和真实恶劣域视频，并提出查询中心自适应（QCA）框架以稳定连接视觉轨迹与指代表达的查询空间。
Result: 领域偏移严重降低RMOT性能，失败主因并非检测错误，而是表达条件时间关联和目标选择不稳定。QCA建立强基线。
Conclusion: CD-RMOT-Bench开辟了跨域语言引导跟踪的新方向，为后续研究提供基准。

papers.title: WHTMix: Efficient Stereo Depth Estimation via Walsh-Hadamard Token Mixing
papers.abstract_en: Stereo depth estimation for driving, robotics and augmented reality must run at high resolution under tight latency budgets, yet in transformer-based matchers the global self-attention that aggregates scene context grows quadratically with the number of pixels and comes to dominate runtime. We show that the joint self-attention stage of a stereo transformer, whose role is to spread context across both views, can be replaced by a data-independent Walsh-Hadamard token mixer that mixes tokens globally in the transform domain at log-linear cost, while the data-dependent cross-attention that performs left-right correspondence is retained. On synthetic driving data the mixer matches the attention baseline in end-point error while reducing model compute by a factor of 2.46 and single-image inference latency by a factor of 2.65. A complexity analysis shows the benefit is governed by the ratio of sequence length to channel width, which explains why high-resolution stereo matching is a particularly favorable setting and why classification transformers are not; we confirm this token-to-channel scaling on non-stereo long-sequence benchmarks. Furthermore, we introduce a hybrid log-disparity loss function designed to up-weight small-disparity pixels corresponding to long-range objects. This approach reduces the error on distant objects without incurring any additional computational overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对立体深度估计中Transformer自注意力计算量随像素数二次增长的问题，提出用数据无关的Walsh-Hadamard token混合器替换联合自注意力阶段，在保持数据依赖的交叉注意力进行左右视差匹配的同时，以对数线性成本实现全局上下文混合。在合成驾驶数据上，该方法在端点误差上与注意力基线持平，但模型计算量减少2.46倍，单图推理延迟降低2.65倍。此外，引入混合对数视差损失函数，在不增加计算开销的情况下提升远处物体的估计精度。
Motivation: 立体深度估计在高分辨率下要求低延迟，但基于Transformer的匹配器中全局自注意力计算量随像素数二次增长，成为运行时间的瓶颈。
Method: 提出WHTMix：用Walsh-Hadamard变换（数据无关的全局token混合器）替代立体Transformer中的联合自注意力阶段，保留数据依赖的交叉注意力；并设计混合对数视差损失函数，对远距离小视差像素赋予更高权重。
Result: 在合成驾驶数据集上，WHTMix的端点误差与注意力基线持平，但模型计算量减少2.46倍，推理延迟降低2.65倍；远距离物体误差降低，且无额外计算开销。复杂度分析表明收益取决于序列长度与通道宽度之比，解释了高分辨率立体匹配的适用性及分类Transformer的不适用。
Conclusion: Walsh-Hadamard token混合器可有效替代立体Transformer中的全局自注意力，显著降低计算和延迟，尤其适合高分辨率立体匹配场景；混合对数视差损失进一步改善远距离物体估计。

papers.title: Beyond Single-Episode Optimization: Sliding-Window Aware Generative Auto-Bidding for Long-Term Advertising Effectiveness
papers.abstract_en: Auto-bidding systems optimize bids to maximize value under efficiency constraints such as Cost-Per-Action (CPA). Existing methods treat each day as an independent episode. However, many advertisers produce value so sparsely that per-day efficiency ratios become statistically unreliable, undermining advertiser retention. Platforms therefore evaluate window-level efficiency over sliding windows of $W{=}7$ days, ensuring fair evaluation and long-term advertising effectiveness. This creates cross-episode coupling: each day's bidding decisions affect up to $W$ overlapping windows, so setting daily targets requires anticipating future market conditions. We propose SWAG-Bid (Sliding-Window Aware Generative Auto-Bidding), a hierarchical framework decomposing this challenge into episode-level planning and step-level execution. The planner uses a Masked Trajectory Model to forecast markets and generate candidate plans, scored across all overlapping windows by Multi-Window Model Predictive Control Sampling (MWMS) with exponential confidence decay. The controller adjusts reliance on this guidance through a state-adaptive gate, Per-Step Gated Adaptive Layer Normalization (PSG-AdaLN), complemented by Return-to-Go and Cost-to-Go channels carrying budget and constraint information. Experiments on AuctionNet-Sparse and online A/B tests on AliExpress show that SWAG-Bid achieves competitive constraint satisfaction and value acquisition under sliding-window evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对自动出价系统中滑动窗口评估导致跨回合耦合的问题，提出SWAG-Bid层次框架。该框架包含一个掩码轨迹模型规划器和一个基于自适应门控的控制器，通过多窗口模型预测控制采样评分，在AuctionNet-Sparse和AliExpress在线实验中实现了有竞争力的约束满足和长期价值获取。
Motivation: 现有自动出价方法将每天作为独立回合优化，但稀疏价值广告主的日均效率比统计不可靠，平台采用滑动窗口评估导致决策跨窗口耦合，需要预测未来市场条件。
Method: 提出SWAG-Bid层次框架：规划器使用Masked Trajectory Model预测市场并生成候选计划，通过Multi-Window Model Predictive Control Sampling (MWMS) 结合指数置信衰减评分；控制器采用Per-Step Gated Adaptive Layer Normalization (PSG-AdaLN) 状态自适应门控，并引入Return-to-Go和Cost-to-Go通道传递预算和约束信息。
Result: 在AuctionNet-Sparse数据集和AliExpress在线A/B测试中，SWAG-Bid在滑动窗口评估下实现有竞争力的约束满足和价值获取。
Conclusion: 论文强调滑动窗口感知对长期广告效果的关键作用，所提框架有效处理了跨回合耦合问题。

papers.title: Neurai-VN Benchmark: Standardized Machine Learning Models for Multimodal Digital Phenotyping in Mental Health Classification
papers.abstract_en: Digital phenotyping (DP) using smartphones and wearable devices has shown considerable potential for mental health monitoring. However, progress remains difficult to evaluate due to heterogeneous datasets, inconsistent preprocessing pipelines. In this study, we present a reproducible benchmark built upon the Neurai-VN dataset, a high-resolution, multimodal dataset comprising passive sensing and active assessment from wearable and smartphone devices, collected from 100 Vietnamese adults over two weeks. The benchmark defines four clinically relevant binary classification tasks evaluated using standardized subject-wise cross-validation. Representative linear, tree-based, and neural baseline models are evaluated across predefined feature configurations. Mean subject-level F1 scores across five cross-validation folds reached 0.71 for Healthy Control vs. Depression and Healthy Control vs. Clinical, while Healthy Control vs. Anxiety and Depression vs. Anxiety achieved 0.69 and 0.56, respectively. These benchmark results provide reproducible baselines for future research on multimodal DP for mental health classification tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文基于Neurai-VN数据集构建了一个可重复的数字表型（digital phenotyping）基准，该数据集包含来自100名越南成年人的可穿戴设备和智能手机的被动传感与主动评估数据。基准定义了四个临床相关的二分类任务，并使用标准化subject-wise交叉验证评估了线性、树和神经网络基线模型。平均subject-level F1分数在0.56到0.71之间，为多模态精神健康分类提供了可重复基线。
Motivation: 现有数字表型研究因数据集异构和预处理不一致而难以评估进展，需要标准化的可重复基准。
Method: 基于Neurai-VN数据集，定义四个精神健康二分类任务（如健康对照vs抑郁等），采用预定义特征配置，使用subject-wise交叉验证评估线性、树和神经网络基线模型。
Result: 平均subject-level F1分数：健康对照vs抑郁和健康对照vs临床为0.71，健康对照vs焦虑为0.69，抑郁vs焦虑为0.56。
Conclusion: 基准结果为未来多模态数字表型精神健康分类研究提供了可重复基线，指出了当前方法的性能水平。

papers.title: Decision-Level Hijacking: Injecting Cognitive Bias into Large Language Models via Bit-Flip Attacks
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have been widely applied in high-stakes decision-making scenarios such as corporate strategy, and users are increasingly relying on their outputs. However, the deep integration of open-source model sharing ecosystems with LLM-powered critical decision-making applications also introduces critical risks: if an attacker can manipulate the model's cognitive stance, they can indirectly influence the judgments and actions of downstream decision-makers. This paper defines such threats as decision-level hijacking. Existing attacks fail to achieve targeted cognitive manipulation without triggering prohibited content or degrading model functionality. To fill this gap, this paper reveals that Bit-Flip Attacks (BFAs) can serve as an attack vector for inducing decision-level hijacking, requiring no real-time interaction or control over the training process, and only a minimal number of weight bits need to be flipped after deployment to achieve stealthy, low-cost, and persistent cognitive manipulation. Therefore, we propose CogBias, a cognitive bias injection framework for LLMs. CogBias converts subjective preferences into optimization signals via a differentiable sentiment evaluator, uses a multi-objective loss to jointly constrain multiple dimensions, and constructs BitScout to locate critical bits, achieving targeted cognitive intervention under an ultra-sparse flip budget. Experiments on Llama-3.2-3B, Mistral-7B, and Qwen2.5-14B, as well as on the commercial recommendation and controversial factual topic scenarios, demonstrate that flipping only a small number of bits stably induces significant stance shifts on target topics, while the impact on non-target tasks and overall output distribution is limited. This work demonstrates that minute perturbations to low-level weight data suffice to undermine the high-level value alignment of LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文定义并研究了针对大语言模型的决策级劫持（decision-level hijacking）威胁，即攻击者通过操纵模型的认知立场来间接影响下游决策者的判断。论文揭示位翻转攻击（Bit-Flip Attacks, BFAs）可以作为实现这种劫持的攻击向量，并提出了CogBias框架，通过可微情感评估器将主观偏好转化为优化信号，使用多目标损失联合约束多个维度，并构建BitScout定位关键位，在极稀疏翻转预算下实现定向认知干预。实验在Llama-3.2-3B、Mistral-7B和Qwen2.5-14B上以及商业推荐和有争议事实话题场景中，证明仅翻转少量位即可稳定诱导目标话题上的显著立场偏移，同时对非目标任务和整体输出分布影响有限。
Motivation: 现有攻击方法无法在不触发禁止内容或降低模型功能的情况下实现定向认知操控，而开放模型共享生态系统与关键决策应用的深度集成带来了风险：攻击者可以操纵模型的认知立场，从而间接影响下游决策者的判断和行动。
Method: 提出CogBias框架，包含一个可微情感评估器将主观偏好转化为优化信号，使用多目标损失联合约束多个维度，并构建BitScout定位关键位，通过位翻转攻击实现超稀疏翻转预算下的定向认知干预。
Result: 在Llama-3.2-3B、Mistral-7B和Qwen2.5-14B模型上以及商业推荐和有争议事实话题场景中，仅翻转少量位即可稳定诱导显著立场偏移，同时非目标任务和整体输出分布影响有限。
Conclusion: 该工作表明，对底层权重数据的微小扰动足以破坏LLM的高层价值对齐，但攻击场景局限于部署后的位翻转，且需特定目标话题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SecDrift: Measuring Sector-Conditioned Security Drift in AI-Generated Code
papers.abstract_en: LLMs are increasingly used for code generation in critical infrastructure, yet the security effect of domain-specific prompting is understudied. We present SecDrift, a benchmark measuring sector-conditioned security drift: the change in static-analysis vulnerability rates when prompts are conditioned on industry contexts versus neutral baselines. We evaluate 7 LLMs (6 producing analyzable code) across 8 CISA critical infrastructure sectors and 9 CWE categories with 5 replicates (5,355 evaluations), using a 5-dimension transformation with a matched-baseline condition that holds the task fixed while substituting only domain terminology. Industry prompts naively appear more secure (14.0% vs. 11.4%, -2.7pp), but the gap is not statistically significant (Fisher's exact p = 0.24, Cohen's h = -0.08) and is a composition artifact of two CWE categories: excluding CWE-502 and CWE-22 eliminates and slightly reverses it (+0.4pp, p = 1.00). A mixed-effects logistic regression confirms sector identity is not a moderator and localizes the only detectable condition effect to those two vulnerability types. 0 of 8 sectors show drift distinguishable from baseline, corrected or uncorrected (|h| < 0.15). A placebo on two non-CISA sectors (e-commerce, online education) reproduces the CISA industry rate almost exactly (10.5% vs. 11.4%, p = 0.63): the small pooled pattern reflects generic industry-framing specificity, not critical-infrastructure identity. In contrast, model selection has a large and consistent effect: among full-output models vulnerability rates range from 11.6% to 16.1%, and these differences persist across conditions. Model choice, not prompt framing, is the more reliable security lever. We release the framework, prompts, generated code, findings, human-validation verdicts, and analysis scripts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SecDrift基准，系统评估AI生成代码在行业特定提示下的安全漂移。在8个CISA关键基础设施部门和9个CWE类别上测试7个LLM（5,355次评估），发现行业提示看似更安全（14.0% vs 11.4%）但统计不显著，差异源自两个CWE类别；模型选择的影响远大于提示框架。
Motivation: 大语言模型越来越用于关键基础设施代码生成，但领域特定提示对安全性的影响尚未被充分研究。
Method: 构建SecDrift基准，采用5维度变换和匹配基线条件（保持任务固定仅替换领域术语），在8个CISA部门和9个CWE类别上评估7个LLM（其中6个产出可分析代码），进行5次重复（共5,355次评估）。

papers.title: Everyone is unique: Towards Behaviorally Heterogeneous Negotiation Dialogue Systems for Debt Collection
papers.abstract_en: Debt collection is a critical negotiation task in the financial industry, with strong practical relevance and exceptional academic value as a behaviorally rich, high-stakes testbed for human-centered dialogue systems. While large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in dialogue and negotiation, effectively evaluating their performance in this complex scenarios remains a major challenge: existing benchmarks uniformly assume users to be static, rational agents with fixed preferences, failing to capture the rich behavioral heterogeneity inherent in real-world debt collection. To bridge this gap, we propose DebtBench, the first public persona-enriched debt collection benchmark, that highlights behavioral heterogeneity in negotiation. Moreover, we develop DebtGPT, a debt collection agent trained to jointly optimize financial recovery and interaction experience. Our experimental results, using 16 state-of-the-art LLMs, find that most existing models struggle in this complex but realistic scenarios, whereas DebtGPT outperforms all open-source baselines and achieves performance on par with GPT-4o. The code and data are available at https://github.com/YYuHhhh/DebtNegotiation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DebtBench，第一个包含用户个性特征的债务催收协商基准，强调行为异质性；同时开发DebtGPT，一个联合优化金融回收和交互体验的债务催收代理。实验表明大多数LLM在此场景中表现不佳，而DebtGPT优于所有开源基线，性能与GPT-4o相当。
Motivation: 现有基准假设用户是静态理性代理，未捕捉真实债务催收中的行为异质性，导致LLM评估不准确。
Method: 构建DebtBench基准，包含用户个性特征；训练DebtGPT代理，联合优化金融回收和交互体验。
Result: 在16个SOTA LLM上的实验表明，大多数模型在复杂真实场景中表现不佳，DebtGPT优于所有开源基线，与GPT-4o相当。
Conclusion: 摘要强调行为异质性在协商系统评估中的重要性，并提供DebtBench和DebtGPT作为资源。

papers.title: TopoGR: Revealing and Preserving Latent Structure of Semantic ID in Generative Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Semantic ID-based generative recommendation tokenizes each item into a sequence of discrete semantic IDs and predicts the next item by generating semantic IDs. However, existing methods typically regard SIDs as independent discrete symbols, while often overlooking the topology of the learned semantic ID space. We identify a structural mismatch between tokenization and generation: the tokenizer learns a structured code space with semantic neighborhood relations, whereas the generator consumes semantic ID tokens as independent categorical symbols. Consequently, item relatedness is reduced to exact semantic ID overlap, making it difficult to identify semantically similar items whose semantic IDs do not overlap. To address this issue, we propose TopoGR, a topology-preserving generative recommendation framework based on Bit-decomposable Semantic ID(Binary SID). Each Binary SID is learned in a bit-decomposable form and can be deterministically converted to a standard integer SID, while exposing an explicit Hamming geometry. TopoGR exploits this topology at three stages: binary SID features preserve Hamming proximity at the input layer; Hamming soft targets inject topology-aware supervision; and Hamming-consistent reranking aligns candidate items with the predicted binary prototype during inference. We further verify that the Hamming topology can capture item relatedness beyond exact SID matching. Experiments on four benchmark datasets show that TopoGR consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art baselines in recommendation performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对生成式推荐中语义ID的拓扑结构被忽视的问题，提出TopoGR框架。该框架使用可分解二进制语义ID（Binary SID）暴露汉明几何拓扑，并在输入层、训练监督和推理重排三个阶段利用该拓扑。实验表明在四个基准数据集上一致优于现有最优方法。
Motivation: 现有方法将语义ID视为独立离散符号，忽略其学习到的拓扑结构，导致生成器无法识别语义相似但ID不重叠的物品。
Method: 提出TopoGR，基于可分解二进制语义ID（Binary SID）：输入层使用二进制特征保留汉明邻近性；训练时使用汉明软目标注入拓扑感知监督；推理时使用汉明一致的重排序对齐候选项与预测的二进制原型。
Result: 在四个基准数据集上，TopoGR一致优于现有最优基线方法，验证了汉明拓扑能够捕获超越精确ID匹配的物品相关性。
Conclusion: 汉明拓扑能够有效捕获物品相关性，改进生成式推荐性能。

papers.title: Leveraging Semantic Maps for City-Scale Cross-View Localization
papers.abstract_en: We want robots to localize in previously untraversed environments against commonly available prior data. Rich semantic data available from OpenStreetMap can be useful in this task. However, existing methods either ignore this semantic information, directly matching panoramas and overhead imagery, or dramatically compress the semantic information, working with a small set of fixed classes. To leverage this rich semantic information, two challenges need to be overcome. First, useful semantic information needs to be extracted from the robot's egocentric observations. Second, the observed information must be quickly associated with the large prior semantic map (e.g., up to 628 km^2). We show that VLMs are effective at both extracting relevant landmarks from panoramas, and identifying feasible correspondences between these landmarks and prior overhead landmarks. However, using VLMs to propose all correspondences scales poorly as the number of mapped landmarks increases. Instead, we propose distilling a lightweight matcher from a VLM which computes correspondences for all entities in a map. We use this output to form an observation likelihood which is fused over time with a Bayes filter to create a time series of pose estimates. To support further investigation into generalizable cross-view methods that leverage semantic information, we release a dataset of extracted semantics and evaluation trajectories spanning eleven environments, including panoramas we collected in a snowstorm and at night in Boston. We demonstrate our method, trained on a single city's fair-weather data, generalizes across location, lighting, weather, and other challenges. Code and datasets are available at https://efahnestock.github.io/loci/.
papers.comment: Equal contribution by Ethan Fahnestock and Erick Fuentes. 13 pages, 7 figures, and 5 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对机器人在未遍历环境中利用OpenStreetMap的丰富语义数据进行跨视图定位的问题，提出通过视觉语言模型（VLM）从全景图中提取地标并与先验语义地图匹配的方法。为了应对大规模地图中匹配效率低的问题，作者从VLM中蒸馏出一个轻量级的匹配器，用于计算所有实体间的对应关系，并结合贝叶斯滤波器生成时序位姿估计。该方法仅在单个城市晴好数据上训练，却能泛化到不同地点、光照、天气（包括雪暴和夜间）等场景。论文还发布了涵盖11个环境的语义提取数据集和评估轨迹。
Motivation: 现有跨视图定位方法要么忽略语义信息直接匹配全景与俯视图像，要么仅使用少量固定类别压缩语义信息，无法充分利用OpenStreetMap等丰富的语义数据。
Method: 利用视觉语言模型（VLM）从机器人全景观测中提取相关地标，并识别与先验俯视地标的可行对应关系；为提升大规模地图中的匹配效率，从VLM蒸馏出一个轻量级匹配器，快速计算所有地图实体的对应关系；以此构建观测似然，并通过贝叶斯滤波器随时间融合生成位姿估计序列。
Result: 该方法仅在单个城市晴好数据上训练，能泛化到不同地点、光照、天气（包括雪暴和夜间）等挑战环境，展示了跨场景的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 论文强调利用VLM提取语义并进行蒸馏匹配可以有效利用先验语义地图，实现城市规模的跨视图定位，同时指出了数据集和代码的开源价值。

papers.title: ObliCity: A Benchmark and Baseline for Roof-to-Ground Projection Displacement Correction
papers.abstract_en: Oblique-view urban remote sensing imagery inevitably exhibits geometric projection displacements between building roofs and footprints, leading to significant distortions in spatial structure. Existing approaches either ignore these deformations or handle them implicitly within segmentation-based frameworks, where progress is dominated by general segmentation advances rather than improvements in geometric correction. In this work, we explicitly define roof-to-footprint offset vector (RFOV) extraction as an independent learning task that decouples geometric alignment from semantic segmentation. To support this task, we introduce the Oblique City dataset (ObliCity), the first large-scale benchmark that integrates high-resolution UAV imagery and globally distributed satellite data, covering diverse city morphologies and camera perspectives. Methodologically, we reformulate DragOSM into DragRoof, an ODE-based framework inspired by human annotation behavior. By simulating the continuous process of dragging roofs toward their footprints, DragRoof learns deterministic, geometry-consistent offset fields and adaptively determines convergence through an end token. Extensive experiments on ObliCity demonstrate that DragRoof achieves state-of-the-art RFOV extraction performance, requiring fewer inference steps while delivering superior directional and length accuracy. Our dataset and model establish a principled foundation for studying projection displacement correction in oblique remote sensing imagery. The source code and dataset will be avaliable at https://github.com/likaiucas/DragRoof.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出屋顶到足迹偏移向量（RFOV）提取作为独立学习任务，并发布首个大规模基准数据集 ObliCity，包含高分辨率无人机影像和全球卫星数据。方法 DragRoof 基于 ODE 模拟从屋顶到足迹的连续拖动过程，学习几何一致的偏移场，通过终止标记自适应收敛。实验表明 DragRoof 在 RFOV 提取上达到最优，推理步数更少且方向与长度精度更高。
Motivation: 倾斜视角城市遥感影像中建筑屋顶与足迹之间存在几何投影位移，现有方法或忽略该变形，或在分割框架中隐式处理，进步依赖于通用分割改进而非几何校正本身。
Method: 将 RFOV 提取定义为独立的学习任务，解耦几何对齐与语义分割；构建 ObliCity 数据集；提出 DragRoof 框架，基于 ODE 系统模拟人工标注中拖动屋顶至足迹的连续过程，学习确定性、几何一致的偏移场，并通过终止标记自适应确定收敛。
Result: 在 ObliCity 数据集上，DragRoof 实现 RFOV 提取的最优性能，推理步数更少，方向与长度精度更高。
Conclusion: 该数据集和模型为倾斜遥感影像中的投影位移校正研究建立了原则性基础。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: VaLiDRec: Variable-Length LLM-Aligned Semantic IDs for Generative Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Generative recommendation commonly represents items using fixed-length semantic identifiers (SIDs) constructed through clustering and quantization. However, these artificial codes may overcompress item semantics, remain misaligned with pretrained LLM vocabularies, and require costly autoregressive decoding. In light of this, we propose VaLiDRec, a generative recommendation framework based on variable-length, LLM-aligned semantic identifiers. VaLiDRec constructs SIDs directly from informative native LLM vocabulary tokens via token importance estimation, semantic-quality-aware pruning, and collision-aware refinement, allowing identifier lengths to adapt to item semantic complexity. To model user preferences, VaLiDRec incorporates graph-aware soft prompts and reformulates recommendation as token-set prediction with token-level item scoring, eliminating autoregressive SID generation and beam search. Experiments on four real-world datasets show that VaLiDRec consistently outperforms strong sequential and generative recommendation baselines across all evaluation metrics. It further achieves superior zero-shot item cold-start performance and 87.49$\times$ faster inference than LC-Rec. These results demonstrate that LLM-native variable-length semantic identifiers provide a more expressive and efficient paradigm for generative recommendation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出VaLiDRec，一种基于可变长度、与LLM对齐的语义标识符的生成式推荐框架。通过从LLM原生词汇中构建标识符，并采用图感知软提示和令牌级评分，避免了自回归解码和束搜索。实验表明，VaLiDRec在四个真实数据集上优于现有基线，并实现零样本冷启动和87.49倍推理加速。
Motivation: 现有固定长度语义标识符可能过度压缩语义，与预训练LLM词汇不一致，且需要昂贵的自回归解码。
Method: 通过令牌重要性估计、语义质量感知剪枝和冲突感知细化，直接从LLM原生词汇中构建可变长度语义标识符；使用图感知软提示建模用户偏好，并采用令牌集预测和令牌级项目评分。
Result: 在四个真实数据集上，VaLiDRec在所有评估指标上持续优于强基线；零样本冷启动性能优越，推理速度比LC-Rec快87.49倍。
Conclusion: LLM原生的可变长度语义标识符为生成式推荐提供了更具表达力和更高效的范式。

papers.title: A Unified Algorithmic Framework for Hybrid Reinforcement Learning in Tabular MDPs with Shifted Transition Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: This paper investigates a hybrid reinforcement learning setting in tabular Markov Decision Processes (MDPs), where an agent aims to learn an optimal policy by combining online interactions with a target environment and offline data from a source environment. A central challenge is that offline data may be collected from outdated environments with shifted transition dynamics, making naive integration of historical data ineffective. To address this, we propose a unified algorithmic framework featuring two algorithms: MIN-UCB-VI for regret minimization and MAX-LCB-VI for best policy identification. Both algorithms leverage fine-grained bias information to more effectively exploit offline data under general transition shifts. We provide theoretical guarantees for our framework, including both instance-dependent and independent upper bounds on regret and sub-optimality gap. Furthermore, we establish matching lower bounds to demonstrate the optimality of our approach and validate our theoretical findings through extensive experiments.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Algorithmic Separation between Constant-Depth and Logarithmic-Depth Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Despite the empirical advantages of deep networks over shallow ones, theoretical depth separations largely concern approximation power, while algorithmic results are mostly limited to comparisons between two- and three-layer networks. In this work, we prove the first algorithmic separation between constant-depth and logarithmic-depth networks. Specifically, we identify a class of Boolean functions with hierarchically structured Fourier spectra that logarithmic-depth networks can learn efficiently using layerwise coordinate descent by reconstructing the spectra hierarchically and adaptively. We also exhibit a subclass for which every constant-depth, polynomial-width network with sufficiently regular activations and controlled spectral norms must incur constant $L^2$ approximation error under the uniform distribution over the hypercube.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明了常数深度神经网络与对数深度神经网络之间首个算法分离结果：存在一类具有分层傅里叶谱的布尔函数，对数深度网络可通过分层坐标下降高效学习，而所有常数深度、多项式宽度、激活函数正则且谱范数受控的网络在超立方体均匀分布下必然产生常数L2近似误差。
Motivation: 现有深度分离理论主要关注逼近能力，算法层面的结果仅限于两层与三层网络对比，缺乏对更广泛深度范围的算法分离认识。
Method: 利用布尔函数的分层傅里叶谱结构，设计基于坐标下降的分层自适应重构算法，证明对数深度网络可高效学习；同时通过构造下界证明常数深度网络的局限性。
Result: 对数深度网络能高效学习该类函数，而常数深度网络在均匀分布下L2误差为常数，实现算法层面的严格分离。
Conclusion: 该工作首次在算法意义上区分常数深度与对数深度网络，揭示深度对学习效率的关键影响。

papers.title: RIDGE: An Autonomous Framework for Validation and Method Discovery in LLM-Generated Option Pricing
papers.abstract_en: Automated code generation is becoming an important tool in quantitative finance, where large language models can generate option pricing implementations directly from mathematical model specifications. Validating such implementations, however, requires considerably more than conventional software testing: numerical pricing methods must remain mathematically consistent, numerically stable, and reliable across a wide range of model parameters. We introduce RIDGE, an autonomous validation framework in which generated pricing implementations are subjected to structured no-arbitrage tests, stress tests, benchmark comparisons, and consistency checks. Validation evidence is interpreted diagnostically, while the resulting knowledge is accumulated in a repository and reused across models and successive validation iterations. This enables systematic refinement of both the pricing implementation and the validation methodology. The framework is applied to five stochastic volatility models. Across these studies, all detected implementation defects are removed and, in two cases, the validation process itself leads to new semi-analytic pricing methodologies. The supplementary material is available in the GitHub repository: https://github.com/ShQiangLiu/ridge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RIDGE，一个用于验证大语言模型生成的期权定价代码的自主框架。该框架对生成的定价实现进行结构化无套利测试、压力测试、基准比较和一致性检查，并将验证证据用于诊断和积累知识。在五个随机波动率模型上应用后，所有检测到的实现缺陷均被移除，并在两个案例中发现了新的半解析定价方法。
Motivation: 大语言模型生成的期权定价代码需要远超常规软件测试的验证，因为数值定价方法必须在数学上一致、数值稳定且跨参数范围可靠。现有验证方法不足。
Method: 提出RIDGE框架，包含结构化无套利测试、压力测试、基准比较和一致性检查；验证证据进行诊断性解释，知识积累在仓库中并跨模型和迭代复用，实现定价实现和验证方法的系统性改进。
Result: 在五个随机波动率模型上应用后，所有检测到的实现缺陷被移除，两个案例中验证过程本身导致了新的半解析定价方法。
Conclusion: RIDGE框架能够有效验证和改进LLM生成的期权定价代码，并能自主发现新的定价方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LGFNet: A CTC-Guided Local-Global Fusion Framework for Single-Channel Sleep Staging
papers.abstract_en: Sleep staging remains challenging due to long-range temporal dependencies, ambiguous stage transitions-particularly in N1-and substantial distribution shifts across subjects, sampling rates, and EEG montages. These difficulties are further amplified in single-channel, low-latency scenarios required by wearable and real-world applications. To address these issues, we propose LGFNet, a CTC-guided sequence-to-sequence framework for robust sleep staging. LGFNet introduces a Local-Global Fusion encoder that jointly models fine-grained temporal dynamics and long-range sleep structure, overcoming the limitations of conventional serial hybrid architectures. A CTC-Attention joint training paradigm is adopted to unify temporal alignment with context-dependent modeling, enabling more accurate recognition of stage boundaries and transitions. Furthermore, a three-stage decoding strategy is devised, leveraging CTC-guided decoding and Viterbi-based smoothing to reduce error accumulation and enforce physiological consistency. Extensive cross-dataset evaluations on five public benchmarks demonstrate that LGFNet consistently outperforms state-of-the-art single-channel methods. In particular, on Sleep-EDF-78, LGFNet surpasses DMIN by +1.27% accuracy, +1.74% macro-F1, and +1.93% kappa, with pronounced gains on N1 and transition segments, highlighting its robustness and strong generalization across diverse sampling rates, montages, and recording environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LGFNet，一个基于CTC引导的序列到序列框架，用于单通道睡眠分期。该框架引入局部-全局融合编码器联合建模细粒度时间动态和长程睡眠结构，采用CTC-Attention联合训练范式对齐时间对齐与上下文依赖建模，并设计三阶段解码策略减少误差累积。在五个公开数据集上的跨数据集评估中，LGFNet持续超越现有单通道方法，在Sleep-EDF-78上相比DMIN提升了准确率1.27%、macro-F1 1.74%和kappa 1.93%，尤其在N1和转换段上表现突出。
Motivation: 睡眠分期面临长程时间依赖、模糊阶段转换（尤其是N1）以及跨被试、采样率和导联的分布偏移挑战，在可穿戴设备所需的单通道低延迟场景下困难进一步放大。
Method: 提出CTC引导的序列到序列框架LGFNet，包含局部-全局融合编码器（Local-Global Fusion encoder）同时建模细粒度时间动态和长程睡眠结构，采用CTC-Attention联合训练范式统一时间对齐与上下文依赖建模，并设计三阶段解码策略（CTC引导解码+Viterbi平滑）减少误差积累并强制生理一致性。
Result: 在Sleep-EDF-78上，LGFNet超越DMIN，准确率提升1.27%，macro-F1提升1.74%，kappa提升1.93%，在N1和转换段上收益显著。在五个公开基准的跨数据集评估中一致优于现有单通道方法。
Conclusion: LGFNet在单通道、低延迟场景下展现出鲁棒性和强泛化能力，能适应不同采样率、导联和记录环境。

papers.title: Rethinking CD: A Reproducibility Study and Extension on the Ineffectiveness of Contrastive Decoding at Mitigating Object Hallucinations in MLLMs
papers.abstract_en: Contrastive decoding (CD) has been proposed as a training-free strategy for mitigating object hallucinations in multimodal large language models (MLLMs), with reported gains on benchmarks such as POPE. However, recent work has questioned whether these gains reflect genuine improvements in visual grounding. In this study, we reproduce and extend the findings of "The Mirage of Performance Gains: Why Contrastive Decoding Fails to Mitigate Object Hallucinations in MLLMs." Specifically, we test the claim that CD induces a unidirectional output distribution shift in discriminative datasets and examine its generalizability across datasets. We also verify that the adaptive plausibility constraint (APC) reduces sampling to greedy search on both discriminative and generative benchmarks. Beyond reproduction, we rigorously study the effects of CD across generative and discriminative datasets. We conduct several experiments that provide additional insights: we analyze the logit distributions induced by different CD strategies on generative datasets, propose a proxy method and compare its performance against CD techniques, and investigate how hallucination signals propagate through each layer of the expert and amateur models. Experimental results across MME, POPE, and CHAIR using LLaVA and Qwen validate the original claims and show that the apparent improvements from CD are often spurious and do not consistently translate into stronger visual grounding for reducing hallucinations. These findings challenge the effectiveness of current contrastive decoding strategies and motivate the development of more reliable approaches for mitigating hallucinations in MLLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文复现并扩展了关于对比解码（Contrastive Decoding, CD）在多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）中缓解物体幻觉无效性的研究。实验表明，CD在POPE等基准上的性能提升是虚假的，并未真正改善视觉 grounding，且自适应似然约束（APC）将采样退化为贪心搜索。
Motivation: 先前工作声称CD能无训练缓解MLLMs的物体幻觉，但近期研究对此提出质疑；本文旨在严格复现并验证这些质疑，并进一步分析CD在不同数据集和模型上的表现。
Method: 在LLaVA和Qwen模型上，对MME、POPE、CHAIR基准进行复现实验；分析CD策略下的logit分布、提出代理方法比较、以及研究幻觉信号在专家和业余模型各层的传播。
Result: 验证了原始主张：CD带来的改进往往是虚假的，不能一致地转化为更强的视觉 grounding 以减少幻觉。
Conclusion: 当前的对比解码策略在缓解MLLMs幻觉方面效果有限，需要开发更可靠的方法。

papers.title: Lloyd's $K$-Means Clustering Algorithm Is Frank-Wolfe in Disguise
papers.abstract_en: Lloyd's $K$-means algorithm, also known as naïve $K$-means, is a widely used ad hoc optimization heuristic, designed to minimize the sum of squared errors (SSE) across all $K$-partitions of a dataset via iterative cluster refinement. In this work, we establish a novel connection between Lloyd's algorithm and the Frank-Wolfe (FW) algorithm, a prominent first-order method for projection-free optimization. We demonstrate that Lloyd's algorithm is a special case of FW. Leveraging recent advances in FW methods for concave objectives, we derive a non-asymptotic $\mathcal{O}(1/t)$ convergence rate to a local minimum of the SSE objective. To account for empty clusters, an outcome possible under Lloyd's greedy assignment, we develop an FW variant for semismooth objectives while retaining the same convergence rate that is solely controlled by the initial SSE value. We illustrate our findings with a simulation study for spherical Gaussian mixtures and a real-world image segmentation dataset.
papers.journal_ref: AISTATS 2026, Poster 6
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示了Lloyd的K-means算法是Frank-Wolfe算法的一个特例，并利用Frank-Wolfe在凹目标上的最新进展，推导出非渐近的O(1/t)收敛率到SSE目标的局部最小值。针对空簇问题，提出了半光滑目标的Frank-Wolfe变体，保持相同收敛率。模拟和真实图像分割数据集验证了结果。
Motivation: Lloyd算法广泛使用但缺乏理论收敛保证，尤其是非凸SSE目标下的收敛率。
Method: 将Lloyd算法重新表述为Frank-Wolfe算法的一个特例，并针对可能出现的空簇问题，设计了半光滑目标的Frank-Wolfe变体。
Result: 建立了Lloyd算法与Frank-Wolfe的联系，并证明了非渐近O(1/t)收敛率到局部最小值，该收敛率仅由初始SSE值控制。
Conclusion: Lloyd算法是Frank-Wolfe的一种特殊形式，为理解其收敛性提供了新视角，但实验仅涉及模拟和图像分割。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TabRank: Chain-of-Thought Distillation for Table Re-Rankers
papers.abstract_en: The ability to retrieve relevant tables for answering questions is a key task for structured information retrieval. Multi-stage retrieval systems rely heavily on rerankers to refine candidate lists produced by efficient first-stage retrievers. As a result, neural rerankers and LLM-based reranking methods have become increasingly important due to their superior capacity for semantic understanding and reasoning compared to conventional sparse or dense retrieval models. Recently, Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) equipped with explicit chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning have shown strong improvements in ranking quality in unstructured passage retrieval. In this work, we present TabRank, a framework for training reasoning rerankers for Tabular Retrieval. We first present a comprehensive dataset of 6728 reasoning traces for tabular reranking on the Natural Questions Tables dataset. We then explore two variants of training a compact reasoning model on these reasoning traces: explicit CoT distillation and conditioning the student reranker on the teacher's reasoning trace within the prompt. We stress-test TabRank on several out-of-distribution generalization settings on diverse domains and multi-table scenarios. Our approach significantly improves performance across a variety of table retrieval datasets, increasing Acc@10 by 30.5% on HybridQA, 15.2% on SQA, 52.9% on TabFact, and 13.1% on TATQA subsets of the Multi-Table QA Benchmark compared to the base model. Notably, TabRank generalizes effectively to multi-table reasoning. Our code, data and models are available at https://github.com/AdarshSingh7647/TabRanker
