papers.title: Less Data, Better Alignment: Data-Centric Multi-Evaluator Agreement for Preference Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Research on preference optimization often varies the training objective while holding the data fixed. We instead ask whether a small, high-confidence set of on-policy responses can provide a reliable learning signal. Our method, DMAPO (Data-centric Multi-evaluator Agreement for Preference Optimization), generates candidate responses from the target policy, evaluates helpfulness, factuality, and conciseness with rubric-specialized evaluators, applies a process-critic correction, and retains only high-consensus desirable or undesirable examples. This procedure accepts 1,871 of 54,236 Mistral-7B candidates (3.45%). KTO trained on this set reaches 7.50 on MT-Bench, 95.5% length-controlled win rate against a text-davinci-003 reference, and 57.3% IFEval prompt accuracy. Independent pairwise evaluation also favors DMAPO over SimPO: GPT-4o yields a net win rate of 23.3 points on 129 held-out prompts and 24.0 points on 200 out-of-distribution LMSYS-Chat prompts; Claude Opus 4.7 yields 24.1 points on the held-out set. Changing the evaluator model or rubric alters the selected examples but has little effect on downstream performance. A second-backbone study yields a similar 3.41% acceptance rate, although its performance gains are more modest. Across these experiments, consensus filtering offers a data-efficient route to preference optimization for general instructions, at the cost of additional curation compute and dependence on evaluator judgments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DMAPO 方法，通过从目标策略生成候选响应，使用多个专业化评估器（帮助性、事实性、简洁性）和过程批评修正，仅保留高共识的样例（3.45%）。在此小数据集上训练 KTO 后，MT-Bench 得分 7.50，长度控制胜率 95.5%（对 text-davinci-003），IFEval 准确率 57.3%，且在独立成对评估中优于 SimPO。共识过滤为偏好优化提供了数据高效路径，但需额外计算并依赖评估器判断。
Motivation: 现有偏好优化研究常固定数据而改变训练目标；本文质疑是否可利用少量高置信度的 on-policy 响应提供可靠学习信号，以减少对大量数据的依赖。
Method: DMAPO 从目标策略生成候选响应，使用三个专业化评估器分别评价帮助性、事实性和简洁性，经过程批评修正后，仅保留评估器间高一致性的 desirable 或 undesirable 样例（接受率 3.45%）。
Result: 在 Mistral-7B 上，1,871/54,236 候选被保留；KTO 训练后 MT-Bench 达 7.50，LC 胜率 95.5%（对 text-davinci-003），IFEval 准确率 57.3%。GPT-4o 成对评估显示 DMAPO 净胜率 23.3 点（129 个留出提示）和 24.0 点（200 个 OOD LMSYS-Chat 提示）；Claude Opus 4.7 在留出集上净胜率 24.1 点。改变评估器或评分标准对所选集影响大但对下游性能影响小。
Conclusion: 共识过滤为通用指令的偏好优化提供了一种数据高效的路径，但以额外的筛选计算和依赖评估器判断为代价。

summary_sections.conclusion: 共识过滤为通用指令的偏好优化提供了一种数据高效的路径，但以额外的筛选计算和依赖评估器判断为代价。

papers.title: ScalableRAG: High-Quality RAG at Zero Ingestion Cost
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in RAG aim to optimize for performance by paying high ingestion costs for knowledge ingestion: building knowledge graphs or extracting SQL tables. In this work we show that the operations that such knowledge bases allow can be replicated with zero ingestion costs (not even a vector database); in fact our solution, Zero-Ingestion ScalableRAG, handily out-performs all baselines (including knowledge graph approaches) in three out of the six corpora considered here, and only marginally missing maximum performance on the other three, with average accuracy across all six datasets 7.36% above the next most competitive baseline. It achieves this by keeping a workspace of document sets and values sets that it can write into and read from, allowing for on-the-fly aggregative reasoning in all situations where grouping is required on a primary key that is in one to one correspondence with a subset of the total document set. Capping the number of LLM calls by a constant independent of the corpus size, we also introduce Limited-Ingestion ScalableRAG, which does use a minimal vector database as well as an automated pattern discovery from a sample of documents, to further improve accuracy at scale. Our code is available at https://github.com/cohesity/ScalableRAG .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ScalableRAG，一种无需知识摄入成本的检索增强生成方法。该方法通过维护文档集和值集的工作空间，实现在主键与文档子集一一对应时的即时聚合推理，在六个语料库的三个中超越了包括知识图谱在内的基线方法，平均准确率高出7.36%。
Motivation: 现有RAG方法为了追求高性能而付出高昂的知识摄入成本（如构建知识图谱或SQL表），本文旨在证明这些操作可以零成本复现，无需向量数据库等基础设施。
Method: 提出Zero-Ingestion ScalableRAG，通过维护文档集和值集的工作空间实现即时聚合推理；此外引入Limited-Ingestion ScalableRAG，使用最小向量数据库和自动模式发现以提升大规模准确性，并将LLM调用次数限制为与语料库大小无关的常数。
Result: 在六个语料库中的三个上，Zero-Ingestion ScalableRAG超越了所有基线（包括知识图谱方法），其余三个仅略低于最佳性能，平均准确率比次优基线高7.36%。
Conclusion: 高质量的RAG可以在零知识摄入成本下实现，且性能优于现有方法，代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Interpretable GOHR Agents via Sparse Autoencoders
papers.abstract_en: A central challenge in interpreting learned decision-making systems is to determine whether their internal representations contain concepts that help explain their behavior. We report interpretability experiments for a tokenized autoregressive Transformer agent in the Game of Hidden Rules (GOHR). We focus on a compact two-rule task in which both hidden rules map object shapes to target buckets, but with different permutations. The policy is trained on episodes sampled from these two hidden rules and then evaluated with fixed weights. It is never given a rule label and does not use an explicit rule classifier; any rule information must be inferred implicitly from interaction history. In this setting, the correct rule is not identifiable before the agent tries an informative move and observes accept/reject feedback. Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) trained on the agent's decision-token embeddings recover this structure. When held-out decisions are labeled by simple concepts such as the chosen shape or bucket, SAE dimensions that are highly selective for a concept cover most decisions where that concept is present. Individual SAE dimensions also correspond to interpretable strategies such as probing one rule hypothesis and switching after negative feedback.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过稀疏自编码器（SAE）分析一个在隐藏规则游戏（GOHR）中训练的Transformer代理的内部表示。代理在一个两规则任务中学习，没有规则标签，但SAE能从决策token嵌入中恢复出与形状或桶等概念对应的可解释维度，并揭示出如试探规则并切换等策略。
Motivation: 理解学习到的决策系统内部是否包含可解释的概念，以及这些概念如何解释行为。
Method: 训练一个token化自回归Transformer代理在GOHR的两规则任务上（形状到桶的映射），然后对代理的决策token嵌入训练SAE，分析SAE维度与概念（形状、桶）的对齐。
Result: SAE维度对概念高度选择，覆盖大多数相关决策；个别维度对应可解释策略（如试探一个规则并在负反馈后切换）。
Conclusion: SAE能有效揭示Transformer代理在隐规则任务中的可解释结构，表明该方法可用于理解学习到的决策系统。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning from 53.6K Real-World Developer Edits of AI-Generated Code
papers.abstract_en: Imperfections in AI-generated code require that software developers modify the generated code manually, or by re-prompting an AI programming assistant. Manual code edits provide more realistic and granular information on editing behavior than Git commits, which only contain final successful code snippets. Yet, due to a lack of high-quality, realistic code editing data, LLMs are mostly trained on publicly available Git data (e.g., commits). To address this gap, we introduce DECODE (Developer Edits of Code Dataset), a dataset of 53.6K real-world in-IDE code edits of AI-generated code in Python, TypeScript, and JavaScript, sourced from 1K+ developers. First, we demonstrate the utility of DECODE for data analysis, obtaining insights on when, why, and how AI-generated code is edited. We find that most edits occur within the first 15 minutes after accepting an AI completion, resulting in the removal of AI completions in 31% of edit trajectories. Second, we use DECODE to benchmark the ability of LLMs to predict code edits. We find that finetuning on DECODE enables open-source 3B models to perform code edit prediction tasks significantly better than frontier LLMs. We then discuss implications of this work, emphasizing the necessity of developer-centric machine learning approaches for future AI programming assistants.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文收集了来自1000多名开发者的53.6K次真实IDE内对AI生成代码的编辑记录，构建了DECODE数据集。分析显示大多数编辑发生在接受AI补全后的15分钟内，且31%的编辑轨迹会移除AI补全。基于该数据集微调的开源3B模型在代码编辑预测任务上显著优于前沿大模型。
Motivation: 现有代码编辑数据多来源于Git提交，缺乏真实、细粒度的开发者编辑行为数据，限制了LLM在代码编辑任务上的训练效果。
Method: 通过IDE插件收集开发者对AI生成代码的实时编辑记录，构建DECODE数据集，包含Python、TypeScript和JavaScript三种语言的53.6K次编辑，并基于此微调开源3B模型进行代码编辑预测。
Result: 51%的编辑发生在AI补全15分钟内，31%的编辑轨迹最终移除了AI生成代码；微调后的3B模型在代码编辑预测任务上超越GPT-4等前沿模型。
Conclusion: 强调开发者中心式机器学习方法对提升AI编程助手的重要性，并指出DECODE数据集可用于分析编辑行为和改进代码生成模型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Deep Label-Wise Attentive Temporal Convolutional Networks Improve Medical Coding
papers.abstract_en: Medical coding is the task of assigning a set of diagnosis and procedure codes for a hospitalization using recorded notes. It requires aggregating information from different parts of the text and focus to different sections for each individual code, making it a very difficult problem even for professional human coders. We model the task as a multi-label text classification problem. To overcome the mentioned difficulties, we propose a deep neural model consisting of a multi-layer temporal convolution network (TCN) followed by label-wise attention. While multi-layer TCN helps extract a global document representation with the ability to learn relations over very long sequences, label-specific attention mechanism allows the model to focus on different aspects of the same document for each individual label. Our method achieves significantly better F-1 scores (9% increase) compared to the previous state-of-the-art model, with a remarkable increase in recall score (28% increase), which we believe is the more important metric for a clinical decision support setting.
papers.comment: Work carried out in 2019; posted as a record of the work. Baselines and state of the art reflect the 2019 literature
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种用于医疗编码任务的深度神经网络模型，结合多层时间卷积网络（TCN）和标签级注意力机制。模型在多个标签上自动聚焦文本不同部分，在2019年的基准上，F1分数提升9%，召回率提升28%。
Motivation: 医疗编码需要从病历中不同部分聚合信息，且每个代码关注点不同，现有模型难以有效处理长序列和标签特异性。
Method: 使用多层TCN提取全局文档表示，再通过标签级注意力机制为每个标签学习不同的文本关注区域。
Result: 与当时最先进模型相比，F1分数提高9%，召回率提高28%，召回率被视为临床决策支持的关键指标。
Conclusion: 标签级注意力结合TCN能有效改善医疗编码的多标签分类性能，尤其提升召回率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LENS: Adaptive Spatio-Temporal Zooming for Keyframe Sampling in Long-Form Videos
papers.abstract_en: Despite rapid progress in Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs), understanding long-form videos is still bottlenecked by limited context windows. While recent keyframe sampling methods attempt to mitigate this by distilling video inputs into a compact set of query-relevant frames, navigating the vast spatio-temporal search space remains challenging, as spatial detail and temporal coverage often conflict. To address this, we introduce LENS, a training-free keyframe sampling framework that dynamically decides when to zoom in for fine-grained details and when to zoom out for broader context based on the text query. Concretely, LENS adaptively allocates a limited frame budget between spatial zoom-ins, which highlight query-relevant regions within individual frames, and temporal zoom-outs, which expand the temporal scope through multi-frame aggregation, enabling the model to reason across multiple granularities while capturing both high-fidelity details and long-range context. Across diverse long-form video benchmarks, LENS consistently outperforms prior state-of-the-art keyframe sampling methods and delivers substantial gains over uniform sampling, improving Video-MME accuracy from 53.3% to 60.7% with Qwen2.5-VL.Code is available at https://github.com/zhangce01/LENS.
papers.comment: Accepted at ECCV 2026. Project page: https://zhangce01.github.io/LENS/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LENS，一种无需训练的自适应关键帧采样框架，通过动态决定何时放大细节（空间缩放）和何时缩小视野（时间缩放），在有限帧预算内平衡空间细节与时间覆盖。在多个长视频基准上，LENS优于先前方法，例如将Video-MME准确率从53.3%提升至60.7%（基于Qwen2.5-VL）。
Motivation: 多模态大模型理解长视频受限于上下文窗口，现有关键帧采样方法难以同时兼顾空间细节和时间覆盖，导致搜索空间大且效率低。
Method: LENS框架通过文本查询自适应分配帧预算：空间缩放聚焦单帧内与查询相关的区域，时间缩放通过多帧聚合扩大时间范围，实现多粒度推理。
Result: 在多个长视频基准上，LENS一致超越先前最先进的关键帧采样方法，并显著优于均匀采样；使用Qwen2.5-VL将Video-MME准确率从53.3%提升至60.7%。
Conclusion: LENS通过自适应时空缩放，在无训练条件下有效捕获高保真细节与长程上下文，提升了长视频理解性能。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Endpoint Replay: Compressing the Recency Buffer in Deep Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Experience replay remains one of the most practical and useful algorithmic tools in the deep reinforcement learning (DRL) toolbox. Aside from the limited success of prioritized replay and specialized approaches for large asynchronous systems, most DRL algorithms make use of a large, uniformly sampled recency buffer---even the size, one million, remains unchanged. Could we store less data, reduce redundancy, or more effectively chain experience together to speed up value propagation and still retain the performance of large buffers? In this paper, we investigate a simple compression approach that stores representative transitions derived from the end-points of a chain of connected $n$-step sequences. By curating these end-points in a smaller recency buffer, our method maintains an effective memory horizon comparable to a standard large buffer while requiring an order of magnitude less storage. Through empirical evaluation, we demonstrate that this approach prevents the systematic bias inherent in naive compression strategies and matches the performance of traditional large buffers in the Pinball environment and the Atari 2600 benchmark.
papers.comment: Accepted at the Reinforcement Learning Conference (RLC) 2026, to appear in the Reinforcement Learning Journal (RLJ)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种简单的经验回放压缩方法，通过存储连接n步序列的端点（end-points）来构建较小的近期缓冲区，从而在减少一个数量级存储的情况下保持与标准大缓冲区相当的有效记忆范围。实验证明该方法避免了朴素压缩策略的系统性偏差，并在Pinball和Atari 2600基准上匹配了传统大缓冲区的性能。
Motivation: 深度强化学习中广泛使用的大型均匀采样近期缓冲区存储量巨大（如一百万），且存在冗余。能否通过压缩减少存储、加速价值传播而不损失性能？
Method: 将连续的n步序列视为链，仅存储链的端点（起始和结束状态-动作-奖励元组）作为代表转换，并放入较小的近期缓冲区中。
Result: 在Pinball环境和Atari 2600基准上，该方法匹配了标准大缓冲区的性能，同时存储量减少一个数量级。
Conclusion: 端点压缩是一种简单有效的经验回放压缩策略，能够避免朴素压缩（如随机子采样）带来的系统性偏差，且无需复杂调整。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Semantic Space Search Trajectory Networks
papers.abstract_en: Search Trajectory Networks (STNs) are a graph-based tool for visualizing and characterizing the behavior of optimization algorithms. STNs' reliance on discretization of the search space has largely confined them to low-dimensional or combinatorial settings. We introduce a methodology for constructing STNs in semantic spaces, defined as the space of a model's predictions on a fixed sample set. Our approach discretizes semantic vectors and aggregates them into network nodes via agglomerative clustering with complete linkage under a normalized Hamming distance. Since any predictor can be summarized by its semantic vector, this method enables comparison of learning dynamics across otherwise incomparable algorithm families. We apply semantic space STNs to classification and regression tasks solved using different machine learning algorithms, recovering known qualitative differences between them. Additionally, we use semantic space STNs to study neural network generalization by contrasting standard training with the label randomization regime of Zhang et al. (2017). The resulting STNs exhibit consistent structural differences, training on real labels produces denser, more efficient and more centralized graphs than training on shuffled labels. Together, our results show that semantic space STNs capture functional training dynamics arising from the interaction between learning algorithms and data, providing a tool for analyzing and comparing learning dynamics across machine learning models and training regimes.

TL;DR: 本文提出语义空间搜索轨迹网络（Semantic Space STNs），将搜索轨迹网络（STNs）扩展到语义空间（模型在固定样本集上的预测空间）中，通过凝聚聚类和归一化汉明距离离散化语义向量。该方法适用于分类和回归任务，可比较不同机器学习算法的学习动态，并用于研究神经网络泛化（对比真实标签与随机标签训练）。实验表明，真实标签训练产生的图更密集、更高效、更集中。
Motivation: 传统STNs依赖搜索空间离散化，主要局限于低维或组合优化场景，难以应用于高维连续空间（如机器学习模型参数空间）。现有方法无法直接比较不同机器学习算法家族（如决策树与神经网络）的学习动态。
Method: 定义语义空间为模型在固定样本集上的预测向量空间；对语义向量按归一化汉明距离进行凝聚聚类（完全链接）以聚合节点；构建有向图，节点代表语义向量聚类，边反映优化过程中的转移。
Result: 语义空间STNs能恢复已知的算法定性差异；在神经网络泛化研究中，真实标签训练产生的图比随机标签训练更密集、更高效、更中心化，表明该工具可以捕捉训练动态的结构差异。
Conclusion: 语义空间STNs提供了一种跨模型和训练机制分析学习动态的工具，可揭示算法与数据交互的功能性训练动态。

papers.title: Score-Based Stabilization for Time-Dependent Problems
papers.abstract_en: We propose a score-based stabilization framework for numerical simulation of partial differential equations, in which a learned score model defines a stabilization operator applied to provisional numerical updates. This operator augments standard time-stepping schemes by enforcing structure and physical consistency through a correction that drives iterates toward the manifold of admissible states. We show that the stabilization operator acts as a contraction toward this manifold, yielding a correction mechanism with basin-conditional stability. Numerical experiments on Advection, Korteweg-de Vries (KdV), Nonlinear Schrodinger (NLS), and Burgers' equations demonstrate improved robustness, suppression of nonphysical instabilities, and preservation of qualitative dynamics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于得分（score）的稳定化框架用于偏微分方程的数值模拟，通过训练一个得分模型定义稳定化算子，对数值迭代进行修正，使状态靠近可行流形，从而抑制非物理不稳定性。在平流、KdV、非线性薛定谔和Burgers方程上的实验表明该方法提升了鲁棒性并保持了定性动力学特性。
Motivation: 传统时间推进格式在模拟某些偏微分方程时可能产生非物理不稳定，需要一种数据驱动的稳定化方法来增强数值模拟的稳健性。
Method: 学习一个得分模型，其梯度作为稳定化算子，对初始数值更新施加修正，推动迭代向满足物理一致性的状态流形收缩。该算子被证明具有收缩性质并保持条件稳定。
Result: 在平流、KdV、非线性薛定谔和Burgers方程上，该方法有效抑制了非物理不稳定，提升了鲁棒性，并保留了定性动力学特征。
Conclusion: 基于得分的稳定化框架是一种有效的数值增强手段，可嵌入现有时间推进格式，为偏微分方程数值模拟提供数据驱动的稳定性保障。

papers.title: Analysis of the Shortcut Learning and Clever Hans Effect in CNN based ECG Image Classification
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning models for ECG image classification may achieve high accuracy by exploiting non-physiological visual cues instead of ECG waveform morphology. Given the black-box nature of deep learning models, their promise of high predictive performance often remains insufficiently translated into clinical or real-world trust, interpretability, and actionable decision-making. In this study, we examine shortcut learning and Clever Hans effect in a publicly available ECG image dataset using convolutional neural networks. In process we have created six image-derived feature sets (FSs), FS1: raw full ECG images, FS2: cropped waveform-only images, FS3: waveform-masked metadata images, FS4: red-arrow artifact images for the myocardial infarction class, FS5: contrast-enhanced images for the abnormal heartbeat class and FS6: Gaussian-blurred images for the normal class. These controlled representations were used to test whether classification performance persists when waveform information is removed or when artificial class-specific artifacts are introduced. Shortcut retention score, prediction consistency and confidence divergence across Feature-Set Representations have been calculated to assess the transparency about the learning pattern. Along with factual results, average Integrated Gradients and occlusion sensitivity test results are presented to inspect whether model attribution focused on ECG-relevant waveform regions or on non-clinical artifacts. Performance changes across feature sets and attribution patterns were used to identify potential Clever Hans behavior. This study evaluates whether ECG image classifiers learn clinically meaningful morphology or shortcut cues introduced by report layout, metadata, contrast, blur, or artificial markers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究CNN在ECG图像分类中的捷径学习和Clever Hans效应，通过构造六种不同特征集（原始图像、裁剪波形、元数据掩码、红色箭头伪影、对比度增强、高斯模糊）来测试模型是否依赖非生理视觉线索而非波形形态。使用积分梯度和遮挡敏感性分析归因，发现模型可能依赖报告布局、元数据、对比度等人造特征。
Motivation: 深度学习模型的ECG分类可能利用非生理线索达到高准确率，但缺乏临床可解释性和信任，需要检查模型是否真正学习到有意义的波形特征还是捷径。
Method: 构建六种特征集，去除波形或引入人工伪影，计算捷径保留分数、预测一致性和置信度发散，并结合积分梯度和遮挡敏感性分析归因模式。
Result: 通过性能变化和归因模式识别出潜在的Clever Hans行为，但摘要未提供具体数值。
Conclusion: 评估ECG图像分类器是否学习临床有意义的形态学或由报告布局、元数据、对比度、模糊或人工标记引入的捷径线索。

papers.title: Memory Layer: Train the In-Model Cache for Recommendation Models
papers.abstract_en: Early ranking stages in recommendation systems precompute item embeddings and cache them in-model for scoring within strict latency constraints. Because this cache exists only at serving time, outside the training loop, training and serving use different item representations, a structural discrepancy that limits quality and adds operational fragility. We show that co-designing the training and serving paths removes this representation discrepancy at its source. We introduce the memory layer, an in-model key-value embedding cache co-trained with the model: the item tower writes embeddings during training and the model reads them at serving, one source of truth for item representations by construction. Always-on embeddings cover items not yet cached, so every item receives a prediction, and the design consolidates three separate trainer-to-predictor update paths into a single self-contained pipeline. Deployed in production on Instagram Reels, the memory layer raises prediction coverage from 96% to 100%, improves embedding freshness from $O(5\text{ min})$ to $O(20\text{ s})$, and narrows the training-serving Normalized Entropy (NE) gap by up to 86%, yielding over $2\times$ recall for the freshest content and a 5-6% cold start engagement lift. Because embeddings are produced during training, the system needs no separate bulk-evaluation or publish-time recomputation, cutting training-and-publish computational cost by 30% at neutral serving computational cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这篇论文提出内存层（Memory Layer），一种与模型共同训练的内部键值嵌入缓存，解决推荐系统中训练和推理时物品嵌入不一致的问题。在Instagram Reels生产环境中部署后，预测覆盖率从96%提升到100%，嵌入新鲜度从5分钟缩短到20秒，训练-推理NE差距缩小高达86%，新鲜内容召回提升2倍以上，冷启动参与度提升5-6%，计算成本降低30%。
Motivation: 推荐系统早期排序阶段在模型外预计算物品嵌入并缓存，导致训练和推理使用不同表示，存在结构差异，限制了质量并增加了操作脆弱性。
Method: 引入内存层，一个与模型共同训练的内部键值嵌入缓存：物品塔在训练时写入嵌入，模型在推理时读取，统一物品表示来源。始终在线嵌入覆盖未缓存物品，每个物品得到预测。设计将三个独立的训练器到预测器更新路径合并为单一自包含流水线。
Result: 在生产环境（Instagram Reels）中，预测覆盖率从96%到100%，嵌入新鲜度从5分钟到20秒，训练-推理NE差距缩小86%，新鲜内容召回提升2倍，冷启动参与度提升5-6%，计算成本降低30%。
Conclusion: 共同设计训练和推理路径消除了表示差异，内存层提供了单一真相源，简化了操作，提高了质量和效率。

papers.title: OPERA: Offline Policy-guided Expert Routing and Adaptation for Universal Biomedical Image Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Biomedical image analysis spans diverse modalities and tasks, yet real-world deployment is hindered by severe distribution shifts across scanners, protocols, and patient populations. High-performing models consequently require repeated domain-specific fine-tuning, which is a costly cycle that becomes impractical when labels are scarce or privacy constraints limit data sharing. We propose OPERA (Offline Policy-guided Expert Routing and Adaptation), a multi-agent ensemble framework that addresses this deployment bottleneck by treating expert weight assignment as an offline policy learning problem: a routing policy is learned from a small validation set without gradient updates to any expert agent, then deployed with test-time adaptation to handle distribution shift. OPERA coordinates heterogeneous specialist agents through complementary mechanisms. The expert profiling module learns selection policies offline, enabling informed allocation of expertise. Each agent undergoes confidence calibration through temperature adjustment, ensuring more reliable probabilistic outputs. OPERA also incorporates distribution aware adaptation, where class weights are dynamically adjusted at the batch level using statistics derived from unlabeled test data. Instance level routing assigns each sample to the most suitable expert by leveraging inter model agreement and predictive entropy. We evaluate OPERA on 9 datasets covering fundus photography, chest X-ray, CT, MRI, and multimodal diagnostic benchmarks, comparing against 30+ baselines across classification, segmentation, and multimodal settings. OPERA consistently improves performance and calibration quality, demonstrating that offline policy-guided expert agents coordination is a practical path to deployable biomedical AI without retraining. Code is on \href{https://github.com/HUANGLIZI/OPERA}{GitHub}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OPERA，一种多智能体集成框架，将专家权重分配视为离线策略学习问题，从小验证集学习路由策略，无需梯更新即可部署，并引入测试时自适应处理分布偏移。在涵盖眼底摄影、胸部X光、CT、MRI等多模态的9个数据集上，OPERA在分类、分割和多模态任务中优于30多个基线，提升了性能和校准质量。
Motivation: 生物医学图像分析面临不同扫描仪、协议和患者群体导致的严重分布偏移，现有模型需要重复的领域特定微调，成本高且难以在标签稀缺或隐私受限时实用。
Method: 提出离线策略引导的专家路由与自适应框架（OPERA），包括：离线学习专家选择策略的专家画像模块；通过温度调整进行置信度校准；利用无标签测试数据的分布感知适应，在批次级别动态调整类别权重；基于模型间一致性和预测熵的实例级路由。
Result: 在9个数据集（眼底摄影、胸X光、CT、MRI等）上，与30多个基线相比，OPERA在分类、分割和多模态任务中持续提升性能和校准质量。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，无需重训练的离线策略引导多专家协作是实现可部署生物医学AI的实用路径。

papers.title: MOSAIC-FL, a micro-service based privacy-preserving framework with application to genomics
papers.abstract_en: Security and privacy are primordial requirements for Federated Learning (FL), especially in fields such as healthcare and genomics where sensitive information has to be analyzed. Our FL framework is designed to address these challenges while proposing a modular, flexible and micro-service architecture. More precisely, it integrates an efficient gRPC communication layer and a Finite State Machine to ensure robust component synchronization and threat detection, while relying on a fault-tolerant secure aggregation protocol using a Threshold variant of the CKKS homomorphic cryptosystem. This allows blind model aggregation by an orchestration server, requiring a minimum of $t$-out-of-$N$ active clients for decryption while minimizing communication overhead thanks to both cryptographic and network protocols. We ensure IND-CPA-D security through noise flooding and mitigate the recent key-recovery attack on synchronized decryptors by renewing the collective key material at every round. We demonstrate the framework's effectiveness through diverse use cases, ranging from standard image recognition (EMNIST) to complex genomic classification including breast cancer subtyping on TCGA, evaluating system performance across different threshold values and model scales.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables. Accepted and presented at SECRYPT 2026, 23rd International Conference on Security and Cryptography, Porto, Portugal, 16-18 July 2026. https://secrypt.scitevents.org
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于微服务架构的隐私保护联邦学习框架 MOSAIC-FL，集成 gRPC 通信层和有限状态机以增强同步与威胁检测，采用 CKKS 同态加密的阈值变体实现容错的安全聚合，并引入噪声洪泛和轮次密钥更新以抵御 IND-CPA-D 攻击和密钥恢复攻击。在 EMNIST 图像识别和 TCGA 乳腺癌亚型分类等任务上验证了框架有效性。
Motivation: 联邦学习在医疗和基因组学等敏感领域面临隐私安全问题，现有框架在模块化、通信效率和抗攻击能力方面存在不足。
Method: 设计微服务架构，使用 gRPC 通信和有限状态机管理组件同步，采用 t-out-of-N 阈值 CKKS 同态加密进行安全聚合，通过噪声洪泛实现 IND-CPA-D 安全性，每轮更新集体密钥材料以防御密钥恢复攻击。
Result: 在 EMNIST 和 TCGA 乳腺癌亚型分类上测试了不同阈值和模型规模下的系统性能，展示了框架的有效性。
Conclusion: 该框架为隐私敏感领域提供了模块化、安全的联邦学习方案，并支持基因组学应用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: IMPRINT: Image-Conditioned Query Enrichment for Long-Tail Object Goal Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Embodied AI increasingly relies on queryable semantic maps built from pre-trained vision-language models to enable zero-shot Object Goal Navigation (ObjectNav). However, existing approaches typically depend on text-only queries, which become less reliable as semantic specificity increases toward fine-grained object categories. We introduce IMPRINT, a zero-shot plug-and-play framework that enriches textual object queries with web-sourced images to improve grounding in queryable maps. Retrieved images are encoded using a vision-language model, matched against the semantic map to produce similarity maps, and aggregated to yield context-aware localization. Notably, this requires no training or modification of the underlying navigation policy. To explicitly evaluate long-tail behavior, we present HSSD-rare, a new ObjectNav benchmark built on Habitat Synthetic Scenes and featuring semantically specific subcategories. Across both OVON and HSSD-rare, image-conditioned queries consistently improve object grounding and yield end-to-end navigation gains. Further analysis reveals that translating localization gains to navigation performance depends critically on downstream detection quality, highlighting a key systems bottleneck in long-tail embodied navigation.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS). Project page: https://github.com/JelinR/IMPRINT
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出IMPRINT，一个零样本即插即用框架，通过从网络检索的图像丰富文本目标查询，提高长尾物体目标导航（ObjectNav）中基于可查询语义地图的定位能力。在OVON和新构建的HSSD-rare基准上，图像条件查询一致地提升了物体定位和端到端导航性能，但下游检测质量是关键瓶颈。
Motivation: 现有零样本ObjectNav方法依赖纯文本查询，对于细粒度类别（长尾物体）可靠性下降，需要更丰富的多模态表示来改进地图中的语义匹配。
Method: IMPRINT通过VLM对网络检索的图像编码，与预建语义地图匹配生成相似度图，并聚合得到上下文感知的定位热图，无需训练或修改导航策略。
Result: 在OVON和HSSD-rare（新提出的长尾子类别基准）上，图像条件查询一致提升目标定位和端到端导航成功率，但将定位增益转化为导航增益受限于下游检测质量。
Conclusion: 图像增强查询有效改善长尾物体导航中的语义定位，但系统级瓶颈在下游检测，未来需加强视觉检测能力以充分发挥定位优势。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Elliptic Regularity Theory in Barron Spaces and Applications to the Deep Ritz Method
papers.abstract_en: We prove that harmonic functions with Dirichlet boundary data in Barron space, a function class tailored to wide ReLU networks with a single hidden layer and suitably bounded weights, are generally neither Lipschitz continuous nor in the Sobolev class $H^2$. A fortiori, they are not in any function class in which the norm controls the Lipschitz constant, which rules out not only Barron space regularity, but also regularity in function classes for deeper ReLU networks with bounded coefficients. They can, however, be approximated to accuracy $\sim \varepsilon$ by Barron functions of low norm $\sim |\log\varepsilon|$ in various Lebesgue and Sobolev norms (with at most two derivatives). The positive result holds on very simple domains: Half-spaces in arbitrary dimension and rectangular domains in two dimensions. As an application of this regularity theory, we obtain a priori error estimates for Deep Ritz neural PDE solvers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明Barron空间中的调和函数（适合单隐层宽ReLU网络）一般不满足Lipschitz连续或属于Sobolev类H^2，从而排除了Barron空间及深层ReLU网络有界系数函数类的正则性。然而，在简单域（任意维半空间和二维矩形域）上，这些函数可以在各种Lebesgue和Sobolev范数下被范数~|logε|的Barron函数以精度~ε逼近。作为应用，获得了Deep Ritz神经PDE求解器的先验误差估计。
Motivation: 理解Barron空间中函数的正则性对于分析深度神经网络在偏微分方程求解中的表现至关重要，但现有理论尚不完善。
Method: 利用势理论和调和分析工具，研究Barron空间中Dirichlet问题解的性质，并证明正反两方面的结果。
Result: Barron空间中调和函数一般不是Lipschitz或H^2正则，但在半空间和二维矩形域上可被低范数Barron函数高精度逼近。
Conclusion: 本文的正则性理论为Deep Ritz方法提供了先验误差界，但结果限于简单几何域。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Evaluating Communicative Belief Updates in Large Language Models via Implicature Recognition and Cancellation
papers.abstract_en: Human language is driven by unspoken beliefs and belief updates, making these critical to model for successful communication between large language models (LLMs) and their users. In this paper, we evaluate the ability of LLMs to recognize unspoken beliefs made through implicatures and to understand their updates through implicature cancellation: the pragmatic phenomenon whereby an utterance's implied meaning is weakened or negated. We create the first expert-annotated implicature cancellation dataset, [DatasetName], crowdsourced for human judgements of implicatures and their corresponding cancellations. We find that LLM belief update understanding lags behind that of humans, especially in more naturally-occurring scenarios. Additional control experiments suggest that successes in LLM belief updates may stem in part from a reliance on prior beliefs, and that failures in belief updates may depend on their type and on their form. Overall, our study suggests that current LLMs have not yet reached human-level understanding of unspoken beliefs and belief updates. Code and data are available at https://github.com/cesare-spinoso/ImplicatureX.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过隐含意义识别与取消任务评估大语言模型（LLM）对交际中未言明信念及其更新的理解能力。作者构建了首个专家标注的隐含意义取消数据集，并通过众包验证人类判断。实验表明，LLM在信念更新理解上落后于人类，尤其在更自然的场景中；控制实验提示LLM的成功部分依赖于先验信念，失败则与信念类型和形式有关。
Motivation: 人类语言依赖未言明的信念及信念更新，这对于LLM与用户间的成功交流至关重要，但现有模型对此理解不足，缺乏系统评估。
Method: 创建首个专家标注的隐含意义取消数据集，包含人类对隐含意义及其取消的判断；设计识别与取消任务，并引入控制实验分析先验信念的影响。
Result: LLM在信念更新理解上整体落后于人类，在更自然场景中差距更大；部分成功可归因于先验信念依赖，失败则取决于信念类型和形式。
Conclusion: 当前LLM尚未达到人类水平的未言明信念及信念更新理解能力，需进一步改进。

papers.title: MorphUNet: Alpha-Controlled Biometric Transport for Diffusion-Based Face Morphing Attacks
papers.abstract_en: Face morphing attacks create synthetic images verifiable against multiple identities, threatening border control and identity verification systems. We introduce MorphUNet, a diffusion morphing framework formulating two-parent generation as alpha-controlled biometric transport: each parent is decomposed into CLIP appearance and ArcFace identity evidence, aligned into a CLIP-compatible token space, with the two contributors preserved as separate identity-aware token banks. To our knowledge, MorphUNet is the first diffusion-based morphing framework using trainable parent-separated dual cross-attention inside the denoising U-Net: a Biometric Transport Layer carrying parent-specific identity evidence through denoising, attending to each parent separately before combining residuals via the morphing parameter alpha. DDIM-inverted latent interpolation gives a coherent denoising start, while weaker-parent-guided selection favours morphs maximising the lower parent-similarity score, reducing collapse toward one contributor. We evaluate MorphUNet against three state-of-the-art baselines (StableMorph, MIPGAN-II, and MorDIFF) on FEI and FRLL using six recognition systems, and propose CFD-based unseen-identity stress testing across gender and ethnicity pairing, demographic shifts, and parent-similarity extremes. MorphUNet achieves the best Morphing Attack Potential (MAP) when at least three of six systems are fooled by one morph, reaching 0.919 on FEI and 0.886 on FRLL, and obtains the best FID on both datasets (35.19 FEI, 44.86 FRLL). It also gives the highest APCER at 5% BPCER in the same-dataset setting, and remains highly difficult to detect under cross-dataset transfer, with APCER 0.996 on FEI and 0.946 on FRLL. The full evaluation analyses MAP, MAD, per-system vulnerability, identity balance, image quality, top/bottom-similarity stress tests, and CFD unseen-identity robustness.
papers.comment: 37 pages, 23 figures, 8 tables. Includes supplementary material (additional robustness analysis, CFD stress tests, and conditioning ablations) appended after the references
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MorphUNet，一种基于扩散模型的人脸变形攻击框架，将双亲生成建模为 alpha 控制的生物特征传输。该方法利用可训练的双交叉注意力层，在去噪过程中分别关注每个父模板的身份特征，并通过 morphing 参数 alpha 组合残差。在 FEI 和 FRLL 数据集上，MorphUNet 在多个识别系统下取得了最佳的 Morphing Attack Potential (MAP) 和 FID 分数，并在跨数据集检测中表现出极高的攻击成功率。
Motivation: 现有面部变形攻击方法在多身份验证场景下容易向某一父模板坍缩，且生成图像质量有限，需要更鲁棒且难以检测的变形生成方法。
Method: 提出 MorphUNet，使用 CLIP 和 ArcFace 分别提取外观和身份特征，通过双交叉注意力的 Biometric Transport Layer 在去噪 U-Net 中各自处理父模板身份，再利用 DDIM 反演潜变量插值和弱父引导选择优化变形质量。
Result: 在 FEI 和 FRLL 上，MorphUNet 在至少三个识别系统同时被欺骗时达到 MAP 0.919 和 0.886，FID 分别为 35.19 和 44.86；同数据集设置下在 5% BPCER 时 APCER 最高，跨数据集转移时 APCER 达 0.996 和 0.946。
Conclusion: MorphUNet 在变形攻击成功率、图像质量和检测难度上均优于现有方法，但在实际部署中仍需考虑对防御系统的适应性。

papers.title: Towards Robust Reinforcement Learning for Small-Scale Language Model Agents
papers.abstract_en: The alignment of Small Language Models (SLMs) in the 70--500M parameter range using reinforcement learning is often considered unstable, though the underlying failure mechanisms have not been systematically investigated. In the State-of-the-Art (SOTA) research, fifteen (model, corpus) configurations were trained using Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO). The experiments included Pythia-70M, 160M, 410M and SmolLM2-135M, 360M on the TinyStories, CNN/DailyMail, and Wikitext-103 corpora. Three reproducible failure modes were identified in small-scale language models: silent LoRA parameter freezing in standard PEFT/TRL pipelines, numerical overflow in importance ratios when using bfloat16, and catastrophic policy collapse due to reward-model error. These issues were addressed using a merge-and-reinitialize adapter technique, float32 precision during PPO updates, and a three-layer safety mechanism comprising reward whitening, importance-ratio guarding, and weight rollback. In this paper, a capacity-headroom hypothesis is proposed, which states that PPO performance at the SLM scale depends on both a fluent supervised model ($\text{PPL}<20$) and a discriminative reward signal, rather than on the number of model parameters. The proposed system converged stably in all experiments and improved preference win rate over the SFT baseline in configurations with a fluent prior and an informative reward signal. Furthermore, it outperformed instruction-tuned baselines while requiring significantly less training data. All checkpoints, preference datasets, and training scripts are publicly released$^§$.
papers.comment: Proceedings of the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics (SMC), Bellevue, WA, USA
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了70–500M参数规模的小语言模型（SLM）在使用强化学习（PPO）进行对齐时的不稳定性问题。识别出三种可复现的失败模式：静默LoRA参数冻结、bfloat16下重要性比率数值溢出以及奖励模型误差导致的策略灾难性崩溃。提出了合并-重新初始化适配器、float32精度和三层安全机制（奖励白化、重要性比率防护、权重回滚）的解决方案，并提出了容量余量假说（capacity-headroom hypothesis）。实验表明该方法在流畅的监督模型和可区分的奖励信号条件下稳定收敛，并优于指令微调基线。
Motivation: 小语言模型（SLM）在强化学习对齐中常被认为不稳定，但缺乏对失败机制的系统性研究。
Method: 通过PPO训练15个（模型，语料）配置，识别三种失败模式，并提出合并-重新初始化适配器、float32精度和三层安全机制（奖励白化、重要性比率防护、权重回滚）来解决问题。
Result: 所提方法在所有实验中稳定收敛，在具有流畅先验和有效奖励信号的配置上提高了相对于SFT基线的偏好胜率，并且以更少的训练数据超越了指令微调基线。
Conclusion: SLM的PPO性能不取决于模型参数数量，而是取决于流畅的监督模型（PPL<20）和可区分的奖励信号。所有检查点、偏好数据集和训练脚本已公开。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.method: 通过PPO训练15个（模型，语料）配置，识别三种失败模式，并提出合并-重新初始化适配器、float32精度和三层安全机制（奖励白化、重要性比率防护、权重回滚）来解决问题。
summary_sections.result: 所提方法在所有实验中稳定收敛，在具有流畅先验和有效奖励信号的配置上提高了相对于SFT基线的偏好胜率，并且以更少的训练数据超越了指令微调基线。
summary_sections.conclusion: SLM的PPO性能不取决于模型参数数量，而是取决于流畅的监督模型（PPL<20）和可区分的奖励信号。所有检查点、偏好数据集和训练脚本已公开。

papers.title: Matryoshka Agent: Unfolding Sub-Agents for Long-Horizon Machine Learning Engineering
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning engineering (MLE) tasks require long-horizon decision making over iterative solution debugging and refinement, under expensive and feedback-driven environment interactions. Developing and training a monolithic agent for such tasks is fundamentally challenging, as it must simultaneously manage extremely long and noisy contexts, explore vast solution spaces, and remain effective under limited model capacity and computational budgets. To address these challenges, we propose Matryoshka Agent, a unified hierarchical agent framework for complex long-horizon tasks. Matryoshka Agent decomposes agentic problem solving into a coordinated hierarchy of decision making and execution: a high-level Orchestrator maintains compact, long-horizon exploration states and issues strategic instructions, while lower-level Sub-Agents execute concrete solution attempts through direct environment interaction, mediated by standardized Tool interface. This design decouples strategic exploration from costly execution, substantially reducing the burden of long-context reasoning and enabling efficient iterative refinement. We further develop an efficient training paradigm for Matryoshka Agent. Experimental results on a broad range of MLE tasks with diverse model types and scales demonstrate that Matryoshka Agent is an effective and scalable paradigm for long-horizon MLE tasks and complex agentic problem solving. Notably, Matryoshka Agent enables Qwen3-4B-Instruct to reach Orchestrator performance comparable to o4-mini. Applying Matryoshka Agent to Qwen3-30B-Coder results in at most 36.7% relative performance gain.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Matryoshka Agent，一种分层智能体框架，用于长时域机器学习工程（MLE）任务。框架将问题求解分解为高层 Orchestrator（维护紧凑探索状态并发出策略指令）和低层 Sub-Agents（通过标准工具接口执行具体方案）。实验表明该方法在多种 MLE 任务上有效且可扩展，例如 Qwen3-4B-Instruct 达到与 o4-mini 相当的 Orchestrator 性能，Qwen3-30B-Coder 应用后相对性能提升最高 36.7%。
Motivation: MLE 任务需要长时域迭代调试和优化，环境交互昂贵且反馈驱动。单一智能体难以管理极长上下文、探索大解空间，并在有限容量和预算下保持高效。
Method: 提出 Matryoshka Agent，统一分层框架：高层 Orchestrator 维护紧凑的长时域探索状态并发出策略指令；低层 Sub-Agents 通过标准化工具接口直接与环境交互执行具体方案。同时开发了高效训练范式。
Result: 在多种 MLE 任务（不同模型类型和规模）上验证了有效性和可扩展性。Qwen3-4B-Instruct 的 Orchestrator 性能与 o4-mini 相当；Qwen3-30B-Coder 应用后相对性能提升最高 36.7%。
Conclusion: Matryoshka Agent 是长时域 MLE 任务和复杂智能体问题求解的有效且可扩展范式。

papers.title: PLATO: Pointer Learner for Agent and Task Openness
papers.abstract_en: Open agent systems (OASYS) are increasingly prevalent in real-world domains where the sets of agents and tasks change unpredictably over time. Such openness, including agent openness (AO) and task openness (TO), poses a fundamental challenge to multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL), which typically assumes fixed state and action spaces. Existing methods address openness only partially: padding and masking approaches introduce artificial bounds, while recent graph-based or hypergraph methods handle one dimension of openness but still depend on restrictive assumptions. In this paper, we introduce Pointer Learner for Agent and Task Openness (PLATO), a pointer-network-based actor combined with a centralized graph neural network (GNN) critic, trained with multi-agent proximal policy optimization under a centralized training and decentralized execution paradigm. Our pointer-based actor outputs distributions directly over the current task set. This directly supports changing action spaces without masking or retraining. Our GNN critic encodes agent-task interactions as a graph that changes shape with task and agent composition. Together, these components consider AO and TO without the boundedness of existing approaches. We formalize PLATO in a Task-and-Agent-Open Markov Game (TaAgO-MG), extending prior task-open formulations, and prove it is well-defined over the resulting unbounded state and action spaces. We evaluate PLATO with the Methods for Open Agent Systems Evaluation Initiative (MOASEI) wildfire suppression domain, an environment designed for open multi-agent system evaluation, and we demonstrate strong performance and more consistent zero-shot generalization than state-of-the-art baselines in OASYS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PLATO，一个基于指针网络与图神经网络（GNN）的框架，用于解决开放多智能体系统（OASYS）中智能体和任务动态变化的问题。PLATO将开放性问题形式化为任务与智能体开放的马尔可夫博弈（TaAgO-MG），并通过指针网络actor直接在当前任务集上输出动作分布，结合中心化GNN critic，在无界状态和动作空间下实现无需重训练的零样本泛化。在MOASEI野火抑制领域上的实验表明，PLATO在性能与零样本泛化一致性上均优于现有基线。
Motivation: 开放多智能体系统中智能体集合与任务集合的动态变化，使传统多智能体强化学习（MARL）面临状态与动作空间不固定的挑战。现有方法如填充掩码或图方法仅部分处理开放性，且依赖有界假设，无法有效应对完全开放性。
Method: PLATO包含一个指针网络（pointer-network）actor与一个中心化图神经网络（GNN）critic，采用中心化训练与去中心化执行（CTDE）范式。指针actor直接输出当前任务集上的概率分布，无需掩码或重训练；GNN critic将智能体-任务交互编码为动态图。该框架在提出的TaAgO-MG博弈中形式化，并证明其在无界状态与动作空间上的良定义性。
Result: 在MOASEI野火抑制基准上，PLATO展现出强性能，并在零样本泛化上比最先进基线更一致，同时避免了传统方法对空间有界的依赖。
Conclusion: PLATO通过指针网络与GNN的结合，有效解决了开放多智能体系统中智能体和任务的双重开放性，无需有界空间假设，为OASYS提供了一种更灵活且可泛化的解决方案。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Diff-ID: Identity Consistent Facial Image Generation and Morphing via Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Generative diffusion models have revolutionized facial image synthesis, yet robust identity preservation in high resolution outputs remains a critical challenge. This issue is especially vital for security systems, biometric authentication, and privacy sensitive applications, where any drift in identity integrity can undermine trust and functionality. We introduce Diff-ID, a diffusion based framework that enforces identity consistency while delivering photorealistic quality. Central to our approach is a custom 210K image dataset synthesized from CelebA-HQ, FFHQ, and LAION-Face and captioned via a fine tuned BLIP model to bolster identity awareness during training. Diff-ID integrates ArcFace and CLIP embeddings through a dual cross attention adapter within a fine tuned Stable Diffusion UNet. To further reinforce identity fidelity, we propose a pseudo discriminator loss based on ArcFace cosine similarity with exponential timestep weighting. Experiments on held out and unseen faces show that Diff-ID does not exceed InstantID in raw ArcFace Face Similarity, but achieves substantially lower FID and the strongest FIQ based identity--realism trade off among the evaluated methods. We also present a unified DDIM based morphing pipeline that enables qualitative facial interpolation without per identity fine tuning. We further argue that identity preservation and photorealism should be evaluated jointly rather than in isolation, as high identity similarity alone does not guarantee realistic outputs. To make this trade off explicit, we report Face Image Quality (FIQ) as a complementary ratio based score that combines identity similarity and perceptual realism while keeping FS and FID as the primary metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Diff-ID 是一个基于扩散模型的人脸图像生成与变形框架，旨在保持身份一致性。它通过从 CelebA-HQ、FFHQ 和 LAION-Face 构建的 21 万张带字幕数据集，结合 ArcFace 和 CLIP 嵌入的双交叉注意力适配器，以及基于 ArcFace 余弦相似度的指数时间步加权伪判别器损失，来增强身份保真度。实验表明，Diff-ID 在 ArcFace 相似度上未超过 InstantID，但实现了更低的 FID 和更好的身份-真实感权衡。此外，还提出了一个基于 DDIM 的统一变形流程，无需逐身份微调即可实现面部插值。
Motivation: 高分辨率人脸图像合成中的身份保持仍是一个关键挑战，尤其在安全系统和生物识别等应用中，身份完整性的任何偏差都会损害信任和功能。
Method: 提出 Diff-ID 框架，包含一个从 CelebA-HQ、FFHQ 和 LAION-Face 合成的 21 万张图像数据集，并通过微调 BLIP 模型生成字幕以增强身份感知。在微调的 Stable Diffusion UNet 中集成 ArcFace 和 CLIP 嵌入的双交叉注意力适配器，并引入基于 ArcFace 余弦相似度的指数时间步加权伪判别器损失。
Result: 在保留和未见人脸上，Diff-ID 的原始 ArcFace 相似度未超过 InstantID，但 FID 显著更低，并且在评估方法中实现了最强的 FIQ 身份-真实感权衡。
Conclusion: 身份保持和照片真实感应联合评估而非孤立考虑，因为高身份相似度并不能保证真实感输出。提出 FIQ 作为补充比率分数，结合身份相似度和感知真实感。

papers.title: Towards an Agent Operating System - Lessons from Classical and Cloud OS
papers.abstract_en: Every major wave of platform software follows the same arc: an initial period of experimentation with competing frameworks and ad-hoc implementations, followed by the articulation of a small set of stable abstractions with well-defined semantics, and finally consolidation around those abstractions into a platform that applications can portably target. POSIX did this for classical operating systems; Kubernetes did it for the cloud. Agentic AI systems - autonomous, LLM-driven agents that plan, use tools, maintain memory, and collaborate - are currently in the experimentation phase of the third such wave. dozens of frameworks and protocols have emerged, but no community consensus exists on what the core abstractions are or what guarantees they carry. Without that consensus, agentic applications cannot be written portably, platforms cannot compose reliably, and the field cannot advance beyond prototype deployments. We argue that the path forward is to follow the prior-wave methodology: derive new agentic abstractions by extending classical OS and cloud OS primitives to stochastic, natural-language-mediated execution, specify their semantics precisely, and consolidate around them - just as POSIX and Kubernetes consolidated their respective waves.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文论证了当前智能体AI系统（agentic AI）正处于类似早期操作系统和云计算平台的实验阶段，并主张通过借鉴POSIX和Kubernetes的成功路径——将经典和云操作系统原语扩展到随机、自然语言媒介的执行环境中，提炼出稳定的核心抽象和精确语义——来推动智能体平台的形成和标准化。
Motivation: 当前大量智能体框架和协议层出不穷，但缺乏社区共识的关键抽象和语义保证，导致应用不可移植、平台不可靠，阻碍了领域从原型部署走向成熟。
Method: 通过分析经典操作系统（POSIX）和云操作系统（Kubernetes）的演化历程，提取其成功方法论，并将其应用于智能体AI系统：将经典OS/云OS原语扩展到随机、自然语言媒介的执行环境，精确定义语义，并围绕它们进行整合。
Result: 论文目前属于观点和架构性论述，未报告具体的实验结果或数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为遵循前一波平台软件（如POSIX和Kubernetes）的演化方法是智能体操作系统走向成熟的关键路径。

papers.title: Spectral Truncation in Synthetic Control
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic control (SC) matches a treated unit's pre-treatment trajectory to a weighted combination of donor units. We study Spectral SC, which instead matches the treated unit in coordinates defined by the leading temporal singular vectors of the donor panel, and a hybrid estimator that places separately tunable weight on retained and discarded directions, nesting raw-path SC and truncated Spectral SC as endpoints. We prove that the family reduces exactly to raw-path SC at full rank, that exact balance on $K$ retained dimensions with $N_0$ donors is underdetermined whenever $N_0>K+1$, with an affine solution set of dimension $N_0-K-1$, and that spectral imbalance maps to treatment-effect bias through a finite-sample best-linear-predictor decomposition. We evaluate the estimators across eleven data-generating regimes, using $400$ replications per regime and donor-only placebo validation to select regularization and the mixing weight. Truncated Spectral SC has significantly higher RMSE than tuned raw-path SC in every regime, with paired differences equal to $4$ to $11$ Monte Carlo standard errors. The hybrid estimator selects raw-path matching in most replications and is statistically indistinguishable from tuned SC in most regimes. The result is highly sensitive to preprocessing. With raw inputs, the performance gap is large; after removing unit and time fixed effects before spectral decomposition, as suggested by the assumptions behind our bound, the gap nearly disappears and placebo validation begins to favor truncation. We interpret these findings diagnostically rather than as evidence that Spectral SC should replace raw-path SC. Basis-estimation noise, balancing underdetermination, and fixed-effects contamination determine when spectral matching can help.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究合成控制（SC）方法中的谱截断技术，提出一种谱SC方法，在保留和丢弃的方向上分别赋予可调权重，并证明该族在满秩时退化为原始路径SC。通过数值实验发现，截断谱SC的RMSE显著高于调优的原始路径SC，但经过预处理（去除单位和时间固定效应）后差距消失。作者将结果解释为诊断性，而非推荐取代原始SC。
Motivation: 合成控制方法在匹配处理单元与对照单元时存在偏差问题，传统方法未充分利用时序结构。
Method: 提出谱SC方法：利用对照面板的前若干个时间奇异向量定义坐标进行匹配，并引入一个混合估计量，可调整保留和丢弃方向的权重，从而嵌套原始路径SC和截断谱SC。
Result: 通过十一组数据生成机制、400次重复实验和安慰剂验证，发现截断谱SC在所有场景下的RMSE均显著高于调优的原始路径SC，差异达4-11个蒙特卡洛标准误；混合估计量多数情况下选择原始路径匹配。预处理（去除固定效应）后性能差距近乎消失，安慰剂验证开始倾向截断。

papers.title: Characterizing and Mitigating the Effects of Device Temperature on RF Fingerprinting Accuracy
papers.abstract_en: Radio Frequency Fingerprinting (RFFP) has emerged as a promising approach for device authentication by exploiting hardware-specific impairments embedded in transmitted signals. Yet existing methods largely overlook a major drawback: RFFP sensitivity to temperature--a critical factor influenced by both internal and environmental conditions--which can significantly alter device signatures and degrade classification performance. In this paper, we propose a novel temperature-aware RFFP framework that explicitly incorporates device temperature information into the learning process to improve robustness and generalization. We evaluate the proposed method on a real-world Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) dataset collected across multiple devices and environmental conditions. Experimental results demonstrate that temperature-aware modeling consistently outperforms other temperature mitigation baselines, achieving significant improvements in classification accuracy, particularly under unseen temperature and environmental conditions.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 11 figures. Accepted at 17th International Conference on Network of the Future (NoF2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对射频指纹识别（RFFP）对设备温度敏感的问题，提出了一种温度感知的RFFP框架，将设备温度信息显式纳入学习过程以提升鲁棒性。在真实BLE数据集上的实验表明，该方法在分类精度上显著优于其他温度缓解基线，尤其是在未见过的温度和环境下。
Motivation: 现有RFFP方法忽略了温度对设备签名的影响，导致分类性能因温度变化而显著下降，这是一个实际部署中的关键缺陷。
Method: 提出温度感知的RFFP框架，通过在模型训练中融入设备温度作为输入特征，使模型学习温度相关的签名变化模式。
Result: 在包含多设备、多环境条件的真实BLE数据集上，温度感知建模的分类精度比基线方法有显著提升，尤其在未见过的温度和环境条件下表现突出。
Conclusion: 温度感知建模能够有效缓解温度对RFFP精度的负面影响，增强系统在真实动态环境下的泛化能力。

papers.title: DS@GT ARC at CheckThat! 2026: LLM-Based Trace Ranking and Grouped Reward Modeling for Multilingual Numerical Claim Verification
papers.abstract_en: Automated verification of numerical claims is a challenging problem, as it requires both language understanding and quantitative reasoning. This paper describes our system for CLEF 2026 CheckThat! Task 2, which focuses on ranking reasoning traces generated by large language models (LLMs) and predicting a final verdict for numerical claims in English and Arabic. We explore two approaches. The first approach fine-tunes an LLM-based verifier using LoRA to score each reasoning trace independently as a binary classification problem, and selects the final verdict using Best-of-N selection. We further experiment with adaptive sub-claim decomposition to break complex claims into simpler parts before verification. The second approach uses a lightweight TF-IDF reward model with handcrafted numeric and temporal overlap features to score traces, and aggregates scores by verdict group to determine the final prediction. For Arabic, we compare a general multilingual model against AraBERT, a language-specific model pretrained on Arabic text. Our results show that the LLM-based approach outperforms the lightweight reward model on most metrics, particularly Recall@5, while the reward-based approach shows stronger performance on the Conflicting class. Sub-claim decomposition did not improve performance, suggesting that claim splitting introduces noise rather than aiding reasoning. For Arabic, AraBERT outperforms the multilingual baseline across most metrics.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at CLEF 2026 CheckThat!. To appear in CEUR Workshop Proceedings
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多语言数值声明的自动验证问题，描述了参加CLEF 2026 CheckThat! Task 2的系统。方法包括基于LoRA微调LLM作为验证器进行二分类并采用Best-of-N选择，以及使用TF-IDF奖励模型结合手工特征进行轨迹评分和分组聚合。实验表明，LLM方法在多数指标上优于奖励模型，而子声明分解未带来提升；阿拉伯语中，专用模型AraBERT优于多语言基线。
Motivation: 数值声明的自动化验证需要同时具备语言理解和定量推理能力，现有方法在跨语言和复杂声明上仍有挑战。
Method: 提出两种方法：1) 基于LoRA微调LLM验证器，对每条推理轨迹进行二分类，通过Best-of-N选择最终裁决；2) 轻量级TF-IDF奖励模型，结合手工设计的数值和时间重叠特征，按裁决组聚合得分进行预测。还实验了自适应子声明分解。
Result: LLM方法在Recall@5等多数指标上优于奖励模型；奖励模型在Conflicting类别上表现更强。子声明分解未提升性能。阿拉伯语中，AraBERT超越多语言基线。
Conclusion: LLM微调方法有效，但子声明分解引入噪声；针对特定语言预训练模型有助于提升多语言任务性能。

papers.title: How Often Should a Recommender Call an LLM? Value-Weighted Routing, Monitoring, and Seasonal Robustness
papers.abstract_en: Routing decisions between a cheap heuristic and an expensive large language model (LLM) are typically framed as a difficulty problem: send the hard cases to the expensive path. We argue this framing is incomplete because difficulty and business value are distinct axes - a difficult cheap item and a difficult costly item do not have the same cost of error. We present Value Router, a fully synthetic simulation of a retail merchandising pipeline that routes items using only estimated difficulty and estimated value, never ground truth. The study has three stages. First, a value-weighted threshold router is compared with a difficulty-only and a random baseline on a synthetic catalog with an inverse correlation between category volume and value. Value-weighting matches the difficulty-only baseline's recall of true high-value items (60%) while achieving substantially higher precision (98.3% vs. 94.3%). Second, a decision logger and monitor expose a failure mode hidden by aggregate metrics showing that the aggregate result is driven almost entirely by between-category differences rather than per-item discrimination. Third, a simulated Black Friday demand surge (2.5 volume with a shift toward higher-value categories) compares a static router, a seasonally tuned router, and two slow-path budget policies. All results are from a controlled synthetic simulation with experimenter-defined ground truth and illustrate design principles for cost-aware routing systems rather than validated real-world claims.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对推荐系统中如何在廉价启发式模型与昂贵大语言模型（LLM）之间进行路由决策的问题，提出价值加权路由（Value Router）方法。在合成零售模拟中，价值加权路由在召回高价值物品方面与仅基于难度的路由相当（60%），但精确度显著更高（98.3% vs. 94.3%）。研究还揭示了聚合指标掩盖的类别间差异模式，并测试了季节性鲁棒性（如黑五需求激增）。所有结果均基于受控合成模拟，而非真实世界验证。
Motivation: 现有路由决策通常仅基于任务难度，忽视了难度与业务价值是独立维度——昂贵物品的出错成本更高。
Method: 提出Value Router，在合成零售管道中，仅使用估计难度和估计价值进行路由，并与仅用难度和随机基线对比；包括价值加权阈值路由、决策日志监控以及季节性鲁棒性测试。
Result: 价值加权路由在召回高价值物品上达到60%召回率（与难度基线持平），但精确度从94.3%提升至98.3%。聚合结果主要由类别间差异驱动，而非单个物品的区分。
Conclusion: 价值感知的路由设计原则对于成本敏感系统更优，但该研究仅为受控合成模拟，需在真实场景中验证。

papers.title: Addressable Recall Compaction for Long Context-Window Control in AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon LLM agents accumulate reasoning traces, actions, and tool observations that can eventually exceed a model's fixed context window. Existing compaction methods address this limitation by discarding, summarizing, or retrieving earlier information, but they may remove task-critical details or fail to recover them reliably. We propose ARC (Addressable Recall Compaction), a context-management framework that separates archival storage from active-context presentation. ARC stores tool observations in an append-only, ID-addressable log and replaces older observations with compact citations when compaction is required. The agent can subsequently use these identifiers to request stored content without re-executing the corresponding tools or depending solely on similarity-based retrieval. We evaluate ARC using Qwen3-8B with a 16k context window and Qwen3-32B with a 32k context window. On the Needle-in-a-Haystack evaluation, ARC achieves an average exact-answer accuracy of 99.40%, compared with 88.12% for the best-performing baseline in our evaluation. ARC also reduces estimated serving time and HBM traffic under our hardware-cost model. On the LongBench-v2 Hard subset, ARC obtains an average accuracy of 29.97%, compared with 28.25% for the best-performing baseline. These results indicate that explicit, address-based recall can improve information retention and serving efficiency relative to the evaluated context-management baselines under the tested settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ARC (Addressable Recall Compaction) 框架，用于管理长上下文 LLM 代理的上下文窗口。ARC 将工具观察存储在只追加、ID 可寻址的日志中，在需要压缩时用紧凑引用替换旧观察，代理可通过 ID 请求存储内容。在 Qwen3-8B 和 Qwen3-32B 上评估，ARC 在 Needle-in-a-Haystack 任务上达到 99.40% 的精确准确率（基线最佳 88.12%），在 LongBench-v2 Hard 上达到 29.97%（基线最佳 28.25%），并降低了服务时间和 HBM 流量。
Motivation: 长期运行的 LLM 代理会积累大量推理痕迹、动作和工具观察，可能超过模型的固定上下文窗口。现有压缩方法（丢弃、总结、检索）可能移除关键细节或无法可靠恢复，需要更好的上下文管理方案。
Method: ARC 框架将归档存储与活动上下文分离，使用只追加的 ID 可寻址日志记录工具观察，在压缩时将旧观察替换为紧凑引用。代理可通过这些 ID 请求存储内容，无需重新执行工具或仅依赖相似性检索。
Result: 在 Needle-in-a-Haystack 评估中，ARC 平均精确答案准确率为 99.40%，显著高于基线最佳 88.12%。在 LongBench-v2 Hard 子集上，ARC 平均准确率 29.97%，优于基线最佳 28.25%。ARC 还减少了估计的服务时间和 HBM 流量。
Conclusion: 显式、基于地址的召回可以提升信息保持和服务效率，相比评估中的上下文管理基线方法，在测试设置下表现更优。

papers.title: Similar Models Learn Differently: Final-Window Pretraining Shapes Post-Training Beyond SFT
papers.abstract_en: Developers judge a model checkpoint by how it behaves. After supervised fine-tuning (SFT), two checkpoints that perform about the same across relevant benchmarks are treated as interchangeable, equally ready for the next alignment stage, typically preference optimization. We ask whether this judgment misses a pretraining imprint: a difference that no post-SFT benchmark reveals, yet that decides how each checkpoint responds to further training. To find out, we run a controlled experiment on the final window of pretraining, the last data trained on before instruction tuning. Six branches fork from one partially pretrained checkpoint and differ only in this window: 500 million tokens, 0.1% to 1% of the tokens that precede it. Each branch trains its window on a single data source: generic web text, filtered web text, normative discourse, safety text, mathematical text, or synthetic educational text. SFT and post-training are then identical. After SFT the branches behave near-identically, within about one point on instruction following, refusal, and capability, yet the same post-training carries them to very different endpoints, under both a direct preference optimization update and a reinforcement learning update with a verifiable reward. We measure this deviation through refusal of harmful requests: when post-training begins the safety text branch refuses no more than the web text branch, yet by the end it has lost far less of its refusal. The other four branches gain little or no protection, so the effect is selective to what the window contained. The protection requires the safety text to arrive last rather than earlier in pretraining, and it reproduces on a second model family. What a model is pretrained on last shapes how it reacts to alignment. Therefore, a checkpoint should not be evaluated by its post-SFT behavior alone, and what it was trained on last should be reported with it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过控制实验发现，预训练的最后500M token（最终窗口）虽然对SFT后的性能影响很小，但会显著影响后续对齐（如偏好优化）的结果。六条分支仅在最终窗口的数据源不同（如通用网页文本、安全文本、数学文本等），SFT后指标接近，但后续DPO/RL训练导致安全文本分支的拒绝能力损失远小于其他分支，且该效应依赖于安全文本出现在最后而非早期。结论是：不应仅凭SFT后行为评估检查点，需报告最后预训练数据。
Motivation: 当前模型开发者通常根据SFT后的行为来判定检查点是否可互换，但可能忽略了预训练印记（pretraining imprint）——这种差异在SFT后基准测试中不显现，却决定了模型对后续训练的反应。
Method: 从部分预训练的检查点分出六个分支，仅在最后500M token（最终窗口）上使用不同数据源（通用网页文本、过滤网页文本、规范话语、安全文本、数学文本、合成教育文本）继续训练，随后进行相同的SFT和后训练（DPO和RL），比较各分支的行为变化。
Result: SFT后六个分支在指令跟随、拒绝能力和能力上差异约1个点内；但后续训练后，安全文本分支的拒绝能力损失远小于其他分支（几乎无损失），而其他四个分支几乎未获得保护。该效应要求安全文本出现在最后而非早期，且在另一个模型族上复现。

papers.title: Lantern: Conflict-Aware Gradient Blending for Physics-Guided Diffusion Models in Calorimeter Simulation
papers.abstract_en: Monte Carlo simulation of calorimeter showers is a principal bottleneck for the High-Luminosity LHC, and diffusion models have emerged as fast, high-fidelity surrogates. Their denoising objective is purely statistical, however: a model can minimize it while placing the physics wrong. Existing physics-informed generative methods cannot close this gap, because they assume a closed-form law, a governing PDE residual or a hard per-sample constraint, that a shower does not supply: no per-sample PDE governs a stochastic cascade, and energy conservation fixes only one scalar per shower. Standard metrics ignore the correlation structure across calorimeter layers and voxels, comparing showers only in a physics feature space. We address both gaps. We introduce the Correlation Frobenius Distance (CFD), a single normalized score for correlation fidelity at layer-wise and voxel-wise scales. We then encode the soft per-sample structure available in a shower as two physics-aware auxiliary losses: a variance-stabilized voxel residual loss grounded in counting statistics, and a graph Laplacian loss over the detector geometry. We combine both with denoising through GradBlend, which anchors the step magnitude to the denoising gradient while letting the auxiliary steer its direction, yielding Lantern, a physics-guided diffusion surrogate. On CaloChallenge Dataset 2, injecting the physics losses through task-symmetric rules such as PCGrad, GradNorm, IMTL-G, and ConFIG inflates FPD by 2-100x relative to denoising alone, whereas GradBlend admits the same signal without regression and, with the Laplacian loss, Lantern improves both FPD and CFD. Our ablation on the auxiliary loss scheduler shows that the voxel residual loss, whose gradient conflicts with denoising, requires a terminal denoising-only phase to preserve shower fidelity, whereas the non-conflicting Laplacian loss is insensitive to the schedule.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Lantern，一种基于冲突感知梯度混合（GradBlend）的物理引导扩散模型用于量热器模拟。该方法引入两个物理辅助损失：基于计数统计的方差稳定化体素残差损失和基于探测器几何的图拉普拉斯损失，并定义相关Frobenius距离（CFD）评估相关性保真度。在CaloChallenge Dataset 2上，GradBlend避免了其他任务对称规则（如PCGrad、GradNorm等）导致FPD膨胀2-100倍，同时改进FPD和CFD。
Motivation: 现有扩散模型在量热器模拟中的去噪目标仅统计最优，可能物理不准确；物理引导方法通常假设封闭形式的物理定律（如PDE残差），但量热器簇射无逐样本PDE，能量守恒仅提供一个标量。标准指标忽略层间和体素间相关结构。
Method: 提出Lantern，使用GradBlend梯度混合方法，将辅助损失梯度方向与去噪梯度结合，保持去噪步长。引入方差稳定化体素残差损失和图拉普拉斯损失，并定义CFD作为相关保真度归一化分数。
Result: 在CaloChallenge Dataset 2上，GradBlend避免其他任务对称规则导致的FPD膨胀（2-100倍），结合图拉普拉斯损失时同时改进FPD和CFD。消融表明体素残差损失与去噪梯度冲突，需终端纯去噪阶段；图拉普拉斯损失无冲突，对调度不敏感。
Conclusion: Lantern通过冲突感知梯度混合有效引入物理引导，在不损害去噪性能的前提下改善物理保真度。

papers.title: Psychological Influences of Conversational AI: Research and Design Directions for Reducing Harm and Promoting Well-Being
papers.abstract_en: As conversational AI systems become increasingly integrated into daily life, their potential effects on user well-being require ongoing attention. While consumer-facing generalist models can provide benefits, including improved access to information, learning, productivity, self-reflection, and companionship, they also introduce risks, such as emotional entanglement, unhealthy dependence, and the amplification of psychological vulnerabilities. Drawing on prior research and empirical observations of AI chatbot behavior, we propose a set of aspirational directions for guiding the behavior of general-purpose AI systems in ways that may reduce potential psychological harms and support user well-being. We acknowledge the difficulty of systematically assessing the long-term impacts of AI chatbot use and frame these directions as hypotheses for studying how AI behavior may influence users across general interactions, role-playing scenarios, and contexts that could be characterized as providing psychological support. While some proposed directions are supported by existing research and expert insights, others identify open questions and areas requiring deeper study. We hope that this formulation and these hypotheses encourage further discussion, empirical investigation, and exploration of interactive design approaches aimed at better accommodating users' psychological needs and promoting their well-being.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨了对话式AI系统对用户心理健康的潜在影响，包括情感纠缠、不健康依赖和心理脆弱性放大等风险。基于前期研究和AI聊天机器人行为的实证观察，作者提出了一系列指导通用AI系统行为的假设性方向，旨在减少心理伤害并促进用户福祉。文章承认评估长期影响的困难，并将这些方向视为研究假设，鼓励进一步的讨论和实证研究。
Motivation: 随着对话式AI融入日常生活，其对用户福祉的潜在影响亟需关注，现有研究缺乏系统性的指导方向来减少心理伤害。
Method: 通过文献综述和AI聊天机器人行为的实证观察，提出一组假设性的行为指导方向，涵盖一般交互、角色扮演和可能提供心理支持的情境。
Result: 提出多个研究方向，部分基于现有研究和专家见解，其余为开放问题，需深入探究。
Conclusion: 呼吁通过互动设计方法更好地适应心理需求，促进用户福祉，并鼓励后续实证研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Extended Reality as a Mediation Layer for Situated Human Control in Human-Robot Teaming
papers.abstract_en: Extended Reality (XR) is increasingly used in human-robot interaction to communicate robot intent, planned motion, reachability, and state. We argue that XR should also be understood as a mediation layer for situated human control in human-robot teaming. Situated human control denotes the human collaborator's ability to understand, shape, authorize, and interrupt robot action within the concrete physical, social, and temporal context in which that action unfolds. We ground this perspective in scenarios from robot-assisted bedside nursing, multi-arm supervisory control, and collaborative assembly under divided attention. Across these scenarios, robot autonomy must remain inspectable and adjustable as people move, goals change, sensing is incomplete, control roles shift, and plans become invalid. We identify four mediation functions connecting human intent and robot autonomy, robot plans and human judgment, levels of shared control, and team roles, handover, and recovery. Building on these functions, we derive six design dimensions: joint action possibilities, socio-physical constraints, uncertainty and plan validity, multimodal control and correction, roles, handover, and accountability, and anticipatory recovery. The paper outlines a research agenda for XR systems that make robot autonomy more actionable and accountable in dynamic shared environments.
papers.comment: Accepted to 2026 IEEE International Symposium on Mixed and Augmented Reality Adjunct (ISMAR-Adjunct)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将扩展现实（XR）理解为人机协作中情境化人类控制的中介层，基于机器人辅助床边护理、多臂监督控制和分心协作装配等场景，识别了四种中介功能和六个设计维度，并提出了研究议程。
Motivation: 现有XR在人机交互中主要用于传达机器人意图，但缺乏对情境化人类控制（即在具体物理、社会和时间背景下理解、塑造、授权和中断机器人行动的能力）的系统理解。
Method: 通过场景分析（机器人辅助护理、多臂控制、协作装配）识别出四种中介功能（连接人类意图与机器人自主性、机器人计划与人类判断、共享控制级别、团队角色与恢复），并推导出六个设计维度（联合行动可能性、社会物理约束、不确定性与计划有效性、多模态控制与纠正、角色与责任、预期恢复）。
Result: 论文未提供实证结果，而是提出了一个理论框架和研究议程。
Conclusion: XR系统应使机器人自主性在动态共享环境中更可操作和可问责，并需要进一步研究验证所提出的维度和功能。

papers.title: CogEEGAgent: Toward Autonomous Cognitive EEG Analysis with Grounded Execution and Selection-Aware Verification
papers.abstract_en: Electroencephalography (EEG) analysis in cognitive studies requires specialized expertise and involves many defensible choices over contrasts, channels, time windows, and statistical tests. LLM agents can translate varied natural-language questions into analysis choices, offering a flexible interface for automation. Yet fluent reports alone cannot establish that an agent selected the requested analysis or evaluated a confirmatory claim independently of adaptive search. We present CogEEGAgent, a cognitive-EEG analysis agent grounded in MNE-Python. Its EEG-specific scientific harness separates semantic from scientific authority. The LLM interprets intent and proposes registered analyses, while deterministic components validate typed contracts, control confirmation access, and authorize evidence-bound release. On a prespecified routing benchmark, CogEEGAgent maps language to registered analyses more accurately than a matched deterministic router, while matched preflight makes both systems abstain whenever required. In an externally model-authored, outcome-blind campaign, the complete system releases supported analyses with participant-disjoint confirmation and blocks prespecified capability hazards and lifecycle-reuse requests. Policy stress testing shows that held-out confirmation curbs false positives from uncorrected adaptive search. Together, these studies establish bounded autonomy and an auditable automation framework for cognitive-EEG workflows. More broadly, they show how scientific agents can combine flexible language understanding with fail-closed control over inference and release.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 5 figures, and 16 tables. The supplementary material is included in the same PDF
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CogEEGAgent，一个基于 MNE-Python 的认知脑电图 (EEG) 分析代理，通过将语义权威与科学权威分离，实现语言驱动的自主分析。系统利用 LLM 理解自然语言问题并提议注册分析，而确定性组件验证类型契约、控制确认访问并授权基于证据的发布。在预定义路由基准上，CogEEGAgent 比确定性路由更准确地将语言映射到注册分析；在外部模型生成且结果盲的测试中，完整系统阻止了预定义能力危害和生命周期重用请求。政策压力测试表明，独立确认可遏制未经校正的自适应搜索产生的假阳性。
Motivation: EEG 分析需要专业知识，且涉及对比、通道、时间窗口和统计检验等多种可选方案，LLM 代理虽可翻译自然语言问题，但难以确保分析选择和执行的可信度。
Method: 提出一个两阶段框架：LLM 解释意图并提出注册分析方案，确定性组件（如类型验证、确认控制、证据边界发布）确保科学权威性。
Result: 在路由基准上，CogEEGAgent 比确定性路由器更准确地将语言映射到注册分析；在外部模型生成的盲测试中，系统成功阻止了能力危害和生命周期重用请求，且独立确认减少了自适应搜索的假阳性。
Conclusion: 该框架展示了在认知 EEG 工作流中实现有限自主性和可审计自动化的可行性，并为科学代理提供了语言理解与失效保护控制的结合范式。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SAFAARI: Schema-Aware Framework for Accelerated Advertiser Response Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: The evolution of customer support systems is rapidly advancing with agentic chatbots, yet these systems face significant limitations when accessing enterprise data without predefined API endpoints. This paper presents SAFAARI (Schema-Aware Framework for Accelerated Advertiser Response Intelligence), a multi-agent framework that addresses the critical bottleneck of schema linking in Natural Language to SQL (NL-to-SQL) systems through specialized content, metadata, and orchestration agents. We also introduce SEAL (Schema Evaluation and Accuracy in Language-to-SQL), a novel composite metric that holistically evaluates system performance while penalizing inconsistent results. Through systematic experimentation with five feature set configurations, SAFAARI achieves an 81.66% SEAL score (6.65% improvement over baseline), with notable gains in datapoint accuracy (5.51%) and schema-linking precision (4.69%). The framework's effectiveness is validated through human-in-the-loop evaluation with domain experts, which proves its adaptability across diverse support domains. By automating the labor-intensive process of schema linking and query generation, our framework demonstrates 8x reduction in development time while maintaining high accuracy. The solution streamlines API development and enhances self-service capabilities, particularly benefiting customer support enterprises with complex data ecosystems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SAFAARI多智能体框架，用于加速广告商响应智能，核心解决自然语言到SQL系统中的模式链接（schema linking）瓶颈。通过内容、元数据和编排三种专门智能体的协作，并引入新型复合评估指标SEAL，在五种特征配置下SEAL得分81.66%，比基线提升6.65%，开发时间减少8倍。
Motivation: 现有客户支持系统在访问企业数据时缺乏预定义API端点，模式链接成为NL-to-SQL系统的主要瓶颈，导致开发效率低下。
Method: 提出SAFAARI框架，包含内容智能体、元数据智能体和编排智能体，以及SEAL复合评估指标，通过五种特征配置实验，并采用人机闭环评估。

papers.title: ScoreShield: Differentially Private Release of Similarity Scores
papers.abstract_en: A growing number of applications, such as biometrics and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), rely on cosine similarity scores computed between vector embeddings of text, images, or audio. These systems return similarity scores through their APIs for ranking and verification. However, such releases can leak information about individual records and enable membership inference attacks. While differential privacy (DP) provides a principled metric for quantifying attack risks, naïve application of DP mechanisms---such as adding i.i.d. Gaussian noise to vector entries---leads to excessive distortion (i.e., low utility) at a given privacy constraint that scales poorly with the number of released scores. We propose \textsc{ScoreShield}, a perturb-then-project mechanism that adds Gaussian noise calibrated to global sensitivity of the chosen score release regime and then projects the result onto the feasibility set of valid cosine objects. \textsc{ScoreShield} satisfies $(\varepsilon,δ)$-DP for releasing similarity score vectors and Gram matrices. We provide utility guarantees for the exact Frobenius metric projection used in the risk analysis, and prove convergence to feasibility for the practical averaged alternating-projection solver used for large-scale Gram releases. For full pairwise cosine Gram release under record-level replacement adjacency, the exact-projection bound improves the $n$-dependence of squared Frobenius risk from $Θ(n^3)$ for the naïve Gaussian baseline to $\mathcal{O}(n^2)$ for fixed privacy parameters, with sharper local bounds at low-rank Grams. We evaluate the mechanism across RAG, face recognition, semantic retrieval, image similarity, and recommender-system tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出ScoreShield，一种差分隐私（DP）机制，用于在生物识别、检索增强生成（RAG）等应用中安全发布余弦相似度分数。该方法通过向分数向量添加校准高斯噪声并投影到有效余弦对象集，满足(ε,δ)-DP，理论分析表明其平方Frobenius风险从朴素基线的Θ(n³)降至O(n²)，并在RAG、人脸识别、语义检索、图像相似度和推荐系统任务上验证。
Motivation: 直接发布余弦相似度分数会泄露个体记录信息，易受成员推断攻击。现有DP机制（如向向量条目添加i.i.d.高斯噪声）在给定隐私约束下导致较大失真，且随发布分数数量扩展性差。
Method: 提出扰动-投影（perturb-then-project）机制：先向相似度分数向量添加校准至全局灵敏度的高斯噪声，再将结果投影到有效余弦对象的可行集。分析中采用精确Frobenius度量投影，大规模Gram矩阵发布则使用平均交替投影求解器。
Result: 理论证明记录级替换邻接下，精确投影界将平方Frobenius风险的n依赖从朴素基线的Θ(n³)改进至O(n²)，且低秩Gram矩阵有更优局部界。在RAG、人脸识别、语义检索、图像相似度和推荐系统任务中评估机制有效性。
Conclusion: ScoreShield通过结构约束投影在保证差分隐私的同时有效降低相似度分数发布的效用损失，理论分析改进了维度依赖性。

papers.title: Grounded in Consensus, In Step With Emerging Science: A Consensus-Anchored Multi-Corpus Clinical Chatbot for Long COVID
papers.abstract_en: Long COVID (LC) poses a challenge for clinical decision support because relevant evidence is distributed across sources with different update cycles, evidentiary roles, and levels of clinical maturity. We present a clinician-facing chatbot that organizes four sources within a retrieval-augmented workflow: expert-curated consensus guidance, current PubMed literature, registered interventional trials, and evidence from living systematic reviews. Consensus guidance is always included to frame responses, while the remaining sources are retrieved in parallel when selected by the user. In an exploratory automated evaluation on 50 clinician-facing questions, our chatbot showed comparable mean ratings to OpenEvidence, with numerically higher scores and lower score variability in an LLM-judged comparison.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对长新冠（Long COVID）临床决策支持中证据分散的问题，提出了一个面向临床医生的聊天机器人，通过检索增强工作流整合专家共识指南、PubMed文献、注册干预试验和活系统综述四类来源。在50个临床问题的自动化评估中，该机器人与OpenEvidence相比评分相当，且在LLM-judged比较中数值更高、变异性更低。
Motivation: 长新冠相关证据跨越多个来源，具有不同的更新周期、证据角色和临床成熟度，传统方法难以有效整合，给临床决策支持带来挑战。
Method: 提出检索增强的聊天机器人工作流：始终包含专家共识指南以框定响应，其他三类来源（PubMed文献、注册试验、活系统综述）由用户选择并行检索。
Result: 在50个临床问题的自动化评估中，聊天机器人的平均评分与OpenEvidence相当，且在LLM-judged比较中显示出更高的数值和更低的评分变异性。
Conclusion: 该聊天机器人通过整合多来源证据为长新冠临床决策提供了可行方案，初步自动化评估表现良好。

papers.title: Authoring Agent Skills: A Software-Engineering Approach
papers.abstract_en: Agent Skills are an emerging way to extend large language model agents with reusable procedural knowledge that the agent loads on demand. Anthropic introduced Agent Skills and published the format as an open specification supported across several agent tools. This note argues that a skill is a software artefact and that its construction should follow software-engineering principles, with qualifications: single responsibility, separation of interface from implementation, low coupling, and economy in a shared token budget, together with behavioural evaluation in place of deterministic testing. Using Claude Code as the reference implementation, it describes how a skill is structured, how its contents are loaded in stages, and how to write the description on which selection depends. It places skills against the other mechanisms a developer can use to shape agent behaviour, like project memory files, slash commands, subagents, external tool connections, and hooks, and gives a rule for choosing between them based on who decides that a mechanism runs and what guarantee it provides. It then sets out an evaluation-driven authoring process, a set of patterns and faults commonly encountered in authoring, and the trust question raised by using skills from third parties. We illustrate the comparison drawn in UML class style, the loading model, the anatomy of a skill, the relative position of each mechanism, and the points at which skills and hooks act during a session.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将大语言模型代理的“技能”（Agent Skills）视为软件工件，并建议其构建应遵循软件工程原则，如单一职责、接口与实现分离、低耦合及共享令牌预算的经济性。以Claude Code为参考实现，详细描述了技能的结构、分阶段加载机制、描述编写方法，并与其他代理行为塑造机制（如项目记忆文件、斜杠命令、子代理、外部工具连接和钩子）进行了对比，给出了基于评估的作者流程、常见模式与故障，以及第三方技能的信任问题。
Motivation: 现有Agent Skills的构建缺乏系统规范，导致可重用性和可维护性不足。本文旨在将软件工程原则应用于技能构建，以提升其质量。
Method: 通过论述和对比，提出了基于软件工程原则的技能构建方法，包括结构设计（如UML类风格比较）、分阶段加载模型、描述编写规则，以及基于评估的作者流程和故障模式识别。
Conclusion: 技能构建应遵循软件工程原则，并给出了基于谁决定机制运行及提供何种保证的机制选择规则。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Transfer Learning in High-Dimensional Clustering: Minimax Thresholds and Applications in Single-Cell Data
papers.abstract_en: Clustering is a fundamental problem in statistics, with applications across many scientific disciplines. In many modern applications involving clustering, the primary dataset (the target data) is accompanied by related datasets (the source data). Transferring information from such sources may improve clustering accuracy in the target, making transfer learning for clustering practically important. Despite recent progress, the conditions under which source data improve target clustering remain unclear in high-dimensional settings, even for the canonical Gaussian mixture model. In this paper, we study the clustering problem in a two-community Gaussian mixture model where relatedness is captured by the geometric alignment of the target and source cluster means. We develop a minimax-optimal transfer-assisted clustering procedure and characterize, up to logarithmic factors, the phase transition for consistent target clustering in terms of the signal-to-noise ratios, sample sizes, ambient dimension, and degree of alignment between the datasets. The technique is also extended to adaptively choose between the target-only or the source assisted clustering depending on the target signal strength. Furthermore, we also extend our techniques to accommodate multiple communities and and multiple source datasets. Extensive simulations and an analysis of a human lung single-cell RNA-sequencing atlas demonstrate the practical effectiveness of our methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究高维聚类中的迁移学习问题，在双群落高斯混合模型下，推导了最小最大最优的迁移辅助聚类过程，并刻画了信号噪声比、样本量、维度、数据集对齐度等因素下一致聚类的相变。扩展到多群落和多源数据，并在人类肺单细胞RNA测序数据上验证。
Motivation: 尽管迁移学习在聚类中重要，但在高维场景下源数据改善目标聚类的条件尚不明确，本文填补这一理论空白。
Method: 提出最小最大最优的迁移辅助聚类过程，考虑目标与源簇均值的几何对齐，推导相变边界。并扩展自适应选择仅用目标或源辅助聚类，以及多群落多源场景。
Result: 理论上刻画了相变边界（达对数因子），模拟和人类肺单细胞RNA-seq分析验证了实际效果。
Conclusion: 本文为高维聚类迁移学习提供了理论基础和实践方法。
